/-
Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap.VanishingIdeal
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.LatticeIntervals
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.Compact

/-!
# The literal asymptotic C-star algebra and quotient lifts

AsymptoticAlgebra B is the actual Cb([1,infty),B)/C0([1,infty),B)
quotient, using the stock bounded-continuous algebra, the constructed closed
star ideal, and the existing quotient C-star factory. Its norm is not changed.

A set-theoretic lifting of an actual homomorphism into this quotient gives a
raw nonlinear asymptotic family. Its four laws are derived from the actual
kernel criterion. No Source bound theorem or extra raw bound premise is used.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Set Filter
open scoped ZeroAtInfty BoundedContinuousFunction

noncomputable section

universe uA uB

/-- The genuine quotient of bounded time-functions by those vanishing at infinity. -/
abbrev AsymptoticAlgebra (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :=
  (BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B).Quotient

namespace AsymptoticAlgebra

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

/-- Explicit existing quotient C-star data. It is not globally registered. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def cStarAlgebra (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (AsymptoticAlgebra B) :=
  (BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B).quotientCStarAlgebra

attribute [local instance] cStarAlgebra

/-- The actual quotient projection, with the preceding fixed quotient dictionaries. -/
def quotientMap (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B :=
  (BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B).quotientMap

private theorem ray_cocompact_eq_atTop :
    cocompact AsymptoticTime = (atTop : Filter AsymptoticTime) := by
  let : OrderBot AsymptoticTime := Set.Ici.orderBot
  let : NoMaxOrder AsymptoticTime :=
    ⟨fun t =>
      ⟨⟨(t : ℝ) + 1, t.property.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right zero_le_one)⟩,
        lt_add_one (t : ℝ)⟩⟩
  let : ClosedIciTopology AsymptoticTime :=
    ⟨fun t => (isClosed_Ici : IsClosed (Set.Ici (t : ℝ))).preimage
      continuous_subtype_val⟩
  let : CompactIccSpace AsymptoticTime :=
    ⟨fun {a b} => by
      apply Subtype.isCompact_iff.mpr
      have himage : Subtype.val '' (Set.Icc a b : Set AsymptoticTime) =
          Set.Icc (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) := by
        ext x
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
          exact ht
        · intro hx
          exact ⟨⟨x, a.property.trans hx.1⟩, hx, rfl⟩
      rw [himage]
      exact isCompact_Icc⟩
  exact cocompact_eq_atTop

/-- The actual ideal on the closed ray is characterized by atTop vanishing. -/
theorem mem_vanishingIdeal_iff (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :
    f ∈ BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B ↔
      Tendsto f atTop (nhds 0) := by
  rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.mem_vanishingIdeal_iff, ray_cocompact_eq_atTop]

/-- Zero in the real quotient is exactly vanishing at infinity. -/
theorem quotientMap_eq_zero_iff (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :
    quotientMap B f = 0 ↔ Tendsto f atTop (nhds 0) := by
  change (BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B).quotientMap f = 0 ↔ _
  rw [ClosedStarIdeal.quotientMap_eq_zero_iff, mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]

/-- Equality of quotient classes is precisely the vanishing-difference criterion. -/
theorem quotientMap_eq_iff (f g : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :
    quotientMap B f = quotientMap B g ↔
      Tendsto (fun t => f t - g t) atTop (nhds 0) := by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, quotientMap_eq_zero_iff]
  rfl

/-- The canonical C0 inclusion has zero quotient class. -/
theorem quotientMap_toBCF (f : C₀(AsymptoticTime, B)) :
    quotientMap B f.toBCF = 0 :=
  ((BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B).quotientMap_eq_zero_iff
    f.toBCF).2 (BoundedContinuousFunction.toBCF_mem_vanishingIdeal f)

/-- Surjectivity is inherited from the actual Submodule quotient, not assumed. -/
theorem quotientMap_surjective (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Function.Surjective (quotientMap B) :=
  (BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B).quotientMap_surjective

/-- Any genuine set-theoretic lifting of a quotient hom yields a raw family.
F is arbitrary in the coefficient; no linearity or continuity-in-a is imposed. -/
def ofLift (ρ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B)
    (F : A → AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B)
    (hF : ∀ a : A, quotientMap B (F a) = ρ a) : AsymptoticMorphism A B where
  toFun t a := F a t
  continuous_orbit a := (F a).continuous
  add_defect_tendsto a b := by
    have hzero : quotientMap B (F (a + b) - (F a + F b)) = 0 := by
      simp only [map_sub, map_add, hF, sub_self]
    have h := (quotientMap_eq_zero_iff _).1 hzero
    exact h.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun (t : AsymptoticTime) => by
      simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply])
  smul_defect_tendsto z a := by
    have hzero : quotientMap B (F (z • a) - z • F a) = 0 := by
      simp only [map_sub, map_smul, hF, sub_self]
    have h := (quotientMap_eq_zero_iff _).1 hzero
    exact h.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun (t : AsymptoticTime) => by
      simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply])
  mul_defect_tendsto a b := by
    have hzero : quotientMap B (F (a * b) - F a * F b) = 0 := by
      simp only [map_sub, map_mul, hF, sub_self]
    have h := (quotientMap_eq_zero_iff _).1 hzero
    exact h.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun (t : AsymptoticTime) => by
      simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.mul_apply])
  star_defect_tendsto a := by
    have hzero : quotientMap B (F (star a) - star (F a)) = 0 := by
      simp only [map_sub, map_star, hF, sub_self]
    have h := (quotientMap_eq_zero_iff _).1 hzero
    exact h.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun (t : AsymptoticTime) => by
      simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.star_apply])

/-- The lifting family has the original pointwise values. -/
@[simp]
theorem ofLift_apply (ρ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B)
    (F : A → AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B)
    (hF : ∀ a : A, quotientMap B (F a) = ρ a)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) : ofLift ρ F hF t a = F a t := by
  rfl

/-- Two set-theoretic liftings of the same quotient map are strictly equivalent. -/
theorem strictlyEquivalent_ofLift (ρ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B)
    (F G : A → AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B)
    (hF : ∀ a : A, quotientMap B (F a) = ρ a)
    (hG : ∀ a : A, quotientMap B (G a) = ρ a) :
    AsymptoticMorphism.StrictlyEquivalent (ofLift ρ F hF) (ofLift ρ G hG) := by
  intro a
  have h := (quotientMap_eq_iff (F a) (G a)).1 ((hF a).trans (hG a).symm)
  simpa only [ofLift_apply] using h

/-- Actual quotient surjectivity supplies a set-theoretic lift by choice.
This choice constructs the family; it is not an output-model input. -/
def ofHom (ρ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B) : AsymptoticMorphism A B :=
  ofLift ρ
    (fun a => Classical.choose (quotientMap_surjective B (ρ a)))
    (fun a => Classical.choose_spec (quotientMap_surjective B (ρ a)))

/-- Characteristic values of the computed set-theoretic lift. -/
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_apply (ρ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    ofHom ρ t a =
      (Classical.choose (quotientMap_surjective B (ρ a)) : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) t := by
  rfl

end AsymptoticAlgebra

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.AsymptoticAlgebraMap
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Category.Basic
public import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.NatTrans

/-!
# The same-universe asymptotic-algebra functor

`asymptoticAlgebraObject` is the deliberately lightweight reducible carrier
view needed by finite iteration.  It stores the existing quotient C-star
dictionary and no proof-heavy map. The functor is a lightweight transparent
wrapper so its object carriers compute to the literal quotient; its maps
delegate to the opaque, independent-universe primary map.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CategoryTheory
open scoped BoundedContinuousFunction

noncomputable section

universe u

namespace NonUnitalCStarAlgCat

/-- The actual asymptotic quotient as an object of the existing category.
This abbreviation is intentionally reducible: its carrier and stored
dictionary are the computational interface used by finite iteration. -/
abbrev asymptoticAlgebraObject
    (A : NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u}) : NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u} where
  carrier := AsymptoticAlgebra A
  str := AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra A

theorem asymptoticAlgebraObject_carrier
    (A : NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u}) :
    (asymptoticAlgebraObject A).carrier = AsymptoticAlgebra A := by
  rfl

/-- The actual asymptotic quotient as an endofunctor of the existing category.
The direct `AsymptoticAlgebra.map` remains the universe-polymorphic primary API. -/
def asymptoticAlgebraFunctor :
    NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u} ⥤ NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u} where
  obj := asymptoticAlgebraObject
  map φ := AsymptoticAlgebra.map φ
  map_id A := AsymptoticAlgebra.map_id A
  map_comp φ ψ := AsymptoticAlgebra.map_comp φ ψ

/-- The functor object is the lightweight literal quotient object. -/
theorem asymptoticAlgebraFunctor_obj
    (A : NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u}) :
    asymptoticAlgebraFunctor.obj A = asymptoticAlgebraObject A := by
  rfl

/-- The functor map is the direct coefficient map. -/
theorem asymptoticAlgebraFunctor_map
    {A B : NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u}} (φ : A ⟶ B) :
    asymptoticAlgebraFunctor.map φ = AsymptoticAlgebra.map φ := by
  rfl

/-- The functor map has the literal postcomposition formula on quotient
representatives. -/
theorem asymptoticAlgebraFunctor_map_quotientMap
    {A B : NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u}} (φ : A ⟶ B)
    (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ A) :
    asymptoticAlgebraFunctor.map φ
        (AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap A f) =
      AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B
        (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom φ f) := by
  exact AsymptoticAlgebra.map_quotientMap φ f

/-- The constant-class inclusions form a natural transformation from the
identity functor to the asymptotic-algebra functor. -/
@[no_expose]
def asymptoticAlgebraConstant :
    NatTrans (𝟭 NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u}) asymptoticAlgebraFunctor where
  app A := AsymptoticAlgebra.constantHom A
  naturality {_A _B} φ :=
    (AsymptoticAlgebra.map_comp_constantHom φ).symm

/-- The natural-transformation component is the actual constant-class map. -/
theorem asymptoticAlgebraConstant_app
    (A : NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u}) :
    asymptoticAlgebraConstant.app A = AsymptoticAlgebra.constantHom A := by
  rfl

theorem asymptoticAlgebraConstant_app_apply
    (A : NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u}) (a : A) :
    asymptoticAlgebraConstant.app A a =
      AsymptoticAlgebra.constantHom A a := by
  rfl

/-- Every component of the constant-class transformation is injective,
including on the zero algebra. -/
theorem asymptoticAlgebraConstant_app_injective
    (A : NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u}) :
    Function.Injective (asymptoticAlgebraConstant.app A) := by
  rw [asymptoticAlgebraConstant_app]
  exact AsymptoticAlgebra.constantHom_injective A

#print axioms asymptoticAlgebraObject
#print axioms asymptoticAlgebraFunctor
#print axioms asymptoticAlgebraFunctor_map
#print axioms asymptoticAlgebraConstant
#print axioms asymptoticAlgebraConstant_app
#print axioms asymptoticAlgebraConstant_app_injective

end NonUnitalCStarAlgCat

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.AsymptoticAlgebra
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap.BoundedHom

/-!
# Functoriality of the literal asymptotic algebra

Coefficient homomorphisms descend through the actual closed vanishing ideal.
Constant functions give a natural injective inclusion into the quotient.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter Set
open scoped BoundedContinuousFunction CStarAlgebra
  NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient

noncomputable section

namespace AsymptoticAlgebra

universe uA uB uC

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]

attribute [local instance] cStarAlgebra

/-- The coefficient map on the literal asymptotic quotient. -/
@[no_expose]
def map (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    AsymptoticAlgebra A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B := by
  let I := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime A
  let J := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B
  let _ : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  let _ : J.carrier.IsTwoSided := J.isTwoSided
  exact NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient.map I.carrier J.carrier
    (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom
      (X := AsymptoticTime) φ)
    (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_mapsTo_vanishingIdeal
      (X := AsymptoticTime) φ)

/-- The coefficient map is computed by postcomposing a bounded representative
and applying the actual target quotient projection. -/
@[simp]
theorem map_quotientMap (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ A) :
    map φ (quotientMap A f) =
      quotientMap B
        (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom φ f) := by
  let I := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime A
  let J := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B
  let _ : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  let _ : J.carrier.IsTwoSided := J.isTwoSided
  exact NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient.map_mk I.carrier J.carrier
    (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom
      (X := AsymptoticTime) φ)
    (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_mapsTo_vanishingIdeal
      (X := AsymptoticTime) φ) f

/-- Quotient coefficient maps intertwine the actual quotient projections. -/
theorem map_comp_quotientMap (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    (map φ).comp (quotientMap A) =
      (quotientMap B).comp
        (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom
          (X := AsymptoticTime) φ) := by
  let I := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime A
  let J := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B
  let _ : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  let _ : J.carrier.IsTwoSided := J.isTwoSided
  exact NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient.map_comp_mk I.carrier J.carrier
    (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom
      (X := AsymptoticTime) φ)
    (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_mapsTo_vanishingIdeal
      (X := AsymptoticTime) φ)

@[simp]
theorem map_id (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    map (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ A) =
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ (AsymptoticAlgebra A) := by
  let I := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime A
  let _ : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  apply NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient.hom_ext I.carrier
  change (map (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ A)).comp (quotientMap A) =
    (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ (AsymptoticAlgebra A)).comp (quotientMap A)
  rw [map_comp_quotientMap,
    BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_id]
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem map_zero (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    map (0 : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) = 0 := by
  let I := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime A
  let _ : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  apply NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient.hom_ext I.carrier
  change (map (0 : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)).comp (quotientMap A) =
    (0 : AsymptoticAlgebra A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B).comp (quotientMap A)
  rw [map_comp_quotientMap,
    BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_zero]
  rfl

/-- The literal quotient coefficient map respects composition. -/
theorem map_comp (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) (ψ : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    map (ψ.comp φ) = (map ψ).comp (map φ) := by
  let I := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime A
  let _ : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  apply NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient.hom_ext I.carrier
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro f
  change map (ψ.comp φ) (quotientMap A f) =
    map ψ (map φ (quotientMap A f))
  simp only [NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply, map_quotientMap,
    BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_comp]

private def boundedConstantHom
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (AsymptoticTime →ᵇ A) where
  toFun := BoundedContinuousFunction.const AsymptoticTime
  map_zero' := by ext t; rfl
  map_add' _ _ := by ext t; rfl
  map_mul' _ _ := by ext t; rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := by ext t; rfl
  map_star' _ := by ext t; rfl

/-- The actual constant-function class in the literal asymptotic quotient. -/
@[no_expose]
def constantHom (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra A :=
  (quotientMap A).comp (boundedConstantHom A)

@[simp]
theorem constantHom_apply
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] (a : A) :
    constantHom A a =
      quotientMap A
        (BoundedContinuousFunction.const AsymptoticTime a) := by
  rfl

private theorem comp_constant
    (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) (a : A) :
    BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom φ
        (BoundedContinuousFunction.const AsymptoticTime a) =
      BoundedContinuousFunction.const AsymptoticTime (φ a) := by
  ext t
  rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply]
  rfl

/-- The constant-class inclusion is natural in the coefficient algebra. -/
theorem map_comp_constantHom (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    (map φ).comp (constantHom A) = (constantHom B).comp φ := by
  ext a
  simp only [NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply, constantHom_apply,
    map_quotientMap, comp_constant]

/-- A constant class is zero exactly when its coefficient is zero. -/
theorem constantHom_eq_zero_iff
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] (a : A) :
    constantHom A a = 0 ↔ a = 0 := by
  let _ : Nonempty AsymptoticTime := ⟨⟨1, le_rfl⟩⟩
  let _ : NeBot (atTop : Filter AsymptoticTime) := Filter.atTop_neBot
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [constantHom_apply] at h
    have ht := (quotientMap_eq_zero_iff
      (BoundedContinuousFunction.const AsymptoticTime a)).1 h
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique
      (tendsto_const_nhds :
        Tendsto (fun _ : AsymptoticTime => a) atTop (nhds a)) ht
  · rintro rfl
    exact _root_.map_zero (constantHom A)

/-- The coefficient algebra embeds in its asymptotic algebra by constant
classes, without a nontriviality hypothesis. -/
theorem constantHom_injective
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    Function.Injective (constantHom A) := by
  intro a b hab
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply (constantHom_eq_zero_iff A (a - b)).1
  rw [map_sub, hab, sub_self]

#print axioms map
#print axioms map_quotientMap
#print axioms map_comp_quotientMap
#print axioms map_id
#print axioms map_zero
#print axioms map_comp
#print axioms constantHom
#print axioms map_comp_constantHom
#print axioms constantHom_eq_zero_iff
#print axioms constantHom_injective

end AsymptoticAlgebra

/-
Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Classes
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap
public import Mathlib.Basic.FunLike.Basic
public import Mathlib.Topology.UnitInterval

import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Star
import Mathlib.Tactic.Abel

/-!
# Nonlinear asymptotic *-morphisms

Only each fixed-coefficient time orbit is continuous. The slices are arbitrary
functions, not necessarily linear or continuous in the coefficient. Boundedness
and sharp asymptotic contractivity are the separate derived Proposition25.1.3,
not fields or premises of this definition. This generic data is motivated by
Blackadar's Definition25.1.1.

The source's four norm-defect limits are equivalently vector limits to zero in
the given normed topology. Homotopy data uses the ACTUAL compact continuous
function algebra and its norm, with exact endpoint values. No homotopy quotient,
E-group or KK object is defined before its own real prerequisites.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter

universe uA uB

/-- The half-line time domain, with its induced real topology and order. -/
abbrev AsymptoticTime := Set.Ici (1 : ℝ)

/-- An asymptotic *-morphism with arbitrary nonlinear slices and no boundedness premise. -/
structure AsymptoticMorphism
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] where
  /-- The raw time-indexed maps; individual slices need not be linear. -/
  toFun : AsymptoticTime → A → B
  continuous_orbit : ∀ a : A, Continuous fun t => toFun t a
  add_defect_tendsto : ∀ a b : A,
    Filter.Tendsto (fun t => toFun t (a + b) - (toFun t a + toFun t b))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
  smul_defect_tendsto : ∀ (z : ℂ) (a : A),
    Filter.Tendsto (fun t => toFun t (z • a) - z • toFun t a)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
  mul_defect_tendsto : ∀ a b : A,
    Filter.Tendsto (fun t => toFun t (a * b) - toFun t a * toFun t b)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
  star_defect_tendsto : ∀ a : A,
    Filter.Tendsto (fun t => toFun t (star a) - star (toFun t a))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

@[macro_inline]
instance instFunLike : FunLike (AsymptoticMorphism A B) AsymptoticTime (A → B) where
  coe := AsymptoticMorphism.toFun
  coe_injective := by
    intro φ ψ h
    cases φ
    cases ψ
    cases h
    rfl

/-- The stored nonlinear time family is the actual public function coercion. -/
@[simp]
theorem toFun_eq_coe (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    φ.toFun = (φ : AsymptoticTime → A → B) := by
  rfl

/-- Asymptotic morphisms are determined by their values; their remaining fields are proofs. -/
@[ext]
theorem ext {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B}
    (h : ∀ (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A), φ t a = ψ t a) : φ = ψ :=
  DFunLike.ext φ ψ (fun t => funext (h t))

/-- The zero orbit tends to zero; exact zero at every finite time is NOT assumed. -/
theorem zero_tendsto (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun t => φ t 0) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
  change Filter.Tendsto (fun t : AsymptoticTime => φ.toFun t (0 : A))
    Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : B))
  simpa only [zero_smul, sub_zero] using
    φ.smul_defect_tendsto (0 : ℂ) (0 : A)

/-- Strict equivalence is the source's pointwise-in-coefficient vanishing difference. -/
def StrictlyEquivalent (φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : Prop :=
  ∀ a : A, Filter.Tendsto (fun t => φ t a - ψ t a) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

theorem strictlyEquivalent_refl (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    StrictlyEquivalent φ φ := by
  intro a
  simp only [sub_self]
  exact tendsto_const_nhds

theorem strictlyEquivalent_symm {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B}
    (h : StrictlyEquivalent φ ψ) : StrictlyEquivalent ψ φ := by
  intro a
  simpa only [neg_sub, neg_zero] using (h a).neg

theorem strictlyEquivalent_trans {φ ψ χ : AsymptoticMorphism A B}
    (h₁ : StrictlyEquivalent φ ψ) (h₂ : StrictlyEquivalent ψ χ) :
    StrictlyEquivalent φ χ := by
  intro a
  have heq : (fun t => φ t a - χ t a) =
      (fun t => (φ t a - ψ t a) + (ψ t a - χ t a)) := by
    funext t
    abel
  rw [heq]
  simpa only [zero_add] using (h₁ a).add (h₂ a)

theorem strictlyEquivalent_equivalence
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Equivalence (StrictlyEquivalent : AsymptoticMorphism A B →
      AsymptoticMorphism A B → Prop) :=
  { refl := strictlyEquivalent_refl
    symm := strictlyEquivalent_symm
    trans := strictlyEquivalent_trans }

/-- An actual strict-equivalence setoid, NOT the source's homotopy quotient [[A,B]]. -/
def strictSetoid
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Setoid (AsymptoticMorphism A B) where
  r := StrictlyEquivalent
  iseqv := strictlyEquivalent_equivalence A B

/-- A genuine homomorphism-valued time family with exactly its point-norm continuity. -/
def ofHomFamily (f : AsymptoticTime → A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hf : ∀ a : A, Continuous fun t => f t a) : AsymptoticMorphism A B where
  toFun t a := f t a
  continuous_orbit := hf
  add_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a b
    simpa only [map_add, sub_self] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : AsymptoticTime => (0 : B)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  smul_defect_tendsto := by
    intro z a
    simpa only [map_smul, sub_self] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : AsymptoticTime => (0 : B)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  mul_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a b
    simpa only [map_mul, sub_self] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : AsymptoticTime => (0 : B)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  star_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a
    simpa only [map_star, sub_self] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : AsymptoticTime => (0 : B)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))

@[simp]
theorem ofHomFamily_apply (f : AsymptoticTime → A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hf : ∀ a : A, Continuous fun t => f t a) (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    ofHomFamily f hf t a = f t a := by
  rfl

/-- The actual constant family of an ordinary star homomorphism. -/
def ofHom (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) : AsymptoticMorphism A B :=
  ofHomFamily (fun _ => f) (fun _ => continuous_const)

@[simp]
theorem ofHom_apply (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    ofHom f t a = f a := by
  rfl

/-- The actual zero input family, without any additive structure on all families. -/
def zero : AsymptoticMorphism A B :=
  ofHom (0 : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)

@[simp]
theorem zero_apply (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    zero (A := A) (B := B) t a = 0 := by
  rw [zero, ofHom_apply, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.zero_apply]

/-- Actual continuous proper-at-infinity reparametrization.
Increasing is not an additional premise. -/
def reparam (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (r : AsymptoticTime → AsymptoticTime) (hr : Continuous r)
    (hrTop : Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop Filter.atTop) :
    AsymptoticMorphism A B where
  toFun t a := φ (r t) a
  continuous_orbit a := (φ.continuous_orbit a).comp hr
  add_defect_tendsto a b := (φ.add_defect_tendsto a b).comp hrTop
  smul_defect_tendsto z a := (φ.smul_defect_tendsto z a).comp hrTop
  mul_defect_tendsto a b := (φ.mul_defect_tendsto a b).comp hrTop
  star_defect_tendsto a := (φ.star_defect_tendsto a).comp hrTop

@[simp]
theorem reparam_apply (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (r : AsymptoticTime → AsymptoticTime) (hr : Continuous r)
    (hrTop : Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) : reparam φ r hr hrTop t a = φ (r t) a := by
  rfl

/-- An ACTUAL asymptotic family into C([0,1],B), with exact endpoint values.
The family's limits/continuity use this algebra's SUP norm, not pointwise s-limits. -/
structure Homotopy (φ₀ φ₁ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) where
  /-- The whole interval-valued asymptotic family defining this homotopy. -/
  family : AsymptoticMorphism A C(unitInterval, B)
  start : ∀ (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A), family t a 0 = φ₀ t a
  finish : ∀ (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A), family t a 1 = φ₁ t a

namespace Homotopy

/-- A homotopy is determined by its actual family; endpoint fields are proofs. -/
@[ext]
theorem ext {φ₀ φ₁ : AsymptoticMorphism A B} {H K : Homotopy φ₀ φ₁}
    (h : H.family = K.family) : H = K := by
  cases H
  cases K
  cases h
  rfl

end Homotopy

/-- Homotopy uses the actual family above, not an arbitrary supplied relation. -/
def Homotopic (φ₀ φ₁ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : Prop :=
  Nonempty (Homotopy φ₀ φ₁)

end AsymptoticMorphism

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Unitization

import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Order
import Mathlib.Order.LatticeIntervals
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.Compact
import Mathlib.Tactic.Abel
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp

/-!
# Non-circular orbit boundedness and asymptotic contractivity

The first tail bound follows from a positive pair of actual image squares.
Small star errors are retained multiplied by the unknown image norms until
an elementary quadratic estimate bounds both images. Only then are the
errors made arbitrarily small. Stock unitization and zero-normalization
reduce arbitrary nonunital families to this argument.

The compact initial interval provides the global bound. No Cb/C0 quotient,
given orbit bound, linear slice, Source theorem or nontriviality premise is
used, and all norms and C-star orders are the actual stock dictionaries.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Set Filter

noncomputable section

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

universe uA uB

attribute [local instance]
  CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing

section Unital

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [CStarAlgebra A] [CStarAlgebra B]

private theorem norm_gram_error_le (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    ‖star (φ t a) * φ t a - φ t (star a * a)‖ ≤
      ‖φ t (star a) - star (φ t a)‖ * ‖φ t a‖ +
        ‖φ t (star a * a) - φ t (star a) * φ t a‖ := by
  have heq :
      star (φ t a) * φ t a - φ t (star a * a) =
        (star (φ t a) - φ t (star a)) * φ t a +
          (φ t (star a) * φ t a - φ t (star a * a)) := by
    rw [sub_mul]
    abel
  rw [heq]
  calc
    ‖(star (φ t a) - φ t (star a)) * φ t a +
        (φ t (star a) * φ t a - φ t (star a * a))‖ ≤
      ‖(star (φ t a) - φ t (star a)) * φ t a‖ +
        ‖φ t (star a) * φ t a - φ t (star a * a)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ ‖star (φ t a) - φ t (star a)‖ * ‖φ t a‖ +
        ‖φ t (star a) * φ t a - φ t (star a * a)‖ :=
      add_le_add (norm_mul_le _ _)
        (le_refl ‖φ t (star a) * φ t a - φ t (star a * a)‖)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [norm_sub_rev (star (φ t a)) (φ t (star a)),
        norm_sub_rev (φ t (star a) * φ t a) (φ t (star a * a))]

private theorem norm_square_pair_le (T S : B) :
    (max ‖T‖ ‖S‖) ^ 2 ≤ ‖star T * T + star S * S‖ := by
  have hT : ‖T‖ * ‖T‖ ≤ ‖star T * T + star S * S‖ := by
    have h := CStarAlgebra.norm_le_norm_of_le_of_nonneg
      (le_add_of_nonneg_right (star_mul_self_nonneg S))
      (star_mul_self_nonneg T)
    simpa only [CStarRing.norm_star_mul_self] using h
  have hS : ‖S‖ * ‖S‖ ≤ ‖star T * T + star S * S‖ := by
    have h := CStarAlgebra.norm_le_norm_of_le_of_nonneg
      (le_add_of_nonneg_left (star_mul_self_nonneg T))
      (star_mul_self_nonneg S)
    simpa only [CStarRing.norm_star_mul_self] using h
  rcases le_total ‖T‖ ‖S‖ with h | h
  · simpa only [max_eq_right h, pow_two] using hS
  · simpa only [max_eq_left h, pow_two] using hT

private theorem eventually_pair_estimate (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (hunit : ∀ t : AsymptoticTime, φ t 1 = 1)
    (a x : A) (hax : star a * a + star x * x = 1)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∀ᶠ t : AsymptoticTime in atTop,
      ‖(star (φ t a) * φ t a + star (φ t x) * φ t x) - 1‖ ≤
        3 * δ + δ * (‖φ t a‖ + ‖φ t x‖) := by
  have hsa : ∀ᶠ t : AsymptoticTime in atTop,
      ‖φ t (star a) - star (φ t a)‖ < δ := by
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, dist_zero_right] using
      Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (φ.star_defect_tendsto a) δ hδ
  have hsx : ∀ᶠ t : AsymptoticTime in atTop,
      ‖φ t (star x) - star (φ t x)‖ < δ := by
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, dist_zero_right] using
      Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (φ.star_defect_tendsto x) δ hδ
  have hma : ∀ᶠ t : AsymptoticTime in atTop,
      ‖φ t (star a * a) - φ t (star a) * φ t a‖ < δ := by
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, dist_zero_right] using
      Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (φ.mul_defect_tendsto (star a) a) δ hδ
  have hmx : ∀ᶠ t : AsymptoticTime in atTop,
      ‖φ t (star x * x) - φ t (star x) * φ t x‖ < δ := by
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, dist_zero_right] using
      Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (φ.mul_defect_tendsto (star x) x) δ hδ
  have hadd : ∀ᶠ t : AsymptoticTime in atTop,
      ‖φ t (star a * a + star x * x) -
        (φ t (star a * a) + φ t (star x * x))‖ < δ := by
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, dist_zero_right] using
      Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (φ.add_defect_tendsto (star a * a) (star x * x)) δ hδ
  filter_upwards [hsa, hsx, hma, hmx, hadd] with t hsa hsx hma hmx hadd
  have heq :
      (star (φ t a) * φ t a + star (φ t x) * φ t x) - 1 =
        (star (φ t a) * φ t a - φ t (star a * a)) +
        (star (φ t x) * φ t x - φ t (star x * x)) +
        ((φ t (star a * a) + φ t (star x * x)) -
          φ t (star a * a + star x * x)) := by
    rw [hax, hunit t]
    abel
  rw [heq]
  calc
    ‖(star (φ t a) * φ t a - φ t (star a * a)) +
        (star (φ t x) * φ t x - φ t (star x * x)) +
        ((φ t (star a * a) + φ t (star x * x)) -
          φ t (star a * a + star x * x))‖ ≤
      (‖star (φ t a) * φ t a - φ t (star a * a)‖ +
        ‖star (φ t x) * φ t x - φ t (star x * x)‖) +
        ‖(φ t (star a * a) + φ t (star x * x)) -
          φ t (star a * a + star x * x)‖ :=
      (norm_add_le _ _).trans
        (add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _)
          (le_refl ‖(φ t (star a * a) + φ t (star x * x)) -
            φ t (star a * a + star x * x)‖))
    _ ≤
      (‖φ t (star a) - star (φ t a)‖ * ‖φ t a‖ +
        ‖φ t (star a * a) - φ t (star a) * φ t a‖) +
      (‖φ t (star x) - star (φ t x)‖ * ‖φ t x‖ +
        ‖φ t (star x * x) - φ t (star x) * φ t x‖) +
      ‖φ t (star a * a + star x * x) -
        (φ t (star a * a) + φ t (star x * x))‖ := by
      rw [norm_sub_rev (φ t (star a * a) + φ t (star x * x))
        (φ t (star a * a + star x * x))]
      exact add_le_add
        (add_le_add (norm_gram_error_le φ t a) (norm_gram_error_le φ t x))
        (le_refl ‖φ t (star a * a + star x * x) -
          (φ t (star a * a) + φ t (star x * x))‖)
    _ ≤ (δ * ‖φ t a‖ + δ) + (δ * ‖φ t x‖ + δ) + δ :=
      add_le_add
        (add_le_add
          (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsa.le (norm_nonneg _)) hma.le)
          (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsx.le (norm_nonneg _)) hmx.le))
        hadd.le
    _ = _ := by ring

private theorem eventually_norm_lt_one_of_unital (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (hunit : ∀ t : AsymptoticTime, φ t 1 = 1)
    (a : A) (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ 1) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ t : AsymptoticTime in atTop, ‖φ t a‖ < 1 + ε := by
  have hle : star a * a ≤ 1 :=
    (CStarAlgebra.norm_le_one_iff_of_nonneg _ (star_mul_self_nonneg a)).1 (by
      rw [CStarRing.norm_star_mul_self]
      simpa only [one_mul] using mul_self_le_mul_self (norm_nonneg a) ha)
  let x := CFC.sqrt (1 - star a * a)
  have hx : star x * x = 1 - star a * a := by
    rw [(CFC.sqrt_nonneg (1 - star a * a)).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq]
    exact CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self _ (sub_nonneg.mpr hle)
  have hax : star a * a + star x * x = 1 := by
    rw [hx]
    abel
  have hone : ‖(1 : B)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    have heq : ‖(1 : B)‖ = ‖(1 : B)‖ * ‖(1 : B)‖ := by
      simpa only [star_one, one_mul] using
        (CStarRing.norm_star_mul_self (x := (1 : B)))
    by_contra hn
    have hgt : 1 < ‖(1 : B)‖ := lt_of_not_ge hn
    have hpos : 0 < ‖(1 : B)‖ := zero_lt_one.trans hgt
    have hm : ‖(1 : B)‖ < ‖(1 : B)‖ * ‖(1 : B)‖ := by
      simpa only [mul_one] using mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hgt hpos
    exact (not_lt_of_ge heq.ge) hm
  have hcoarse : ∀ᶠ t : AsymptoticTime in atTop, ‖φ t a‖ ≤ 2 ∧ ‖φ t x‖ ≤ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_pair_estimate φ hunit a x hax (1 / 8) (by norm_num)]
      with t ht
    let M := max ‖φ t a‖ ‖φ t x‖
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (norm_nonneg _).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have hsum : ‖φ t a‖ + ‖φ t x‖ ≤ M + M :=
      add_le_add (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have hupper : M * M ≤ 1 + 3 / 8 + M / 4 := by
      calc
        M * M ≤ ‖star (φ t a) * φ t a + star (φ t x) * φ t x‖ := by
          simpa only [M, pow_two] using norm_square_pair_le (φ t a) (φ t x)
        _ ≤ ‖(star (φ t a) * φ t a + star (φ t x) * φ t x) - 1‖ + ‖(1 : B)‖ := by
          simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using
            (norm_add_le
              ((star (φ t a) * φ t a + star (φ t x) * φ t x) - 1) (1 : B))
        _ ≤ 3 * (1 / 8) + (1 / 8) * (M + M) + 1 :=
          add_le_add
            (ht.trans (add_le_add (le_refl (3 * (1 / 8) : ℝ))
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum
                (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) from by norm_num)))) hone
        _ = _ := by ring
    have hM2 : M ≤ 2 := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hgt : 2 < M := lt_of_not_ge hnot
      have hmul : 2 * M ≤ M * M :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hgt.le hM0
      nlinarith [hupper, hmul]
    exact ⟨(le_max_left _ _).trans hM2, (le_max_right _ _).trans hM2⟩
  have hδ : 0 < ε / 7 := div_pos hε (by norm_num)
  filter_upwards [hcoarse, eventually_pair_estimate φ hunit a x hax (ε / 7) hδ]
    with t ht he
  have hupper : ‖φ t a‖ * ‖φ t a‖ ≤ 1 + ε := by
    calc
      ‖φ t a‖ * ‖φ t a‖ ≤ ‖star (φ t a) * φ t a + star (φ t x) * φ t x‖ := by
        have h := CStarAlgebra.norm_le_norm_of_le_of_nonneg
          (le_add_of_nonneg_right (star_mul_self_nonneg (φ t x)))
          (star_mul_self_nonneg (φ t a))
        simpa only [CStarRing.norm_star_mul_self] using h
      _ ≤ ‖(star (φ t a) * φ t a + star (φ t x) * φ t x) - 1‖ + ‖(1 : B)‖ := by
        simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using
          (norm_add_le
            ((star (φ t a) * φ t a + star (φ t x) * φ t x) - 1) (1 : B))
      _ ≤ 3 * (ε / 7) + (ε / 7) * (2 + 2) + 1 :=
        add_le_add
          (he.trans (add_le_add (le_refl (3 * (ε / 7)))
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add ht.1 ht.2) hδ.le))) hone
      _ = _ := by ring
  by_contra hnot
  have hgt : 1 + ε ≤ ‖φ t a‖ := le_of_not_gt hnot
  have hprod : (1 + ε) * (1 + ε) ≤ ‖φ t a‖ * ‖φ t a‖ :=
    mul_self_le_mul_self (by linarith) hgt
  nlinarith [hupper, hprod, sq_nonneg ε]

private theorem eventually_unital_norm_lt (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (hunit : ∀ t : AsymptoticTime, φ t 1 = 1)
    (a : A) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ t : AsymptoticTime in atTop, ‖φ t a‖ < ‖a‖ + ε := by
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · subst a
    simpa only [dist_zero_right, norm_zero, zero_add] using
      Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp φ.zero_tendsto ε hε
  let r := ‖a‖
  have hr : 0 < r := norm_pos_iff.mpr ha
  let b : A := ((r⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • a
  have hb : ‖b‖ ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp only [b]
    rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hr)]
    change r⁻¹ * r ≤ 1
    exact (inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne').le
  have hbr : (r : ℂ) • b = a := by
    dsimp only [b]
    rw [smul_smul]
    have hc : (r : ℂ) * ((r⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) = 1 := by
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne', Complex.ofReal_one]
    rw [hc, one_smul]
  have hd : ∀ᶠ t : AsymptoticTime in atTop,
      ‖φ t a - (r : ℂ) • φ t b‖ < ε / 2 := by
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, hbr, dist_zero_right] using
      Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (φ.smul_defect_tendsto (r : ℂ) b)
        (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
  have hsmall := eventually_norm_lt_one_of_unital φ hunit b hb
    (ε / (2 * r)) (div_pos hε (mul_pos (by norm_num) hr))
  filter_upwards [hd, hsmall] with t hd ht
  have hn : ‖(r : ℂ) • φ t b‖ = r * ‖φ t b‖ := by
    rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr]
  calc
    ‖φ t a‖ ≤ ‖φ t a - (r : ℂ) • φ t b‖ + ‖(r : ℂ) • φ t b‖ := by
      simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le
        (φ t a - (r : ℂ) • φ t b) ((r : ℂ) • φ t b)
    _ < ε / 2 + r * (1 + ε / (2 * r)) :=
      add_lt_add hd (by rw [hn]; exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left ht hr)
    _ = ‖a‖ + ε := by
      have hc : r * (ε / (2 * r)) = ε / 2 := by
        field_simp [hr.ne']
      rw [mul_add, mul_one, hc]
      dsimp only [r]
      ring

end Unital

section Nonunital

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

private theorem eventually_raw_norm_lt (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (a : A) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ t : AsymptoticTime in atTop, ‖φ t a‖ < ‖a‖ + ε := by
  have hu := eventually_unital_norm_lt (unitization (normalize φ))
    (unitization_normalize_one φ) (Unitization.inr a)
    (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ t : AsymptoticTime in atTop,
      ‖normalize φ t a‖ < ‖a‖ + ε / 2 := by
    simpa only [unitization_inr_apply, Unitization.norm_inr] using hu
  have hz : ∀ᶠ t : AsymptoticTime in atTop, ‖φ t 0‖ < ε / 2 := by
    simpa only [dist_zero_right] using
      Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp φ.zero_tendsto (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
  filter_upwards [hsmall, hz] with t ht hz
  calc
    ‖φ t a‖ = ‖normalize φ t a + φ t 0‖ := by
      rw [normalize_apply, sub_add_cancel]
    _ ≤ ‖normalize φ t a‖ + ‖φ t 0‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ < (‖a‖ + ε / 2) + ε / 2 := add_lt_add ht hz
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Every actual raw orbit is globally bounded and sharply asymptotically
contractive. These are conclusions, never additional raw-family fields. -/
theorem norm_bounded_and_eventually_contractive (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (a : A) :
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t : AsymptoticTime, ‖φ t a‖ ≤ C) ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
        Filter.Eventually (fun t : AsymptoticTime => ‖φ t a‖ < ‖a‖ + ε) Filter.atTop := by
  have hsharp := eventually_raw_norm_lt φ a
  refine ⟨?_, hsharp⟩
  let t0 : AsymptoticTime := ⟨1, le_rfl⟩
  let : Nonempty AsymptoticTime := ⟨t0⟩
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := Filter.mem_atTop_sets.mp (hsharp 1 zero_lt_one)
  have hK : IsCompact (Set.Icc t0 T) := by
    apply Subtype.isCompact_iff.mpr
    have himage : Subtype.val '' (Set.Icc t0 T : Set AsymptoticTime) =
        Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) (T : ℝ) := by
      ext s
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
        exact ht
      · intro hs
        exact ⟨⟨s, hs.1⟩, hs, rfl⟩
    rw [himage]
    exact isCompact_Icc
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.bddAbove_image (φ.continuous_orbit a).norm.continuousOn
  refine ⟨max C (‖a‖ + 1), fun t => ?_⟩
  by_cases ht : t ≤ T
  · have htK : t ∈ Set.Icc t0 T := ⟨t.property, ht⟩
    exact (hC (Set.mem_image_of_mem (fun s : AsymptoticTime => ‖φ s a‖) htK)).trans
      (le_max_left _ _)
  · exact (hT t (le_of_not_ge ht)).le.trans (le_max_right _ _)

end Nonunital

end AsymptoticMorphism

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Uniform
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Spectrum

/-!
# Completely positive asymptotic families

This file separates a broad neutral CP-slice carrier from Blackadar's literal
CP-contraction specialization. Both reuse the existing nonlinear asymptotic
family and canonical spectral orders. No finite-time norm bound is added to
the broad carrier.

The literal homotopy DATA uses CP contractions into `C([0,1],B)`. No homotopy
setoid or quotient is installed before CP-contractive gluing is proved.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open Filter
open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

universe uA uB

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

/-- Every finite-time slice has a genuine completely positive complex-linear
witness. No finite-time norm contraction is required. -/
def IsCompletelyPositive (phi : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : Prop :=
  letI : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
  letI : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
  letI : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
  letI : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
  ∀ t : AsymptoticTime, ∃ s : A →CP B, ∀ a : A, s a = phi t a

/-- Broad neutral carrier of CP-slice asymptotic families. Blackadar's
source carrier is the contraction specialization below. -/
structure CompletelyPositiveFamily (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    extends AsymptoticMorphism A B where
  /-- Every finite-time slice has a CP complex-linear witness. -/
  completelyPositive : IsCompletelyPositive toAsymptoticMorphism

/-- Blackadar's literal finite-time completely-positive-contraction carrier. -/
structure CompletelyPositiveContraction (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    extends AsymptoticMorphism A B where
  /-- Every finite-time slice has a CP contraction witness. -/
  completelyPositiveContraction :
    IsCompletelyPositiveContraction toAsymptoticMorphism

namespace CompletelyPositiveFamily

@[ext]
theorem ext {phi psi : CompletelyPositiveFamily A B}
    (h : phi.toAsymptoticMorphism = psi.toAsymptoticMorphism) : phi = psi := by
  cases phi
  cases psi
  cases h
  rfl

/-- Proper reparametrization preserves the same CP slice witnesses. -/
def reparam (phi : CompletelyPositiveFamily A B)
    (r : AsymptoticTime → AsymptoticTime) (hr : Continuous r)
    (hrTop : Tendsto r atTop atTop) : CompletelyPositiveFamily A B where
  toAsymptoticMorphism := phi.toAsymptoticMorphism.reparam r hr hrTop
  completelyPositive := by
    have h := phi.completelyPositive
    dsimp only [IsCompletelyPositive] at h ⊢
    intro t
    exact h (r t)

@[simp]
theorem reparam_apply (phi : CompletelyPositiveFamily A B)
    (r : AsymptoticTime → AsymptoticTime) (hr : Continuous r)
    (hrTop : Tendsto r atTop atTop) (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    (reparam phi r hr hrTop).toAsymptoticMorphism t a =
      phi.toAsymptoticMorphism (r t) a := by
  rfl

end CompletelyPositiveFamily

namespace CompletelyPositiveContraction

@[ext]
theorem ext {phi psi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B}
    (h : phi.toAsymptoticMorphism = psi.toAsymptoticMorphism) : phi = psi := by
  cases phi
  cases psi
  cases h
  rfl

/-- Forgetting the norm inequalities gives the broad neutral CP carrier. -/
def toCompletelyPositiveFamily (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) :
    CompletelyPositiveFamily A B where
  toAsymptoticMorphism := phi.toAsymptoticMorphism
  completelyPositive := by
    have h := phi.completelyPositiveContraction
    dsimp only [IsCompletelyPositiveContraction] at h
    dsimp only [IsCompletelyPositive]
    intro t
    obtain ⟨s, _, hs⟩ := h t
    exact ⟨s, hs⟩

@[simp]
theorem toCompletelyPositiveFamily_toAsymptoticMorphism
    (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) :
    (toCompletelyPositiveFamily phi).toAsymptoticMorphism =
      phi.toAsymptoticMorphism := by
  rfl

/-- An actual star homomorphism as a constant CP-contractive asymptotic
family. -/
def ofHom (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B where
  toAsymptoticMorphism := AsymptoticMorphism.ofHom f
  completelyPositiveContraction := by
    let : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
    let : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
    let : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
    let : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
    let s : A →CP B :=
      CompletelyPositiveMapClass.toCompletelyPositiveLinearMap f
    change ∀ t : AsymptoticTime, ∃ s : A →CP B,
      (∀ a : A, ‖s a‖ ≤ ‖a‖) ∧ ∀ a : A, s a = AsymptoticMorphism.ofHom f t a
    intro t
    exact ⟨s, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le f, fun _ => rfl⟩

@[simp]
theorem ofHom_apply (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    (ofHom f).toAsymptoticMorphism t a = f a := by
  rfl

/-- A point-norm continuous time family of star homomorphisms is a literal
CP-contractive asymptotic family. No uniform-in-time hom-space continuity is
required beyond the continuous orbit of each input. -/
def ofHomFamily (f : AsymptoticTime → A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hf : ∀ a : A, Continuous fun t => f t a) :
    CompletelyPositiveContraction A B where
  toAsymptoticMorphism := AsymptoticMorphism.ofHomFamily f hf
  completelyPositiveContraction := by
    let _ : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
    let _ : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
    let _ : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
    let _ : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
    change ∀ t : AsymptoticTime, ∃ s : A →CP B,
      (∀ a : A, ‖s a‖ ≤ ‖a‖) ∧
        ∀ a : A, s a = AsymptoticMorphism.ofHomFamily f hf t a
    intro t
    let s : A →CP B :=
      CompletelyPositiveMapClass.toCompletelyPositiveLinearMap (f t)
    exact ⟨s, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le (f t), fun _ => rfl⟩

/-- Forgetting the CPC witness retains the existing raw time family. -/
@[simp]
theorem ofHomFamily_toAsymptoticMorphism
    (f : AsymptoticTime → A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hf : ∀ a : A, Continuous fun t => f t a) :
    (ofHomFamily f hf).toAsymptoticMorphism =
      AsymptoticMorphism.ofHomFamily f hf :=
  rfl

/-- The time-family constructor keeps the literal homomorphism value. -/
theorem ofHomFamily_apply (f : AsymptoticTime → A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hf : ∀ a : A, Continuous fun t => f t a)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    (ofHomFamily f hf).toAsymptoticMorphism t a = f t a :=
  rfl

/-- Proper reparametrization preserves CP and every finite-time contraction
inequality. -/
def reparam (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B)
    (r : AsymptoticTime → AsymptoticTime) (hr : Continuous r)
    (hrTop : Tendsto r atTop atTop) : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B where
  toAsymptoticMorphism := phi.toAsymptoticMorphism.reparam r hr hrTop
  completelyPositiveContraction := by
    have h := phi.completelyPositiveContraction
    dsimp only [IsCompletelyPositiveContraction] at h ⊢
    intro t
    exact h (r t)

@[simp]
theorem reparam_apply (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B)
    (r : AsymptoticTime → AsymptoticTime) (hr : Continuous r)
    (hrTop : Tendsto r atTop atTop) (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    (reparam phi r hr hrTop).toAsymptoticMorphism t a =
      phi.toAsymptoticMorphism (r t) a := by
  rfl

/-- A literal CP-contractive homotopy: the whole interval-valued family,
not only its endpoint evaluations, has CP-contraction slices. -/
structure Homotopy (phi₀ phi₁ : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) where
  /-- The whole interval-valued CP-contractive asymptotic family. -/
  family : CompletelyPositiveContraction A C(unitInterval, B)
  /-- Exact value at the initial endpoint. -/
  start : ∀ (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A),
    family.toAsymptoticMorphism t a 0 = phi₀.toAsymptoticMorphism t a
  /-- Exact value at the terminal endpoint. -/
  finish : ∀ (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A),
    family.toAsymptoticMorphism t a 1 = phi₁.toAsymptoticMorphism t a

namespace Homotopy

/-- Forget the CP-contraction evidence while retaining the actual homotopy
family and endpoints. -/
def toAsymptoticHomotopy
    {phi₀ phi₁ : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B}
    (H : Homotopy phi₀ phi₁) :
    AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy phi₀.toAsymptoticMorphism
      phi₁.toAsymptoticMorphism where
  family := H.family.toAsymptoticMorphism
  start := H.start
  finish := H.finish

end Homotopy

/-- Literal homotopy through one whole interval-valued CPC family. -/
def Homotopic
    (phi psi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) : Prop :=
  Nonempty (Homotopy phi psi)

end CompletelyPositiveContraction

/-- An actual star homomorphism also supplies the broad CP-only family. -/
def CompletelyPositiveFamily.ofHom (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    CompletelyPositiveFamily A B :=
  (CompletelyPositiveContraction.ofHom f).toCompletelyPositiveFamily

@[simp]
theorem CompletelyPositiveFamily.ofHom_apply (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    (CompletelyPositiveFamily.ofHom f).toAsymptoticMorphism t a = f a := by
  rfl

end AsymptoticMorphism

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.CompletelyPositiveHomotopyEquivalence
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Functoriality

/-!
# Fixed-star-hom functoriality for CPC asymptotic families

Only one side is an actual star homomorphism. No composition of two arbitrary
asymptotic families is defined.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace AsymptoticMorphism
namespace CompletelyPositiveContraction

universe uA uB uC

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]

/-- Precompose a CPC asymptotic family by an actual nonunital star hom. -/
noncomputable def precomp (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B)
    (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) : CompletelyPositiveContraction C B where
  toAsymptoticMorphism :=
    AsymptoticMorphism.precomp phi.toAsymptoticMorphism f
  completelyPositiveContraction := by
    let _ : PartialOrder C := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder C
    let _ : StarOrderedRing C := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing C
    let _ : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
    let _ : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
    let _ : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
    let _ : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
    have hphi := phi.completelyPositiveContraction
    dsimp only [IsCompletelyPositiveContraction] at hphi ⊢
    intro t
    obtain ⟨s, hsNorm, hsValue⟩ := hphi t
    let fCP : C →CP A :=
      CompletelyPositiveMapClass.toCompletelyPositiveLinearMap f
    let sf : C →CP B := CompletelyPositiveMap.comp s fCP
    refine ⟨sf, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro c
      calc
        ‖sf c‖ = ‖s (f c)‖ := rfl
        _ ≤ ‖f c‖ := hsNorm (f c)
        _ ≤ ‖c‖ := NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le f c
    · intro c
      change s (f c) = phi.toAsymptoticMorphism t (f c)
      exact hsValue (f c)

/-- Forgetting CPC evidence gives exactly ordinary fixed-hom precomposition. -/
@[simp]
theorem precomp_toAsymptoticMorphism
    (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    (precomp phi f).toAsymptoticMorphism =
      AsymptoticMorphism.precomp phi.toAsymptoticMorphism f :=
  rfl

/-- CPC fixed-hom precomposition has the literal value. -/
theorem precomp_apply
    (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (c : C) :
    (precomp phi f).toAsymptoticMorphism t c =
      phi.toAsymptoticMorphism t (f c) :=
  rfl

namespace Homotopy

variable {phi psi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B}

/-- Precompose a whole CPC homotopy by a fixed source star hom. -/
noncomputable def precomp (H : Homotopy phi psi)
    (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) : Homotopy (phi.precomp f) (psi.precomp f) where
  family := H.family.precomp f
  start := by
    intro t c
    rw [CompletelyPositiveContraction.precomp_apply,
      CompletelyPositiveContraction.precomp_apply]
    exact H.start t (f c)
  finish := by
    intro t c
    rw [CompletelyPositiveContraction.precomp_apply,
      CompletelyPositiveContraction.precomp_apply]
    exact H.finish t (f c)

/-- Postcompose a whole CPC homotopy by a fixed target star hom. -/
noncomputable def postcomp (H : Homotopy phi psi)
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) : Homotopy (phi.postcomp g) (psi.postcomp g) where
  family := H.family.postcomp
    (ContinuousMap.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom unitInterval g)
  start := by
    intro t a
    rw [CompletelyPositiveContraction.postcomp_apply,
      ContinuousMap.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply,
      CompletelyPositiveContraction.postcomp_apply]
    exact congrArg g (H.start t a)
  finish := by
    intro t a
    rw [CompletelyPositiveContraction.postcomp_apply,
      ContinuousMap.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply,
      CompletelyPositiveContraction.postcomp_apply]
    exact congrArg g (H.finish t a)

/-- CPC homotopy precomposition forgets to ordinary homotopy precomposition. -/
@[simp]
theorem precomp_toAsymptoticHomotopy
    (H : Homotopy phi psi) (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    (precomp H f).toAsymptoticHomotopy =
      _root_.AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy.precomp
        H.toAsymptoticHomotopy f := by
  apply _root_.AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy.ext
  rfl

/-- CPC homotopy postcomposition forgets to ordinary homotopy
postcomposition. -/
@[simp]
theorem postcomp_toAsymptoticHomotopy
    (H : Homotopy phi psi) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    (postcomp H g).toAsymptoticHomotopy =
      _root_.AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy.postcomp
        H.toAsymptoticHomotopy g := by
  apply _root_.AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy.ext
  rfl

end Homotopy

/-- Fixed source-star-hom precomposition preserves literal CPC homotopy. -/
theorem homotopic_precomp {phi psi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B}
    (h : Homotopic phi psi) (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    Homotopic (phi.precomp f) (psi.precomp f) := by
  rcases h with ⟨H⟩
  exact ⟨H.precomp f⟩

/-- Fixed target-star-hom postcomposition preserves literal CPC homotopy. -/
theorem homotopic_postcomp {phi psi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B}
    (h : Homotopic phi psi) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    Homotopic (phi.postcomp g) (psi.postcomp g) := by
  rcases h with ⟨H⟩
  exact ⟨H.postcomp g⟩

/-- Contravariant fixed-star-hom action on CPC homotopy classes. -/
def precompClass (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    HomotopyClasses A B → HomotopyClasses C B :=
  Quotient.map (sa := homotopySetoid A B) (sb := homotopySetoid C B)
    (fun phi => phi.precomp f) (by
      intro phi psi h
      exact homotopic_precomp h f)

/-- Covariant fixed-star-hom action on CPC homotopy classes. -/
def postcompClass (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    HomotopyClasses A B → HomotopyClasses A C :=
  Quotient.map (sa := homotopySetoid A B) (sb := homotopySetoid A C)
    (fun phi => phi.postcomp g) (by
      intro phi psi h
      exact homotopic_postcomp h g)

/-- Fixed-hom precomposition computes on CPC class constructors. -/
@[simp]
theorem precompClass_mk
    (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) :
    precompClass f (mkClass phi) = mkClass (phi.precomp f) :=
  rfl

/-- Fixed-hom postcomposition computes on CPC class constructors. -/
@[simp]
theorem postcompClass_mk
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) :
    postcompClass g (mkClass phi) = mkClass (phi.postcomp g) :=
  rfl

end CompletelyPositiveContraction
end AsymptoticMorphism

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.CompletelyPositive
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CompletelyPositiveMap.CodRestrict

/-!
# CPC witnesses for the existing matching-endpoint pair family

Compatible literal CPC homotopies determine a CPC family in the already
existing matching-path pullback.  The underlying asymptotic family is exactly
the ordinary `Homotopy.pairFamily`.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace AsymptoticMorphism
namespace CompletelyPositiveContraction
namespace Homotopy

open ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing

universe uA uB

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable {phi psi chi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B}

/-- The existing ordinary matching-endpoint pair family has a genuine CPC
witness at every finite time. -/
theorem pairFamily_isCompletelyPositiveContraction
    (H : Homotopy phi psi) (K : Homotopy psi chi) :
    IsCompletelyPositiveContraction
      (AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy.pairFamily
        H.toAsymptoticHomotopy K.toAsymptoticHomotopy) := by
  let S : NonUnitalStarSubalgebra ℂ
      (C(unitInterval, B) × C(unitInterval, B)) :=
    NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback (evalAt B 1) (evalAt B 0)
  let _ : IsClosed (S : Set (C(unitInterval, B) × C(unitInterval, B))) :=
    NonUnitalCStarPullback.isClosed_pullback (evalAt B 1) (evalAt B 0)
  let _ : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
  let _ : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
  let _ : PartialOrder C(unitInterval, B) :=
    CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder C(unitInterval, B)
  let _ : StarOrderedRing C(unitInterval, B) :=
    CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing C(unitInterval, B)
  let _ : PartialOrder (C(unitInterval, B) × C(unitInterval, B)) :=
    CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder (C(unitInterval, B) × C(unitInterval, B))
  let _ : StarOrderedRing (C(unitInterval, B) × C(unitInterval, B)) :=
    CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing
      (C(unitInterval, B) × C(unitInterval, B))
  let _ : PartialOrder S := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder S
  let _ : StarOrderedRing S := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing S
  have hH := H.family.completelyPositiveContraction
  have hK := K.family.completelyPositiveContraction
  dsimp only [IsCompletelyPositiveContraction] at hH hK ⊢
  intro t
  obtain ⟨f, hfNorm, hfValue⟩ := hH t
  obtain ⟨g, hgNorm, hgValue⟩ := hK t
  let fg : CompletelyPositiveMap.Canonical A
      (C(unitInterval, B) × C(unitInterval, B)) :=
    CompletelyPositiveMap.prod f g
  have hfgNorm : ∀ a : A, ‖fg a‖ ≤ ‖a‖ := fun a =>
    CompletelyPositiveMap.norm_prod_apply_le f g hfNorm hgNorm a
  have hmem : ∀ a : A, fg a ∈ S := by
    intro a
    change f a 1 = g a 0
    rw [hfValue a, hgValue a, H.finish t a, K.start t a]
  let restricted : CompletelyPositiveMap.Canonical A S :=
    CompletelyPositiveMap.Canonical.codRestrictClosed fg S hmem
  refine ⟨restricted, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a
    exact CompletelyPositiveMap.Canonical.norm_codRestrictClosed_apply_le
      fg S hmem hfgNorm a
  · intro a
    apply Subtype.ext
    change ((restricted a : S) :
      C(unitInterval, B) × C(unitInterval, B)) =
      ((AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy.pairFamily
        H.toAsymptoticHomotopy K.toAsymptoticHomotopy t a : MatchingPaths B) :
          C(unitInterval, B) × C(unitInterval, B))
    rw [CompletelyPositiveMap.Canonical.codRestrictClosed_apply,
      CompletelyPositiveMap.prod_apply, hfValue a, hgValue a,
      AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy.pairFamily_val]
    rfl

/-- Package the CPC witness without changing the existing ordinary pair
family. -/
noncomputable def matchingPairFamily
    (H : Homotopy phi psi) (K : Homotopy psi chi) :
    CompletelyPositiveContraction A (MatchingPaths B) where
  toAsymptoticMorphism :=
    AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy.pairFamily
      H.toAsymptoticHomotopy K.toAsymptoticHomotopy
  completelyPositiveContraction :=
    pairFamily_isCompletelyPositiveContraction H K

/-- Forgetting the CPC witness returns exactly the established ordinary
matching-endpoint pair family. -/
@[simp]
theorem matchingPairFamily_toAsymptoticMorphism
    (H : Homotopy phi psi) (K : Homotopy psi chi) :
    (matchingPairFamily H K).toAsymptoticMorphism =
      AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy.pairFamily
        H.toAsymptoticHomotopy K.toAsymptoticHomotopy :=
  rfl

/-- The CPC pair family has the literal two path coordinates of `H` and `K`. -/
theorem matchingPairFamily_val
    (H : Homotopy phi psi) (K : Homotopy psi chi)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    (((matchingPairFamily H K).toAsymptoticMorphism t a : MatchingPaths B) :
      C(unitInterval, B) × C(unitInterval, B)) =
      (H.family.toAsymptoticMorphism t a,
        K.family.toAsymptoticMorphism t a) :=
  AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy.pairFamily_val
    H.toAsymptoticHomotopy K.toAsymptoticHomotopy t a

end Homotopy
end CompletelyPositiveContraction
end AsymptoticMorphism

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.CompletelyPositiveHomotopyGluing

/-!
# Completely-positive asymptotic homotopy classes

Literal CPC homotopy is proved reflexive, symmetric and transitive by reusing
the established ordinary homotopy operations and the H2 CPC proofs. The proved
equivalence then defines the actual Setoid and quotient.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace AsymptoticMorphism
namespace CompletelyPositiveContraction

open ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing

universe uA uB

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable {phi psi chi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B}

namespace Homotopy

/-- A CPC homotopy is determined by its actual CPC family; endpoint fields are
proofs. -/
@[ext]
theorem ext {H K : Homotopy phi psi} (h : H.family = K.family) : H = K := by
  cases H
  cases K
  cases h
  rfl

/-- Literal constant-in-homotopy-parameter CPC homotopy. -/
noncomputable def refl
    (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) : Homotopy phi phi where
  family := phi.postcomp (constantHom B)
  start := by
    intro t a
    rw [CompletelyPositiveContraction.postcomp_apply, constantHom_apply]
  finish := by
    intro t a
    rw [CompletelyPositiveContraction.postcomp_apply, constantHom_apply]

/-- Reverse the interval parameter of a CPC homotopy. -/
noncomputable def symm (H : Homotopy phi psi) : Homotopy psi phi where
  family := H.family.postcomp (reverseHom B)
  start := by
    intro t a
    rw [CompletelyPositiveContraction.postcomp_apply, reverseHom_zero]
    exact H.finish t a
  finish := by
    intro t a
    rw [CompletelyPositiveContraction.postcomp_apply, reverseHom_one]
    exact H.start t a

/-- Concatenate CPC homotopies using the exact existing ordinary trans family
and its proved H2 CPC property. -/
noncomputable def trans
    (H : Homotopy phi psi) (K : Homotopy psi chi) : Homotopy phi chi where
  family :=
    { toAsymptoticMorphism :=
        (H.toAsymptoticHomotopy.trans K.toAsymptoticHomotopy).family
      completelyPositiveContraction :=
        trans_family_isCompletelyPositiveContraction H K }
  start := (H.toAsymptoticHomotopy.trans K.toAsymptoticHomotopy).start
  finish := (H.toAsymptoticHomotopy.trans K.toAsymptoticHomotopy).finish

/-- CPC reflexivity forgets to the established ordinary reflexivity homotopy. -/
@[simp]
theorem refl_toAsymptoticHomotopy
    (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) :
    (refl phi).toAsymptoticHomotopy =
      _root_.AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy.refl
        phi.toAsymptoticMorphism := by
  apply _root_.AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy.ext
  rfl

/-- CPC symmetry forgets to the established ordinary reversed homotopy. -/
@[simp]
theorem symm_toAsymptoticHomotopy (H : Homotopy phi psi) :
    (symm H).toAsymptoticHomotopy =
      _root_.AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy.symm
        H.toAsymptoticHomotopy := by
  apply _root_.AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy.ext
  rfl

/-- CPC transitivity forgets to the established ordinary concatenated
homotopy. -/
@[simp]
theorem trans_toAsymptoticHomotopy
    (H : Homotopy phi psi) (K : Homotopy psi chi) :
    (trans H K).toAsymptoticHomotopy =
      _root_.AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy.trans
        H.toAsymptoticHomotopy K.toAsymptoticHomotopy := by
  apply _root_.AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy.ext
  rfl

end Homotopy

/-- CPC homotopy is reflexive. -/
theorem homotopic_refl (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) :
    Homotopic phi phi :=
  ⟨Homotopy.refl phi⟩

/-- CPC homotopy is symmetric. -/
theorem homotopic_symm {phi psi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B}
    (h : Homotopic phi psi) : Homotopic psi phi := by
  rcases h with ⟨H⟩
  exact ⟨H.symm⟩

/-- CPC homotopy is transitive. -/
theorem homotopic_trans {phi psi chi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B}
    (hphi : Homotopic phi psi) (hpsi : Homotopic psi chi) :
    Homotopic phi chi := by
  rcases hphi with ⟨H⟩
  rcases hpsi with ⟨K⟩
  exact ⟨H.trans K⟩

/-- The literal CPC homotopy relation is an equivalence relation. -/
theorem homotopic_equivalence
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Equivalence (Homotopic :
      CompletelyPositiveContraction A B →
      CompletelyPositiveContraction A B → Prop) :=
  { refl := homotopic_refl
    symm := homotopic_symm
    trans := homotopic_trans }

/-- Actual Setoid of CPC asymptotic families under literal CPC homotopy. -/
def homotopySetoid
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Setoid (CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) where
  r := Homotopic
  iseqv := homotopic_equivalence A B

/-- Actual homotopy classes of finite-time CPC asymptotic families. -/
abbrev HomotopyClasses
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :=
  Quotient (homotopySetoid A B)

/-- Class of a literal CPC asymptotic family. -/
def mkClass (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) :
    HomotopyClasses A B :=
  Quotient.mk _ phi

/-- Equality of CPC classes is exactly literal CPC homotopy. -/
@[simp]
theorem mkClass_eq_mkClass_iff
    (phi psi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) :
    mkClass phi = mkClass psi ↔ Homotopic phi psi := by
  constructor
  · exact Quotient.exact
  · intro h
    exact Quotient.sound h

end CompletelyPositiveContraction
end AsymptoticMorphism

the proved CPC homotopy Setoid.

/-!
# CPC preservation for the existing ordinary homotopy gluing

The existing matching pair family is postcomposed by the existing glue hom.
This proves CPC for the exact ordinary transitive homotopy family; no second
glued family or CPC transitivity operation is defined.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace AsymptoticMorphism
namespace CompletelyPositiveContraction
namespace Homotopy

open ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing

universe uA uB

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable {phi psi chi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B}

/-- The exact family stored by the existing ordinary transitive homotopy is
CPC at every finite time. -/
theorem trans_family_isCompletelyPositiveContraction
    (H : Homotopy phi psi) (K : Homotopy psi chi) :
    IsCompletelyPositiveContraction
      ((H.toAsymptoticHomotopy.trans K.toAsymptoticHomotopy).family) := by
  let glued := (H.matchingPairFamily K).postcomp

    (AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp
      (AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy.pairFamily
        H.toAsymptoticHomotopy K.toAsymptoticHomotopy)
      (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.glueHom (B := B)))
  simpa only [glued,
    CompletelyPositiveContraction.postcomp_toAsymptoticMorphism,
    matchingPairFamily_toAsymptoticMorphism] using hCPC

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.CompletelyPositive
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CompletelyPositiveMap.Basic

/-!
# Postcomposition of CPC asymptotic families

A genuine nonunital star homomorphism is completely positive and norm
contractive, so postcomposition preserves every finite-time CPC witness.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace AsymptoticMorphism
namespace CompletelyPositiveContraction

universe uA uB uC

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]

/-- Postcompose a CPC asymptotic family by an actual nonunital star hom. -/
noncomputable def postcomp (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B)
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) : CompletelyPositiveContraction A C where
  toAsymptoticMorphism :=
    AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp phi.toAsymptoticMorphism g
  completelyPositiveContraction := by
    let _ : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
    let _ : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
    let _ : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
    let _ : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
    let _ : PartialOrder C := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder C
    let _ : StarOrderedRing C := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing C
    have hphi := phi.completelyPositiveContraction
    dsimp only [IsCompletelyPositiveContraction] at hphi ⊢
    intro t
    obtain ⟨s, hsNorm, hsValue⟩ := hphi t
    let gCP : B →CP C :=
      CompletelyPositiveMapClass.toCompletelyPositiveLinearMap g
    let gs : A →CP C := CompletelyPositiveMap.comp gCP s
    refine ⟨gs, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a
      calc
        ‖gs a‖ = ‖g (s a)‖ := rfl
        _ ≤ ‖s a‖ := NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le g (s a)
        _ ≤ ‖a‖ := hsNorm a
    · intro a
      rw [CompletelyPositiveMap.comp_apply, hsValue a,
        AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp_apply]
      rfl

/-- Forgetting CPC evidence gives exactly ordinary postcomposition. -/
@[simp]
theorem postcomp_toAsymptoticMorphism
    (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    (postcomp phi g).toAsymptoticMorphism =
      AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp phi.toAsymptoticMorphism g :=
  rfl

/-- CPC postcomposition has the literal star-hom value. -/
theorem postcomp_apply
    (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    (postcomp phi g).toAsymptoticMorphism t a =
      g (phi.toAsymptoticMorphism t a) :=
  rfl

end CompletelyPositiveContraction
end AsymptoticMorphism

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.CompletelyPositive
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CompletelyPositiveMap.Bounded

/-!
# Access to the actual CP slices of asymptotic families

The existing CP and CPC carriers provide a completely positive map witness
for each time. The accessors choose only from that supplied evidence and
retain the raw value. A CPC slice has its supplied pointwise contraction and
therefore a continuous linear map of operator norm at most one.

No carrier, quotient, homotopy, global instance or boundedness field changes.
No source representative-existence theorem is used.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

universe uA uB

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

namespace CompletelyPositiveFamily

/-- A CP slice chosen only from the given family's actual finite-time
complete-positivity evidence. -/
def slice (phi : CompletelyPositiveFamily A B) (t : AsymptoticTime) :
    CompletelyPositiveMap.Canonical A B := by
  letI : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
  letI : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
  letI : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
  letI : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
  exact Classical.choose (phi.completelyPositive t)

/-- The chosen CP witness has exactly the original raw slice values. -/
@[simp]
theorem slice_apply (phi : CompletelyPositiveFamily A B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    slice phi t a = phi.toAsymptoticMorphism t a := by
  let : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
  let : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
  let : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
  let : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
  exact Classical.choose_spec (phi.completelyPositive t) a

/-- Each actual broad CP slice has the upstream continuous linear adapter,
without a contraction assumption. -/
def sliceContinuousLinearMap (phi : CompletelyPositiveFamily A B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) : A →L[ℂ] B := by
  letI : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
  letI : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
  letI : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
  letI : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
  exact CompletelyPositiveMap.toContinuousLinearMap (slice phi t)

/-- Continuous access retains every raw value. -/
@[simp]
theorem sliceContinuousLinearMap_apply (phi : CompletelyPositiveFamily A B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    sliceContinuousLinearMap phi t a = phi.toAsymptoticMorphism t a := by
  let : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
  let : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
  let : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
  let : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
  rw [sliceContinuousLinearMap, CompletelyPositiveMap.toContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    slice_apply]

end CompletelyPositiveFamily

namespace CompletelyPositiveContraction

/-- A CP slice chosen only from the supplied CP-contraction evidence.
The norm evidence is retained by the characteristic theorem below. -/
def slice (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) (t : AsymptoticTime) :
    CompletelyPositiveMap.Canonical A B := by
  letI : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
  letI : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
  letI : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
  letI : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
  exact Classical.choose (phi.completelyPositiveContraction t)

/-- The chosen CP witness has exactly the original raw slice values. -/
@[simp]
theorem slice_apply (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    slice phi t a = phi.toAsymptoticMorphism t a := by
  let : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
  let : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
  let : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
  let : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (phi.completelyPositiveContraction t)).2 a

/-- The chosen slice retains its supplied pointwise contraction. -/
theorem norm_slice_apply_le (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    ‖slice phi t a‖ ≤ ‖a‖ := by
  let : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
  let : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
  let : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
  let : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (phi.completelyPositiveContraction t)).1 a

/-- The continuous linear map of an actual CPC slice, with unchanged values. -/
def sliceContinuousLinearMap (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) : A →L[ℂ] B := by
  letI : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
  letI : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
  letI : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
  letI : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
  exact CompletelyPositiveMap.toContinuousLinearMap (slice phi t)

/-- Continuous access retains every raw value. -/
@[simp]
theorem sliceContinuousLinearMap_apply (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    sliceContinuousLinearMap phi t a = phi.toAsymptoticMorphism t a := by
  let : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
  let : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
  let : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
  let : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
  rw [sliceContinuousLinearMap, CompletelyPositiveMap.toContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    slice_apply]

/-- The actual continuous linear slice has operator norm at most one. -/
theorem norm_sliceContinuousLinearMap_le_one
    (phi : CompletelyPositiveContraction A B) (t : AsymptoticTime) :
    ‖sliceContinuousLinearMap phi t‖ ≤ 1 := by
  let : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
  let : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
  let : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
  let : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
  exact CompletelyPositiveMap.norm_toContinuousLinearMap_le_one (slice phi t)
    (norm_slice_apply_le phi t)

end CompletelyPositiveContraction

end AsymptoticMorphism
