module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Uniform

/-!
# A literal sufficiently-fast composition-class criterion

This is only a property of the ACTUAL asymptotic homotopy class. It selects no
composition operation. Each uniform representative pair gets its own knots
and thresholds; no universal rate over all representatives is assumed.

The rates are continuous, increasing and proper, and dominate the thresholds
at the specified knots. The output family has the literal outer-reparametrized
formula. No condition assuming that this formula is already an asymptotic
morphism is passed as an input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

universe uA uB uC

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]

/-- Operational representative criterion for the printed reparametrized
composition. Existence/uniqueness is a separate source theorem, not a field. -/
def IsCompositionClass (z : HomotopyClasses A C)
    (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (ψ : AsymptoticMorphism B C) : Prop :=
  ∀ (φu : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (ψu : AsymptoticMorphism B C),
    IsUniform φu → IsUniform ψu → Homotopic φu φ → Homotopic ψu ψ →
      ∃ τ ν : ℕ → AsymptoticTime,
        Monotone τ ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (τ n : ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (ν n : ℝ)) ∧
        ∀ r : AsymptoticTime → AsymptoticTime,
          Continuous r → Monotone r → Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
          (∀ n : ℕ, ν n ≤ r (τ n)) →
          ∃ σ : AsymptoticMorphism A C,
            (∀ (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A), σ t a = ψu (r t) (φu t a)) ∧
              mkClass σ = z

end AsymptoticMorphism

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.AsymptoticAlgebra
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Bounds

/-!
# Raw asymptotic families and the actual asymptotic-algebra correspondence

The derived neutral orbit bound packages every raw time orbit in BCF.
The four asymptotic defects then give an actual nonunital star homomorphism
into the existing closed-ray Cb/C0 quotient. Equality is precisely strict
equivalence, and the existing quotient-surjective set lift proves surjectivity.

This is the strict quotient, not a homotopy quotient. No coefficient continuity,
unitality, separability, extra bound or exact-zero hypothesis is imposed.
The carrier, norm, quotient projection and strict setoid are the existing ones.

Reference: Blackadar, K-Theory for Operator Algebras (1998), 25.1.3–25.1.4(a).
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter
open scoped ZeroAtInfty BoundedContinuousFunction

noncomputable section

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

universe uA uB

attribute [local instance] _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

/-- An actual raw time orbit bundled using the derived neutral bound. -/
@[no_expose]
def orbitBCF (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (a : A) : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B where
  toFun t := φ t a
  continuous_toFun := by
    simpa only [_root_.AsymptoticMorphism.toFun_eq_coe] using
      _root_.AsymptoticMorphism.continuous_orbit φ a
  map_bounded' := by
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (_root_.AsymptoticMorphism.norm_bounded_and_eventually_contractive φ a).1
    refine ⟨C + C, fun s t => ?_⟩
    exact (dist_le_norm_add_norm (φ s a) (φ t a)).trans
      (add_le_add (hC s) (hC t))

/-- Bundling changes no pointwise value or time parameter. -/
@[simp]
theorem orbitBCF_apply (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (a : A) (t : AsymptoticTime) : orbitBCF φ a t = φ t a := by
  rfl

/-- The actual quotient homomorphism of a raw asymptotic family. -/
@[no_expose]
def toHom (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B where
  toFun a := _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B (orbitBCF φ a)
  map_zero' := by
    apply (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap_eq_zero_iff _).2
    have ht : Tendsto (fun t : AsymptoticTime => φ t (0 : A)) atTop (nhds (0 : B)) :=
      _root_.AsymptoticMorphism.zero_tendsto φ
    exact ht.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun (t : AsymptoticTime) => by
      simp only [orbitBCF_apply])
  map_add' := by
    intro a b
    have h :
        _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B
          (orbitBCF φ (a + b) - (orbitBCF φ a + orbitBCF φ b)) = 0 := by
      apply (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap_eq_zero_iff _).2
      have ht : Tendsto (fun t : AsymptoticTime =>
          φ t (a + b) - (φ t a + φ t b)) atTop (nhds (0 : B)) := by
        simpa only [_root_.AsymptoticMorphism.toFun_eq_coe] using
          _root_.AsymptoticMorphism.add_defect_tendsto φ a b
      exact ht.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun (t : AsymptoticTime) => by
        simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply,
          BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply, orbitBCF_apply])
    rw [map_sub, map_add, sub_eq_zero] at h
    exact h
  map_smul' := by
    intro z a
    have h :
        _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B
          (orbitBCF φ (z • a) - z • orbitBCF φ a) = 0 := by
      apply (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap_eq_zero_iff _).2
      have ht : Tendsto (fun t : AsymptoticTime =>
          φ t (z • a) - z • φ t a) atTop (nhds (0 : B)) := by
        simpa only [_root_.AsymptoticMorphism.toFun_eq_coe] using
          _root_.AsymptoticMorphism.smul_defect_tendsto φ z a
      exact ht.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun (t : AsymptoticTime) => by
        simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply,
          BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply, orbitBCF_apply])
    rw [map_sub, map_smul, sub_eq_zero] at h
    exact h
  map_mul' := by
    intro a b
    have h :
        _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B
          (orbitBCF φ (a * b) - orbitBCF φ a * orbitBCF φ b) = 0 := by
      apply (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap_eq_zero_iff _).2
      have ht : Tendsto (fun t : AsymptoticTime =>
          φ t (a * b) - φ t a * φ t b) atTop (nhds (0 : B)) := by
        simpa only [_root_.AsymptoticMorphism.toFun_eq_coe] using
          _root_.AsymptoticMorphism.mul_defect_tendsto φ a b
      exact ht.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun (t : AsymptoticTime) => by
        simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply,
          BoundedContinuousFunction.mul_apply, orbitBCF_apply])
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, sub_eq_zero] at h
    exact h
  map_star' := by
    intro a
    have h :
        _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B
          (orbitBCF φ (star a) - star (orbitBCF φ a)) = 0 := by
      apply (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap_eq_zero_iff _).2
      have ht : Tendsto (fun t : AsymptoticTime =>
          φ t (star a) - star (φ t a)) atTop (nhds (0 : B)) := by
        simpa only [_root_.AsymptoticMorphism.toFun_eq_coe] using
          _root_.AsymptoticMorphism.star_defect_tendsto φ a
      exact ht.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun (t : AsymptoticTime) => by
        simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply,
          BoundedContinuousFunction.star_apply, orbitBCF_apply])
    rw [map_sub, map_star, sub_eq_zero] at h
    exact h

/-- The printed quotient class of the actual time orbit. -/
@[simp]
theorem toHom_apply (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (a : A) :
    toHom φ a = _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B (orbitBCF φ a) := by
  rfl

/-- The kernel criterion recovers EXACT strict equivalence, not homotopy. -/
theorem toHom_eq_iff (φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    toHom φ = toHom ψ ↔ StrictlyEquivalent φ ψ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a
    have hq := DFunLike.congr_fun h a
    rw [toHom_apply, toHom_apply] at hq
    have ht := (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap_eq_iff
      (orbitBCF φ a) (orbitBCF ψ a)).1 hq
    simpa only [orbitBCF_apply] using ht
  · intro h
    apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
    intro a
    apply (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap_eq_iff _ _).2
    simpa only [orbitBCF_apply] using h a

/-- The actual neutral set lift maps back to the original quotient hom. -/
theorem toHom_ofHom (ρ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B) :
    toHom (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.ofHom ρ) = ρ := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro a
  change _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B
      (orbitBCF (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.ofHom ρ) a) = ρ a
  have horbit : orbitBCF (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.ofHom ρ) a =
      Classical.choose (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap_surjective B (ρ a)) := by
    apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
    intro t
    rw [orbitBCF_apply, _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.ofHom_apply]
  rw [horbit]
  exact Classical.choose_spec (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap_surjective B (ρ a))

/-- The induced map on the ACTUAL existing strict-equivalence quotient. -/
def strictClassToHom :
    Quotient (strictSetoid A B) → (A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B) :=
  Quotient.lift toHom (fun φ ψ h => (toHom_eq_iff φ ψ).2 h)

/-- The strict-equivalence class map has its original representative formula. -/
@[simp]
theorem strictClassToHom_mk (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    strictClassToHom (Quotient.mk (strictSetoid A B) φ) = toHom φ := by
  rfl

/-- The literal strict correspondence, using the separate derived orbit bound.
It does not equate strict and homotopy classes. -/
def strictClassEquiv :
    Quotient (strictSetoid A B) ≃ (A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective strictClassToHom ⟨
    by
      intro q r
      refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ q r ?_
      intro φ ψ h
      rw [strictClassToHom_mk, strictClassToHom_mk] at h
      exact Quotient.sound ((toHom_eq_iff φ ψ).1 h),
    by
      intro ρ
      exact ⟨Quotient.mk (strictSetoid A B) (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.ofHom ρ),
        toHom_ofHom ρ⟩⟩

/-- The concrete bijection is the quotient hom of the original raw family. -/
@[simp]
theorem strictClassEquiv_mk (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    strictClassEquiv (Quotient.mk (strictSetoid A B) φ) = toHom φ := by
  rfl


end AsymptoticMorphism

end

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.AsymptoticAlgebraMap
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Correspondence
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy

/-!
# Naturality of the strict asymptotic-algebra correspondence

This upper module is the first nontrivial consumer of the coefficient map.
It stays above both the strict correspondence and fixed-hom functoriality, so
neither lower provider imports a later consumer.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped BoundedContinuousFunction

noncomputable section

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

universe uA uB uC

attribute [local instance] _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]

/-- Postcomposition of a raw family gives literal coefficient
postcomposition of every bounded time orbit. -/
theorem orbitBCF_postcomp
    (Φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (a : A) :
    orbitBCF (postcomp Φ g) a =
      BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom g (orbitBCF Φ a) := by
  apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
  intro t
  rw [orbitBCF_apply, postcomp_apply,
    BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply, orbitBCF_apply]

/-- The actual strict correspondence is covariantly natural under a fixed
coefficient star homomorphism. -/
theorem toHom_postcomp
    (Φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    toHom (postcomp Φ g) =
      (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.map g).comp (toHom Φ) := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro a
  rw [toHom_apply, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply, toHom_apply,
    _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.map_quotientMap, orbitBCF_postcomp]

/-- Ordinary fixed homomorphisms correspond exactly to the constant-class
inclusion into the actual asymptotic quotient. -/
theorem toHom_ofHom_constant (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    toHom (ofHom f) =
      (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.constantHom B).comp f := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro a
  rw [toHom_apply, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply,
    _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.constantHom_apply]
  congr 1
  apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
  intro t
  rw [orbitBCF_apply, ofHom_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.const_apply]

#print axioms orbitBCF_postcomp
#print axioms toHom_postcomp
#print axioms toHom_ofHom_constant

end AsymptoticMorphism

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Correspondence
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Pullback
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Extension.Basic

/-!
# The full-time pullback extension of an asymptotic morphism

A raw asymptotic morphism determines a homomorphism into the actual closed-ray
asymptotic algebra. Its pullback along the bounded-function quotient is a
genuine C-star extension with full C0 kernel. No coefficient-wise linearity,
faithfulness, separability, uniformity or unitality is assumed.

The middle algebra and norm are the existing closed pullback. The quotient
C-star dictionary is the explicit existing factory, not a new global instance.
The orbit section is only set-theoretic. Evaluation gives ordinary star
homomorphisms and is point-norm continuous in time.

Reference: Blackadar, K-Theory for Operator Algebras (1998), §25.6, the extension
preceding Proposition 25.6.2. The E-theory inverse, homotopy comparison and
universal property are not asserted here.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped ZeroAtInfty BoundedContinuousFunction

noncomputable section

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

universe uA uB

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

attribute [local instance] _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra

/-- The actual closed full-time pullback, with the fixed quotient dictionary.
Its C-star structure and norm are inherited from the existing pullback. -/
abbrev FullTimePullback (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : Type (max uA uB) :=
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (AsymptoticAlgebra B) :=
    _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra B
  ↥(NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback (toHom φ)
    (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B))

namespace FullTimePullback

variable (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)

/-- Projection of the full-time pullback onto the coefficient algebra. -/
def projection : FullTimePullback φ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A :=
  NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom (toHom φ)
    (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B)

/-- The actual bounded-function coordinate of a pullback element. -/
def orbitProjection : FullTimePullback φ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :=
  NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom (toHom φ)
    (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B)

/-- Projection has the unchanged first-coordinate value. -/
theorem projection_apply (d : FullTimePullback φ) :
    projection φ d = d.val.1 :=
  rfl

/-- The bounded-function coordinate has its unchanged pointwise data. -/
theorem orbitProjection_apply (d : FullTimePullback φ) :
    orbitProjection φ d = d.val.2 :=
  rfl

/-- The literal compatibility equation defining the closed pullback. -/
theorem condition (d : FullTimePullback φ) :
    toHom φ (projection φ d) =
      _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B (orbitProjection φ d) :=
  NonUnitalCStarPullback.condition (toHom φ)
    (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B) d

/-- The raw orbit is a deterministic set section, not a homomorphism section. -/
def setSection (a : A) : FullTimePullback φ :=
  NonUnitalCStarPullback.mk (toHom φ)
    (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B)
    a (orbitBCF φ a) (toHom_apply φ a)

/-- The orbit section is a right inverse of the actual projection. -/
@[simp]
theorem projection_setSection (a : A) :
    projection φ (setSection φ a) = a :=
  rfl

/-- The section retains the complete original bounded time orbit. -/
@[simp]
theorem orbitProjection_setSection (a : A) :
    orbitProjection φ (setSection φ a) = orbitBCF φ a :=
  rfl

/-- Include full C0 on the closed ray into the actual kernel.
No vanishing-at-one condition is imposed on the input. -/
def kernelInclusion : C₀(AsymptoticTime, B) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] FullTimePullback φ where
  toFun f :=
    NonUnitalCStarPullback.mk (toHom φ)
      (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B) 0 f.toBCF
      ((map_zero (toHom φ)).trans
        (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap_toBCF f).symm)
  map_zero' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  map_add' := by
    intro f g
    apply NonUnitalCStarPullback.ext (toHom φ)
      (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B)
    · change (0 : A) = 0 + 0
      exact (zero_add 0).symm
    · change (f + g).toBCF = f.toBCF + g.toBCF
      apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
      intro t
      rfl
  map_smul' := by
    intro z f
    apply NonUnitalCStarPullback.ext (toHom φ)
      (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B)
    · change (0 : A) = z • 0
      exact (smul_zero z).symm
    · change (z • f).toBCF = z • f.toBCF
      apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
      intro t
      rfl
  map_mul' := by
    intro f g
    apply NonUnitalCStarPullback.ext (toHom φ)
      (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B)
    · change (0 : A) = 0 * 0
      exact (zero_mul 0).symm
    · change (f * g).toBCF = f.toBCF * g.toBCF
      apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
      intro t
      rfl
  map_star' := by
    intro f
    apply NonUnitalCStarPullback.ext (toHom φ)
      (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B)
    · change (0 : A) = star 0
      exact (star_zero A).symm
    · change (star f).toBCF = star f.toBCF
      apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
      intro t
      rfl

/-- Every included full C0 function is in the kernel of the projection. -/
@[simp]
theorem projection_kernelInclusion (f : C₀(AsymptoticTime, B)) :
    projection φ (kernelInclusion φ f) = 0 :=
  rfl

/-- Inclusion retains the complete original bounded-function coordinate. -/
@[simp]
theorem orbitProjection_kernelInclusion (f : C₀(AsymptoticTime, B)) :
    orbitProjection φ (kernelInclusion φ f) = f.toBCF :=
  rfl

/-- The full C0 kernel inclusion is injective. -/
theorem kernelInclusion_injective : Function.Injective (kernelInclusion φ) := by
  intro f g h
  apply ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.toBCF_injective AsymptoticTime B
  have hcoord := congrArg (orbitProjection φ) h
  simpa only [orbitProjection_kernelInclusion] using hcoord

/-- The deterministic orbit section proves actual quotient surjectivity. -/
theorem projection_surjective : Function.Surjective (projection φ) :=
  fun a => ⟨setSection φ a, projection_setSection φ a⟩

/-- The actual sequence with full closed-ray C0 kernel is exact. -/
theorem exact : Function.Exact (kernelInclusion φ) (projection φ) := by
  intro d
  constructor
  · intro hd
    have hq :
        _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B (orbitProjection φ d) = 0 := by
      rw [← condition φ d, hd, map_zero]
    have hmem :
        orbitProjection φ d ∈
          (BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B :
            Set (AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B)) :=
      (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.mem_vanishingIdeal_iff (orbitProjection φ d)).2
        ((_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap_eq_zero_iff
          (orbitProjection φ d)).1 hq)
    rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal_carrier AsymptoticTime B] at hmem
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hmem
    refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
    apply NonUnitalCStarPullback.ext (toHom φ)
      (_root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap B)
    · change projection φ (kernelInclusion φ f) = projection φ d
      rw [projection_kernelInclusion, hd]
    · change orbitProjection φ (kernelInclusion φ f) = orbitProjection φ d
      exact (orbitProjection_kernelInclusion φ f).trans hf
  · rintro ⟨f, rfl⟩
    exact projection_kernelInclusion φ f

/-- The normalized extension has the actual full-time pullback as its middle. -/
def extension : CStarExtension A C₀(AsymptoticTime, B) :=
  CStarExtension.ofExact (kernelInclusion φ) (projection φ)
    (kernelInclusion_injective φ) (projection_surjective φ) (exact φ)

/-- Normalization retains the actual middle carrier, not a replacement algebra. -/
theorem extension_middle :
    (extension φ).Middle = FullTimePullback φ :=
  rfl

/-- The normalized inclusion has the original full C0 inclusion value. -/
theorem extension_inclusion_apply (f : C₀(AsymptoticTime, B)) :
    (extension φ).inclusion f = kernelInclusion φ f :=
  CStarExtension.ofExact_inclusion_apply (kernelInclusion φ) (projection φ)
    (kernelInclusion_injective φ) (projection_surjective φ) (exact φ) f

/-- The normalized quotient has the original coefficient-projection value. -/
theorem extension_quotient_apply (d : FullTimePullback φ) :
    (extension φ).quotient d = projection φ d :=
  CStarExtension.ofExact_quotient_apply (kernelInclusion φ) (projection φ)
    (kernelInclusion_injective φ) (projection_surjective φ) (exact φ) d

/-- Evaluation at an actual time is an ordinary nonunital star homomorphism. -/
def evaluation (t : AsymptoticTime) : FullTimePullback φ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B where
  toFun d := orbitProjection φ d t
  map_zero' := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  map_mul' _ _ := rfl
  map_star' _ := rfl

/-- Ordinary evaluation uses the unchanged bounded-function coordinate. -/
@[simp]
theorem evaluation_apply (t : AsymptoticTime) (d : FullTimePullback φ) :
    evaluation φ t d = orbitProjection φ d t :=
  rfl

/-- Evaluating the set section recovers the original possibly nonlinear value. -/
theorem evaluation_setSection (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    evaluation φ t (setSection φ a) = φ t a := by
  rw [evaluation_apply, orbitProjection_setSection, orbitBCF_apply]

/-- Full C0 inclusion allows its original evaluation at every time, including one. -/
theorem evaluation_kernelInclusion
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (f : C₀(AsymptoticTime, B)) :
    evaluation φ t (kernelInclusion φ f) = f t := by
  rw [evaluation_apply, orbitProjection_kernelInclusion]
  rfl

/-- Evaluation is point-norm continuous in time for each fixed pullback element. -/
theorem evaluation_continuous (d : FullTimePullback φ) :
    Continuous (fun t : AsymptoticTime => evaluation φ t d) := by
  have hd : Continuous (fun t : AsymptoticTime => orbitProjection φ d t) :=
    (orbitProjection φ d).continuous
  simpa only [evaluation_apply] using hd

end FullTimePullback

end AsymptoticMorphism

Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap.Hom
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Homotopy
public import Mathlib.Data.Quot

/-!
# Fixed-hom functoriality and ordinary homomorphism inclusion

Only the composing map in pre/postcomposition is an actual star hom.
The other family remains arbitrary and nonlinear. No same-time composition
of two arbitrary asymptotic families is defined.

Ordinary classes are the real quotient of the existing point-norm Homotopic
predicate. Its proven equivalence is reused, and ofHom descends through the
actual constructed asymptotic homotopy quotient.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

universe uA uB uC uD

namespace NonUnitalStarAlgHom

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]

/-- The ordinary homotopy setoid, using the existing real hom-valued paths. -/
def homotopySetoid
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Setoid (A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) where
  r := Homotopic
  iseqv := Homotopic.equivalence A B

/-- The actual ordinary homomorphism homotopy classes [A,B]. -/
abbrev HomotopyClasses
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :=
  Quotient (homotopySetoid A B)

/-- The class of an actual star homomorphism in the point-norm homotopy quotient. -/
def mkHomotopyClass (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) : HomotopyClasses A B :=
  Quotient.mk _ f

@[simp]
theorem mkHomotopyClass_eq_iff (f g : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    mkHomotopyClass f = mkHomotopyClass g ↔ Homotopic f g := by
  constructor
  · exact Quotient.exact
  · intro h
    exact Quotient.sound h

/-- Contravariant fixed-hom action on actual ordinary classes. -/
def precompClass (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    HomotopyClasses A B → HomotopyClasses C B :=
  Quotient.map (sa := homotopySetoid A B) (sb := homotopySetoid C B)
    (fun g => g.comp f) (by
    intro g h hgh
    exact Homotopic.precomp hgh f)

/-- Covariant fixed-hom action on actual ordinary classes. -/
def postcompClass (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    HomotopyClasses A B → HomotopyClasses A C :=
  Quotient.map (sa := homotopySetoid A B) (sb := homotopySetoid A C)
    (fun f => g.comp f) (by
    intro f h hfh
    exact Homotopic.postcomp hfh g)

@[simp]
theorem precompClass_mk (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (g : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    precompClass f (mkHomotopyClass g) = mkHomotopyClass (g.comp f) := by
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem postcompClass_mk (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    postcompClass g (mkHomotopyClass f) = mkHomotopyClass (g.comp f) := by
  rfl

end NonUnitalStarAlgHom

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra D]

/-- Precompose by a fixed actual nonunital star hom.
No continuity or linearity of the asymptotic slice is added. -/
def precomp (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    AsymptoticMorphism C B where
  toFun t a := φ t (f a)
  continuous_orbit a := φ.continuous_orbit (f a)
  add_defect_tendsto a b := by
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, map_add] using φ.add_defect_tendsto (f a) (f b)
  smul_defect_tendsto z a := by
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, map_smul] using φ.smul_defect_tendsto z (f a)
  mul_defect_tendsto a b := by
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, map_mul] using φ.mul_defect_tendsto (f a) (f b)
  star_defect_tendsto a := by
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, map_star] using φ.star_defect_tendsto (f a)

@[simp]
theorem precomp_apply (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : C) : precomp φ f t a = φ t (f a) := by
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem precomp_id (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    precomp φ (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ A) = φ := by
  apply ext
  intro t a
  rw [precomp_apply]
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem postcomp_id (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    postcomp φ (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ B) = φ := by
  apply ext
  intro t a
  rw [postcomp_apply]
  rfl

theorem precomp_comp (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (g : D →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    precomp (precomp φ f) g = precomp φ (f.comp g) := by
  apply ext
  intro t a
  simp only [precomp_apply, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply]

theorem postcomp_comp (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (h : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] D) :
    postcomp (postcomp φ g) h = postcomp φ (h.comp g) := by
  apply ext
  intro t a
  simp only [postcomp_apply, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply]

theorem postcomp_precomp (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] D) :
    postcomp (precomp φ f) g = precomp (postcomp φ g) f := by
  apply ext
  intro t a
  simp only [precomp_apply, postcomp_apply]

@[simp]
theorem precomp_ofHom (g : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    precomp (ofHom g) f = ofHom (g.comp f) := by
  apply ext
  intro t a
  simp only [precomp_apply, ofHom_apply, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply]

@[simp]
theorem postcomp_ofHom (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    postcomp (ofHom f) g = ofHom (g.comp f) := by
  apply ext
  intro t a
  simp only [postcomp_apply, ofHom_apply, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply]

namespace Homotopy

/-- Precompose the actual homotopy family by a fixed star hom. -/
def precomp {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B} (H : Homotopy φ ψ)
    (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) : Homotopy (AsymptoticMorphism.precomp φ f)
      (AsymptoticMorphism.precomp ψ f) where
  family := AsymptoticMorphism.precomp H.family f
  start := by
    intro t a
    rw [precomp_apply, precomp_apply]
    exact H.start t (f a)
  finish := by
    intro t a
    rw [precomp_apply, precomp_apply]
    exact H.finish t (f a)

/-- Postcompose through the actual coefficient star hom on C([0,1],B). -/
def postcomp {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B} (H : Homotopy φ ψ)
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) : Homotopy (AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp φ g)
      (AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp ψ g) where
  family := AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp H.family
    (ContinuousMap.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom unitInterval g)
  start := by
    intro t a
    rw [postcomp_apply, ContinuousMap.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply, postcomp_apply]
    exact congrArg g (H.start t a)
  finish := by
    intro t a
    rw [postcomp_apply, ContinuousMap.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply, postcomp_apply]
    exact congrArg g (H.finish t a)

end Homotopy

theorem homotopic_precomp {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B}
    (h : Homotopic φ ψ) (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    Homotopic (precomp φ f) (precomp ψ f) := by
  rcases h with ⟨H⟩
  exact ⟨H.precomp f⟩

theorem homotopic_postcomp {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B}
    (h : Homotopic φ ψ) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    Homotopic (postcomp φ g) (postcomp ψ g) := by
  rcases h with ⟨H⟩
  exact ⟨H.postcomp g⟩

/-- An ordinary point-norm homotopy supplies a constant-in-time asymptotic
homotopy. The existing relation is an existential F, not a record assumed here. -/
theorem homotopic_ofHom {f g : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B}
    (h : NonUnitalStarAlgHom.Homotopic f g) : Homotopic (ofHom f) (ofHom g) := by
  rcases h with ⟨F, h0, h1⟩
  refine ⟨{ family := ofHom F, start := ?_, finish := ?_ }⟩
  · intro t a
    rw [ofHom_apply, ofHom_apply]
    exact h0 a
  · intro t a
    rw [ofHom_apply, ofHom_apply]
    exact h1 a

/-- Contravariant fixed-hom action on actual asymptotic homotopy classes. -/
def precompClass (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    HomotopyClasses A B → HomotopyClasses C B :=
  Quotient.map (sa := homotopySetoid A B) (sb := homotopySetoid C B)
    (fun φ => precomp φ f) (by
    intro φ ψ h
    exact homotopic_precomp h f)

/-- Covariant fixed-hom action on actual asymptotic homotopy classes. -/
def postcompClass (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    HomotopyClasses A B → HomotopyClasses A C :=
  Quotient.map (sa := homotopySetoid A B) (sb := homotopySetoid A C)
    (fun φ => postcomp φ g) (by
    intro φ ψ h
    exact homotopic_postcomp h g)

@[simp]
theorem precompClass_mk (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    precompClass f (mkClass φ) = mkClass (precomp φ f) := by
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem postcompClass_mk (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    postcompClass g (mkClass φ) = mkClass (postcomp φ g) := by
  rfl

/-- The actual natural map [A,B]->[[A,B]]. -/
def ofHomClass : NonUnitalStarAlgHom.HomotopyClasses A B → HomotopyClasses A B :=
  Quotient.map (sa := NonUnitalStarAlgHom.homotopySetoid A B)
    (sb := homotopySetoid A B) ofHom (by
    intro f g h
    exact homotopic_ofHom h)

@[simp]
theorem ofHomClass_mk (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    ofHomClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.mkHomotopyClass f) = mkClass (ofHom f) := by
  rfl

theorem precompClass_id (q : HomotopyClasses A B) :
    precompClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ A) q = q := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q fun φ => ?_
  change precompClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ A) (mkClass φ) = mkClass φ
  rw [precompClass_mk, precomp_id]

theorem postcompClass_id (q : HomotopyClasses A B) :
    postcompClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ B) q = q := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q fun φ => ?_
  change postcompClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ B) (mkClass φ) = mkClass φ
  rw [postcompClass_mk, postcomp_id]

theorem precompClass_comp (q : HomotopyClasses A B)
    (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (g : D →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    precompClass g (precompClass f q) = precompClass (f.comp g) q := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q fun φ => ?_
  change precompClass g (precompClass f (mkClass φ)) =
    precompClass (f.comp g) (mkClass φ)
  rw [precompClass_mk, precompClass_mk, precompClass_mk, precomp_comp]

theorem postcompClass_comp (q : HomotopyClasses A B)
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (h : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] D) :
    postcompClass h (postcompClass g q) = postcompClass (h.comp g) q := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q fun φ => ?_
  change postcompClass h (postcompClass g (mkClass φ)) =
    postcompClass (h.comp g) (mkClass φ)
  rw [postcompClass_mk, postcompClass_mk, postcompClass_mk, postcomp_comp]

theorem postcompClass_precomp (q : HomotopyClasses A B)
    (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] D) :
    postcompClass g (precompClass f q) = precompClass f (postcompClass g q) := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q fun φ => ?_
  change postcompClass g (precompClass f (mkClass φ)) =
    precompClass f (postcompClass g (mkClass φ))
  rw [precompClass_mk, postcompClass_mk, postcompClass_mk, precompClass_mk,
    postcomp_precomp]

theorem ofHomClass_precomp
    (q : NonUnitalStarAlgHom.HomotopyClasses A B) (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    ofHomClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.precompClass f q) =
      precompClass f (ofHomClass q) := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q fun g => ?_
  change ofHomClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.precompClass f
      (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.mkHomotopyClass g)) =
    precompClass f (ofHomClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.mkHomotopyClass g))
  rw [NonUnitalStarAlgHom.precompClass_mk, ofHomClass_mk, ofHomClass_mk,
    precompClass_mk, precomp_ofHom]

theorem ofHomClass_postcomp
    (q : NonUnitalStarAlgHom.HomotopyClasses A B) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    ofHomClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.postcompClass g q) =
      postcompClass g (ofHomClass q) := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q fun f => ?_
  change ofHomClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.postcompClass g
      (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.mkHomotopyClass f)) =
    postcompClass g (ofHomClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.mkHomotopyClass f))
  rw [NonUnitalStarAlgHom.postcompClass_mk, ofHomClass_mk, ofHomClass_mk,
    postcompClass_mk, postcomp_ofHom]

end AsymptoticMorphism

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Basic
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing

import Mathlib.Topology.Constructions

/-!
# Actual asymptotic homotopy equivalence and classes

Postcomposition uses a genuine nonunital star hom. Compatible homotopies are
paired in the actual closed endpoint pullback and glued by its star hom.
Thus time continuity and all four defects use the inherited supremum norm,
not pointwise-only interval convergence or a supplied orbit bound.

The Setoid and Quotient below are constructed from real reflexive, reversed
and concatenated homotopy data. No E-group, KK-group or additive law is assumed.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter
open scoped CStarAlgebra

noncomputable section

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

universe uA uB uC

section Postcomposition

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]

/-- Apply an actual star hom to an arbitrary nonlinear asymptotic family. -/
def postcomp (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    AsymptoticMorphism A C where
  toFun t a := g (φ t a)
  continuous_orbit a := (map_continuous g).comp (φ.continuous_orbit a)
  add_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a b
    have h := ((map_continuous g).tendsto 0).comp (φ.add_defect_tendsto a b)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, toFun_eq_coe, map_sub, map_add, map_zero] using h
  smul_defect_tendsto := by
    intro z a
    have h := ((map_continuous g).tendsto 0).comp (φ.smul_defect_tendsto z a)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, toFun_eq_coe, map_sub, map_smul, map_zero] using h
  mul_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a b
    have h := ((map_continuous g).tendsto 0).comp (φ.mul_defect_tendsto a b)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, toFun_eq_coe, map_sub, map_mul, map_zero] using h
  star_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a
    have h := ((map_continuous g).tendsto 0).comp (φ.star_defect_tendsto a)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, toFun_eq_coe, map_sub, map_star, map_zero] using h

@[simp]
theorem postcomp_apply (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) : postcomp φ g t a = g (φ t a) := by
  rfl

end Postcomposition

section Homotopies

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable {φ ψ χ : AsymptoticMorphism A B}

open ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing

namespace Homotopy

/-- Pair two exact-compatible homotopies in the actual matching-endpoint
subalgebra. The time topology and defect limits are inherited product norms. -/
def pairFamily (H : Homotopy φ ψ) (K : Homotopy ψ χ) :
    AsymptoticMorphism A (MatchingPaths B) where
  toFun t a := NonUnitalCStarPullback.mk (evalAt B 1) (evalAt B 0)
    (H.family t a) (K.family t a) ((H.finish t a).trans (K.start t a).symm)
  continuous_orbit := by
    intro a
    exact ((H.family.continuous_orbit a).prodMk
      (K.family.continuous_orbit a)).subtype_mk
        (fun t => (H.finish t a).trans (K.start t a).symm)
  add_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a b
    apply tendsto_subtype_rng.mpr
    change Filter.Tendsto (fun t =>
      (H.family t (a + b) - (H.family t a + H.family t b),
        K.family t (a + b) - (K.family t a + K.family t b)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds ((0 : C(unitInterval, B)), (0 : C(unitInterval, B))))
    exact (H.family.add_defect_tendsto a b).prodMk_nhds
      (K.family.add_defect_tendsto a b)
  smul_defect_tendsto := by
    intro z a
    apply tendsto_subtype_rng.mpr
    change Filter.Tendsto (fun t =>
      (H.family t (z • a) - z • H.family t a,
        K.family t (z • a) - z • K.family t a))
      Filter.atTop (nhds ((0 : C(unitInterval, B)), (0 : C(unitInterval, B))))
    exact (H.family.smul_defect_tendsto z a).prodMk_nhds
      (K.family.smul_defect_tendsto z a)
  mul_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a b
    apply tendsto_subtype_rng.mpr
    change Filter.Tendsto (fun t =>
      (H.family t (a * b) - H.family t a * H.family t b,
        K.family t (a * b) - K.family t a * K.family t b))
      Filter.atTop (nhds ((0 : C(unitInterval, B)), (0 : C(unitInterval, B))))
    exact (H.family.mul_defect_tendsto a b).prodMk_nhds
      (K.family.mul_defect_tendsto a b)
  star_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a
    apply tendsto_subtype_rng.mpr
    change Filter.Tendsto (fun t =>
      (H.family t (star a) - star (H.family t a),
        K.family t (star a) - star (K.family t a)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds ((0 : C(unitInterval, B)), (0 : C(unitInterval, B))))
    exact (H.family.star_defect_tendsto a).prodMk_nhds
      (K.family.star_defect_tendsto a)

@[simp]
theorem pairFamily_val (H : Homotopy φ ψ) (K : Homotopy ψ χ)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    ((pairFamily H K t a : MatchingPaths B) :
      C(unitInterval, B) × C(unitInterval, B)) = (H.family t a, K.family t a) := by
  rfl

/-- The literal constant-in-homotopy-parameter family. -/
def refl (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : Homotopy φ φ where
  family := postcomp φ (constantHom B)
  start := by
    intro t a
    rw [postcomp_apply, constantHom_apply]
  finish := by
    intro t a
    rw [postcomp_apply, constantHom_apply]

/-- Reverse the interval parameter, retaining exact endpoint values. -/
def symm (H : Homotopy φ ψ) : Homotopy ψ φ where
  family := postcomp H.family (reverseHom B)
  start := by
    intro t a
    rw [postcomp_apply, reverseHom_zero]
    exact H.finish t a
  finish := by
    intro t a
    rw [postcomp_apply, reverseHom_one]
    exact H.start t a

/-- Concatenate exact-compatible homotopies through real closed-pullback gluing. -/
def trans (H : Homotopy φ ψ) (K : Homotopy ψ χ) : Homotopy φ χ where
  family := postcomp (pairFamily H K) (glueHom (B := B))
  start := by
    intro t a
    rw [postcomp_apply, glueHom_zero, pairFamily_val]
    exact H.start t a
  finish := by
    intro t a
    rw [postcomp_apply, glueHom_one, pairFamily_val]
    exact K.finish t a

end Homotopy

theorem homotopic_refl (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : Homotopic φ φ :=
  ⟨Homotopy.refl φ⟩

theorem homotopic_symm {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B}
    (h : Homotopic φ ψ) : Homotopic ψ φ := by
  rcases h with ⟨H⟩
  exact ⟨H.symm⟩

theorem homotopic_trans {φ ψ χ : AsymptoticMorphism A B}
    (h₁ : Homotopic φ ψ) (h₂ : Homotopic ψ χ) : Homotopic φ χ := by
  rcases h₁ with ⟨H⟩
  rcases h₂ with ⟨K⟩
  exact ⟨H.trans K⟩

theorem homotopic_equivalence
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Equivalence (Homotopic : AsymptoticMorphism A B →
      AsymptoticMorphism A B → Prop) :=
  { refl := homotopic_refl
    symm := homotopic_symm
    trans := homotopic_trans }

/-- The Setoid is constructed from the actual homotopy data and its proofs. -/
def homotopySetoid
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Setoid (AsymptoticMorphism A B) where
  r := Homotopic
  iseqv := homotopic_equivalence A B

/-- Actual asymptotic homotopy classes, the quotient denoted [[A,B]].
No addition, group or E-theory structure is introduced here. -/
abbrev HomotopyClasses
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :=
  Quotient (homotopySetoid A B)

/-- The class of an actual asymptotic family. -/
def mkClass (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : HomotopyClasses A B :=
  Quotient.mk _ φ

@[simp]
theorem mkClass_eq_mkClass_iff (φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    mkClass φ = mkClass ψ ↔ Homotopic φ ψ := by
  constructor
  · exact Quotient.exact
  · intro h
    exact Quotient.sound h

end Homotopies

end AsymptoticMorphism

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.FullTimePullback
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap.ZeroAtInftyOpen
public import MathlibExt.KTheory.CStar.Cone.EndpointLift

import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.OrderIso
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.MonotoneContinuity
import Mathlib.Topology.Instances.NNReal.Lemmas
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/-!
# The initial-evaluation kernel of the full-time pullback

The kernel of evaluation at time one is a closed ideal of the actual full-time
pullback. Its coefficient projection is onto: subtracting the translated cone
endpoint lift corrects the existing set section at time one. This is only a
set-theoretic section, with no finite-time linearity assumption.

The kernel of the restricted coefficient projection is the suspension algebra.
The reciprocal coordinate sends time infinity to the puncture zero and time
one to endpoint one. The norm and C-star dictionaries are inherited from the
existing closed ideals; no global instance or parallel middle algebra is added.

Reference: Blackadar, K-Theory for Operator Algebras (1998), §25.1.2(b),
§25.1.4(b), and the full-time pullback in §25.6. The parent's full C0 kernel is
unchanged. Mapping-cone comparison, Busby converses and E-theory inverses are
not asserted here.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Set
open scoped NNReal ZeroAtInfty BoundedContinuousFunction

noncomputable section

namespace AsymptoticMorphism.FullTimePullback

/-! ## Actual time coordinates -/

/-- Translate the closed time ray to the nonnegative reals by `t ↦ t - 1`. -/
def timeHomeomorphNNReal : AsymptoticTime ≃ₜ ℝ≥0 := by
  let e : ℝ ≃o ℝ := OrderIso.addRight (-1)
  have h₁ : e 1 = 0 := by
    change (1 : ℝ) + (-1) = 0
    exact add_neg_cancel 1
  exact ((e.Ici 1).trans
    (Set.orderIsoOfEq (Ici (e 1)) (Ici 0) (congrArg Ici h₁))).toHomeomorph

/-- The translated time has its literal real coordinate. -/
theorem timeHomeomorphNNReal_apply (t : AsymptoticTime) :
    (timeHomeomorphNNReal t : ℝ) = (t : ℝ) - 1 := by
  change (t : ℝ) + (-1) = (t : ℝ) - 1
  exact (sub_eq_add_neg _ _).symm

/-- The inverse translation has real coordinate `u + 1`. -/
theorem timeHomeomorphNNReal_symm_apply (u : ℝ≥0) :
    (timeHomeomorphNNReal.symm u : ℝ) = (u : ℝ) + 1 := by
  have h := timeHomeomorphNNReal_apply (timeHomeomorphNNReal.symm u)
  rw [timeHomeomorphNNReal.apply_symm_apply] at h
  linarith

/-- Time one is sent to zero, using the proved endpoint transport. -/
@[simp]
theorem timeHomeomorphNNReal_one :
    timeHomeomorphNNReal ⟨1, le_rfl⟩ = 0 := by
  apply NNReal.eq
  rw [timeHomeomorphNNReal_apply]
  exact sub_self 1

/-- Zero is sent back to time one. -/
@[simp]
theorem timeHomeomorphNNReal_symm_zero :
    timeHomeomorphNNReal.symm 0 = ⟨1, le_rfl⟩ := by
  apply timeHomeomorphNNReal.injective
  rw [timeHomeomorphNNReal.apply_symm_apply, timeHomeomorphNNReal_one]

/-- Interior times have strictly positive translated coordinates. -/
theorem timeHomeomorphNNReal_pos {t : AsymptoticTime} (ht : 1 < (t : ℝ)) :
    0 < timeHomeomorphNNReal t := by
  have h : 0 < (timeHomeomorphNNReal t : ℝ) := by
    rw [timeHomeomorphNNReal_apply]
    exact sub_pos.mpr ht
  exact_mod_cast h

/-- The decreasing reciprocal coordinate from the positive half-line to `(0,1)`. -/
def positiveNNRealReciprocalHomeomorph :
    Ioi (0 : ℝ≥0) ≃ₜ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 where
  toFun u := ⟨1 / (1 + ((u : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)), by
    have hu : 0 < ((u : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast u.property
    have hd : 0 < 1 + ((u : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by linarith
    exact ⟨div_pos zero_lt_one hd, (div_lt_one hd).2 (by linarith)⟩⟩
  invFun s := ⟨NNReal.mk (1 / (s : ℝ) - 1) (by
    exact le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr ((one_lt_div s.property.1).2 s.property.2))), by
    have h : 0 < 1 / (s : ℝ) - 1 :=
      sub_pos.mpr ((one_lt_div s.property.1).2 s.property.2)
    exact_mod_cast h⟩
  left_inv u := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply NNReal.eq
    change 1 / (1 / (1 + ((u : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) - 1 = ((u : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)
    simp only [one_div, inv_inv]
    ring
  right_inv s := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change 1 / (1 + (1 / (s : ℝ) - 1)) = (s : ℝ)
    have h : 1 + (1 / (s : ℝ) - 1) = 1 / (s : ℝ) := by ring
    rw [h]
    simp only [one_div, inv_inv]
  continuous_toFun := by
    have hu : Continuous (fun u : Ioi (0 : ℝ≥0) ↦ ((u : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :=
      NNReal.continuous_coe.comp continuous_subtype_val
    exact (continuous_const.div (continuous_const.add hu) (fun u ↦ by
      have hp : 0 < ((u : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast u.property
      exact ne_of_gt (by linarith : 0 < 1 + ((u : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)))).subtype_mk _
  continuous_invFun := by
    have hs : Continuous (fun s : Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ↦ 1 / (s : ℝ) - 1) :=
      (continuous_const.div continuous_subtype_val
        (fun s ↦ ne_of_gt s.property.1)).sub continuous_const
    exact (hs.subtype_mk _).subtype_mk _

/-- The reciprocal coordinate has the stated scalar value. -/
theorem positiveNNRealReciprocalHomeomorph_apply (u : Ioi (0 : ℝ≥0)) :
    (positiveNNRealReciprocalHomeomorph u : ℝ) =
      1 / (1 + ((u : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :=
  rfl

/-- The inverse coordinate is the actual positive number `1/s - 1`. -/
theorem positiveNNRealReciprocalHomeomorph_symm_apply (s : Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ((positiveNNRealReciprocalHomeomorph.symm s : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = 1 / (s : ℝ) - 1 :=
  rfl

/-- Translation followed by the reciprocal coordinate has value `1/t`. -/
theorem positiveNNRealReciprocalHomeomorph_time
    {t : AsymptoticTime} (ht : 1 < (t : ℝ)) :
    (positiveNNRealReciprocalHomeomorph
      ⟨timeHomeomorphNNReal t, timeHomeomorphNNReal_pos ht⟩ : ℝ) = 1 / (t : ℝ) := by
  rw [positiveNNRealReciprocalHomeomorph_apply, timeHomeomorphNNReal_apply]
  congr 1
  ring

universe uA uB

/-! ## Cone and suspension transport -/

section ConeTransport

variable (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

/-- Transport the existing cone to the closed time ray by translation. -/
def coneTimeEquiv : CStarKTheory.Cone B ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] C₀(AsymptoticTime, B) :=
  ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.starAlgEquivPrecomp timeHomeomorphNNReal

/-- Cone transport has the literal translated value. -/
theorem coneTimeEquiv_apply (f : CStarKTheory.Cone B) (t : AsymptoticTime) :
    coneTimeEquiv B f t = f (timeHomeomorphNNReal t) :=
  rfl

/-- The inverse uses the computed inverse time translation. -/
theorem coneTimeEquiv_symm_apply (f : C₀(AsymptoticTime, B)) (u : ℝ≥0) :
    (coneTimeEquiv B).symm f u = f (timeHomeomorphNNReal.symm u) :=
  rfl

/-- Transport preserves the endpoint value, with zero corresponding to time one. -/
@[simp]
theorem coneTimeEquiv_one (f : CStarKTheory.Cone B) :
    coneTimeEquiv B f ⟨1, le_rfl⟩ = f 0 := by
  rw [coneTimeEquiv_apply, timeHomeomorphNNReal_one]

/-- Restrict cone transport to the two actual point-evaluation kernels. -/
def conePointKernelEquiv :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra
        (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B) (0 : ℝ≥0)).carrier :=
      ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra _
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra
        (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B)
          (⟨1, le_rfl⟩ : AsymptoticTime)).carrier :=
      ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra _
    (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B) (0 : ℝ≥0)).carrier ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ]
      (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B)
        (⟨1, le_rfl⟩ : AsymptoticTime)).carrier := by
  let W := ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B) (0 : ℝ≥0)
  let V := ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B)
    (⟨1, le_rfl⟩ : AsymptoticTime)
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra W.carrier := ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra W
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra V.carrier := ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra V
  let forward : W.carrier →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] V.carrier :=
    NonUnitalStarAlgHom.codRestrict
      ((coneTimeEquiv B).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp
        (NonUnitalStarSubalgebraClass.subtype W.carrier)) V.carrier (fun g ↦ by
          apply (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.mem_vanishingAt _ _).2
          change coneTimeEquiv B g.val ⟨1, le_rfl⟩ = 0
          rw [coneTimeEquiv_one]
          exact (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.mem_vanishingAt _ _).1 g.property)
  let backward : V.carrier →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] W.carrier :=
    NonUnitalStarAlgHom.codRestrict
      ((coneTimeEquiv B).symm.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp
        (NonUnitalStarSubalgebraClass.subtype V.carrier)) W.carrier (fun f ↦ by
          apply (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.mem_vanishingAt _ _).2
          change (coneTimeEquiv B).symm f.val 0 = 0
          rw [coneTimeEquiv_symm_apply, timeHomeomorphNNReal_symm_zero]
          exact (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.mem_vanishingAt _ _).1 f.property)
  exact StarAlgEquiv.ofNonUnitalStarAlgHom forward backward
    (by
      apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
      intro g
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (coneTimeEquiv B).symm_apply_apply g.val)
    (by
      apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
      intro f
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (coneTimeEquiv B).apply_symm_apply f.val)

/-- The restricted equivalence retains the original translated function. -/
theorem conePointKernelEquiv_apply
    (g : (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B) (0 : ℝ≥0)).carrier)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) :
    (conePointKernelEquiv B g : C₀(AsymptoticTime, B)) t =
      (g : C₀(ℝ≥0, B)) (timeHomeomorphNNReal t) :=
  rfl

/-- Its inverse retains the original inverse-translation coordinate. -/
theorem conePointKernelEquiv_symm_apply
    (f : (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B)
      (⟨1, le_rfl⟩ : AsymptoticTime)).carrier) (u : ℝ≥0) :
    ((conePointKernelEquiv B).symm f : C₀(ℝ≥0, B)) u =
      (f : C₀(AsymptoticTime, B)) (timeHomeomorphNNReal.symm u) :=
  rfl

/-- The suspension is the actual time-one-zero subideal of full closed-ray C0. -/
def openIntervalKernelEquiv :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra
        (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B)
          (⟨1, le_rfl⟩ : AsymptoticTime)).carrier :=
      ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra _
    C₀(Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, B) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ]
      (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B)
        (⟨1, le_rfl⟩ : AsymptoticTime)).carrier := by
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra
      (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B) (0 : ℝ≥0)).carrier :=
    ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra _
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra
      (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B)
        (⟨1, le_rfl⟩ : AsymptoticTime)).carrier :=
    ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra _
  exact ((ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.starAlgEquivPrecomp
    (A := B) positiveNNRealReciprocalHomeomorph).trans
      ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.positiveNNRealStarAlgEquivVanishingAtZero).trans
    (conePointKernelEquiv B)

/-- The suspension transport is zero at time one. -/
theorem openIntervalKernelEquiv_one (f : C₀(Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, B)) :
    (openIntervalKernelEquiv B f : C₀(AsymptoticTime, B)) ⟨1, le_rfl⟩ = 0 :=
  (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.mem_vanishingAt _ _).1
    (openIntervalKernelEquiv B f).property

/-- At an interior time the literal suspension coordinate is `1/t`. -/
theorem openIntervalKernelEquiv_apply_of_one_lt
    (f : C₀(Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, B)) {t : AsymptoticTime} (ht : 1 < (t : ℝ)) :
    (openIntervalKernelEquiv B f : C₀(AsymptoticTime, B)) t =
      f ⟨1 / (t : ℝ),
        div_pos zero_lt_one (lt_trans zero_lt_one ht),
        (div_lt_one (lt_trans zero_lt_one ht)).2 ht⟩ := by
  change ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.extendZeroFromPositiveNNReal
    (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.starAlgEquivPrecomp
      positiveNNRealReciprocalHomeomorph f) (timeHomeomorphNNReal t) = _
  rw [ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.extendZeroFromPositiveNNReal_apply_of_pos _
    (timeHomeomorphNNReal_pos ht),
    ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.starAlgEquivPrecomp_apply]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact positiveNNRealReciprocalHomeomorph_time ht

/-- The computed inverse recovers the interior reciprocal time coordinate. -/
theorem openIntervalKernelEquiv_symm_apply
    (f : (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B)
      (⟨1, le_rfl⟩ : AsymptoticTime)).carrier) (s : Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (openIntervalKernelEquiv B).symm f s =
      (f : C₀(AsymptoticTime, B))
        (timeHomeomorphNNReal.symm
          (positiveNNRealReciprocalHomeomorph.symm s : ℝ≥0)) :=
  rfl

end ConeTransport

/-! ## The actual anchored closed ideal -/

section AnchoredPullback

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)

attribute [local instance] _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra

/-- The actual kernel of ordinary evaluation at time one in the full pullback. -/
def initialEvaluationIdeal :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (AsymptoticAlgebra B) :=
      _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra B
    ClosedStarIdeal (FullTimePullback φ) :=
  ClosedStarIdeal.ker (evaluation φ ⟨1, le_rfl⟩)

/-- Membership in the anchored ideal is exactly zero initial evaluation. -/
@[simp]
theorem mem_initialEvaluationIdeal (d : FullTimePullback φ) :
    d ∈ initialEvaluationIdeal φ ↔ evaluation φ ⟨1, le_rfl⟩ d = 0 :=
  ClosedStarIdeal.mem_ker (evaluation φ ⟨1, le_rfl⟩) d

/-- The anchored middle carrier, with the unchanged inherited subobject norm. -/
abbrev InitialEvaluationKernel : Type (max uA uB) :=
  (initialEvaluationIdeal φ).carrier

/-- Restrict the existing coefficient projection to its anchored closed ideal. -/
def initialProjection :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (AsymptoticAlgebra B) :=
      _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra B
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (InitialEvaluationKernel φ) :=
      ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra (initialEvaluationIdeal φ)
    InitialEvaluationKernel φ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A := by
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (AsymptoticAlgebra B) :=
    _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra B
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (InitialEvaluationKernel φ) :=
    ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra (initialEvaluationIdeal φ)
  exact (projection φ).comp
    (NonUnitalStarSubalgebraClass.subtype (initialEvaluationIdeal φ).carrier)

/-- The restricted projection retains the actual first-coordinate value. -/
theorem initialProjection_apply (d : InitialEvaluationKernel φ) :
    initialProjection φ d = projection φ d.val :=
  rfl

/-- Correct the existing orbit section by its translated cone endpoint lift.
This is a plain set section, not a star-algebra homomorphism. -/
def initialSetSection (a : A) : InitialEvaluationKernel φ :=
  ⟨setSection φ a - kernelInclusion φ
      (coneTimeEquiv B (CStarKTheory.Cone.endpointLift (φ ⟨1, le_rfl⟩ a))), by
    apply (mem_initialEvaluationIdeal φ _).2
    rw [map_sub, evaluation_setSection, evaluation_kernelInclusion,
      coneTimeEquiv_one, CStarKTheory.Cone.endpointLift_zero, sub_self]⟩

/-- The corrected set section has the stated ambient subtraction value. -/
theorem initialSetSection_val (a : A) :
    (initialSetSection φ a).val = setSection φ a - kernelInclusion φ
      (coneTimeEquiv B (CStarKTheory.Cone.endpointLift (φ ⟨1, le_rfl⟩ a))) :=
  rfl

/-- Initial evaluation of the actual corrected section is zero. -/
theorem evaluation_initialSetSection (a : A) :
    evaluation φ ⟨1, le_rfl⟩ (initialSetSection φ a).val = 0 :=
  (mem_initialEvaluationIdeal φ _).1 (initialSetSection φ a).property

/-- Subtracting a full-kernel element leaves the coefficient unchanged. -/
@[simp]
theorem initialProjection_initialSetSection (a : A) :
    initialProjection φ (initialSetSection φ a) = a := by
  rw [initialProjection_apply, initialSetSection_val, map_sub,
    projection_setSection, projection_kernelInclusion, sub_zero]

/-- The explicit set section proves actual surjectivity for arbitrary raw orbits. -/
theorem initialProjection_surjective : Function.Surjective (initialProjection φ) :=
  fun a ↦ ⟨initialSetSection φ a, initialProjection_initialSetSection φ a⟩

/-- Restrict the old full C0 inclusion to functions vanishing at time one. -/
def actualKernelInclusion :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (AsymptoticAlgebra B) :=
      _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra B
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra
        (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B)
          (⟨1, le_rfl⟩ : AsymptoticTime)).carrier :=
      ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra _
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (InitialEvaluationKernel φ) :=
      ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra (initialEvaluationIdeal φ)
    (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B)
      (⟨1, le_rfl⟩ : AsymptoticTime)).carrier →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] InitialEvaluationKernel φ := by
  let V := ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B)
    (⟨1, le_rfl⟩ : AsymptoticTime)
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra V.carrier := ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra V
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (InitialEvaluationKernel φ) :=
    ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra (initialEvaluationIdeal φ)
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.codRestrict
    ((kernelInclusion φ).comp (NonUnitalStarSubalgebraClass.subtype V.carrier))
    (initialEvaluationIdeal φ).carrier (fun f ↦ by
      apply (mem_initialEvaluationIdeal φ _).2
      change evaluation φ ⟨1, le_rfl⟩ (kernelInclusion φ f.val) = 0
      rw [evaluation_kernelInclusion]
      exact (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.mem_vanishingAt _ _).1 f.property)

/-- The intermediate inclusion uses the parent's unchanged full C0 inclusion. -/
theorem actualKernelInclusion_val
    (f : (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B)
      (⟨1, le_rfl⟩ : AsymptoticTime)).carrier) :
    (actualKernelInclusion φ f).val = kernelInclusion φ f.val :=
  rfl

/-- This inclusion has zero coefficient projection. -/
@[simp]
theorem initialProjection_actualKernelInclusion
    (f : (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B)
      (⟨1, le_rfl⟩ : AsymptoticTime)).carrier) :
    initialProjection φ (actualKernelInclusion φ f) = 0 := by
  rw [initialProjection_apply, actualKernelInclusion_val, projection_kernelInclusion]

/-- The restricted full-kernel inclusion is injective. -/
theorem actualKernelInclusion_injective : Function.Injective (actualKernelInclusion φ) := by
  intro f g h
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply kernelInclusion_injective φ
  exact congrArg Subtype.val h

/-- Exactness uses the parent's full C0 witness and proves its initial value zero. -/
theorem actualKernelInclusion_exact :
    Function.Exact (actualKernelInclusion φ) (initialProjection φ) := by
  intro d
  constructor
  · intro hd
    have hd₀ : projection φ d.val = 0 := (initialProjection_apply φ d).symm.trans hd
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := (_root_.AsymptoticMorphism.FullTimePullback.exact φ d.val).1 hd₀
    have hf₀ : f (⟨1, le_rfl⟩ : AsymptoticTime) = 0 := by
      calc
        f ⟨1, le_rfl⟩ = evaluation φ ⟨1, le_rfl⟩ (kernelInclusion φ f) :=
          (evaluation_kernelInclusion φ ⟨1, le_rfl⟩ f).symm
        _ = evaluation φ ⟨1, le_rfl⟩ d.val := congrArg (evaluation φ ⟨1, le_rfl⟩) hf
        _ = 0 := (mem_initialEvaluationIdeal φ d.val).1 d.property
    refine ⟨⟨f, (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.mem_vanishingAt _ _).2 hf₀⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hf
  · rintro ⟨f, rfl⟩
    exact initialProjection_actualKernelInclusion φ f

/-- Include the literal reciprocal suspension kernel in the anchored middle. -/
def initialSuspensionInclusion :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (AsymptoticAlgebra B) :=
      _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra B
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (InitialEvaluationKernel φ) :=
      ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra (initialEvaluationIdeal φ)
    C₀(Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, B) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] InitialEvaluationKernel φ := by
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra
      (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.vanishingAt (A := B)
        (⟨1, le_rfl⟩ : AsymptoticTime)).carrier :=
    ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra _
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (InitialEvaluationKernel φ) :=
    ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra (initialEvaluationIdeal φ)
  exact (actualKernelInclusion φ).comp (openIntervalKernelEquiv B).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom

/-- The ambient value is the original inclusion of the computed C0 suspension. -/
theorem initialSuspensionInclusion_val (f : C₀(Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, B)) :
    (initialSuspensionInclusion φ f).val =
      kernelInclusion φ (openIntervalKernelEquiv B f).val :=
  rfl

/-- The suspension inclusion has zero initial-time evaluation. -/
theorem initialSuspensionInclusion_one (f : C₀(Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, B)) :
    evaluation φ ⟨1, le_rfl⟩ (initialSuspensionInclusion φ f).val = 0 :=
  (mem_initialEvaluationIdeal φ _).1 (initialSuspensionInclusion φ f).property

/-- At every interior time its bounded coordinate is the literal value `f(1/t)`. -/
theorem initialSuspensionInclusion_apply_of_one_lt
    (f : C₀(Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, B)) {t : AsymptoticTime} (ht : 1 < (t : ℝ)) :
    evaluation φ t (initialSuspensionInclusion φ f).val =
      f ⟨1 / (t : ℝ),
        div_pos zero_lt_one (lt_trans zero_lt_one ht),
        (div_lt_one (lt_trans zero_lt_one ht)).2 ht⟩ := by
  rw [initialSuspensionInclusion_val, evaluation_kernelInclusion]
  exact openIntervalKernelEquiv_apply_of_one_lt B f ht

/-- The suspension inclusion is injective for zero and nonfaithful coefficient maps too. -/
theorem initialSuspensionInclusion_injective :
    Function.Injective (initialSuspensionInclusion φ) :=
  (actualKernelInclusion_injective φ).comp (openIntervalKernelEquiv B).injective

/-- The coefficient projection kills the suspension inclusion. -/
@[simp]
theorem initialProjection_initialSuspensionInclusion (f : C₀(Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, B)) :
    initialProjection φ (initialSuspensionInclusion φ f) = 0 :=
  initialProjection_actualKernelInclusion φ (openIntervalKernelEquiv B f)

/-- Exactness of the anchored sequence, using the actual suspension inverse. -/
theorem initialSuspensionInclusion_exact :
    Function.Exact (initialSuspensionInclusion φ) (initialProjection φ) := by
  intro d
  constructor
  · intro hd
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := (actualKernelInclusion_exact φ d).1 hd
    refine ⟨(openIntervalKernelEquiv B).symm f, ?_⟩
    change actualKernelInclusion φ
      (openIntervalKernelEquiv B ((openIntervalKernelEquiv B).symm f)) = d
    rw [(openIntervalKernelEquiv B).apply_symm_apply]
    exact hf
  · rintro ⟨f, rfl⟩
    exact initialProjection_initialSuspensionInclusion φ f

/-- Normalize the proved exact pair, retaining the actual anchored middle and norm. -/
def initialEvaluationExtension :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (AsymptoticAlgebra B) :=
      _root_.AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra B
    CStarExtension.{uA, uB, max uA uB} A C₀(Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, B) := by
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (InitialEvaluationKernel φ) :=
    ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra (initialEvaluationIdeal φ)
  exact CStarExtension.ofExact (initialSuspensionInclusion φ) (initialProjection φ)
    (initialSuspensionInclusion_injective φ) (initialProjection_surjective φ)
    (initialSuspensionInclusion_exact φ)

/-- Exact-pair normalization does not replace the anchored middle carrier. -/
theorem initialEvaluationExtension_middle :
    (initialEvaluationExtension φ).Middle = InitialEvaluationKernel φ :=
  rfl

/-- The normalized inclusion is the actual reciprocal suspension inclusion. -/
theorem initialEvaluationExtension_inclusion_apply (f : C₀(Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, B)) :
    (initialEvaluationExtension φ).inclusion f = initialSuspensionInclusion φ f := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (InitialEvaluationKernel φ) :=
    ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra (initialEvaluationIdeal φ)
  exact CStarExtension.ofExact_inclusion_apply (initialSuspensionInclusion φ)
    (initialProjection φ) (initialSuspensionInclusion_injective φ)
    (initialProjection_surjective φ) (initialSuspensionInclusion_exact φ) f

/-- The normalized quotient is the actual restricted coefficient projection. -/
theorem initialEvaluationExtension_quotient_apply (d : InitialEvaluationKernel φ) :
    (initialEvaluationExtension φ).quotient d = initialProjection φ d := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (InitialEvaluationKernel φ) :=
    ClosedStarIdeal.carrierCStarAlgebra (initialEvaluationIdeal φ)
  exact CStarExtension.ofExact_quotient_apply (initialSuspensionInclusion φ)
    (initialProjection φ) (initialSuspensionInclusion_injective φ)
    (initialProjection_surjective φ) (initialSuspensionInclusion_exact φ) d

end AnchoredPullback

end AsymptoticMorphism.FullTimePullback

Author: @toskua
