module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.AsymptoticAlgebraFunctor

public import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.EqToHom

/-!
# Finite iterates of the actual asymptotic quotient

The object recursion uses the reducible `asymptoticAlgebraObject`, never the
functor's record body. Direct maps retain independent universes.  Stage
offset composition exposes its natural-number reassociation transport.

`alphaRepresentative` applies the asymptotic quotient functor to a homomorphism
into a finite iterate. Its codomain is the literal successor quotient. This
file defines no homotopy quotient or class-level transition map.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CategoryTheory
open scoped BoundedContinuousFunction

noncomputable section

universe u uA uB uC

attribute [local instance] AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra

namespace NonUnitalCStarAlgCat

/-- Canonical finite iteration of the lightweight literal quotient object. -/
abbrev iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject
    (n : ℕ) (A : NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u}) :
    NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u} :=
  Nat.rec A (fun _ B => asymptoticAlgebraObject B) n

theorem iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject_zero
    (A : NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u}) :
    iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject 0 A = A := by
  rfl

theorem iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject_succ
    (n : ℕ) (A : NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u}) :
    iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject (n + 1) A =
      asymptoticAlgebraObject (iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject n A) := by
  rfl

/-- Iterating the stored asymptotic-algebra object `n` times after `m`
times is the stored object at summed stage `n + m`. -/
theorem iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject_add (n m : ℕ)
    (C : NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u}) :
    iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject n
        (iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject m C) =
      iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject (n + m) C := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      exact
        (iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject_zero
          (iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject m C)).trans
        (congrArg (fun k => iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject k C)
          (Nat.zero_add m).symm)
  | succ n ih =>
      change
        asymptoticAlgebraObject
            (iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject n
              (iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject m C)) =
          iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject (Nat.succ n + m) C
      rw [ih, Nat.succ_add]

end NonUnitalCStarAlgCat

/-- Literal carrier of the nth finite iterate, with its exact stored quotient
C-star dictionary. -/
abbrev IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra
    (n : ℕ) (A : Type u) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] : Type u :=
  (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject n
    (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of A)).carrier

theorem iteratedAsymptoticAlgebra_zero
    (A : Type u) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra 0 A = A := by
  rfl

theorem iteratedAsymptoticAlgebra_succ
    (n : ℕ) (A : Type u) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra (n + 1) A =
      AsymptoticAlgebra (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A) := by
  rfl

namespace NonUnitalCStarAlgCat

/-- Rebundling an iterated carrier with its inferred canonical dictionary
recovers the stored iterated category object. -/
theorem of_iteratedAsymptoticAlgebra (n : ℕ)
    (C : Type u) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C] :
    of (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n C) =
      iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject n (of C) := by
  rfl

end NonUnitalCStarAlgCat

namespace IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra

/-! ## Canonical summed-stage transport -/

/-- The dictionary-safe equality morphism from nested finite iteration to the
literal summed stage. -/
@[no_expose]
def iteratedAddHom (n m : ℕ)
    (C : Type uC) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C] :
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra m C) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra (n + m) C := by
  change
    (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject n
        (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject m
          (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C))) ⟶
      NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject (n + m)
        (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C)
  exact eqToHom
    (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject_add n m
      (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C))

private theorem iteratedAddHom_eq_eqToHom (n m : ℕ)
    (C : Type uC) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C] :
    (iteratedAddHom n m C :
      (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject n
        (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject m
          (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C))) ⟶
      NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject (n + m)
        (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C)) =
      eqToHom
        (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject_add n m
          (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C)) := by
  rfl

theorem iteratedAddHom_zero_left (m : ℕ)
    (C : Type uC) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C] :
    eqToHom
        (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject_zero
          (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject m
            (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C))).symm ≫
      (iteratedAddHom 0 m C :
        (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject 0
          (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject m
            (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C))) ⟶
        NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject (0 + m)
          (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C)) =
      eqToHom
        (congrArg
          (fun k => NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject k
            (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C))
          (Nat.zero_add m)).symm := by
  simp only [iteratedAddHom_eq_eqToHom, eqToHom_trans]

theorem iteratedAddHom_zero_right (n : ℕ)
    (C : Type uC) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C] :
    iteratedAddHom n 0 C =
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n C) := by
  change
    (eqToHom
      (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject_add n 0
        (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C)) :
      NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject n
          (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C) ⟶
        NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject n
          (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C)) = 𝟙 _
  exact eqToHom_refl _ _

/-- Independent-universe map on finite iterates. -/
@[no_expose]
def map (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n B :=
  Nat.rec (motive := fun k =>
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra k A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
        IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra k B)
    φ (fun _ ψ => AsymptoticAlgebra.map ψ) n

@[simp]
theorem map_zero_stage
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) : map 0 φ = φ := by
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem map_succ
    (n : ℕ) {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    map (n + 1) φ = AsymptoticAlgebra.map (map n φ) := by
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem map_id (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    map n (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ A) =
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [map_succ, ih, AsymptoticAlgebra.map_id]

@[simp]
theorem map_zero (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    map n (0 : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) = 0 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [map_succ, ih, AsymptoticAlgebra.map_zero]

/-- Finite alpha iteration respects composition across independent universes. -/
theorem map_comp (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) (ψ : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    map n (ψ.comp φ) = (map n ψ).comp (map n φ) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [map_succ, map_succ, map_succ, ih, AsymptoticAlgebra.map_comp]

/-- Natural constant inclusion from one finite stage to its successor. -/
@[no_expose]
def stageHom (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra (n + 1) A :=
  AsymptoticAlgebra.constantHom (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A)

/-- The successor map is exactly the actual constant-class hom. -/
theorem stageHom_eq_constantHom (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    stageHom n A =
      AsymptoticAlgebra.constantHom (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A) := by
  rfl

theorem stageHom_apply (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
    (x : IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A) :
    stageHom n A x =
      AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A)
        (BoundedContinuousFunction.const AsymptoticTime x) := by
  rw [stageHom_eq_constantHom, AsymptoticAlgebra.constantHom_apply]

theorem stageHom_injective (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    Function.Injective (stageHom n A) := by
  rw [stageHom_eq_constantHom]
  exact AsymptoticAlgebra.constantHom_injective
    (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A)

/-- The successor square commutes for maps between unrelated universes. -/
theorem stageHom_naturality (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    (map (n + 1) φ).comp (stageHom n A) =
      (stageHom n B).comp (map n φ) := by
  rw [map_succ, stageHom_eq_constantHom, stageHom_eq_constantHom]
  exact AsymptoticAlgebra.map_comp_constantHom (map n φ)

/-- Computational stage change by an offset. -/
@[no_expose]
def stageMapFrom (n k : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra (n + k) A :=
  Nat.rec (motive := fun j =>
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
        IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra (n + j) A)
    (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A))
    (fun j h => (stageHom (n + j) A).comp h) k

@[simp]
theorem stageMapFrom_zero (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    stageMapFrom n 0 A =
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A) := by
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem stageMapFrom_succ (n k : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    stageMapFrom n (k + 1) A =
      (stageHom (n + k) A).comp (stageMapFrom n k A) := by
  rfl

theorem stageMapFrom_one (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    stageMapFrom n 1 A = stageHom n A := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro x
  rfl

theorem stageMapFrom_injective (n k : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    Function.Injective (stageMapFrom n k A) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact Function.injective_id
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [stageMapFrom_succ]
      exact (stageHom_injective (n + k) A).comp ih

/-- Every finite stage change is natural in the coefficient algebra. -/
theorem stageMapFrom_naturality (n k : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    (map (n + k) φ).comp (stageMapFrom n k A) =
      (stageMapFrom n k B).comp (map n φ) := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
      intro x
      rfl
  | succ k ih =>
      apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
      intro x
      rw [stageMapFrom_succ, stageMapFrom_succ,
        NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply,
        NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply]
      calc
        map (n + (k + 1)) φ
            (stageHom (n + k) A (stageMapFrom n k A x)) =
          stageHom (n + k) B
            (map (n + k) φ (stageMapFrom n k A x)) :=
          DFunLike.congr_fun (stageHom_naturality (n + k) φ)
            (stageMapFrom n k A x)
        _ = stageHom (n + k) B
            (stageMapFrom n k B (map n φ x)) :=
          congrArg (stageHom (n + k) B) (DFunLike.congr_fun ih x)

private def castTarget (n : ℕ) {m m' : ℕ}
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
    (h : m = m')
    (F : IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra m' A) :
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra m A := by
  cases h
  exact F

private theorem castTarget_eq_cast (n : ℕ) {m m' : ℕ}
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] (h : m = m')
    (F : IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra m' A) :
    castTarget n A h F =
      cast
        (congrArg
          (fun k => IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
            IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra k A) h.symm) F := by
  cases h
  rfl

private theorem castTarget_stageHom (n : ℕ) {m m' : ℕ}
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
    (h : m = m')
    (F : IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra m' A) :
    castTarget n A (congrArg Nat.succ h)
        ((stageHom m' A).comp F) =
      (stageHom m A).comp (castTarget n A h F) := by
  cases h
  rfl

/-- Explicit transport of the direct `(k+l)`-offset map to the
left-associated target `(n+k)+l`. -/
@[no_expose]
def stageMapFromReassoc (n k l : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra ((n + k) + l) A :=
  castTarget n A (Nat.add_assoc n k l) (stageMapFrom n (k + l) A)

/-- The reassociated stage map is exactly the direct offset map transported
along natural-number addition associativity. -/
theorem stageMapFromReassoc_eq_cast (n k l : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    stageMapFromReassoc n k l A =
      cast
        (congrArg
          (fun m =>
            IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
              IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra m A)
          (Nat.add_assoc n k l).symm)
        (stageMapFrom n (k + l) A) := by
  exact castTarget_eq_cast n A (Nat.add_assoc n k l)
    (stageMapFrom n (k + l) A)

private theorem stageMapFromReassoc_succ (n k l : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    stageMapFromReassoc n k (l + 1) A =
      (stageHom ((n + k) + l) A).comp
        (stageMapFromReassoc n k l A) := by
  unfold stageMapFromReassoc
  have hstep :
      stageMapFrom n (k + (l + 1)) A =
        (stageHom (n + (k + l)) A).comp (stageMapFrom n (k + l) A) :=
    stageMapFrom_succ n (k + l) A
  calc
    castTarget n A (Nat.add_assoc n k (l + 1))
        (stageMapFrom n (k + (l + 1)) A) =
      castTarget n A (Nat.add_assoc n k (l + 1))
        ((stageHom (n + (k + l)) A).comp (stageMapFrom n (k + l) A)) :=
      congrArg (castTarget n A (Nat.add_assoc n k (l + 1))) hstep
    _ = (stageHom ((n + k) + l) A).comp
        (castTarget n A (Nat.add_assoc n k l) (stageMapFrom n (k + l) A)) :=
      castTarget_stageHom n A (Nat.add_assoc n k l)
        (stageMapFrom n (k + l) A)

/-- Offset addition computes composition, with the target reassociation made
explicit by `stageMapFromReassoc`. -/
theorem stageMapFrom_add (n k l : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    stageMapFromReassoc n k l A =
      (stageMapFrom (n + k) l A).comp (stageMapFrom n k A) := by
  induction l with
  | zero =>
      apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
      intro x
      rfl
  | succ l ih =>
      rw [stageMapFromReassoc_succ, stageMapFrom_succ, ih,
        NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc]

end IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra

namespace NonUnitalCStarAlgCat

/-- Lightweight same-universe categorical packaging of the opaque direct iterated map. -/
def iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraFunctor (n : ℕ) :
    NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u} ⥤ NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u} where
  obj := iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject n
  map φ := IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n φ
  map_id A := IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_id n A
  map_comp φ ψ := IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_comp n φ ψ

/-- The categorical map is exactly the independent-universe direct map at
the same object universe. -/
theorem iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraFunctor_map (n : ℕ)
    {A B : NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u}} (φ : A ⟶ B) :
    (iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraFunctor n).map φ =
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n φ := by
  rfl

/-- Successor inclusions as a same-universe natural transformation. -/
@[no_expose]
def stageNatTrans (n : ℕ) :
    NatTrans (iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraFunctor n)
      (iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraFunctor (n + 1)) where
  app A := IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.stageHom n A
  naturality {_A _B} φ :=
    (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.stageHom_naturality n φ).symm

theorem stageNatTrans_app (n : ℕ)
    (A : NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.{u}) :
    (stageNatTrans n).app A = IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.stageHom n A := by
  rfl

end NonUnitalCStarAlgCat

namespace IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra

/-- Representatives before any homotopy quotient. -/
abbrev HomN (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :=
  A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n B

/-- Literal application of alpha to a representative.  Its codomain is
shown without a class-index reinterpretation. -/
@[no_expose]
def alphaRepresentative (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ : HomN n A B) :
    AsymptoticAlgebra A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      AsymptoticAlgebra (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n B) :=
  AsymptoticAlgebra.map φ

theorem alphaRepresentative_eq (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ : HomN n A B) :
    alphaRepresentative n φ = AsymptoticAlgebra.map φ := by
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem alphaRepresentative_quotientMap (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ : HomN n A B) (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ A) :
    alphaRepresentative n φ (AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap A f) =
      AsymptoticAlgebra.quotientMap (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n B)
        (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom φ f) := by
  exact AsymptoticAlgebra.map_quotientMap φ f

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.IteratedSplitPullback
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing

/-!
# Matching paths after finite alpha iteration

The carrier is the literal pullback of the iterated endpoint maps on
`alpha^n C([0,1], B)`.  The gluing homomorphism is obtained from the actual
base gluing map and the proved iterated split-pullback equivalence.

This file contains data and endpoint laws only. It defines no homotopy
relation, Setoid, class, stage transition, product, direct limit, flattening,
or alpha/continuous-map comparison.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace AsymptoticAlgebra

universe uB uX uY uZ

attribute [local instance] cStarAlgebra

/-- The endpoint map on the nth literal alpha iterate of the interval
coefficient algebra. -/
@[no_expose]
def endpointHom (n : ℕ) (t : unitInterval)
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n C(unitInterval, B) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n B :=
  IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n
    (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B t)

/-- The iterated endpoint map is the direct finite-alpha map of evaluation. -/
theorem endpointHom_eq (n : ℕ) (t : unitInterval)
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    endpointHom n t B =
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n
        (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B t) := by
  rfl

/-- Literal matching paths at stage n. -/
abbrev IteratedMatchingPaths (n : ℕ)
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :=
  NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback
    (endpointHom n 1 B) (endpointHom n 0 B)

private theorem evalAt_zero_comp_constantHom
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 0).comp
        (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.constantHom B) =
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ B := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro b
  rfl

/-- Iterating alpha carries the actual base matching-path pullback to the
literal pullback of the iterated endpoint maps. -/
@[no_expose]
noncomputable def iteratedMatchingPathsEquiv (n : ℕ)
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n
        (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.MatchingPaths B) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ]
      IteratedMatchingPaths n B :=
  iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv n
    (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 1)
    (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 0)
    (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.constantHom B)
    (evalAt_zero_comp_constantHom B)

/-- Genuine iterated matching-path gluing into
`alpha^n C([0,1], B)`. -/
@[no_expose]
noncomputable def glueHomN (n : ℕ)
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    IteratedMatchingPaths n B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n C(unitInterval, B) :=
  (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n
    (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.glueHom (B := B))).comp
      (iteratedMatchingPathsEquiv n B).symm.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom

private theorem evalAt_zero_comp_glueHom
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 0).comp
        (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.glueHom (B := B)) =
      (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 0).comp
        (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom
          (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 1)
          (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 0)) := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro p
  change ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.glueHom p 0 = p.1.1 0
  exact ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.glueHom_zero p

private theorem evalAt_one_comp_glueHom
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 1).comp
        (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.glueHom (B := B)) =
      (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 1).comp
        (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom
          (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 1)
          (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 0)) := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro p
  change ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.glueHom p 1 = p.1.2 1
  exact ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.glueHom_one p

private theorem comp_symm_eq_of_comp_eq
    {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} {Z : Type uZ}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra X] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra Y]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra Z]
    (e : X ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] Y) (p : Y →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] Z) (q : X →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] Z)
    (h : p.comp e.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom = q) :
    q.comp e.symm.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom = p := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro y
  change q (e.symm y) = p y
  have hy := DFunLike.congr_fun h (e.symm y)
  change p (e (e.symm y)) = q (e.symm y) at hy
  exact hy.symm.trans (congrArg p (e.apply_symm_apply y))

private theorem map_fst_comp_matchingEquiv_symm (n : ℕ)
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n
      (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom
        (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 1)
        (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 0))).comp
        (iteratedMatchingPathsEquiv n B).symm.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom =
      NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom
        (endpointHom n 1 B) (endpointHom n 0 B) := by
  exact comp_symm_eq_of_comp_eq
    (iteratedMatchingPathsEquiv n B)
    (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom
      (endpointHom n 1 B) (endpointHom n 0 B))
    (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n
      (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom
        (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 1)
        (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 0)))
    (fstHom_comp_iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv n
      (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 1)
      (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 0)
      (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.constantHom B)
      (evalAt_zero_comp_constantHom B))

private theorem map_snd_comp_matchingEquiv_symm (n : ℕ)
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n
      (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom
        (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 1)
        (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 0))).comp
        (iteratedMatchingPathsEquiv n B).symm.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom =
      NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom
        (endpointHom n 1 B) (endpointHom n 0 B) := by
  exact comp_symm_eq_of_comp_eq
    (iteratedMatchingPathsEquiv n B)
    (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom
      (endpointHom n 1 B) (endpointHom n 0 B))
    (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n
      (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom
        (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 1)
        (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 0)))
    (sndHom_comp_iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv n
      (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 1)
      (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 0)
      (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.constantHom B)
      (evalAt_zero_comp_constantHom B))

/-- Evaluation at zero after iterated gluing is evaluation at zero on the
first matching path. -/
theorem endpointHom_zero_comp_glueHomN (n : ℕ)
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (endpointHom n 0 B).comp (glueHomN n B) =
      (endpointHom n 0 B).comp
        (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom
          (endpointHom n 1 B) (endpointHom n 0 B)) := by
  unfold endpointHom glueHomN
  rw [← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc,
    ← IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_comp,
    evalAt_zero_comp_glueHom,
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_comp,
    NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc,
    map_fst_comp_matchingEquiv_symm]
  rfl

/-- Evaluation at one after iterated gluing is evaluation at one on the
second matching path. -/
theorem endpointHom_one_comp_glueHomN (n : ℕ)
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (endpointHom n 1 B).comp (glueHomN n B) =
      (endpointHom n 1 B).comp
        (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom
          (endpointHom n 1 B) (endpointHom n 0 B)) := by
  unfold endpointHom glueHomN
  rw [← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc,
    ← IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_comp,
    evalAt_one_comp_glueHom,
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_comp,
    NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc,
    map_snd_comp_matchingEquiv_symm]
  rfl

#print axioms endpointHom
#print axioms iteratedMatchingPathsEquiv
#print axioms glueHomN
#print axioms endpointHom_zero_comp_glueHomN
#print axioms endpointHom_one_comp_glueHomN

end AsymptoticAlgebra

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.SplitPullback
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.IteratedAlgebra

/-!
# Finite iteration of split-pullback preservation

A star-homomorphic section of one cospan leg is carried through every finite
iterate of the literal asymptotic algebra.  The resulting equivalence has the
expected two coordinate maps.

This file contains only the iterated equivalence and its projection laws.
It does not define paths, gluing, n-homotopy, classes, products, or limits.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace AsymptoticAlgebra

universe uA uB uC uX uY

attribute [local instance] cStarAlgebra

private noncomputable def alphaEquiv
    {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra X] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra Y]
    (e : X ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] Y) :
    AsymptoticAlgebra X ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra Y := by
  let f : X →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] Y := e.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
  let g : Y →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] X := e.symm.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
  have hgf : g.comp f = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ X := by
    apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
    intro x
    exact e.symm_apply_apply x
  have hfg : f.comp g = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ Y := by
    apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
    intro y
    exact e.apply_symm_apply y
  have hGF :
      (map g).comp (map f) =
        NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ (AsymptoticAlgebra X) := by
    calc
      (map g).comp (map f) = map (g.comp f) := (map_comp f g).symm
      _ = map (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ X) :=
        congrArg (fun h : X →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] X => map h) hgf
      _ = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ (AsymptoticAlgebra X) := map_id X
  have hFG :
      (map f).comp (map g) =
        NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ (AsymptoticAlgebra Y) := by
    calc
      (map f).comp (map g) = map (f.comp g) := (map_comp g f).symm
      _ = map (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ Y) :=
        congrArg (fun h : Y →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] Y => map h) hfg
      _ = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ (AsymptoticAlgebra Y) := map_id Y
  exact StarAlgEquiv.ofNonUnitalStarAlgHom (map f) (map g) hGF hFG

private theorem alphaEquiv_toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra X] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra Y]
    (e : X ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] Y) :
    (alphaEquiv e).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom =
      map e.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom := by
  rfl

private theorem iteratedMap_rightInverse
    (n : ℕ)
    {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (s : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hs : g.comp s = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ C) :
    (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n g).comp
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n s) =
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n C) := by
  calc
    _ = IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n (g.comp s) :=
      (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_comp n s g).symm
    _ = IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n
        (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ C) :=
      congrArg
        (fun h : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C =>
          IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n h) hs
    _ = _ := IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_id n C

/- Transport a literal pullback when both cospan legs are propositionally
equal. Cases on the equalities transport the pullback carrier together with
its inherited C-star dictionary. -/
private noncomputable def pullbackEquivOfEq
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (f₀ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g₀ : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (f₁ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g₁ : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (hf : f₀ = f₁) (hg : g₀ = g₁) :
    NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f₀ g₀ ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ]
      NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f₁ g₁ := by
  cases hf
  cases hg
  exact StarAlgEquiv.refl ℂ _

private theorem fstHom_comp_pullbackEquivOfEq
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (f₀ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g₀ : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (f₁ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g₁ : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (hf : f₀ = f₁) (hg : g₀ = g₁) :
    (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f₁ g₁).comp
        (pullbackEquivOfEq f₀ g₀ f₁ g₁ hf hg).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom =
      NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f₀ g₀ := by
  cases hf
  cases hg
  rfl

private theorem sndHom_comp_pullbackEquivOfEq
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (f₀ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g₀ : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (f₁ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g₁ : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (hf : f₀ = f₁) (hg : g₀ = g₁) :
    (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f₁ g₁).comp
        (pullbackEquivOfEq f₀ g₀ f₁ g₁ hf hg).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom =
      NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f₀ g₀ := by
  cases hf
  cases hg
  rfl

/-- Every finite alpha iterate preserves a pullback whose right leg has a
star-homomorphic section. -/
@[no_expose]
noncomputable def iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv
    (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (s : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hs : g.comp s = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ C) :
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n
        (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ]
      NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n f)
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n g) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      exact pullbackEquivOfEq f g
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map 0 f)
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map 0 g)
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_zero_stage f).symm
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_zero_stage g).symm
  | succ n ih =>
      let eStep := (alphaEquiv ih).trans
        (splitPullbackEquiv
          (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n f)
          (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n g)
          (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n s)
          (iteratedMap_rightInverse n g s hs))
      exact eStep.trans <| pullbackEquivOfEq
        (map (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n f))
        (map (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n g))
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map (n + 1) f)
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map (n + 1) g)
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_succ n f).symm
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_succ n g).symm

private theorem iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv_zero
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (s : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hs : g.comp s = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ C) :
    iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv 0 f g s hs =
      pullbackEquivOfEq f g
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map 0 f)
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map 0 g)
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_zero_stage f).symm
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_zero_stage g).symm := by
  rfl

private theorem iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv_succ
    (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (s : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hs : g.comp s = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ C) :
    iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv (n + 1) f g s hs =
      (((alphaEquiv (iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv n f g s hs)).trans
        (splitPullbackEquiv
          (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n f)
          (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n g)
          (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n s)
          (iteratedMap_rightInverse n g s hs))).trans
        (pullbackEquivOfEq
          (map (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n f))
          (map (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n g))
          (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map (n + 1) f)
          (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map (n + 1) g)
          (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_succ n f).symm
          (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_succ n g).symm)) := by
  rfl

theorem fstHom_comp_iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv
    (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (s : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hs : g.comp s = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ C) :
    (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n f)
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n g)).comp
      (iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv n f g s hs).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom =
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n
      (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f g) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv_zero,
        fstHom_comp_pullbackEquivOfEq,
        IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_zero_stage]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv_succ,
        ← StarAlgEquiv.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom_comp,
        ← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc,
        fstHom_comp_pullbackEquivOfEq,
        ← StarAlgEquiv.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom_comp,
        ← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc,
        fstHom_comp_splitPullbackEquiv,
        alphaEquiv_toNonUnitalStarAlgHom,
        ← map_comp, ih]
      exact (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_succ n
        (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f g)).symm

theorem sndHom_comp_iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv
    (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (s : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hs : g.comp s = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ C) :
    (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n f)
        (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n g)).comp
      (iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv n f g s hs).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom =
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n
      (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f g) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv_zero,
        sndHom_comp_pullbackEquivOfEq,
        IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_zero_stage]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv_succ,
        ← StarAlgEquiv.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom_comp,
        ← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc,
        sndHom_comp_pullbackEquivOfEq,
        ← StarAlgEquiv.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom_comp,
        ← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc,
        sndHom_comp_splitPullbackEquiv,
        alphaEquiv_toNonUnitalStarAlgHom,
        ← map_comp, ih]
      exact (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_succ n
        (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f g)).symm

#print axioms iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv
#print axioms fstHom_comp_iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv
#print axioms sndHom_comp_iteratedSplitPullbackEquiv

end AsymptoticAlgebra

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.NClassFunctoriality

/-!
# Naturality and stage compatibility of literal alpha-next classes

The unambiguous alpha-next map is natural under source precomposition and
coefficient postcomposition. Precomposing it by the constant-class inclusion
of the source recovers the ordinary one-step stage transition.

This is finite-stage class data only. It does not construct the disputed
printed target, a path/alpha comparison, a direct-limit map, a class product,
flattening, or an E-theory operation.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra

attribute [local instance] AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra

namespace IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra

universe uA uA' uB uC

/-! ## Naturality in the source -/

/-- Applying literal alpha commutes with source precomposition. -/
theorem alphaNextRepresentative_precomp (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {A' : Type uA'} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A']
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (u : A' →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (phi : HomN n A B) :
    alphaNextRepresentative n (precompRepresentative n u phi) =
      precompRepresentative (n + 1) (AsymptoticAlgebra.map u)
        (alphaNextRepresentative n phi) := by
  have hpre :
      precompRepresentative n u phi = phi.comp u := by
    apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
    intro a
    rw [precompRepresentative_apply,
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply]
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro x
  rw [hpre, precompRepresentative_apply,
    alphaNextRepresentative_eq, alphaRepresentative_eq,
    alphaNextRepresentative_eq, alphaRepresentative_eq]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (AsymptoticAlgebra.map_comp u phi) x

/-- Source naturality descends to literal finite-stage homotopy classes. -/
theorem alphaNextClass_precomp (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {A' : Type uA'} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A']
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (u : A' →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (q : NClasses n A B) :
    alphaNextClass n A' B (precompClass n u q) =
      precompClass (n + 1) (B := B) (AsymptoticAlgebra.map u)
        (alphaNextClass n A B q) := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro phi
  change alphaNextClass n A' B (precompClass n u (classOf n phi)) =
    precompClass (n + 1) (B := B) (AsymptoticAlgebra.map u)
      (alphaNextClass n A B (classOf n phi))
  rw [precompClass_classOf, alphaNextClass_classOf,
    alphaNextClass_classOf, precompClass_classOf,
    alphaNextRepresentative_precomp]

/-! ## Naturality in the coefficient -/

/-- Applying literal alpha commutes with coefficient postcomposition. -/
theorem alphaNextRepresentative_postcomp (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (phi : HomN n A B) :
    alphaNextRepresentative n (postcompRepresentative n g phi) =
      postcompRepresentative (n + 1) g
        (alphaNextRepresentative n phi) := by
  have hpost :
      postcompRepresentative n g phi = (map n g).comp phi := by
    apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
    intro a
    rw [postcompRepresentative_apply,
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply]
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro x
  rw [hpost, postcompRepresentative_apply,
    alphaNextRepresentative_eq, alphaRepresentative_eq,
    alphaNextRepresentative_eq, alphaRepresentative_eq,
    map_succ]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun
    (AsymptoticAlgebra.map_comp phi (map n g)) x

/-- Coefficient naturality descends to literal finite-stage homotopy classes. -/
theorem alphaNextClass_postcomp (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (q : NClasses n A B) :
    alphaNextClass n A C (postcompClass n g q) =
      postcompClass (n + 1) (A := AsymptoticAlgebra A) g
        (alphaNextClass n A B q) := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro phi
  change alphaNextClass n A C (postcompClass n g (classOf n phi)) =
    postcompClass (n + 1) (A := AsymptoticAlgebra A) g
      (alphaNextClass n A B (classOf n phi))
  rw [postcompClass_classOf, alphaNextClass_classOf,
    alphaNextClass_classOf, postcompClass_classOf,
    alphaNextRepresentative_postcomp]

/-! ## Compatibility with the ordinary stage transition -/

/-- Restricting literal alpha along the source constant-class inclusion is the
ordinary one-step representative transition. -/
theorem alphaNextRepresentative_precomp_constantHom (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (phi : HomN n A B) :
    precompRepresentative (n + 1) (AsymptoticAlgebra.constantHom A)
        (alphaNextRepresentative n phi) =
      stageTransitionRepresentative n phi := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro a
  rw [precompRepresentative_apply,
    alphaNextRepresentative_eq, alphaRepresentative_eq,
    stageTransitionRepresentative_apply,
    stageHom_eq_constantHom]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun
    (AsymptoticAlgebra.map_comp_constantHom phi) a

/-- The alpha-next class map restricts along source constants to the ordinary
one-step stage transition. This is the true finite-stage compatibility
triangle; no alpha/path comparison is assumed. -/
theorem precompClass_comp_alphaNextClass (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Function.comp
        (precompClass (n + 1) (B := B)
          (AsymptoticAlgebra.constantHom A))
        (alphaNextClass n A B) =
      stageTransition n A B := by
  funext q
  change
    precompClass (n + 1) (B := B)
        (AsymptoticAlgebra.constantHom A)
        (alphaNextClass n A B q) =
      stageTransition n A B q
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro phi
  change precompClass (n + 1) (B := B) (AsymptoticAlgebra.constantHom A)
    (alphaNextClass n A B (classOf n phi)) =
    stageTransition n A B (classOf n phi)
  rw [alphaNextClass_classOf, precompClass_classOf,
    stageTransition_classOf,
    alphaNextRepresentative_precomp_constantHom]

#print axioms alphaNextRepresentative_precomp
#print axioms alphaNextClass_precomp
#print axioms alphaNextRepresentative_postcomp
#print axioms alphaNextClass_postcomp
#print axioms alphaNextRepresentative_precomp_constantHom
#print axioms precompClass_comp_alphaNextClass

end IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import Mathlib.Order.DirectedInverseSystem
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.NClassStageTransition

/-!
# The raw direct limit of literal finite-stage homotopy classes

For a proof `h : i <= j`, the transition map is the already constructed
offset map by `j - i`, transported along `Nat.add_sub_of_le h`.  Its identity
and composition laws make the literal classes a genuine `DirectedSystem` of
types.  Mathlib's arbitrary-type `DirectLimit` then supplies the raw colimit,
its canonical stage maps, and its universal lift.

No additive, group, algebraic, or E-theory structure is placed on the
colimit.  In particular this file does not define products, flattening,
surjectivity, or the disputed shifted map in Blackadar 25.7.4.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra

attribute [local instance] AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra

namespace IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra

universe uA uB uC

/-! ## Explicit transport and proof-indexed stage maps -/

/-- Transport literal classes across an equality of finite stage indices. -/
def nClassesCast {n m : ℕ}
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (h : n = m) : NClasses n A B → NClasses m A B := by
  cases h
  exact id

@[simp]
theorem nClassesCast_rfl (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (q : NClasses n A B) :
    nClassesCast A B rfl q = q :=
  rfl


/- A generic stage equality can be eliminated before specializing to an
arithmetic index; this transports the actual class of the composed hom. -/
private theorem nClassesCast_classOf_comp_castTarget
    {i m m' : ℕ}
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (h : m = m')
    (F : IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra i B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra m B)
    (phi : HomN i A B) :
    nClassesCast A B h (classOf m (F.comp phi)) =
      classOf m'
        ((cast
          (congrArg
            (fun j => IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra i B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
              IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra j B) h) F).comp phi) := by
  cases h
  rfl

/- Equal offsets give the same transported transition after carrying both
target-equality proofs explicitly. Only independent equalities are eliminated. -/
private theorem nClassesCast_stageTransitionFrom_offset
    {i d d' j : ℕ}
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (hd : d = d') (h : i + d = j) (h' : i + d' = j)
    (q : NClasses i A B) :
    nClassesCast A B h (stageTransitionFrom i d A B q) =
      nClassesCast A B h' (stageTransitionFrom i d' A B q) := by
  cases hd
  have hh : h = h' := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  cases hh
  rfl

/-- The stage map attached to a proof `i <= j`.  Its computational offset is
literally `j-i`; the result is transported into stage `j` by
`Nat.add_sub_of_le`. -/
@[no_expose]
def stageTransitionLE
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) : NClasses i A B → NClasses j A B :=
  Function.comp
    (nClassesCast A B (Nat.add_sub_of_le h))
    (stageTransitionFrom i (j - i) A B)

@[simp]
theorem stageTransitionLE_classOf
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) (phi : HomN i A B) :
    stageTransitionLE A B h (classOf i phi) =
      nClassesCast A B (Nat.add_sub_of_le h)
        (classOf (i + (j - i))
          (stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom i (j - i) phi)) := by
  unfold stageTransitionLE Function.comp
  rw [stageTransitionFrom_classOf]

/-- For the canonical proof `i <= i+k`, the proof-indexed map is exactly the
offset map by `k`. -/
theorem stageTransitionLE_of_add (i k : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    stageTransitionLE A B (Nat.le_add_right i k) =
      stageTransitionFrom i k A B := by
  funext q
  unfold stageTransitionLE Function.comp
  calc
    nClassesCast A B (Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_add_right i k))
        (stageTransitionFrom i (i + k - i) A B q) =
      nClassesCast A B rfl (stageTransitionFrom i k A B q) :=
        nClassesCast_stageTransitionFrom_offset A B
          (Nat.add_sub_cancel_left i k)
          (Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_add_right i k)) rfl q
    _ = stageTransitionFrom i k A B q :=
      nClassesCast_rfl (i + k) A B _

private theorem nClassesCast_stageTransitionFrom_add (i k l : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (q : NClasses i A B) :
    nClassesCast A B (Nat.add_assoc i k l).symm
        (stageTransitionFrom i (k + l) A B q) =
      stageTransitionFromReassoc i k l A B q := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro phi
  change nClassesCast A B (Nat.add_assoc i k l).symm
    (stageTransitionFrom i (k + l) A B (classOf i phi)) =
    stageTransitionFromReassoc i k l A B (classOf i phi)
  rw [stageTransitionFrom_classOf,
    stageTransitionFromReassoc_classOf,
    stageMapFromReassoc_eq_cast]
  have hrepresentative :
      stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom i (k + l) phi =
        (stageMapFrom i (k + l) B).comp phi := by
    apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
    intro a
    rw [stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom_apply,
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply]
  rw [hrepresentative]
  exact nClassesCast_classOf_comp_castTarget A B
    (Nat.add_assoc i k l).symm
    (stageMapFrom i (k + l) B) phi

private theorem stageTransitionLE_of_add_add (i k l : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    stageTransitionLE A B
        ((Nat.le_add_right i k).trans (Nat.le_add_right (i + k) l)) =
      stageTransitionFromReassoc i k l A B := by
  funext q
  unfold stageTransitionLE Function.comp
  have hoff : ((i + k) + l) - i = k + l := by
    rw [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  calc
    nClassesCast A B
        (Nat.add_sub_of_le
          ((Nat.le_add_right i k).trans (Nat.le_add_right (i + k) l)))
        (stageTransitionFrom i (((i + k) + l) - i) A B q) =
      nClassesCast A B (Nat.add_assoc i k l).symm
        (stageTransitionFrom i (k + l) A B q) :=
          nClassesCast_stageTransitionFrom_offset A B hoff
            (Nat.add_sub_of_le
              ((Nat.le_add_right i k).trans
                (Nat.le_add_right (i + k) l)))
            (Nat.add_assoc i k l).symm q
    _ = stageTransitionFromReassoc i k l A B q :=
      nClassesCast_stageTransitionFrom_add i k l A B q

/-! ## Directed-system laws -/

/-- The proof-indexed stage maps form a directed system.  This dictionary is
ordinary public data, not a globally registered instance. -/
theorem nClassesDirectedSystem
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    DirectedSystem (fun n : ℕ => NClasses n A B)
      (fun _ _ h => stageTransitionLE A B h) where
  map_self {i} q := by
    have hproof : (le_rfl : i ≤ i) = Nat.le_add_right i 0 :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    calc
      stageTransitionLE A B le_rfl q =
          stageTransitionLE A B (Nat.le_add_right i 0) q :=
        congrArg (fun h : i ≤ i => stageTransitionLE A B h q) hproof
      _ = stageTransitionFrom i 0 A B q :=
        congrFun (stageTransitionLE_of_add i 0 A B) q
      _ = q :=
        congrFun (stageTransitionFrom_zero i A B) q
  map_map {k} {j} {i} hij hjk q := by
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hij
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hjk
    rw [stageTransitionLE_of_add i a A B,
      stageTransitionLE_of_add (i + a) b A B,
      stageTransitionLE_of_add_add i a b A B]
    exact (congrFun (stageTransitionFrom_add i a b A B) q).symm

/-! ## Raw direct limit and its universal maps -/

/-- The raw set-level direct limit of literal finite-stage homotopy classes.
It is Mathlib's arbitrary-type `DirectLimit`, not a new quotient model. -/
abbrev NClassesDirectLimit
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :=
  @DirectLimit ℕ inferInstance (fun n => NClasses n A B)
    (fun {i j} _ => NClasses i A B → NClasses j A B)
    (fun _ _ h => stageTransitionLE A B h)
    (fun {_ _} _ => { coe := id, coe_injective := Function.injective_id })
    (nClassesDirectedSystem A B) inferInstance

/-- The canonical map from one finite stage into the raw direct limit. -/
@[no_expose]
def nClassesDirectLimitOf
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (n : ℕ) : NClasses n A B → NClassesDirectLimit A B :=
  fun q => ⟦⟨n, q⟩⟧

/-- Canonical direct-limit maps identify a class with every later-stage
image. -/
theorem nClassesDirectLimitOf_transition
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) (q : NClasses i A B) :
    nClassesDirectLimitOf A B j (stageTransitionLE A B h q) =
      nClassesDirectLimitOf A B i q := by
  unfold nClassesDirectLimitOf
  exact @DirectLimit.mk_apply ℕ inferInstance (fun n => NClasses n A B)
    (fun {i j} _ => NClasses i A B → NClasses j A B)
    (fun _ _ h => stageTransitionLE A B h)
    (fun {_ _} _ => { coe := id, coe_injective := Function.injective_id })
    (nClassesDirectedSystem A B) inferInstance i j q h

/-- Lift compatible finite-stage functions out of the raw direct limit. The
codomain is an arbitrary `Sort`; no algebraic structure is required. -/
@[no_expose]
def nClassesDirectLimitLift
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    {C : Sort uC}
    (g : ∀ n, NClasses n A B → C)
    (hcompat : ∀ i j (h : i ≤ j) q,
      g i q = g j (stageTransitionLE A B h q)) :
    NClassesDirectLimit A B → C :=
  @DirectLimit.lift ℕ inferInstance (fun n => NClasses n A B)
    (fun {i j} _ => NClasses i A B → NClasses j A B)
    (fun _ _ h => stageTransitionLE A B h)
    (fun {_ _} _ => { coe := id, coe_injective := Function.injective_id })
    (nClassesDirectedSystem A B) inferInstance C g hcompat

@[simp]
theorem nClassesDirectLimitLift_of
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    {C : Sort uC}
    (g : ∀ n, NClasses n A B → C)
    (hcompat : ∀ i j (h : i ≤ j) q,
      g i q = g j (stageTransitionLE A B h q))
    (n : ℕ) (q : NClasses n A B) :
    nClassesDirectLimitLift A B g hcompat
        (nClassesDirectLimitOf A B n q) = g n q := by
  unfold nClassesDirectLimitLift nClassesDirectLimitOf
  rfl

#print axioms nClassesCast_rfl
#print axioms stageTransitionLE
#print axioms stageTransitionLE_classOf
#print axioms stageTransitionLE_of_add
#print axioms nClassesDirectedSystem
#print axioms NClassesDirectLimit
#print axioms nClassesDirectLimitOf
#print axioms nClassesDirectLimitOf_transition

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.NHomotopy
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap.Hom

/-!
# Functoriality of literal finite-stage homotopy classes

Literal `n`-homotopy classes are contravariant in the source and covariant in
the coefficient algebra. Applying alpha to a representative also gives a
canonical class at the next stage with source `alpha A` and the same
coefficient algebra `B`.

This module does not define the disputed printed map to
`[[alpha A, alpha B]]_(n+1)`, products, direct limits, or flattening.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra

attribute [local instance] AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra

namespace IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra

universe uA uA' uA'' uB uC uD

/-! ## Source precomposition -/

/-- Precompose a finite-stage representative in its source algebra. -/
def precompRepresentative (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {A' : Type uA'} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A']
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (u : A' →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (φ : HomN n A B) : HomN n A' B :=
  φ.comp u

@[simp]
theorem precompRepresentative_apply (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {A' : Type uA'} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A']
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (u : A' →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (φ : HomN n A B) (a : A') :
    precompRepresentative n u φ a = φ (u a) :=
  rfl

theorem precompRepresentative_id (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ : HomN n A B) :
    precompRepresentative n (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ A) φ = φ := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro a
  rfl

theorem precompRepresentative_comp (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {A' : Type uA'} {A'' : Type uA''} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A']
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A''] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (u : A' →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (v : A'' →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A')
    (φ : HomN n A B) :
    precompRepresentative n v (precompRepresentative n u φ) =
      precompRepresentative n (u.comp v) φ :=
  NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc φ u v

/-- Source precomposition preserves literal finite-stage homotopy. -/
theorem precompRepresentative_respects (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {A' : Type uA'} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A']
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (u : A' →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) {φ ψ : HomN n A B}
    (h : HomotopicN n φ ψ) :
    HomotopicN n (precompRepresentative n u φ)
      (precompRepresentative n u ψ) := by
  obtain ⟨H, h0, h1⟩ := h
  refine ⟨precompRepresentative n u H, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold precompRepresentative
    rw [← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc, h0]
  · unfold precompRepresentative
    rw [← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc, h1]

/-- Source precomposition on literal finite-stage homotopy classes. -/
def precompClass (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {A' : Type uA'} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A']
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (u : A' →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) : NClasses n A B → NClasses n A' B :=
  Quotient.map (precompRepresentative n u)
    (fun _ _ h => precompRepresentative_respects n u h)

@[simp]
theorem precompClass_classOf (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {A' : Type uA'} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A']
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (u : A' →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (φ : HomN n A B) :
    precompClass n u (classOf n φ) =
      classOf n (precompRepresentative n u φ) :=
  rfl

theorem precompClass_id (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    precompClass n (B := B) (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ A) =
      id := by
  funext q
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro φ
  change precompClass n (B := B) (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ A)
    (classOf n φ) = classOf n φ
  rw [precompClass_classOf, precompRepresentative_id]

theorem precompClass_comp (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {A' : Type uA'} {A'' : Type uA''} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A']
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A''] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (u : A' →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (v : A'' →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A')
    (q : NClasses n A B) :
    precompClass n v (precompClass n u q) =
      precompClass n (u.comp v) q := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro φ
  change precompClass n v (precompClass n u (classOf n φ)) =
    precompClass n (u.comp v) (classOf n φ)
  rw [precompClass_classOf, precompClass_classOf,
    precompClass_classOf, precompRepresentative_comp]

/-! ## Coefficient postcomposition -/

/-- Iterated endpoint evaluation is natural under pointwise coefficient
postcomposition. -/
theorem endpointHom_comp_postcompPathMap (n : ℕ) (t : unitInterval)
    {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n t C).comp
        (map n (ContinuousMap.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom unitInterval g)) =
      (map n g).comp (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n t B) := by
  have hbase :
      (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt C t).comp
          (ContinuousMap.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom unitInterval g) =
        g.comp (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B t) := by
    apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
    intro f
    rfl
  rw [AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom_eq,
    AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom_eq,
    ← map_comp, hbase, map_comp]

/-- Postcompose a finite-stage representative in its coefficient algebra. -/
def postcompRepresentative (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (φ : HomN n A B) : HomN n A C :=
  (map n g).comp φ

@[simp]
theorem postcompRepresentative_apply (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (φ : HomN n A B) (a : A) :
    postcompRepresentative n g φ a = map n g (φ a) :=
  rfl

theorem postcompRepresentative_id (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ : HomN n A B) :
    postcompRepresentative n (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ B) φ = φ := by
  unfold postcompRepresentative
  rw [map_id]
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro a
  rfl

theorem postcompRepresentative_comp (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra D]
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (h : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] D)
    (φ : HomN n A B) :
    postcompRepresentative n h (postcompRepresentative n g φ) =
      postcompRepresentative n (h.comp g) φ := by
  unfold postcompRepresentative
  calc
    (map n h).comp ((map n g).comp φ) =
        ((map n h).comp (map n g)).comp φ :=
      (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (map n (h.comp g)).comp φ :=
      congrArg (fun k => k.comp φ) (map_comp n g h).symm

/-- Coefficient postcomposition preserves literal finite-stage homotopy. -/
theorem postcompRepresentative_respects (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) {φ ψ : HomN n A B}
    (h : HomotopicN n φ ψ) :
    HomotopicN n (postcompRepresentative n g φ)
      (postcompRepresentative n g ψ) := by
  obtain ⟨H, h0, h1⟩ := h
  let gI : C(unitInterval, B) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C(unitInterval, C) :=
    ContinuousMap.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom unitInterval g
  refine ⟨(map n gI).comp H, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 0 C).comp ((map n gI).comp H) =
          ((AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 0 C).comp (map n gI)).comp H :=
        (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = ((map n g).comp (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 0 B)).comp H :=
        congrArg (fun k => k.comp H)
          (endpointHom_comp_postcompPathMap n 0 g)
      _ = (map n g).comp
          ((AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 0 B).comp H) :=
        NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc _ _ _
      _ = (map n g).comp φ := congrArg (fun k => (map n g).comp k) h0
      _ = postcompRepresentative n g φ := rfl
  · calc
      (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 1 C).comp ((map n gI).comp H) =
          ((AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 1 C).comp (map n gI)).comp H :=
        (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = ((map n g).comp (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 1 B)).comp H :=
        congrArg (fun k => k.comp H)
          (endpointHom_comp_postcompPathMap n 1 g)
      _ = (map n g).comp
          ((AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 1 B).comp H) :=
        NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc _ _ _
      _ = (map n g).comp ψ := congrArg (fun k => (map n g).comp k) h1
      _ = postcompRepresentative n g ψ := rfl

/-- Coefficient postcomposition on literal finite-stage homotopy classes. -/
def postcompClass (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) : NClasses n A B → NClasses n A C :=
  Quotient.map (postcompRepresentative n g)
    (fun _ _ h => postcompRepresentative_respects n g h)

@[simp]
theorem postcompClass_classOf (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (φ : HomN n A B) :
    postcompClass n g (classOf n φ) =
      classOf n (postcompRepresentative n g φ) :=
  rfl

theorem postcompClass_id (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    postcompClass n (A := A) (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ B) =
      id := by
  funext q
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro φ
  change postcompClass n (A := A) (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ B)
    (classOf n φ) = classOf n φ
  rw [postcompClass_classOf, postcompRepresentative_id]

theorem postcompClass_comp (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra D]
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (h : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] D)
    (q : NClasses n A B) :
    postcompClass n h (postcompClass n g q) =
      postcompClass n (h.comp g) q := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro φ
  change postcompClass n h (postcompClass n g (classOf n φ)) =
    postcompClass n (h.comp g) (classOf n φ)
  rw [postcompClass_classOf, postcompClass_classOf,
    postcompClass_classOf, postcompRepresentative_comp]

/-! ## Literal alpha at the next stage -/

/-- Applying alpha to a representative, with its unambiguous next-stage
target and unchanged coefficient algebra. -/
def alphaNextRepresentative (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ : HomN n A B) :
    HomN (n + 1) (AsymptoticAlgebra A) B :=
  alphaRepresentative n φ

theorem alphaNextRepresentative_eq (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ : HomN n A B) :
    alphaNextRepresentative n φ = alphaRepresentative n φ :=
  rfl

/-- Iterated endpoint evaluation commutes with literal alpha on a
representative. -/
theorem endpointHom_comp_alphaNextRepresentative (n : ℕ)
    (t : unitInterval)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (H : HomN n A C(unitInterval, B)) :
    (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom (n + 1) t B).comp
        (alphaNextRepresentative n H) =
      alphaNextRepresentative n
        ((AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n t B).comp H) := by
  rw [alphaNextRepresentative_eq, alphaNextRepresentative_eq,
    alphaRepresentative_eq, alphaRepresentative_eq,
    AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom_eq,
    AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom_eq,
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map_succ]
  exact (AsymptoticAlgebra.map_comp H
    (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra.map n
      (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B t))).symm

/-- Literal alpha preserves finite-stage homotopy at its unambiguous target. -/
theorem alphaNextRepresentative_respects (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    {φ ψ : HomN n A B} (h : HomotopicN n φ ψ) :
    HomotopicN (n + 1) (alphaNextRepresentative n φ)
      (alphaNextRepresentative n ψ) := by
  obtain ⟨H, h0, h1⟩ := h
  refine ⟨alphaNextRepresentative n H, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [endpointHom_comp_alphaNextRepresentative, h0]
  · rw [endpointHom_comp_alphaNextRepresentative, h1]

/-- Literal alpha on finite-stage homotopy classes, targeting the next stage
with source `alpha A` and unchanged coefficient algebra `B`. -/
def alphaNextClass (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    NClasses n A B → NClasses (n + 1) (AsymptoticAlgebra A) B :=
  Quotient.map (alphaNextRepresentative n)
    (fun _ _ h => alphaNextRepresentative_respects n h)

@[simp]
theorem alphaNextClass_classOf (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ : HomN n A B) :
    alphaNextClass n A B (classOf n φ) =
      classOf (n + 1) (alphaNextRepresentative n φ) :=
  rfl

#print axioms precompClass
#print axioms postcompClass
#print axioms endpointHom_comp_postcompPathMap
#print axioms alphaNextRepresentative
#print axioms alphaNextRepresentative_respects
#print axioms alphaNextClass

end IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra

Author: @toskua
