module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.NHomotopy

/-!
# Arbitrary finite-stage maps on literal homotopy classes

The direct iterated map `stageMapFrom n k` sends an actual representative at
stage `n` to one at stage `n + k`.  Naturality with the two endpoint maps
transports a literal interval homotopy, so this map descends to the explicit
quotient `NClasses`.

The offset-addition law uses a separately named reassociated map.  Thus its
target is visibly `(n + k) + l`; no definitional identification of that stage
with `n + (k + l)` and no replacement relation are hidden in the API.

This file defines only finite-stage data.  It does not construct a direct
limit, product, flattening map, or E-theory class.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra

attribute [local instance] AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra

namespace IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra

universe uA uB

/-! ## Representative and quotient maps -/

/-- Include one representative by an arbitrary finite stage offset. -/
def stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom (n k : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (phi : HomN n A B) : HomN (n + k) A B :=
  (stageMapFrom n k B).comp phi

@[simp]
theorem stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom_apply (n k : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (phi : HomN n A B) (a : A) :
    stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom n k phi a =
      stageMapFrom n k B (phi a) :=
  rfl

/-- Every finite stage offset preserves the literal interval-homotopy
relation. -/
theorem stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom_respects (n k : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    {phi psi : HomN n A B} (h : HomotopicN n phi psi) :
    HomotopicN (n + k)
      (stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom n k phi)
      (stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom n k psi) := by
  obtain ⟨H, h0, h1⟩ := h
  have hnat (t : unitInterval) :
      (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom (n + k) t B).comp
          (stageMapFrom n k C(unitInterval, B)) =
        (stageMapFrom n k B).comp
          (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n t B) := by
    simpa only [AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom_eq] using
      stageMapFrom_naturality n k
        (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B t)
  refine ⟨(stageMapFrom n k C(unitInterval, B)).comp H, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom
    rw [← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc, hnat,
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc, h0]
  · unfold stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom
    rw [← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc, hnat,
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc, h1]

/-- The arbitrary finite-stage map on literal homotopy classes. -/
def stageTransitionFrom (n k : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    NClasses n A B → NClasses (n + k) A B :=
  Quotient.map (stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom n k)
    (fun _ _ h => stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom_respects n k h)

@[simp]
theorem stageTransitionFrom_classOf (n k : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (phi : HomN n A B) :
    stageTransitionFrom n k A B (classOf n phi) =
      classOf (n + k) (stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom n k phi) :=
  rfl

/-! ## Zero and one offsets -/

private theorem stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom_zero (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (phi : HomN n A B) :
    stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom n 0 phi = phi := by
  unfold stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom
  rw [stageMapFrom_zero]
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro a
  rfl

/-- Offset zero is the identity on literal homotopy classes. -/
theorem stageTransitionFrom_zero (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    stageTransitionFrom n 0 A B = id := by
  funext q
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro phi
  change stageTransitionFrom n 0 A B (classOf n phi) = classOf n phi
  rw [stageTransitionFrom_classOf, stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom_zero]
  rfl

private theorem stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom_one (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (phi : HomN n A B) :
    stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom n 1 phi =
      stageTransitionRepresentative n phi := by
  unfold stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom stageTransitionRepresentative
  rw [stageMapFrom_one]

/-- Offset one is the existing one-step constant-stage transition. -/
theorem stageTransitionFrom_one (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    stageTransitionFrom n 1 A B = stageTransition n A B := by
  funext q
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro phi
  change stageTransitionFrom n 1 A B (classOf n phi) =
    stageTransition n A B (classOf n phi)
  rw [stageTransitionFrom_classOf, stageTransition_classOf,
    stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom_one]

/-! ## Explicitly reassociated offset composition -/

/-- The direct `(k + l)`-offset map, with its class target transported to the
left-associated stage `(n + k) + l` by the already named representative map
`stageMapFromReassoc`. -/
def stageTransitionFromReassoc (n k l : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    NClasses n A B → NClasses ((n + k) + l) A B :=
  Quotient.map (sa := homotopicNSetoid n A B)
    (sb := homotopicNSetoid ((n + k) + l) A B)
    (fun phi => (stageMapFromReassoc n k l B).comp phi)
    (fun _ _ h => by
      change HomotopicN ((n + k) + l) _ _
      have hk := stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom_respects n k h
      have hkl := stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom_respects (n + k) l hk
      simpa only [stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom,
        stageMapFrom_add, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc] using hkl)

@[simp]
theorem stageTransitionFromReassoc_classOf (n k l : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (phi : HomN n A B) :
    stageTransitionFromReassoc n k l A B (classOf n phi) =
      classOf ((n + k) + l) ((stageMapFromReassoc n k l B).comp phi) :=
  rfl

/-- Offset addition is composition after making the target reassociation
explicit. -/
theorem stageTransitionFrom_add (n k l : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    stageTransitionFromReassoc n k l A B =
      Function.comp (stageTransitionFrom (n + k) l A B)
        (stageTransitionFrom n k A B) := by
  funext q
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro phi
  change
    stageTransitionFromReassoc n k l A B (classOf n phi) =
      stageTransitionFrom (n + k) l A B
        (stageTransitionFrom n k A B (classOf n phi))
  rw [stageTransitionFromReassoc_classOf,
    stageTransitionFrom_classOf, stageTransitionFrom_classOf,
    stageMapFrom_add, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc]
  rfl

#print axioms stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom
#print axioms stageTransitionRepresentativeFrom_respects
#print axioms stageTransitionFrom
#print axioms stageTransitionFrom_zero
#print axioms stageTransitionFrom_one
#print axioms stageTransitionFromReassoc
#print axioms stageTransitionFrom_add

end IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.IteratedAlgebra
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.IteratedMatchingPaths

/-!
# Literal finite-stage homotopy classes

Two representatives `A → α^n B` are `n`-homotopic when they are the two
actual iterated endpoint evaluations of one homomorphism
`A → α^n C([0,1], B)`. Constant paths, interval reversal, and genuine
matching-path gluing prove that this is an equivalence relation.

The explicit quotient and its constant-stage transition are data only. This
file defines no product, direct limit, flattening, E-theory class, or
comparison with ordinary asymptotic homotopy.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra

attribute [local instance] AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra

namespace IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra

universe uA uB

/-! ## Iterated constant paths and reversal -/

/-- Constant paths after applying the nth finite alpha iterate. -/
@[no_expose]
def constantPathHomN (n : ℕ)
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n C(unitInterval, B) :=
  map n (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.constantHom B)

/-- Interval reversal after applying the nth finite alpha iterate. -/
@[no_expose]
def reversePathHomN (n : ℕ)
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n C(unitInterval, B) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n C(unitInterval, B) :=
  map n (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.reverseHom B)

private theorem evalAt_comp_constantHom (t : unitInterval)
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B t).comp
        (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.constantHom B) =
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ B := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro b
  rfl

private theorem evalAt_zero_comp_reverseHom
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 0).comp
        (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.reverseHom B) =
      ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 1 := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro f
  exact ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.reverseHom_zero (B := B) f

private theorem evalAt_one_comp_reverseHom
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 1).comp
        (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.reverseHom B) =
      ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B 0 := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro f
  exact ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.reverseHom_one (B := B) f

@[simp]
theorem endpointHom_comp_constantPathHomN (n : ℕ) (t : unitInterval)
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n t B).comp (constantPathHomN n B) =
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ (IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra n B) := by
  unfold constantPathHomN
  rw [AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom_eq, ← map_comp,
    evalAt_comp_constantHom, map_id]

@[simp]
theorem endpointHom_zero_comp_reversePathHomN (n : ℕ)
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 0 B).comp (reversePathHomN n B) =
      AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 1 B := by
  unfold reversePathHomN
  rw [AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom_eq, ← map_comp,
    evalAt_zero_comp_reverseHom, ← AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom_eq]

@[simp]
theorem endpointHom_one_comp_reversePathHomN (n : ℕ)
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 1 B).comp (reversePathHomN n B) =
      AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 0 B := by
  unfold reversePathHomN
  rw [AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom_eq, ← map_comp,
    evalAt_one_comp_reverseHom, ← AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom_eq]

/-! ## The literal relation -/

/-- Literal `n`-homotopy of homomorphisms `A → α^n B`. -/
def HomotopicN (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ ψ : HomN n A B) : Prop :=
  ∃ H : HomN n A C(unitInterval, B),
    (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 0 B).comp H = φ ∧
      (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 1 B).comp H = ψ

namespace HomotopicN

variable {n : ℕ} {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

/-- Every representative is `n`-homotopic to itself. -/
theorem refl (φ : HomN n A B) : HomotopicN n φ φ := by
  refine ⟨(constantPathHomN n B).comp φ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc,
      endpointHom_comp_constantPathHomN]
    rfl
  · rw [← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc,
      endpointHom_comp_constantPathHomN]
    rfl

/-- Reversing the interval reverses an `n`-homotopy. -/
theorem symm {φ ψ : HomN n A B} (h : HomotopicN n φ ψ) :
    HomotopicN n ψ φ := by
  obtain ⟨H, h0, h1⟩ := h
  refine ⟨(reversePathHomN n B).comp H, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc,
      endpointHom_zero_comp_reversePathHomN]
    exact h1
  · rw [← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc,
      endpointHom_one_comp_reversePathHomN]
    exact h0

/-- Genuine matching-path gluing concatenates two `n`-homotopies. -/
theorem trans {φ ψ χ : HomN n A B}
    (hφψ : HomotopicN n φ ψ) (hψχ : HomotopicN n ψ χ) :
    HomotopicN n φ χ := by
  obtain ⟨H₀₁, h₀, h₁⟩ := hφψ
  obtain ⟨H₁₂, h₁', h₂⟩ := hψχ
  have hmatch :
      (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 1 B).comp H₀₁ =
        (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 0 B).comp H₁₂ :=
    h₁.trans h₁'.symm
  let P : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra.IteratedMatchingPaths n B :=
    NonUnitalCStarPullback.lift
      (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 1 B)
      (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n 0 B) H₀₁ H₁₂ hmatch
  refine ⟨(AsymptoticAlgebra.glueHomN n B).comp P, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp only [P]
    rw [← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc,
      AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom_zero_comp_glueHomN,
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc,
      NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom_comp_lift, h₀]
  · dsimp only [P]
    rw [← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc,
      AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom_one_comp_glueHomN,
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc,
      NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom_comp_lift, h₂]

end HomotopicN

/-! ## Explicit quotient data -/

/-- The explicit, non-global setoid of literal `n`-homotopy. -/
def homotopicNSetoid (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Setoid (HomN n A B) where
  r := HomotopicN n
  iseqv :=
    { refl := HomotopicN.refl
      symm := HomotopicN.symm
      trans := HomotopicN.trans }

/-- Literal `n`-homotopy classes. This is an explicit quotient, not a global
setoid instance. -/
def NClasses (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :=
  Quotient (homotopicNSetoid n A B)

/-- The class of one representative. -/
def classOf (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ : HomN n A B) : NClasses n A B :=
  Quotient.mk _ φ

/-! ## Constant-stage transition -/

/-- Include a representative into the next finite alpha stage. -/
def stageTransitionRepresentative (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ : HomN n A B) : HomN (n + 1) A B :=
  (stageHom n B).comp φ

theorem stageTransitionRepresentative_apply (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ : HomN n A B) (a : A) :
    stageTransitionRepresentative n φ a = stageHom n B (φ a) :=
  rfl

/-- Constant-stage inclusion preserves literal `n`-homotopy. -/
theorem stageTransitionRepresentative_respects (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    {φ ψ : HomN n A B} (h : HomotopicN n φ ψ) :
    HomotopicN (n + 1)
      (stageTransitionRepresentative n φ)
      (stageTransitionRepresentative n ψ) := by
  obtain ⟨H, h0, h1⟩ := h
  have hnat (t : unitInterval) :
      (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom (n + 1) t B).comp
          (stageHom n C(unitInterval, B)) =
        (stageHom n B).comp (AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom n t B) := by
    simpa only [AsymptoticAlgebra.endpointHom_eq] using
      stageHom_naturality n (ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing.evalAt B t)
  refine ⟨(stageHom n C(unitInterval, B)).comp H, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold stageTransitionRepresentative
    rw [← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc, hnat,
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc, h0]
  · unfold stageTransitionRepresentative
    rw [← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc, hnat,
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_assoc, h1]

/-- The constant-stage map on literal `n`-homotopy classes. Naturality in
the source and target algebras is separate future work. -/
def stageTransition (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    NClasses n A B → NClasses (n + 1) A B :=
  Quotient.map (stageTransitionRepresentative n)
    (fun _ _ h ↦ stageTransitionRepresentative_respects n h)

@[simp]
theorem stageTransition_classOf (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (φ : HomN n A B) :
    stageTransition n A B (classOf n φ) =
      classOf (n + 1) (stageTransitionRepresentative n φ) :=
  rfl

end IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra

/-
Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Basic

import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.MulAction
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Star
import Mathlib.Tactic.Abel

/-!
# Literal zero-normalization of asymptotic families

The original family need not send zero to zero at each finite time.
Subtract its actual zero orbit to obtain an exactly zero-preserving equivalent
family. All four asymptotic laws are proved directly from the original defects;
boundedness, B-infinity and unitization are NOT used.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

universe uA uB

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

/-- Subtract the actual vanishing zero orbit, preserving arbitrary nonlinear slices. -/
def normalize (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : AsymptoticMorphism A B := by
  let f : AsymptoticTime → A → B := fun t a => φ t a - φ t 0
  refine
    { toFun := f
      continuous_orbit := ?_
      add_defect_tendsto := ?_
      smul_defect_tendsto := ?_
      mul_defect_tendsto := ?_
      star_defect_tendsto := ?_ }
  · intro a
    change Continuous fun t => φ t a - φ t 0
    exact (φ.continuous_orbit a).fun_sub (φ.continuous_orbit 0)
  · intro a b
    have heq : (fun t => f t (a + b) - (f t a + f t b)) =
        (fun t => (φ t (a + b) - (φ t a + φ t b)) + φ t 0) := by
      funext t
      dsimp only [f]
      abel
    rw [heq]
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, zero_add] using (φ.add_defect_tendsto a b).add φ.zero_tendsto
  · intro z a
    have heq : (fun t => f t (z • a) - z • f t a) =
        (fun t => (φ t (z • a) - z • φ t a) - φ t 0 + z • φ t 0) := by
      funext t
      dsimp only [f]
      rw [smul_sub]
      abel
    rw [heq]
    have hz : Filter.Tendsto (fun t => z • φ t 0) Filter.atTop (nhds (z • (0 : B))) :=
      (tendsto_const_nhds :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : AsymptoticTime => z) Filter.atTop (nhds z)).smul
          φ.zero_tendsto
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, sub_zero, zero_add, smul_zero] using
      ((φ.smul_defect_tendsto z a).sub φ.zero_tendsto).add hz
  · intro a b
    have heq : (fun t => f t (a * b) - f t a * f t b) =
        (fun t =>
          (φ t (a * b) - φ t a * φ t b) -
          (φ t (a * 0) - φ t a * φ t 0) -
          (φ t (0 * b) - φ t 0 * φ t b) + φ t 0 - φ t 0 * φ t 0) := by
      funext t
      dsimp only [f]
      simp only [mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_mul, mul_sub]
      abel
    rw [heq]
    have hz := φ.zero_tendsto.mul φ.zero_tendsto
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, sub_zero, zero_add, zero_mul] using
      ((((φ.mul_defect_tendsto a b).sub (φ.mul_defect_tendsto a 0)).sub
        (φ.mul_defect_tendsto 0 b)).add φ.zero_tendsto).sub hz
  · intro a
    have heq : (fun t => f t (star a) - star (f t a)) =
        (fun t => (φ t (star a) - star (φ t a)) - φ t 0 + star (φ t 0)) := by
      funext t
      dsimp only [f]
      rw [star_sub]
      abel
    rw [heq]
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, sub_zero, zero_add, star_zero] using
      ((φ.star_defect_tendsto a).sub φ.zero_tendsto).add φ.zero_tendsto.star

/-- Public characteristic formula, not an assumed chosen normalized family. -/
@[simp]
theorem normalize_apply (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) : normalize φ t a = φ t a - φ t 0 := by
  rfl

/-- Exact zero holds for the newly defined family, not for every original family. -/
theorem normalize_zero (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (t : AsymptoticTime) :
    normalize φ t 0 = 0 := by
  rw [normalize_apply, sub_self]

/-- The defined normalized family is strictly equivalent to its original. -/
theorem normalize_strictlyEquivalent (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    StrictlyEquivalent (normalize φ) φ := by
  intro a
  have heq : (fun t => normalize φ t a - φ t a) = (fun t => -φ t 0) := by
    funext t
    rw [normalize_apply]
    abel
  rw [heq]
  simpa only [neg_zero] using φ.zero_tendsto.neg

end AsymptoticMorphism

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Basic

/-!
# Products of nonlinear asymptotic families

The product is formed on the actual product C-star algebra. Fixed-coefficient
time continuity and each of the four defect limits follow from the product
topology. Individual finite-time slices need not be homomorphisms.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
open scoped Topology
noncomputable section
namespace AsymptoticMorphism

universe uA uB uC
variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]

/-- Pair two actual nonlinear asymptotic families on their product coefficient algebra. -/
def prod (phi : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (psi : AsymptoticMorphism A C) :
    AsymptoticMorphism A (B × C) where
  toFun t a := (phi t a, psi t a)
  continuous_orbit a := (phi.continuous_orbit a).prodMk (psi.continuous_orbit a)
  add_defect_tendsto a b := by
    change Filter.Tendsto (fun t =>
      (phi t (a + b) - (phi t a + phi t b), psi t (a + b) - (psi t a + psi t b)))
      Filter.atTop (𝓝 ((0 : B), (0 : C)))
    exact (phi.add_defect_tendsto a b).prodMk_nhds (psi.add_defect_tendsto a b)
  smul_defect_tendsto z a := by
    change Filter.Tendsto (fun t =>
      (phi t (z • a) - z • phi t a, psi t (z • a) - z • psi t a))
      Filter.atTop (𝓝 ((0 : B), (0 : C)))
    exact (phi.smul_defect_tendsto z a).prodMk_nhds (psi.smul_defect_tendsto z a)
  mul_defect_tendsto a b := by
    change Filter.Tendsto (fun t =>
      (phi t (a * b) - phi t a * phi t b, psi t (a * b) - psi t a * psi t b))
      Filter.atTop (𝓝 ((0 : B), (0 : C)))
    exact (phi.mul_defect_tendsto a b).prodMk_nhds (psi.mul_defect_tendsto a b)
  star_defect_tendsto a := by
    change Filter.Tendsto (fun t => (phi t (star a) - star (phi t a), psi t (star a) - star (psi t a)))
      Filter.atTop (𝓝 ((0 : B), (0 : C)))
    exact (phi.star_defect_tendsto a).prodMk_nhds (psi.star_defect_tendsto a)

/-- The product retains both families' actual point values at every time and coefficient. -/
@[simp]
theorem prod_apply (phi : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (psi : AsymptoticMorphism A C)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) : prod phi psi t a = (phi t a, psi t a) := by
  rw [← AsymptoticMorphism.toFun_eq_coe]
  rfl

end AsymptoticMorphism

Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Basic

/-!
# The actual affine interpolation of reparametrized time

This constructs only the half-line time point. No homotopy or asymptotic
defect law is assumed as data.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

/-- The printed r_s(t)=s*t+(1-s)*r(t), staying in the genuine time half-line. -/
def blendTime (r : AsymptoticTime → AsymptoticTime)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (s : unitInterval) : AsymptoticTime :=
  ⟨(s : ℝ) * (t : ℝ) + (1 - (s : ℝ)) * (r t : ℝ), by
    apply Set.mem_Ici.mpr
    have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left t.property s.property.1
    have hr := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (r t).property
      (sub_nonneg.mpr s.property.2)
    have hsum : (s : ℝ) + (1 - (s : ℝ)) = 1 := by
      rw [add_comm, sub_add_cancel]
    simpa only [mul_one, hsum] using add_le_add ht hr⟩

@[simp]
theorem blendTime_coe (r : AsymptoticTime → AsymptoticTime)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (s : unitInterval) :
    (blendTime r t s : ℝ) =
      (s : ℝ) * (t : ℝ) + (1 - (s : ℝ)) * (r t : ℝ) := by
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem blendTime_zero (r : AsymptoticTime → AsymptoticTime) (t : AsymptoticTime) :
    blendTime r t 0 = r t := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (0 : ℝ) * (t : ℝ) + (1 - 0) * (r t : ℝ) = (r t : ℝ)
  simp

@[simp]
theorem blendTime_one (r : AsymptoticTime → AsymptoticTime) (t : AsymptoticTime) :
    blendTime r t 1 = t := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (1 : ℝ) * (t : ℝ) + (1 - 1) * (r t : ℝ) = (t : ℝ)
  simp

end AsymptoticMorphism

Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.IteratedAlgebra

public import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.EqToHom

/-!
# Products of finite-stage representatives

The canonical finite-iteration transport is owned by `IteratedAlgebra`.
This module uses it to package the literal representative composite

```text
(map n psi).comp phi : A -> alpha^n(alpha^m C)
```

at summed stage `n + m`.

This is representative-level data only. There is no class product, path/alpha
comparison, direct-limit operation, flattening map, associativity theorem, or
E-theory product here.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CategoryTheory
open scoped CStarAlgebra

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] AsymptoticAlgebra.cStarAlgebra

namespace IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra

universe uA uB uC

/-- Compose finite-stage representatives. The mathematical composite is
`(map n psi).comp phi`; `iteratedAddHom` only transports its canonical
stored carrier to the literal summed stage. -/
def productRepresentative (n m : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (phi : HomN n A B) (psi : HomN m B C) : HomN (n + m) A C :=
  (iteratedAddHom n m C).comp ((map n psi).comp phi)

@[simp]
theorem productRepresentative_apply (n m : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (phi : HomN n A B) (psi : HomN m B C) (a : A) :
    productRepresentative n m phi psi a =
      iteratedAddHom n m C (map n psi (phi a)) :=
  rfl

/-- At source stage zero, representative product is ordinary composition. -/
private theorem map_zero_stage_eq_eqToHom_comp
    (m : ℕ)
    {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (psi : HomN m B C) :
    map 0 psi =
      (eqToHom
        (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject_zero
          (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject m
            (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C))).symm).comp psi := by
  rw [map_zero_stage]
  rfl

/-- At source stage zero, representative product is ordinary composition
followed by the explicit transport from stage `m` to literal stage `0+m`. -/
theorem productRepresentative_zero_left (m : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (phi : HomN 0 A B) (psi : HomN m B C) :
    productRepresentative 0 m phi psi =
      (eqToHom
        (congrArg
          (fun k => NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject k
            (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C))
          (Nat.zero_add m)).symm).comp (psi.comp phi) := by
  unfold productRepresentative
  rw [map_zero_stage_eq_eqToHom_comp]
  calc
    (iteratedAddHom 0 m C).comp
        (((eqToHom
          (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject_zero
            (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject m
              (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C))).symm).comp psi).comp phi) =
      ((iteratedAddHom 0 m C).comp
        (eqToHom
          (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject_zero
            (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject m
              (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C))).symm)).comp
        (psi.comp phi) := by
          apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
          intro a
          rfl
    _ = (eqToHom
          (congrArg
            (fun k => NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.iteratedAsymptoticAlgebraObject k
              (NonUnitalCStarAlgCat.of C))
            (Nat.zero_add m)).symm).comp (psi.comp phi) := by
      exact congrArg (fun F => F.comp (psi.comp phi))
        (iteratedAddHom_zero_left m C)

/-- At coefficient stage zero, only the existing `map n` action remains. -/
theorem productRepresentative_zero_right (n : ℕ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
    (phi : HomN n A B) (psi : HomN 0 B C) :
    productRepresentative n 0 phi psi = (map n psi).comp phi := by
  unfold productRepresentative
  rw [iteratedAddHom_zero_right]
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro a
  rfl

#print axioms productRepresentative
#print axioms productRepresentative_apply
#print axioms productRepresentative_zero_left
#print axioms productRepresentative_zero_right

end IteratedAsymptoticAlgebra

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.AsymptoticAlgebraMap
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Pullback

import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Spectrum

/-!
# The asymptotic-algebra comparison for a literal pullback

Applying the literal asymptotic-algebra functor to the two coordinate maps
gives the canonical comparison from the asymptotic algebra of a pullback to
the pullback of the two induced coefficient maps.

The comparison is injective. If the right leg of the cospan has a
star-homomorphic section, it is surjective and therefore gives a
star-algebra equivalence. The file stops before finite iteration, matching
paths, gluing, endpoint laws, or an n-homotopy relation.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter
open scoped BoundedContinuousFunction CStarAlgebra

noncomputable section

namespace AsymptoticAlgebra

universe uA uB uC

attribute [local instance] cStarAlgebra

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]

/-- The canonical map from the asymptotic algebra of a literal pullback to
the pullback of the two induced coefficient maps. -/
def pullbackComparison
    (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    AsymptoticAlgebra (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback (map f) (map g) := by
  have hcompat :
      (map f).comp
          (map (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f g)) =
        (map g).comp
          (map (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f g)) := by
    calc
      (map f).comp
          (map (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f g)) =
        map (f.comp (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f g)) :=
          (map_comp (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f g) f).symm
      _ = map (g.comp (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f g)) :=
        congrArg
          (fun h : NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C =>
            map h)
          (NonUnitalCStarPullback.condition_hom f g)
      _ = (map g).comp
          (map (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f g)) :=
        map_comp (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f g) g
  exact NonUnitalCStarPullback.lift (map f) (map g)
    (map (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f g))
    (map (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f g)) hcompat

/-- The first coordinate of the comparison is the induced first-coordinate
coefficient map. -/
theorem fstHom_comp_pullbackComparison
    (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom (map f) (map g)).comp
        (pullbackComparison f g) =
      map (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f g) := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro q
  rfl

/-- The second coordinate of the comparison is the induced second-coordinate
coefficient map. -/
theorem sndHom_comp_pullbackComparison
    (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom (map f) (map g)).comp
        (pullbackComparison f g) =
      map (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f g) := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro q
  rfl

/-- The canonical comparison is injective.  A quotient class whose two
coordinate classes vanish has a representative whose two coordinate
functions tend to zero, hence the pullback-valued representative itself
tends to zero. -/
theorem pullbackComparison_injective
    (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    Function.Injective (pullbackComparison f g) := by
  intro x y hxy
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  have hcomp : pullbackComparison f g (x - y) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ :=
    quotientMap_surjective
      (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) (x - y)
  have hcompP :
      pullbackComparison f g
          (quotientMap (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) p) = 0 := by
    rw [hp]
    exact hcomp
  have hfstQ :
      map (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f g)
          (quotientMap (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) p) = 0 := by
    calc
      map (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f g)
          (quotientMap (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) p) =
        NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom (map f) (map g)
          (pullbackComparison f g
            (quotientMap (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) p)) :=
        (DFunLike.congr_fun (fstHom_comp_pullbackComparison f g) _).symm
      _ = NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom (map f) (map g) 0 :=
        congrArg (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom (map f) (map g)) hcompP
      _ = 0 := _root_.map_zero _
  have hsndQ :
      map (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f g)
          (quotientMap (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) p) = 0 := by
    calc
      map (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f g)
          (quotientMap (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) p) =
        NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom (map f) (map g)
          (pullbackComparison f g
            (quotientMap (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) p)) :=
        (DFunLike.congr_fun (sndHom_comp_pullbackComparison f g) _).symm
      _ = NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom (map f) (map g) 0 :=
        congrArg (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom (map f) (map g)) hcompP
      _ = 0 := _root_.map_zero _
  have hfstClass :
      quotientMap A
          (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom
            (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f g) p) = 0 := by
    simpa only [map_quotientMap] using hfstQ
  have hsndClass :
      quotientMap B
          (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom
            (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f g) p) = 0 := by
    simpa only [map_quotientMap] using hsndQ
  have hfst :
      Tendsto (fun t : AsymptoticTime =>
          NonUnitalCStarPullback.fst f g (p t))
        atTop (nhds (0 : A)) := by
    have haction :
        (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom
          (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f g) p : AsymptoticTime → A) =
        fun t => NonUnitalCStarPullback.fst f g (p t) := by
      funext t
      rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply,
        NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom_apply]
    rw [← haction]
    exact (quotientMap_eq_zero_iff _).1 hfstClass
  have hsnd :
      Tendsto (fun t : AsymptoticTime =>
          NonUnitalCStarPullback.snd f g (p t))
        atTop (nhds (0 : B)) := by
    have haction :
        (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom
          (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f g) p : AsymptoticTime → B) =
        fun t => NonUnitalCStarPullback.snd f g (p t) := by
      funext t
      rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply,
        NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom_apply]
    rw [← haction]
    exact (quotientMap_eq_zero_iff _).1 hsndClass
  have hpzero :
      Tendsto (fun t : AsymptoticTime => p t) atTop
        (nhds (0 : NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g)) := by
    apply tendsto_subtype_rng.mpr
    change Tendsto (fun t : AsymptoticTime =>
        ((p t : NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) : A × B))
      atTop
      (nhds (((0 : NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) : A × B)))
    have hpair := hfst.prodMk_nhds hsnd
    change Tendsto (fun t : AsymptoticTime => ((p t).1.1, (p t).1.2))
      atTop (nhds ((0 : A), (0 : B))) at hpair
    convert hpair using 1
  calc
    x - y = quotientMap (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) p := hp.symm
    _ = 0 := (quotientMap_eq_zero_iff p).2 hpzero

/-- The canonical comparison is surjective when the right leg of the
defining cospan has a star-homomorphic section. -/
theorem pullbackComparison_surjective_of_rightInverse
    (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (s : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hs : g.comp s = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ C) :
    Function.Surjective (pullbackComparison f g) := by
  intro q
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
    quotientMap_surjective A
      (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom (map f) (map g) q)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
    quotientMap_surjective B
      (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom (map f) (map g) q)
  have hcompatQ :
      map f (quotientMap A x) = map g (quotientMap B y) := by
    calc
      map f (quotientMap A x) =
          map f (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom (map f) (map g) q) :=
        congrArg (map f) hx
      _ = map g (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom (map f) (map g) q) :=
        NonUnitalCStarPullback.condition (map f) (map g) q
      _ = map g (quotientMap B y) :=
        congrArg (map g) hy.symm
  let delta : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ C :=
    BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom f x -
      BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom g y
  have hdeltaQ : quotientMap C delta = 0 := by
    dsimp only [delta]
    calc
      quotientMap C
          (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom f x -
            BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom g y) =
        quotientMap C
            (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom f x) -
          quotientMap C
            (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom g y) :=
        map_sub _ _ _
      _ = map f (quotientMap A x) - map g (quotientMap B y) := by
        rw [← map_quotientMap f x, ← map_quotientMap g y]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hcompatQ, sub_self]
  have hdelta :
      Tendsto (fun t : AsymptoticTime => delta t) atTop (nhds (0 : C)) :=
    (quotientMap_eq_zero_iff delta).1 hdeltaQ
  let correction : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B :=
    BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom s delta
  have hcorrection :
      Tendsto (fun t : AsymptoticTime => correction t)
        atTop (nhds (0 : B)) := by
    have hS : Continuous (s : C → B) := map_continuous s
    have hs0 := (hS.tendsto (0 : C)).comp hdelta
    simpa only [correction,
      BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply,
      Function.comp_def, _root_.map_zero] using hs0
  have hcorrectionQ : quotientMap B correction = 0 :=
    (quotientMap_eq_zero_iff correction).2 hcorrection
  let y' : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B := y + correction
  have hy' :
      quotientMap B y' =
        NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom (map f) (map g) q := by
    dsimp only [y']
    rw [map_add, hcorrectionQ, add_zero, hy]
  have hpoint (t : AsymptoticTime) : f (x t) = g (y' t) := by
    have hsval :
        g (s (f (x t) - g (y t))) = f (x t) - g (y t) := by
      have h := DFunLike.congr_fun hs (f (x t) - g (y t))
      change g (s (f (x t) - g (y t))) = f (x t) - g (y t) at h
      exact h
    dsimp only [y', correction, delta]
    rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply,
      BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply,
      BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply,
      BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply,
      BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply,
      map_add, hsval, add_comm, sub_add_cancel]
  let pair : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ (A × B) :=
    { toFun := fun t => (x t, y' t)
      continuous_toFun := x.continuous.prodMk y'.continuous
      map_bounded' := by
        obtain ⟨Kx, hKx⟩ := x.bounded
        obtain ⟨Ky, hKy⟩ := y'.bounded
        refine ⟨max Kx Ky, fun t u => ?_⟩
        rw [Prod.dist_eq]
        exact max_le_max (hKx t u) (hKy t u) }
  let p : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ
      NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g :=
    BoundedContinuousFunction.codRestrict
      (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) pair fun t =>
        (NonUnitalCStarPullback.mem_pullback f g _).2 (hpoint t)
  have hpFst :
      BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom
          (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f g) p = x := by
    apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
    intro t
    rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply,
      NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom_apply]
    rfl
  have hpSnd :
      BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom
          (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f g) p = y' := by
    apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
    intro t
    rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply,
      NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom_apply]
    rfl
  refine ⟨quotientMap (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) p, ?_⟩
  apply NonUnitalCStarPullback.ext (map f) (map g)
  · calc
      NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom (map f) (map g)
          (pullbackComparison f g
            (quotientMap (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) p)) =
        map (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f g)
          (quotientMap (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) p) :=
        DFunLike.congr_fun (fstHom_comp_pullbackComparison f g) _
      _ = quotientMap A
          (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom
            (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f g) p) :=
        map_quotientMap _ _
      _ = quotientMap A x := congrArg (quotientMap A) hpFst
      _ = NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom (map f) (map g) q := hx
  · calc
      NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom (map f) (map g)
          (pullbackComparison f g
            (quotientMap (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) p)) =
        map (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f g)
          (quotientMap (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) p) :=
        DFunLike.congr_fun (sndHom_comp_pullbackComparison f g) _
      _ = quotientMap B
          (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom
            (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f g) p) :=
        map_quotientMap _ _
      _ = quotientMap B y' := congrArg (quotientMap B) hpSnd
      _ = NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom (map f) (map g) q := hy'

/-- The canonical comparison as a star-algebra equivalence when the right
leg of the cospan has a star-homomorphic section. -/
noncomputable def splitPullbackEquiv
    (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (s : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hs : g.comp s = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ C) :
    AsymptoticAlgebra (NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback f g) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ]
      NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback (map f) (map g) :=
  StarAlgEquiv.ofBijective (pullbackComparison f g)
    ⟨pullbackComparison_injective f g,
      pullbackComparison_surjective_of_rightInverse f g s hs⟩

/-- The forward homomorphism of the split-pullback equivalence is the
canonical comparison. -/
theorem splitPullbackEquiv_toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (s : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hs : g.comp s = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ C) :
    (splitPullbackEquiv f g s hs).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom =
      pullbackComparison f g := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro q
  rfl

/-- The first projection of the split-pullback equivalence is the induced
first-coordinate coefficient map. -/
theorem fstHom_comp_splitPullbackEquiv
    (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (s : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hs : g.comp s = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ C) :
    (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom (map f) (map g)).comp
        (splitPullbackEquiv f g s hs).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom =
      map (NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom f g) := by
  rw [splitPullbackEquiv_toNonUnitalStarAlgHom]
  exact fstHom_comp_pullbackComparison f g

/-- The second projection of the split-pullback equivalence is the induced
second-coordinate coefficient map. -/
theorem sndHom_comp_splitPullbackEquiv
    (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (s : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hs : g.comp s = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ C) :
    (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom (map f) (map g)).comp
        (splitPullbackEquiv f g s hs).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom =
      map (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom f g) := by
  rw [splitPullbackEquiv_toNonUnitalStarAlgHom]
  exact sndHom_comp_pullbackComparison f g

#print axioms pullbackComparison
#print axioms fstHom_comp_pullbackComparison
#print axioms sndHom_comp_pullbackComparison
#print axioms pullbackComparison_injective
#print axioms pullbackComparison_surjective_of_rightInverse
#print axioms splitPullbackEquiv
#print axioms splitPullbackEquiv_toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
#print axioms fstHom_comp_splitPullbackEquiv
#print axioms sndHom_comp_splitPullbackEquiv

end AsymptoticAlgebra

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap.ZeroAtInftyFlip
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.ZeroAtInfty

/-!
# Suspension representatives of uniform asymptotic morphisms

A given uniform asymptotic morphism acts on the canonical suspension by the
already constructed full-norm `C₀` lift. Since a raw family need not preserve
zero at finite time, the honest formula uses its literal zero normalization:

`f ↦ fun x ↦ φ_t (f x) - φ_t 0`.

A whole uniform homotopy suspends coherently. The construction first applies
the same `C₀` lift to its interval-valued family and then uses the existing
compact-interval/function-at-infinity flip. Thus the output is one genuine
homotopy, not separately selected time or interval slices.

This is reusable representative data motivated by Blackadar 25.2.2. It does
not select a uniform replacement, descend to all homotopy classes, construct
maximal tensor products or assert that the resulting class map is defined.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra ZeroAtInfty

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

universe uA uB

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

/-- The normalized suspension representative attached to a given uniform
asymptotic morphism. No uniform representative is selected here. -/
noncomputable def normalizedUniformSuspension
    (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (hφ : IsUniform φ) :
    AsymptoticMorphism C₀(ℝ, A) C₀(ℝ, B) :=
  uniformC0Morphism (X := ℝ) φ hφ

/-- Exact coefficient formula for the normalized suspension representative. -/
@[simp]
theorem normalizedUniformSuspension_apply
    (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (hφ : IsUniform φ)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (f : C₀(ℝ, A)) (x : ℝ) :
    normalizedUniformSuspension φ hφ t f x = φ t (f x) - φ t 0 := by
  change uniformC0Morphism (X := ℝ) φ hφ t f x = _
  rw [uniformC0Morphism_apply, normalize_apply]

/-- Suspension preserves the supplied representative's genuine uniformity. -/
theorem isUniform_normalizedUniformSuspension
    (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (hφ : IsUniform φ) :
    IsUniform (normalizedUniformSuspension φ hφ) := by
  simpa only [normalizedUniformSuspension] using
    (isUniform_uniformC0Morphism (X := ℝ) φ hφ)

/-- For an exactly zero-preserving input, the normalized construction is the
literal pointwise suspension formula. -/
theorem normalizedUniformSuspension_apply_of_zero
    (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (hφ : IsUniform φ)
    (hzero : ∀ t : AsymptoticTime, φ t 0 = 0)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (f : C₀(ℝ, A)) (x : ℝ) :
    normalizedUniformSuspension φ hφ t f x = φ t (f x) := by
  rw [normalizedUniformSuspension_apply, hzero, sub_zero]

/-- Suspend one whole uniform interval-valued family and flip its interval and
vanishing-at-infinity variables. -/
noncomputable def normalizedUniformSuspensionHomotopyFamily
    {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B} (H : Homotopy φ ψ)
    (hH : IsUniform H.family) :
    AsymptoticMorphism C₀(ℝ, A) C(unitInterval, C₀(ℝ, B)) :=
  postcomp (uniformC0Morphism (X := ℝ) H.family hH)
    (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.continuousMapFlipStarAlgEquiv
      (X := ℝ) (Y := unitInterval) (B := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom

/-- The suspended whole family keeps the normalized pointwise values. -/
@[simp]
theorem normalizedUniformSuspensionHomotopyFamily_apply
    {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B} (H : Homotopy φ ψ)
    (hH : IsUniform H.family) (t : AsymptoticTime)
    (f : C₀(ℝ, A)) (s : unitInterval) (x : ℝ) :
    normalizedUniformSuspensionHomotopyFamily H hH t f s x =
      normalize H.family t (f x) s := by
  rw [normalizedUniformSuspensionHomotopyFamily, postcomp_apply]
  change
    (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.continuousMapFlipStarAlgEquiv
      (X := ℝ) (Y := unitInterval) (B := B)
      (uniformC0Morphism (X := ℝ) H.family hH t f)) s x = _
  rw [
    ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.continuousMapFlipStarAlgEquiv_apply,
    uniformC0Morphism_apply]

namespace Homotopy

/-- A whole uniform homotopy induces an actual homotopy of its normalized
suspension representatives. Endpoint uniformity proofs determine only proof
fields; the values are fixed by the public apply formula. -/
noncomputable def normalizedUniformSuspension
    {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B} (H : Homotopy φ ψ)
    (hφ : IsUniform φ) (hψ : IsUniform ψ)
    (hH : IsUniform H.family) :
    Homotopy (AsymptoticMorphism.normalizedUniformSuspension φ hφ)
      (AsymptoticMorphism.normalizedUniformSuspension ψ hψ) where
  family := normalizedUniformSuspensionHomotopyFamily H hH
  start := by
    intro t f
    apply ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.ext
    intro x
    rw [normalizedUniformSuspensionHomotopyFamily_apply,
      AsymptoticMorphism.normalizedUniformSuspension_apply,
      normalize_apply]
    change H.family t (f x) 0 - H.family t 0 0 = φ t (f x) - φ t 0
    rw [H.start t (f x), H.start t 0]
  finish := by
    intro t f
    apply ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.ext
    intro x
    rw [normalizedUniformSuspensionHomotopyFamily_apply,
      AsymptoticMorphism.normalizedUniformSuspension_apply,
      normalize_apply]
    change H.family t (f x) 1 - H.family t 0 1 = ψ t (f x) - ψ t 0
    rw [H.finish t (f x), H.finish t 0]

end Homotopy

/-- The bundled construction gives the corresponding homotopy relation. -/
theorem homotopic_normalizedUniformSuspension
    {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B} (H : Homotopy φ ψ)
    (hφ : IsUniform φ) (hψ : IsUniform ψ)
    (hH : IsUniform H.family) :
    Homotopic (normalizedUniformSuspension φ hφ)
      (normalizedUniformSuspension ψ hψ) :=
  ⟨H.normalizedUniformSuspension hφ hψ hH⟩

end AsymptoticMorphism

Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.TailIdeals
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.IdealQuotient.DirectedSup

import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Archimedean.Basic
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.MulAction
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith

/-!
# The directed tail closure is the actual C0 ideal

The explicit private scalar cutoff min1(max0(n-t)) is bounded by1,
equal1 before n-1 and zero from n on. Multiplication of an actual BCF by
this scalar yields a true member of J_n. The real atTop vanishing property
gives sup-norm approximation, proving closure(unionJ_n)=C0.

No approximation, closure equality, limit ideal or lifting output is assumed.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Set Filter
open scoped ZeroAtInfty BoundedContinuousFunction

noncomputable section

namespace AsymptoticAlgebra

universe uB

private def tailCutoff (n : ℕ) (t : AsymptoticTime) : ℝ :=
  min 1 (max 0 ((n : ℝ) - (t : ℝ)))

private theorem tailCutoff_bounds (n : ℕ) (t : AsymptoticTime) :
    0 ≤ tailCutoff n t ∧ tailCutoff n t ≤ 1 :=
  ⟨le_min zero_le_one (le_max_left _ _), min_le_left _ _⟩

private theorem tailCutoff_continuous (n : ℕ) : Continuous (tailCutoff n) := by
  have hsub : Continuous (fun t : AsymptoticTime => (n : ℝ) - (t : ℝ)) :=
    continuous_const.fun_sub continuous_subtype_val
  exact continuous_const.min (continuous_const.max hsub)

private theorem tailCutoff_zero (n : ℕ) (t : AsymptoticTime)
    (ht : (n : ℝ) ≤ (t : ℝ)) : tailCutoff n t = 0 := by
  rw [tailCutoff, max_eq_left (sub_nonpos.mpr ht), min_eq_right zero_le_one]

private theorem tailCutoff_one (n : ℕ) (t : AsymptoticTime)
    (ht : (t : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) - 1) : tailCutoff n t = 1 := by
  have h1 : 1 ≤ (n : ℝ) - (t : ℝ) := by linarith
  rw [tailCutoff, min_eq_left (h1.trans (le_max_right _ _))]

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

private theorem norm_tailCutoff_smul_le (n : ℕ) (t : AsymptoticTime) (b : B) :
    ‖(tailCutoff n t : ℂ) • b‖ ≤ ‖b‖ := by
  rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (tailCutoff_bounds n t).1]
  calc
    tailCutoff n t * ‖b‖ ≤ 1 * ‖b‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (tailCutoff_bounds n t).2 (norm_nonneg b)
    _ = ‖b‖ := one_mul _

/-- A computed bounded tail-supported approximation in the STOCK function norm. -/
@[no_expose]
def tailApprox (n : ℕ) (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B where
  toFun t := (tailCutoff n t : ℂ) • f t
  continuous_toFun :=
    (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (tailCutoff_continuous n)).fun_smul f.continuous
  map_bounded' := by
    refine ⟨‖f‖ + ‖f‖, fun s t => ?_⟩
    apply (dist_le_norm_add_norm _ _).trans
    exact add_le_add
      ((norm_tailCutoff_smul_le n s (f s)).trans (f.norm_coe_le_norm s))
      ((norm_tailCutoff_smul_le n t (f t)).trans (f.norm_coe_le_norm t))

/-- The public pointwise formula does not expose any private cutoff/proof name. -/
@[simp]
theorem tailApprox_apply (n : ℕ) (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) (t : AsymptoticTime) :
    tailApprox n f t =
      ((min 1 (max 0 ((n : ℝ) - (t : ℝ))) : ℝ) : ℂ) • f t := by
  rfl

/-- The concrete approximation belongs to the exact source J_n. -/
theorem tailApprox_mem (n : ℕ) (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :
    tailApprox n f ∈ tailIdeal n B := by
  apply (mem_tailIdeal_iff n _).2
  intro t ht
  change (tailCutoff n t : ℂ) • f t = 0
  rw [tailCutoff_zero n t ht, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_smul]

theorem tailApprox_eq_of_le (n : ℕ) (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (ht : (t : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) - 1) :
    tailApprox n f t = f t := by
  change (tailCutoff n t : ℂ) • f t = f t
  rw [tailCutoff_one n t ht, Complex.ofReal_one, one_smul]

private theorem tailApprox_error_le (n : ℕ) (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) : ‖tailApprox n f t - f t‖ ≤ ‖f t‖ := by
  have heq : tailApprox n f t - f t = ((tailCutoff n t : ℂ) - 1) • f t := by
    change (tailCutoff n t : ℂ) • f t - f t = _
    rw [sub_smul, one_smul]
  rw [heq, norm_smul]
  have hc : ‖(tailCutoff n t : ℂ) - 1‖ ≤ 1 := by
    have heq : (tailCutoff n t : ℂ) - 1 = ((tailCutoff n t - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.ofReal_one]
    rw [heq, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr (tailCutoff_bounds n t).2)]
    have hnonneg := (tailCutoff_bounds n t).1
    linarith
  calc
    ‖(tailCutoff n t : ℂ) - 1‖ * ‖f t‖ ≤ 1 * ‖f t‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = ‖f t‖ := one_mul _

/-- C0 vanishing produces actual members of J_n arbitrarily close in sup norm. -/
theorem exists_tailApprox_close (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B)
    (hf : f ∈ BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ‖tailApprox n f - f‖ < ε := by
  let : Nonempty AsymptoticTime := ⟨⟨1, le_rfl⟩⟩
  have htendsto := (mem_vanishingIdeal_iff f).1 hf
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ t : AsymptoticTime in atTop, ‖f t‖ < ε / 2 := by
    simpa only [dist_zero_right] using
      Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp htendsto (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Filter.mem_atTop_sets.mp hsmall
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((r : ℝ) + 1)
  have hnlarge : (r : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
  have hnorm : ‖tailApprox n f - f‖ ≤ ε / 2 := by
    apply (BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le (half_pos hε).le).2
    intro t
    rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply]
    by_cases ht : (t : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) - 1
    · rw [tailApprox_eq_of_le n f t ht, sub_self, norm_zero]
      exact (half_pos hε).le
    · have htail : r ≤ t := hnlarge.le.trans (le_of_not_ge ht)
      exact (tailApprox_error_le n f t).trans (hr t htail).le
  exact ⟨n, hnorm.trans_lt (half_lt_self hε)⟩

/-- Literal closed-union identity, preserving the original C0 carrier. -/
theorem closure_iUnion_tailIdeal (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    closure (⋃ n : ℕ, (tailIdeal n B : Set (AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B))) =
      (BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B :
        Set (AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B)) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact closure_minimal
      (Set.iUnion_subset fun n => tailIdeal_le_vanishingIdeal n B)
      (BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B).isClosed
  · intro f hf
    apply Metric.mem_closure_iff.2
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_tailApprox_close f hf ε hε
    refine ⟨tailApprox n f, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨n, tailApprox_mem n f⟩, ?_⟩
    calc
      dist f (tailApprox n f) = dist (tailApprox n f) f := dist_comm _ _
      _ = ‖tailApprox n f - f‖ := dist_eq_norm _ _
      _ < ε := hn

/-- The independently constructed directed closed supremum IS the concrete C0 ideal. -/
theorem directedSup_tailIdeal (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    ClosedStarIdeal.directedSup (fun n : ℕ => tailIdeal n B) (tailIdeal_directed B) =
      BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B := by
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  calc
    (ClosedStarIdeal.directedSup (fun n : ℕ => tailIdeal n B)
        (tailIdeal_directed B) : Set (AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B)) =
      closure (⋃ n : ℕ, (tailIdeal n B : Set (AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B))) :=
        ClosedStarIdeal.directedSup_carrier _ _
    _ = _ := closure_iUnion_tailIdeal B

end AsymptoticAlgebra

/-
Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.AsymptoticAlgebra
public import Mathlib.Order.Directed
public import Mathlib.Topology.Order.OrderClosed

/-!
# Actual tail ideals and restriction quotients

The kernel J_n of restriction to the true closed tail gives the exact
vanishing-on-[n,infty) ideal in Cb([1,infty),B). Clamp-extension is a computed
right inverse, hence the restriction quotient is the actual tail algebra.
No ideal comparison, inverse, lifting output or alternate C-star model is input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Set Filter
open scoped ZeroAtInfty BoundedContinuousFunction

noncomputable section

namespace AsymptoticAlgebra

universe uB

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

attribute [local instance] cStarAlgebra

/-- The true source-domain tail; n=0,1 do not remove any source points. -/
abbrev TailTime (n : ℕ) := {t : AsymptoticTime // (n : ℝ) ≤ (t : ℝ)}

/-- Continuous inclusion of the actual tail in the original ray. -/
def tailInclusion (n : ℕ) : C(TailTime n, AsymptoticTime) :=
  ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩

@[simp]
theorem tailInclusion_apply (n : ℕ) (t : TailTime n) :
    tailInclusion n t = t.val := by
  rfl

/-- Actual continuous clamping, constant below the effective tail endpoint. -/
def tailClamp (n : ℕ) : C(AsymptoticTime, TailTime n) where
  toFun t :=
    ⟨⟨max (t : ℝ) (n : ℝ), t.property.trans (le_max_left _ _)⟩, le_max_right _ _⟩
  continuous_toFun := by
    have hmax : Continuous (fun t : AsymptoticTime => max (t : ℝ) (n : ℝ)) :=
      continuous_subtype_val.max
        (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : AsymptoticTime => (n : ℝ)))
    exact (hmax.subtype_mk
      (fun t : AsymptoticTime => t.property.trans (le_max_left (t : ℝ) (n : ℝ)))).subtype_mk
        (fun t : AsymptoticTime => le_max_right (t : ℝ) (n : ℝ))

@[simp]
theorem tailClamp_coe (n : ℕ) (t : AsymptoticTime) :
    ((tailClamp n t : AsymptoticTime) : ℝ) = max (t : ℝ) (n : ℝ) := by
  rfl

/-- Inclusion followed by clamp is the actual identity on the tail. -/
theorem tailClamp_inclusion (n : ℕ) (t : TailTime n) :
    tailClamp n (tailInclusion n t) = t := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact max_eq_left t.property

/-- Restriction of the stock BCF algebra as a real nonunital star hom. -/
def tailRestriction (n : ℕ) (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (TailTime n →ᵇ B) where
  toFun f := f.compContinuous (tailInclusion n)
  map_zero' := by
    ext t
    rfl
  map_add' := by
    intro f g
    ext t
    rfl
  map_smul' := by
    intro c f
    ext t
    rfl
  map_mul' := by
    intro f g
    ext t
    rfl
  map_star' := by
    intro f
    ext t
    rfl

@[simp]
theorem tailRestriction_apply (n : ℕ) (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) (t : TailTime n) :
    tailRestriction n B f t = f (tailInclusion n t) :=
  BoundedContinuousFunction.compContinuous_apply _ _ _

/-- The actual constant-below-endpoint extension along the computed clamp. -/
def tailExtension (n : ℕ) (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (TailTime n →ᵇ B) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) where
  toFun f := f.compContinuous (tailClamp n)
  map_zero' := by
    ext t
    rfl
  map_add' := by
    intro f g
    ext t
    rfl
  map_smul' := by
    intro c f
    ext t
    rfl
  map_mul' := by
    intro f g
    ext t
    rfl
  map_star' := by
    intro f
    ext t
    rfl

@[simp]
theorem tailExtension_apply (n : ℕ) (f : TailTime n →ᵇ B) (t : AsymptoticTime) :
    tailExtension n B f t = f (tailClamp n t) :=
  BoundedContinuousFunction.compContinuous_apply _ _ _

/-- The two computed maps give an actual right-inverse identity. -/
theorem tailRestriction_extension (n : ℕ) (f : TailTime n →ᵇ B) :
    tailRestriction n B (tailExtension n B f) = f := by
  ext t
  rw [tailRestriction_apply, tailExtension_apply, tailClamp_inclusion]

theorem tailRestriction_surjective (n : ℕ) (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Function.Surjective (tailRestriction n B) :=
  fun f => ⟨tailExtension n B f, tailRestriction_extension n f⟩

/-- The source's exact tail ideal is a true closed kernel, not a model input. -/
def tailIdeal (n : ℕ) (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    ClosedStarIdeal (AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :=
  ClosedStarIdeal.ker (tailRestriction n B)

/-- Exact printed membership: zero at every source time at least n. -/
theorem mem_tailIdeal_iff (n : ℕ) (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :
    f ∈ tailIdeal n B ↔
      ∀ t : AsymptoticTime, (n : ℝ) ≤ (t : ℝ) → f t = 0 := by
  rw [tailIdeal, ClosedStarIdeal.mem_ker]
  constructor
  · intro h t ht
    have hv := DFunLike.congr_fun h (⟨t, ht⟩ : TailTime n)
    simpa only [tailRestriction_apply, tailInclusion_apply,
      BoundedContinuousFunction.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using hv
  · intro h
    ext t
    simpa only [tailRestriction_apply, tailInclusion_apply,
      BoundedContinuousFunction.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using h t.val t.property

/-- Monotonicity uses the literal nested-tail relation. -/
theorem tailIdeal_monotone (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Monotone (fun n : ℕ => tailIdeal n B) := by
  intro n m hnm f hf
  apply (mem_tailIdeal_iff m f).2
  intro t ht
  have hcast : (n : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hnm
  exact (mem_tailIdeal_iff n f).1 hf t (hcast.trans ht)

theorem tailIdeal_directed (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Directed (· ≤ ·) (fun n : ℕ => tailIdeal n B) :=
  (tailIdeal_monotone B).directed_le

/-- Exact eventual zero implies membership in the real C0 ideal. -/
theorem tailIdeal_le_vanishingIdeal (n : ℕ) (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    tailIdeal n B ≤ BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B := by
  intro f hf
  apply (mem_vanishingIdeal_iff f).2
  have hzero : ∀ᶠ t : AsymptoticTime in atTop, f t = 0 := by
    let r : AsymptoticTime := ⟨max (n : ℝ) 1, le_max_right _ _⟩
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop r] with t ht
    exact (mem_tailIdeal_iff n f).1 hf t ((le_max_left _ _).trans ht)
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun _ : AsymptoticTime => (0 : B)) atTop (nhds (0 : B)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds
  exact hconst.congr' (Filter.EventuallyEq.symm hzero)

/-- The actual restriction quotient is the actual tail BCF algebra. -/
def tailQuotientEquiv (n : ℕ) (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
      (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
    (tailIdeal n B).Quotient ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] (TailTime n →ᵇ B) := by
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
    (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective
    (tailRestriction n B) (tailRestriction_surjective n B)

/-- Its characteristic formula is restriction of the original representative. -/
theorem tailQuotientEquiv_quotientMap (n : ℕ) (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
      (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
    tailQuotientEquiv n B ((tailIdeal n B).quotientMap f) = tailRestriction n B f := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
    (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective_quotientMap
    (tailRestriction n B) (tailRestriction_surjective n B) f

/-- The genuine stage-to-asymptotic quotient map is induced by the proven inclusion. -/
def tailToAsymptotic (n : ℕ) (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
      (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
    (tailIdeal n B).Quotient →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B := by
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
    (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
  exact ClosedStarIdeal.quotientMapOfLE
    (tailIdeal n B) (BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B)
    (tailIdeal_le_vanishingIdeal n B)

theorem tailToAsymptotic_quotientMap (n : ℕ) (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
      (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
    tailToAsymptotic n B ((tailIdeal n B).quotientMap f) = quotientMap B f := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
    (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
  exact ClosedStarIdeal.quotientMapOfLE_quotientMap _ _
    (tailIdeal_le_vanishingIdeal n B) f

/-- The canonical stage transition uses the actual monotonicity proof. -/
def tailTransition {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m)
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
      (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal m B).Quotient :=
      (tailIdeal m B).quotientCStarAlgebra
    (tailIdeal n B).Quotient →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (tailIdeal m B).Quotient := by
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
    (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal m B).Quotient :=
    (tailIdeal m B).quotientCStarAlgebra
  exact ClosedStarIdeal.quotientMapOfLE (tailIdeal n B) (tailIdeal m B)
    (tailIdeal_monotone B hnm)

theorem tailTransition_quotientMap {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m)
    (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
      (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal m B).Quotient :=
      (tailIdeal m B).quotientCStarAlgebra
    tailTransition hnm B ((tailIdeal n B).quotientMap f) =
      (tailIdeal m B).quotientMap f := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
    (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal m B).Quotient :=
    (tailIdeal m B).quotientCStarAlgebra
  exact ClosedStarIdeal.quotientMapOfLE_quotientMap _ _ (tailIdeal_monotone B hnm) f

end AsymptoticAlgebra
