Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Basic
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CompletelyPositiveMap

/-!
# Separate uniform, star-linear and CP-contraction representative properties

None of these is added to the raw asymptotic-morphism structure. Uniformity
means an actual continuous map into the bounded continuous function algebra
with its supremum topology, not only joint continuity.

CP maps use the canonical spectral orders locally inside the property; the
raw morphism's norm/topology dictionaries are unchanged.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra BoundedContinuousFunction

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

universe uA uB

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

/-- The actual continuous A->BCF(Time,B) uniform representative property. -/
def IsUniform (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : Prop :=
  ∃ F : C(A, AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B), ∀ (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A), F a t = φ t a

/-- Exact star-linear slices, with no boundedness or continuity-in-a premise. -/
def IsStarLinear (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : Prop :=
  ∀ t : AsymptoticTime,
    (∀ a b : A, φ t (a + b) = φ t a + φ t b) ∧
    (∀ (z : ℂ) (a : A), φ t (z • a) = z • φ t a) ∧
    ∀ a : A, φ t (star a) = star (φ t a)

/-- Actual completely positive linear contraction slices for the canonical
C-star orders; no exact algebra homomorphism property is assumed. -/
def IsCompletelyPositiveContraction (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : Prop :=
  letI : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
  letI : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
  letI : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
  letI : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
  ∀ t : AsymptoticTime, ∃ s : A →CP B,
    (∀ a : A, ‖s a‖ ≤ ‖a‖) ∧ ∀ a : A, s a = φ t a

end AsymptoticMorphism

/-
Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Normalization
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Unitization

import Mathlib.Tactic.Abel

/-!
# Algebraic unitization of nonlinear asymptotic families

The stock always-adjoined C-star carriers and norms are used. No boundedness
or asymptotic-algebra construction is needed: the product defect is a finite
sum of raw defects at fixed source coordinates. Exact unitality is asserted
only after the already constructed zero-normalization.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter

noncomputable section

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

universe uA uB

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

/-- The actual raw unitization formula on the stock C-star unitizations.
The original nonlinear family need not preserve zero or the unit exactly. -/
def unitization (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    AsymptoticMorphism (Unitization ℂ A) (Unitization ℂ B) := by
  let F : AsymptoticTime → Unitization ℂ A → Unitization ℂ B :=
    fun t x => Unitization.inl x.fst + Unitization.inr (φ t x.snd)
  have hinr {f : AsymptoticTime → B} (hf : Tendsto f atTop (nhds 0)) :
      Tendsto (fun t => (Unitization.inr (f t) : Unitization ℂ B))
        atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Unitization.inr_zero] using
      (Unitization.continuous_inr.tendsto (0 : B)).comp hf
  refine
    { toFun := F
      continuous_orbit := ?_
      add_defect_tendsto := ?_
      smul_defect_tendsto := ?_
      mul_defect_tendsto := ?_
      star_defect_tendsto := ?_ }
  · intro x
    exact continuous_const.fun_add
      (Unitization.continuous_inr.comp (φ.continuous_orbit x.snd))
  · intro x y
    have heq :
        (fun t => F t (x + y) - (F t x + F t y)) =
        (fun t => (Unitization.inr
          (φ t (x.snd + y.snd) - (φ t x.snd + φ t y.snd)) :
            Unitization ℂ B)) := by
      funext t
      apply Unitization.ext <;> simp [F, sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [heq]
    exact hinr (φ.add_defect_tendsto x.snd y.snd)
  · intro z x
    have heq :
        (fun t => F t (z • x) - z • F t x) =
        (fun t => (Unitization.inr
          (φ t (z • x.snd) - z • φ t x.snd) : Unitization ℂ B)) := by
      funext t
      apply Unitization.ext <;> simp [F, sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [heq]
    exact hinr (φ.smul_defect_tendsto z x.snd)
  · intro x y
    let a := x.fst • y.snd
    let b := y.fst • x.snd
    let c := x.snd * y.snd
    let D : AsymptoticTime → B := fun t =>
      (φ t ((a + b) + c) - (φ t (a + b) + φ t c)) +
      (φ t (a + b) - (φ t a + φ t b)) +
      (φ t a - x.fst • φ t y.snd) +
      (φ t b - y.fst • φ t x.snd) +
      (φ t c - φ t x.snd * φ t y.snd)
    have hD : Tendsto D atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, D, a, b, c, zero_add] using
        ((((φ.add_defect_tendsto (a + b) c).add
          (φ.add_defect_tendsto a b)).add
          (φ.smul_defect_tendsto x.fst y.snd)).add
          (φ.smul_defect_tendsto y.fst x.snd)).add
          (φ.mul_defect_tendsto x.snd y.snd)
    have heq :
        (fun t => F t (x * y) - F t x * F t y) =
        (fun t => (Unitization.inr (D t) : Unitization ℂ B)) := by
      funext t
      apply Unitization.ext
      · simp [F, sub_eq_add_neg]
      · simp only [F, D, a, b, c, sub_eq_add_neg,
          Unitization.snd_add, Unitization.snd_neg, Unitization.snd_mul,
          Unitization.snd_inl, Unitization.snd_inr,
          Unitization.fst_add, Unitization.fst_inl, Unitization.fst_inr,
          add_zero, zero_add]
        abel
    rw [heq]
    exact hinr hD
  · intro x
    have heq :
        (fun t => F t (star x) - star (F t x)) =
        (fun t => (Unitization.inr
          (φ t (star x.snd) - star (φ t x.snd)) : Unitization ℂ B)) := by
      funext t
      apply Unitization.ext <;> simp [F, sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [heq]
    exact hinr (φ.star_defect_tendsto x.snd)

/-- Characteristic values of the computed unitization, without a chosen model. -/
@[simp]
theorem unitization_apply (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (x : Unitization ℂ A) :
    unitization φ t x =
      Unitization.inl x.fst + Unitization.inr (φ t x.snd) := by
  rfl

/-- Restricting the actual unitization recovers the original raw family. -/
theorem unitization_inr_apply (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    unitization φ t (Unitization.inr a) =
      (Unitization.inr (φ t a) : Unitization ℂ B) := by
  simp only [unitization_apply, Unitization.fst_inr, Unitization.snd_inr,
    Unitization.inl_zero, zero_add]

/-- Exact unitality follows for the actual normalized family, not every raw one. -/
theorem unitization_normalize_one (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) :
    unitization (normalize φ) t 1 = (1 : Unitization ℂ B) := by
  simp only [unitization_apply, Unitization.fst_one, Unitization.snd_one,
    normalize_zero, Unitization.inr_zero, Unitization.inl_one, add_zero]

end AsymptoticMorphism

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Uniform
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Normalization
public import MathlibExt.Topology.ContinuousMap.ZeroAtInfty.Postcomp
public import MathlibExt.Topology.ContinuousMap.ZeroAtInfty.Flip

public import Mathlib.Topology.UniformSpace.Ascoli

/-!
# Uniform asymptotic morphisms on functions vanishing at infinity

A uniform raw asymptotic morphism remains uniform after exact zero-normalization.
Its normalized coefficient map acts continuously on C₀ functions and transposes
to a bounded, whole-C₀-continuous time orbit. Compact coefficient ranges and the
stock compact-domain Ascoli theorem upgrade all four pointwise defects to limits
in the actual C₀ supremum norm.

Only a topological parameter space is required. No local compactness,
separation, metrizability or nonemptiness assumption is imposed, and no
homotopy-class suspension or tensor-product identification is asserted.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter
open scoped ZeroAtInfty BoundedContinuousFunction UniformConvergence

universe uA uB uX

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

/-- Literal zero-normalization preserves the existing uniform representative property. -/
theorem IsUniform.normalize {φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B} (hφ : IsUniform φ) :
    IsUniform (AsymptoticMorphism.normalize φ) := by
  rcases hφ with ⟨F, hF⟩
  let F' : C(A, AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :=
    { toFun := fun a => F a - F 0
      continuous_toFun := (map_continuous F).fun_sub continuous_const }
  refine ⟨F', ?_⟩
  intro t a
  change (F a - F (0 : A)) t = AsymptoticMorphism.normalize φ t a
  rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, hF t a, hF t 0, normalize_apply]

/-- The computed continuous C₀-to-bounded-orbit map of a normalized uniform family.

The chosen coefficient map is constrained by the existing IsUniform property;
its output values are exposed by uniformC0Orbit_apply. -/
noncomputable def uniformC0Orbit {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (hφ : IsUniform φ) :
    C(C₀(X, A), AsymptoticTime →ᵇ C₀(X, B)) := by
  let hnormalized : IsUniform (AsymptoticMorphism.normalize φ) := IsUniform.normalize hφ
  let F : C(A, AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) := Classical.choose hnormalized
  have hF : ∀ (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A),
      F a t = AsymptoticMorphism.normalize φ t a :=
    Classical.choose_spec hnormalized
  have hzero : F 0 = 0 := by
    apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
    intro t
    change F 0 t = 0
    exact (hF t 0).trans (normalize_zero φ t)
  exact
    { toFun := fun f =>
        ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.flipToBCF
          (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.postcomp F hzero f)
      continuous_toFun :=
        (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.isometry_flipToBCF
          (X := X) (T := AsymptoticTime) (B := B)).continuous.comp
          (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.continuous_postcomp
            (X := X) (A := A) (B := AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) F hzero) }

/-- Exact normalized values of the computed orbit family. -/
@[simp]
theorem uniformC0Orbit_apply {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (hφ : IsUniform φ)
    (f : C₀(X, A)) (t : AsymptoticTime) (x : X) :
    uniformC0Orbit φ hφ f t x = AsymptoticMorphism.normalize φ t (f x) := by
  let hnormalized : IsUniform (AsymptoticMorphism.normalize φ) := IsUniform.normalize hφ
  let F : C(A, AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) := Classical.choose hnormalized
  have hF : ∀ (s : AsymptoticTime) (a : A),
      F a s = AsymptoticMorphism.normalize φ s a :=
    Classical.choose_spec hnormalized
  have hzero : F 0 = 0 := by
    apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
    intro s
    change F 0 s = 0
    exact (hF s 0).trans (normalize_zero φ s)
  change ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.flipToBCF
    (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.postcomp F hzero f) t x =
      AsymptoticMorphism.normalize φ t (f x)
  rw [ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.flipToBCF_apply, ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.postcomp_apply]
  exact hF t (f x)

/-- The actual normalized asymptotic family on C₀, with all four sup-norm limits. -/
noncomputable def uniformC0Morphism {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (hφ : IsUniform φ) :
    AsymptoticMorphism C₀(X, A) C₀(X, B) := by
  let hnormalized : IsUniform (AsymptoticMorphism.normalize φ) := IsUniform.normalize hφ
  let F : C(A, AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) := Classical.choose hnormalized
  have hF : ∀ (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A),
      F a t = AsymptoticMorphism.normalize φ t a :=
    Classical.choose_spec hnormalized
  have hOrbit (f : C₀(X, A)) (t : AsymptoticTime) (x : X) :
      uniformC0Orbit φ hφ f t x = F (f x) t :=
    (uniformC0Orbit_apply φ hφ f t x).trans ((hF t (f x)).symm)
  -- A proof-local adapter, not a new compact-convergence API. Its filter is arbitrary.
  have hlimit {Y : Type uA} [TopologicalSpace Y]
      (K : Set Y) (hK : IsCompact K) (D : C(Y, AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B))
      (r : X → K) (d : AsymptoticTime → C₀(X, B)) (L : Filter AsymptoticTime)
      (hvalue : ∀ (t : AsymptoticTime) (x : X), d t x = D (r x) t)
      (hpoint : ∀ y : K, Tendsto (fun t => D y t) L (nhds (0 : B))) :
      Tendsto d L (nhds (0 : C₀(X, B))) := by
    let _ : CompactSpace K := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hK
    have hEqui : Equicontinuous (fun t (y : K) => D y t) := by
      apply equicontinuous_iff_continuous.mpr
      change Continuous (fun y : K =>
        UniformFun.ofFun (fun t : AsymptoticTime => D (y : Y) t))
      exact BoundedContinuousFunction.isInducing_coeFn.continuous.comp
        ((map_continuous D).comp continuous_subtype_val)
    have hPi : Tendsto (fun t (y : K) => D y t) L (nhds (fun _ : K => (0 : B))) :=
      tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr hpoint
    have hUniformFun :=
      (Equicontinuous.tendsto_uniformFun_iff_pi hEqui L
        (fun _ : K => (0 : B))).mpr hPi
    have hUniform : TendstoUniformly (fun t (y : K) => D y t)
        (fun _ : K => (0 : B)) L := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, UniformFun.toFun_ofFun] using
        UniformFun.tendsto_iff_tendstoUniformly.mp hUniformFun
    apply ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.tendsto_iff_tendstoUniformly.mpr
    change TendstoUniformly (fun t x => d t x) (fun _ : X => (0 : B)) L
    have hvalues : (fun t x => d t x) = (fun t x => D (r x) t) :=
      funext fun t => funext (hvalue t)
    rw [hvalues]
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hUniform.comp r
  refine
    { toFun := fun t f => uniformC0Orbit φ hφ f t
      continuous_orbit := ?_
      add_defect_tendsto := ?_
      smul_defect_tendsto := ?_
      mul_defect_tendsto := ?_
      star_defect_tendsto := ?_ }
  · intro f
    exact map_continuous (uniformC0Orbit φ hφ f)
  · intro f g
    let K : Set (A × A) :=
      (insert 0 (Set.range f)) ×ˢ (insert 0 (Set.range g))
    have hK : IsCompact K :=
      ((zero_at_infty f).isCompact_insert_range_of_cocompact (map_continuous f)).prod
        ((zero_at_infty g).isCompact_insert_range_of_cocompact (map_continuous g))
    let D : C(A × A, AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :=
      { toFun := fun p => F (p.1 + p.2) - (F p.1 + F p.2)
        continuous_toFun :=
          ((map_continuous F).comp (continuous_fst.fun_add continuous_snd)).fun_sub
            (((map_continuous F).comp continuous_fst).fun_add
              ((map_continuous F).comp continuous_snd)) }
    let r : X → K := fun x =>
      ⟨(f x, g x), ⟨Set.mem_insert_of_mem 0 (Set.mem_range_self x),
        Set.mem_insert_of_mem 0 (Set.mem_range_self x)⟩⟩
    refine hlimit K hK D r
      (fun t => uniformC0Orbit φ hφ (f + g) t -
        (uniformC0Orbit φ hφ f t + uniformC0Orbit φ hφ g t)) atTop ?_ ?_
    · intro t x
      change (uniformC0Orbit φ hφ (f + g) t -
        (uniformC0Orbit φ hφ f t + uniformC0Orbit φ hφ g t)) x =
        (F (f x + g x) - (F (f x) + F (g x))) t
      simp only [ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.sub_apply, ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.add_apply,
        hOrbit, BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply]
    · intro p
      change Tendsto (fun t =>
        (F ((p : A × A).1 + (p : A × A).2) -
          (F ((p : A × A).1) + F ((p : A × A).2))) t) atTop (nhds (0 : B))
      simpa only [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply,
        hF, toFun_eq_coe] using
        (AsymptoticMorphism.normalize φ).add_defect_tendsto
          (p : A × A).1 (p : A × A).2
  · intro z f
    let K : Set A := insert 0 (Set.range f)
    have hK : IsCompact K :=
      (zero_at_infty f).isCompact_insert_range_of_cocompact (map_continuous f)
    let D : C(A, AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :=
      { toFun := fun a => F (z • a) - z • F a
        continuous_toFun :=
          ((map_continuous F).comp (continuous_id.fun_const_smul z)).fun_sub
            ((map_continuous F).fun_const_smul z) }
    let r : X → K := fun x => ⟨f x, Set.mem_insert_of_mem 0 (Set.mem_range_self x)⟩
    refine hlimit K hK D r
      (fun t => uniformC0Orbit φ hφ (z • f) t - z • uniformC0Orbit φ hφ f t)
      atTop ?_ ?_
    · intro t x
      change (uniformC0Orbit φ hφ (z • f) t - z • uniformC0Orbit φ hφ f t) x =
        (F (z • f x) - z • F (f x)) t
      simp only [ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.sub_apply, ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.smul_apply,
        hOrbit, BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply]
    · intro a
      change Tendsto (fun t => (F (z • (a : A)) - z • F (a : A)) t)
        atTop (nhds (0 : B))
      simpa only [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply,
        hF, toFun_eq_coe] using
        (AsymptoticMorphism.normalize φ).smul_defect_tendsto z (a : A)
  · intro f g
    let K : Set (A × A) :=
      (insert 0 (Set.range f)) ×ˢ (insert 0 (Set.range g))
    have hK : IsCompact K :=
      ((zero_at_infty f).isCompact_insert_range_of_cocompact (map_continuous f)).prod
        ((zero_at_infty g).isCompact_insert_range_of_cocompact (map_continuous g))
    let D : C(A × A, AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :=
      { toFun := fun p => F (p.1 * p.2) - F p.1 * F p.2
        continuous_toFun :=
          ((map_continuous F).comp (continuous_fst.fun_mul continuous_snd)).fun_sub
            (((map_continuous F).comp continuous_fst).fun_mul
              ((map_continuous F).comp continuous_snd)) }
    let r : X → K := fun x =>
      ⟨(f x, g x), ⟨Set.mem_insert_of_mem 0 (Set.mem_range_self x),
        Set.mem_insert_of_mem 0 (Set.mem_range_self x)⟩⟩
    refine hlimit K hK D r
      (fun t => uniformC0Orbit φ hφ (f * g) t -
        uniformC0Orbit φ hφ f t * uniformC0Orbit φ hφ g t) atTop ?_ ?_
    · intro t x
      change (uniformC0Orbit φ hφ (f * g) t -
        uniformC0Orbit φ hφ f t * uniformC0Orbit φ hφ g t) x =
        (F (f x * g x) - F (f x) * F (g x)) t
      simp only [ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.sub_apply, ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.mul_apply,
        hOrbit, BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.mul_apply]
    · intro p
      change Tendsto (fun t =>
        (F ((p : A × A).1 * (p : A × A).2) -
          F ((p : A × A).1) * F ((p : A × A).2)) t) atTop (nhds (0 : B))
      simpa only [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.mul_apply,
        hF, toFun_eq_coe] using
        (AsymptoticMorphism.normalize φ).mul_defect_tendsto
          (p : A × A).1 (p : A × A).2
  · intro f
    let K : Set A := insert 0 (Set.range f)
    have hK : IsCompact K :=
      (zero_at_infty f).isCompact_insert_range_of_cocompact (map_continuous f)
    let D : C(A, AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :=
      { toFun := fun a => F (star a) - star (F a)
        continuous_toFun :=
          ((map_continuous F).comp continuous_star).fun_sub (map_continuous F).star }
    let r : X → K := fun x => ⟨f x, Set.mem_insert_of_mem 0 (Set.mem_range_self x)⟩
    refine hlimit K hK D r
      (fun t => uniformC0Orbit φ hφ (star f) t - star (uniformC0Orbit φ hφ f t))
      atTop ?_ ?_
    · intro t x
      change (uniformC0Orbit φ hφ (star f) t - star (uniformC0Orbit φ hφ f t)) x =
        (F (star (f x)) - star (F (f x))) t
      simp only [ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.sub_apply, ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.star_apply,
        hOrbit, BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.star_apply]
    · intro a
      change Tendsto (fun t => (F (star (a : A)) - star (F (a : A))) t)
        atTop (nhds (0 : B))
      simpa only [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.star_apply,
        hF, toFun_eq_coe] using
        (AsymptoticMorphism.normalize φ).star_defect_tendsto (a : A)

/-- The computed C₀ family has exactly the normalized pointwise values. -/
@[simp]
theorem uniformC0Morphism_apply {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (hφ : IsUniform φ)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (f : C₀(X, A)) (x : X) :
    uniformC0Morphism φ hφ t f x = AsymptoticMorphism.normalize φ t (f x) := by
  change uniformC0Orbit φ hφ f t x = AsymptoticMorphism.normalize φ t (f x)
  exact uniformC0Orbit_apply φ hφ f t x

/-- Uniformity of the genuine output is witnessed by the same computed orbit map. -/
theorem isUniform_uniformC0Morphism {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (hφ : IsUniform φ) :
    IsUniform (uniformC0Morphism (X := X) φ hφ) := by
  refine ⟨uniformC0Orbit φ hφ, ?_⟩
  intro t f
  rfl

end AsymptoticMorphism

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.NonUnitalRepresentation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarRegularCovariantModel

/-!
# The canonical regular Haar pair from the strict nonunital GN construction

Select the actual same-universe Hilbert representation supplied by the
proved nonunital Gelfand--Naimark construction. Its original dictionaries,
injective coefficient map share the single neutral GN packet and choice.
The original coefficient norm follows from the neutral norm theorem. The
verified original regular construction then gives the coefficient and
Haar translation pair on that selected Hilbert space's actual Lp carrier.

The canonical endpoint has no coefficient-representation or regular-model
input. The group and coefficient universes remain independent, and zero
coefficient algebras are permitted. Independence of the resulting source
model and raw-core faithfulness remain separate theorem obligations.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory
open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace PointNormCStarAction

open MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.NonUnitalRepresentation

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

/-- The actual source-sized coefficient Hilbert space selected from strict GN data. -/
abbrev CanonicalCoefficientSpace (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] : Type uA :=
  (faithfulHilbertRepresentationData A).space

instance instCanonicalCoefficientNormed (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    NormedAddCommGroup (CanonicalCoefficientSpace A) := (faithfulHilbertRepresentationData A).normed

instance instCanonicalCoefficientInner (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    InnerProductSpace ℂ (CanonicalCoefficientSpace A) := (faithfulHilbertRepresentationData A).inner

instance instCanonicalCoefficientComplete (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    CompleteSpace (CanonicalCoefficientSpace A) := (faithfulHilbertRepresentationData A).complete

/-- The canonical coefficient representation is the actual selected strict GN map. -/
def canonicalCoefficientRepresentation (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (CanonicalCoefficientSpace A →L[ℂ] CanonicalCoefficientSpace A) :=
  (faithfulHilbertRepresentationData A).representation

/-- The canonical selected coefficient map is genuinely faithful. -/
theorem canonicalCoefficientRepresentation_injective (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    Function.Injective (canonicalCoefficientRepresentation A) :=
  (faithfulHilbertRepresentationData A).injective_representation

/-- The canonical coefficient operator retains the original algebra norm. -/
theorem norm_canonicalCoefficientRepresentation (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] (a : A) :
    ‖canonicalCoefficientRepresentation A a‖ = ‖a‖ :=
  (faithfulHilbertRepresentationData A).norm_representation a

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.Regular] [μ.IsHaarMeasure] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- The actual original Haar L2 carrier of the internally selected canonical GN coefficient space. -/
abbrev CanonicalRegularSpace := Lp (CanonicalCoefficientSpace A) 2 μ

/-- The actual canonical regular covariant pair, with no external coefficient-model input. -/
def canonicalRegularCovariantRepresentation : CovariantRepresentation α (CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ) :=
  α.regularCovariantRepresentation (canonicalCoefficientRepresentation A) μ

/-- The canonical regular coefficient keeps the original inverse-action formula on every vector. -/
theorem canonicalRegularCoefficient_ae_eq (a : A) (ξ : CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ) :
    (canonicalRegularCovariantRepresentation μ α).algebra a ξ =ᵐ[μ]
      fun s : G => canonicalCoefficientRepresentation A (α s⁻¹ a) (ξ s) :=
  α.regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq (canonicalCoefficientRepresentation A) μ a ξ

/-- The canonical group's actual vector action is the original Haar inverse left translation. -/
theorem canonicalRegularGroup_ae_eq (g : G) (ξ : CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ) :
    ((canonicalRegularCovariantRepresentation μ α).group g :
        CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ →L[ℂ] CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ) ξ =ᵐ[μ]
      fun s : G => ξ (g⁻¹ * s) :=
  StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular_ae_eq G μ (CanonicalCoefficientSpace A) g ξ

end

end PointNormCStarAction

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.CanonicalHaarRegularModel
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarCovariantSeminorm
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Classes
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousLinearMap
public import Mathlib.Topology.Constructions

/-!
# Actual reduced operator closure for the fixed canonical regular pair

Use the strictly constructed canonical GN coefficient space and original
regular Haar covariant pair. Its literal integrated image is a nonunital
star subalgebra of the original bounded L2 operators. Take the actual
operator-norm topological closure and its inherited nonunital C-star data.
The original core map is literal codomain restriction with the same norm.

No Hilbert witness, coefficient representation, reduced model, norm or
comparison equivalence is supplied as a constructor input. Independence
from other faithful coefficient representations is a separate source
statement and is not used as data here.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory
open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace PointNormCStarAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.Regular] [μ.IsHaarMeasure] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- The original bounded operators on the canonical regular Hilbert space have their stock C-star structure. -/
local instance : CStarAlgebra
    (CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ →L[ℂ] CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ) :=
  inferInstance

/-- The original integrated homomorphism of the internally constructed canonical regular pair. -/
def canonicalRegularIntegratedHom : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
    (CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ →L[ℂ] CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ) :=
  CovariantRepresentation.haarIntegratedHom μ (canonicalRegularCovariantRepresentation μ α)

/-- The actual canonical regular integrated norm as the existing C-star seminorm pullback. -/
def canonicalRegularSeminorm : CStarSeminorm (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
  CovariantRepresentation.haarIntegratedCStarSeminorm μ (canonicalRegularCovariantRepresentation μ α)

/-- Every canonical regular seminorm value is the literal original integrated operator norm. -/
@[simp]
theorem canonicalRegularSeminorm_apply (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    canonicalRegularSeminorm μ α f = ‖canonicalRegularIntegratedHom μ α f‖ := rfl

/-- The original full maximal norm bounds each actual canonical regular integrated value. -/
theorem canonicalRegularSeminorm_le_maximal (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    canonicalRegularSeminorm μ α f ≤ HaarTwistedCore.maximalCStarSeminorm μ α f :=
  HaarTwistedCore.le_maximalCStarSeminorm μ α
    (CovariantRepresentation.haarIntegratedCStarSeminorm_mem_admissible μ
      (canonicalRegularCovariantRepresentation μ α)) f

/-- The literal operator-norm closure of the original canonical regular integrated image. -/
def canonicalReducedSubalgebra : NonUnitalStarSubalgebra ℂ
    (CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ →L[ℂ] CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ) :=
  (canonicalRegularIntegratedHom μ α).range.topologicalClosure

/-- The actual reduced operator subalgebra is closed in the original bounded-operator norm. -/
instance isClosed_canonicalReducedSubalgebra :
    IsClosed (canonicalReducedSubalgebra μ α :
      Set (CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ →L[ℂ] CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ)) :=
  (canonicalRegularIntegratedHom μ α).range.isClosed_topologicalClosure

/-- The actual reduced C-star carrier is that same closed operator subalgebra. -/
abbrev CanonicalReducedAlgebra := ↥(canonicalReducedSubalgebra μ α)

/-- The inherited actual nonunital C-star dictionaries on the same reduced operator closure. -/
instance canonicalReducedCStarAlgebra : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α) :=
  inferInstanceAs (NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (canonicalReducedSubalgebra μ α))

/-- The original source coefficient map into its actual canonical reduced operator closure. -/
def toCanonicalReducedAlgebra : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α :=
  (canonicalRegularIntegratedHom μ α).codRestrict (canonicalReducedSubalgebra μ α)
    fun f => (canonicalRegularIntegratedHom μ α).range.le_topologicalClosure
      ((canonicalRegularIntegratedHom μ α).mem_range_self f)

/-- The original core map is dense in its literal canonical reduced operator closure. -/
theorem denseRange_toCanonicalReducedAlgebra : DenseRange (toCanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α) := by
  rw [DenseRange, Subtype.dense_iff, ← Set.range_comp]
  change closure (Set.range (canonicalRegularIntegratedHom μ α)) ⊆
    closure (Set.range (canonicalRegularIntegratedHom μ α))
  exact fun _ hx => hx

/-- The original inclusion of the reduced operator closure into its actual L2 operators. -/
def canonicalReducedAlgebraInclusion : CanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
    (CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ →L[ℂ] CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ) :=
  NonUnitalStarSubalgebraClass.subtype (canonicalReducedSubalgebra μ α)

/-- Every original reduced image has exactly its original canonical regular integrated value. -/
@[simp]
theorem toCanonicalReducedAlgebra_apply (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    canonicalReducedAlgebraInclusion μ α (toCanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α f) =
      canonicalRegularIntegratedHom μ α f := rfl

/-- The original reduced coefficient image has the exact actual canonical regular seminorm. -/
theorem norm_toCanonicalReducedAlgebra (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    ‖toCanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α f‖ = canonicalRegularSeminorm μ α f := rfl

end

end PointNormCStarAction

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.CanonicalReducedAlgebra
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.FullCovariantSeminorm
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.SeminormNonUnitalCompletionHom

/-!
# Actual full-to-canonical-reduced homomorphism

The original canonical regular seminorm is bounded by the computed full
maximum. Extend its original codomain-restricted core map to the actual
full completion using the proved nonunital star-hom completion factory.
Every original full image keeps its same reduced operator value.
No model-independence, quotient or comparison result supplies these data.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory

namespace PointNormCStarAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.Regular] [μ.IsHaarMeasure] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- The actual full completion retains its already constructed nonunital C-star dictionaries. -/
local instance : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (HaarTwistedCore.FullCovariantCompletion μ α) :=
  HaarTwistedCore.fullCovariantCompletionCStarAlgebra μ α

/-- The canonical reduced core map has its proved original full-norm bound. -/
theorem norm_toCanonicalReducedAlgebra_le_full (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    ‖toCanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α f‖ ≤ HaarTwistedCore.maximalCStarSeminorm μ α f :=
  (norm_toCanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α f).trans_le (canonicalRegularSeminorm_le_maximal μ α f)

/-- The actual completed homomorphism from the full carrier to the fixed canonical reduced closure. -/
def fullToCanonicalReducedAlgebra : HaarTwistedCore.FullCovariantCompletion μ α →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
    CanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α :=
  (HaarTwistedCore.maximalCStarSeminorm μ α).fromNonUnitalCompletion
    (toCanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α) (norm_toCanonicalReducedAlgebra_le_full μ α)

/-- Every original full coefficient image retains its actual canonical reduced image. -/
@[simp]
theorem fullToCanonicalReducedAlgebra_apply (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    fullToCanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α (HaarTwistedCore.toFullCovariantCompletion μ α f) =
      toCanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α f :=
  (HaarTwistedCore.maximalCStarSeminorm μ α).fromNonUnitalCompletion_apply
    (toCanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α) (norm_toCanonicalReducedAlgebra_le_full μ α) f

/-- The constructed full-to-reduced function is continuous in the actual C-star norm topologies. -/
theorem continuous_fullToCanonicalReducedAlgebra : Continuous (fullToCanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α) :=
  (HaarTwistedCore.maximalCStarSeminorm μ α).continuous_fromNonUnitalCompletion
    (toCanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α) (norm_toCanonicalReducedAlgebra_le_full μ α)

/-- The actual full map has dense range because its range contains every original reduced core image. -/
theorem denseRange_fullToCanonicalReducedAlgebra : DenseRange (fullToCanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α) := by
  have hrange : Set.range (toCanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α) ⊆
      Set.range (fullToCanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α) := by
    rintro _ ⟨f, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨HaarTwistedCore.toFullCovariantCompletion μ α f,
      fullToCanonicalReducedAlgebra_apply μ α f⟩
  exact fun y => closure_mono hrange (denseRange_toCanonicalReducedAlgebra μ α y)

end

end PointNormCStarAction

Pull back the original bounded-operator C-star norm along the actual Haar
integrated star-algebra homomorphism. Its existing literal L1 coefficient
bound makes this actual seminorm admissible, so the computed intrinsic
maximum bounds every original integrated coefficient.

This bound supplies continuity for the completed representation map on
the actual maximal completion. The Hilbert universe is independent; no
nondegeneracy or full covariant norm identity is used to construct it.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory

namespace CovariantRepresentation

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
variable {α : PointNormCStarAction G A} (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H)

/-- The norm of the original Haar integrated map is an actual source C-star seminorm. -/
def haarIntegratedCStarSeminorm : CStarSeminorm (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
  CStarSeminorm.ofNonUnitalStarAlgHom (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ)

/-- Every seminorm value is the original integrated operator norm. -/
@[simp]
theorem haarIntegratedCStarSeminorm_apply (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    haarIntegratedCStarSeminorm μ ρ f = ‖haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f‖ :=
  rfl

/-- The original coefficient-integral bound makes every actual covariant seminorm admissible. -/
theorem haarIntegratedCStarSeminorm_mem_admissible :
    haarIntegratedCStarSeminorm μ ρ ∈ HaarTwistedCore.admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α := by
  intro f
  change ‖haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f‖ ≤ HaarTwistedCore.l1Gauge μ α f
  exact norm_haarIntegratedHom_le μ ρ f

/-- The intrinsic maximal source seminorm bounds every actual covariant integrated coefficient. -/
theorem norm_haarIntegratedHom_le_maximalCStarSeminorm (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    ‖haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f‖ ≤ HaarTwistedCore.maximalCStarSeminorm μ α f :=
  HaarTwistedCore.le_maximalCStarSeminorm μ α (haarIntegratedCStarSeminorm_mem_admissible μ ρ) f

end

end CovariantRepresentation

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.CharacterContinuity
public import MathlibExt.Topology.Algebra.PontryaginDual.Pairing

/-!
# The actual full locally compact dual action and second crossed-product carrier

The compact-open continuous-character group acts on the same original full
Haar maximal completion by the computed raw character automorphisms. Every
orbit is point-norm continuous by the strict compact-support/dense estimate.
The second crossed product uses the same existing full completion constructor
for that actual action and an original dual Haar measure.

The canonical group-to-bidual evaluation map can pull the second dual action
back to the original group without selecting a Pontryagin-duality equivalence.
No Takai isomorphism, stability result, Fourier model or norm certificate is
used to construct this action or carrier. Nonunital and zero coefficients,
all locally compact group/dual data and the original Haar convention remain.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory
open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace HaarTwistedCore

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (mu : Measure G) [mu.IsHaarMeasure] [mu.Regular] (alpha : PointNormCStarAction G A)

attribute [local instance] fullCovariantCompletionCStarAlgebra

/-- The actual original compact-open dual action on the full Haar crossed product. -/
def fullHaarDualAction :
    PointNormCStarAction (PontryaginDual G) (FullCovariantCompletion mu alpha) where
  toMonoidHom :=
    { toFun := completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha
      map_one' := by
        apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
        intro x
        exact DFunLike.congr_fun (completedCharacterHom_one mu alpha) x
      map_mul' := fun chi eta => by
        apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
        intro x
        exact DFunLike.congr_fun (completedCharacterHom_mul mu alpha chi eta) x }
  continuous_orbit := continuous_completedCharacterEquiv_orbit mu alpha

omit [mu.Regular] in
/-- On the dense original core, the actual dual action has exactly the printed scalar character formula. -/
@[simp]
theorem fullHaarDualAction_apply (chi : PontryaginDual G) (f : Carrier mu alpha) :
    fullHaarDualAction mu alpha chi (toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha f) =
      toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha (characterModulation mu alpha chi f) :=
  completedCharacterEquiv_apply mu alpha chi f

section Double

variable [MeasurableSpace (PontryaginDual G)] [BorelSpace (PontryaginDual G)]
variable (muDual : Measure (PontryaginDual G)) [muDual.IsHaarMeasure] [muDual.Regular]

/-- The actual second full Haar crossed product of the original full carrier by its computed dual action. -/
abbrev DoubleFullHaarCrossedProduct : Type (max uG uA) :=
  FullCovariantCompletion muDual (fullHaarDualAction mu alpha)

/-- The second carrier retains its actual inherited nonunital C-star dictionary. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def doubleFullHaarCrossedProductCStarAlgebra :
    NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (DoubleFullHaarCrossedProduct mu alpha muDual) :=
  fullCovariantCompletionCStarAlgebra muDual (fullHaarDualAction mu alpha)

attribute [local instance] doubleFullHaarCrossedProductCStarAlgebra

/-- The original second crossed-product core has its existing actual dense completed map. -/
def toDoubleFullHaarCrossedProduct :
    Carrier muDual (fullHaarDualAction mu alpha) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] DoubleFullHaarCrossedProduct mu alpha muDual :=
  toFullCovariantCompletion muDual (fullHaarDualAction mu alpha)

/-- The computed second dual action is pulled back along actual original group evaluation. -/
def doubleDualHaarAction :
    PointNormCStarAction G (DoubleFullHaarCrossedProduct mu alpha muDual) :=
  (fullHaarDualAction muDual (fullHaarDualAction mu alpha)).restrict (PontryaginDual.evaluation G)

omit [mu.Regular] [muDual.Regular] in
/-- On the original dense second core, the pulled-back dual action is the actual evaluation character. -/
@[simp]
theorem doubleDualHaarAction_apply (g : G) (f : Carrier muDual (fullHaarDualAction mu alpha)) :
    doubleDualHaarAction mu alpha muDual g (toDoubleFullHaarCrossedProduct mu alpha muDual f) =
      toDoubleFullHaarCrossedProduct mu alpha muDual
        (characterModulation muDual (fullHaarDualAction mu alpha) (PontryaginDual.evaluation G g) f) := by
  simpa only [doubleDualHaarAction, PointNormCStarAction.restrict_apply,
    toDoubleFullHaarCrossedProduct] using
    fullHaarDualAction_apply muDual (fullHaarDualAction mu alpha) (PontryaginDual.evaluation G g) f

end Double
end HaarTwistedCore

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.PointNormAction.EssentialCovariantRepresentation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarIntegratedForm
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.EssentialRestrictionNorm
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.ContinuousLinearMap

/-!
# The actual essential covariant pair preserves its Haar-integrated norm

The original coefficient operators have range in their actual essential
space. Integration through its linear isometric inclusion preserves every
source-vector integral. The source star identity gives the same range
property for the adjoint, so restriction preserves the original operator
norm. This provides the nondegenerate covariant norm model used by the full
source covariant norm, with no faithfulness or norm-equality assumption.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter

namespace CovariantRepresentation

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
variable {α : PointNormCStarAction G A} (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H)

/-- Every original integrated covariant vector lies in the actual coefficient essential space. -/
theorem haarIntegratedHom_mem_essentialSpace (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) (ξ : H) :
    haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f ξ ∈ ρ.algebra.essentialSpace := by
  let φ : G → ρ.algebra.essentialSpace := fun s =>
    ⟨ρ.algebra (f s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ),
      ρ.algebra.range_mem_essentialSpace (f s) _⟩
  have hTransport : (∫ s : G, (φ s : H) ∂μ) =
      ρ.algebra.essentialSpace.subtypeₗᵢ (∫ s : G, φ s ∂μ) :=
    ρ.algebra.essentialSpace.subtypeₗᵢ.integral_comp_comm (μ := μ) φ
  rw [haarIntegratedHom_apply_vector]
  change (∫ s : G, (φ s : H) ∂μ) ∈ ρ.algebra.essentialSpace
  exact hTransport.symm ▸ (∫ s : G, φ s ∂μ).property

/-- The essential covariant pair retains exactly every original integrated source-vector value. -/
theorem essentialCovariantRepresentation_haarIntegratedHom_apply_coe
    (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) (ξ : ρ.algebra.essentialSpace) :
    (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ.essentialCovariantRepresentation f ξ : H) =
      haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f (ξ : H) := by
  let φ : G → ρ.algebra.essentialSpace := fun s =>
    ρ.essentialCovariantRepresentation.algebra (f s)
      ((ρ.essentialCovariantRepresentation.group s :
        ρ.algebra.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.algebra.essentialSpace) ξ)
  have hTransport : (∫ s : G, ρ.algebra.essentialSpace.subtypeₗᵢ (φ s) ∂μ) =
      ρ.algebra.essentialSpace.subtypeₗᵢ (∫ s : G, φ s ∂μ) :=
    ρ.algebra.essentialSpace.subtypeₗᵢ.integral_comp_comm (μ := μ) φ
  calc
    (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ.essentialCovariantRepresentation f ξ : H) =
        ρ.algebra.essentialSpace.subtypeₗᵢ (∫ s : G, φ s ∂μ) := rfl
    _ = ∫ s : G, ρ.algebra.essentialSpace.subtypeₗᵢ (φ s) ∂μ := hTransport.symm
    _ = haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f (ξ : H) := by
      rw [haarIntegratedHom_apply_vector]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl

/-- The actual essential integrated homomorphism is literal restriction of the original operator. -/
theorem essentialCovariantRepresentation_haarIntegratedHom_eq
    (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    haarIntegratedHom μ ρ.essentialCovariantRepresentation f =
      ((haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f).domRestrict ρ.algebra.essentialSpace).codRestrict
        ρ.algebra.essentialSpace (fun ξ => haarIntegratedHom_mem_essentialSpace μ ρ f ξ) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact essentialCovariantRepresentation_haarIntegratedHom_apply_coe μ ρ f ξ

/-- Actual essential restriction preserves the full original Haar-integrated operator norm. -/
theorem norm_essentialCovariantRepresentation_haarIntegratedHom
    (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    ‖haarIntegratedHom μ ρ.essentialCovariantRepresentation f‖ = ‖haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f‖ := by
  have hStarRange (ξ : H) : star (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f) ξ ∈ ρ.algebra.essentialSpace := by
    rw [← map_star]
    exact haarIntegratedHom_mem_essentialSpace μ ρ (star f) ξ
  rw [essentialCovariantRepresentation_haarIntegratedHom_eq]
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_domRestrict_codRestrict_eq_of_range_star
    (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f) ρ.algebra.essentialSpace
    (fun ξ => haarIntegratedHom_mem_essentialSpace μ ρ f ξ) hStarRange

end

end CovariantRepresentation

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.StarRing
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.IntegratedOperator
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Group.HaarWeightedInversion

/-!
# Haar-integrated covariant star-algebra homomorphisms

The original compact-support convolution core acts by its actual vector-integrated
operators. Compact-support vector Fubini and left translation prove multiplication;
the modularly weighted inversion formula and Hilbert adjoints prove star preservation.
The homomorphism retains the original vector action and literal coefficient L1 bound.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter Set
open scoped CompactlySupported CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace Pointwise

namespace CovariantRepresentation

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
variable {α : PointNormCStarAction G A} (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The original Haar convolution acts by the product of its actual integrated operators. -/
theorem haarIntegratedOperator_mul (f g : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
        (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α (f * g)) =
      StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
          (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f) *
        StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
          (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α g) := by
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  let fc : C_c(G, A) := HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f
  let gc : C_c(G, A) := HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α g
  let P : A →L[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
    ⟨{ toFun := ρ.algebra
       map_add' := map_add ρ.algebra
       map_smul' := fun c a => map_smul ρ.algebra c a }, map_continuous ρ.algebra⟩
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  let K : G → G → H := fun s t =>
    ρ.algebra (HaarTwistedCore.kernel α fc gc s t) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)
  have hKcont : Continuous K.uncurry :=
    ((map_continuous ρ.algebra).comp
      (HaarTwistedCore.continuous_kernel α fc gc)).clm_apply
        ((ρ.group.continuous_orbit ξ).comp continuous_fst)
  let Sfg : Set G := tsupport fc * tsupport gc
  have hSfgcompact : IsCompact Sfg := fc.hasCompactSupport.mul gc.hasCompactSupport
  have hSfgclosed : IsClosed Sfg :=
    (isClosed_tsupport gc).mul_left_of_isCompact fc.hasCompactSupport
  have hKzero (p : G × G) (hp : p ∉ Sfg ×ˢ tsupport fc) : K p.1 p.2 = 0 := by
    by_cases ht : p.2 ∈ tsupport fc
    · have hs : p.1 ∉ Sfg := fun hs => hp ⟨hs, ht⟩
      have hg : p.2⁻¹ * p.1 ∉ tsupport gc := by
        intro hg
        apply hs
        simpa only [mul_inv_cancel_left] using Set.mul_mem_mul ht hg
      change ρ.algebra (fc p.2 * α p.2 (gc (p.2⁻¹ * p.1)))
        ((ρ.group p.1 : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) = 0
      rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hg, α.apply_zero, mul_zero, map_zero]
      rfl
    · change ρ.algebra (HaarTwistedCore.kernel α fc gc p.1 p.2)
        ((ρ.group p.1 : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) = 0
      rw [HaarTwistedCore.kernel_zero_of_notMem_tsupport_left α fc gc p.1 p.2 ht, map_zero]
      rfl
  have hKcompact : HasCompactSupport K.uncurry :=
    HasCompactSupport.intro' (hSfgcompact.prod fc.hasCompactSupport)
      (hSfgclosed.prod (isClosed_tsupport fc)) hKzero
  have hLeft :
      StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
          (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α (f * g)) ξ =
        ∫ s : G, (∫ t : G, K s t ∂μ) ∂μ := by
    rw [StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator_apply]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun s => by
      let L : A →L[ℂ] H :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ H ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)).comp P
      have hL := L.integral_comp_comm (HaarTwistedCore.integrable_kernel μ α fc gc s)
      change ρ.algebra (HaarTwistedCore.convolution μ α f g s)
        ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) = ∫ t : G, K s t ∂μ
      rw [HaarTwistedCore.convolution_apply]
      change L (∫ t : G, HaarTwistedCore.kernel α fc gc s t ∂μ) =
        ∫ t : G, L (HaarTwistedCore.kernel α fc gc s t) ∂μ
      exact hL.symm
  have hSwap : (∫ s : G, (∫ t : G, K s t ∂μ) ∂μ) =
      ∫ t : G, (∫ s : G, K s t ∂μ) ∂μ :=
    integral_integral_swap_of_hasCompactSupport hKcont hKcompact
  have hRight : (∫ t : G, (∫ s : G, K s t ∂μ) ∂μ) =
      StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra fc
        (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra gc ξ) := by
    change (∫ t : G, (∫ s : G, K s t ∂μ) ∂μ) =
      ∫ t : G, ρ.algebra (fc t) ((ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H)
        (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra gc ξ)) ∂μ
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun t => by
      let T : H →L[ℂ] H := ρ.algebra (fc t) * (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H)
      have hPoint (r : G) : K (t * r) t =
          T (ρ.algebra (gc r) ((ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)) := by
        have hU : (ρ.group (t * r) : H →L[ℂ] H) =
            (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) * (ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H) :=
          congrArg (fun u : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H) => (u : H →L[ℂ] H))
            (ρ.group.toMonoidHom.map_mul t r)
        have hu : star (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) * (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) = 1 :=
          (ρ.group t).prop.1
        have hCov : ρ.algebra (α t (gc r)) * (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) =
            (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) * ρ.algebra (gc r) := by
          rw [← ρ.covariance t (gc r)]
          simp only [mul_assoc, hu, mul_one]
        have hOp :
            ρ.algebra (fc t * α t (gc r)) * (ρ.group (t * r) : H →L[ℂ] H) =
              (ρ.algebra (fc t) * (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H)) * ρ.algebra (gc r) *
                (ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H) := by
          rw [map_mul ρ.algebra, hU]
          calc
            (ρ.algebra (fc t) * ρ.algebra (α t (gc r))) *
                ((ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) * (ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H)) =
              ρ.algebra (fc t) * (ρ.algebra (α t (gc r)) * (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H)) *
                (ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
            _ = ρ.algebra (fc t) *
                ((ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) * ρ.algebra (gc r)) *
                  (ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H) := by rw [hCov]
            _ = (ρ.algebra (fc t) * (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H)) * ρ.algebra (gc r) *
                (ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
        change ρ.algebra (fc t * α t (gc (t⁻¹ * (t * r))))
          ((ρ.group (t * r) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) = _
        rw [inv_mul_cancel_left]
        exact congrArg (fun B : H →L[ℂ] H => B ξ) hOp
      calc
        (∫ s : G, K s t ∂μ) = ∫ r : G, K (t * r) t ∂μ :=
          (integral_mul_left_eq_self (μ := μ) (fun s : G => K s t) t).symm
        _ = ∫ r : G, T (ρ.algebra (gc r) ((ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)) ∂μ :=
          integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall hPoint)
        _ = T (∫ r : G, ρ.algebra (gc r) ((ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ∂μ) :=
          T.integral_comp_comm
            (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedVector_integrable
              μ ρ.group ρ.algebra gc ξ)
        _ = ρ.algebra (fc t) ((ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H)
            (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator
              μ ρ.group ρ.algebra gc ξ)) :=
          rfl
  exact hLeft.trans (hSwap.trans hRight)

/-- The original modularly weighted Haar involution acts by the actual Hilbert adjoint. -/
theorem haarIntegratedOperator_star (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
        (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α (star f)) =
      star (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
        (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f)) := by
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
  apply (ContinuousLinearMap.eq_adjoint_iff _ _).mpr
  intro ξ η
  let fc : C_c(G, A) := HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f
  let F : G → ℂ := fun s =>
    ⟪ξ, ρ.algebra (fc s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) η)⟫_ℂ
  have hFcont : Continuous F :=
    continuous_const.inner
      (((map_continuous ρ.algebra).comp fc.continuous).clm_apply
        (ρ.group.continuous_orbit η))
  have hFcompact : HasCompactSupport F := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro' fc.hasCompactSupport (isClosed_tsupport fc) ?_
    intro s hs
    change ⟪ξ, ρ.algebra (fc s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) η)⟫_ℂ = 0
    rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hs, map_zero]
    change ⟪ξ, (0 : H)⟫_ℂ = 0
    simp only [inner_zero_right]
  have hPoint (s : G) :
      ⟪ρ.algebra ((star f) s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ), η⟫_ℂ =
        (Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) • F s⁻¹ := by
    have hu : star (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) * (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) = 1 :=
      (ρ.group s).prop.1
    have hCov : ρ.algebra (α s (star (fc s⁻¹))) * (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) =
        (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) * star (ρ.algebra (fc s⁻¹)) := by
      rw [← ρ.covariance s (star (fc s⁻¹)), StarHomClass.map_star ρ.algebra (fc s⁻¹)]
      simp only [mul_assoc, hu, mul_one]
    have hInv : star (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) = (ρ.group s⁻¹ : H →L[ℂ] H) :=
      congrArg (fun u : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H) => (u : H →L[ℂ] H))
        (ρ.group.toMonoidHom.map_inv s).symm
    change ⟪ρ.algebra (HaarTwistedCore.crossedStar μ α f s)
      ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ), η⟫_ℂ = _
    rw [HaarTwistedCore.crossedStar_apply, map_smul]
    simp only [_root_.smul_apply]
    change ⟪((Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) : ℂ) •
      (ρ.algebra (α s (star (fc s⁻¹))) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) : H), η⟫_ℂ = _
    refine (inner_smul_real_left (𝕜 := ℂ)
      (ρ.algebra (α s (star (fc s⁻¹))) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ))
      η (Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ)).trans ?_
    change (Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) •
      ⟪(ρ.algebra (α s (star (fc s⁻¹))) * (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H)) ξ, η⟫_ℂ = _
    rw [hCov]
    apply congrArg (fun z : ℂ => (Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) • z)
    change ⟪(ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) (star (ρ.algebra (fc s⁻¹)) ξ), η⟫_ℂ =
      ⟪ξ, ρ.algebra (fc s⁻¹) ((ρ.group s⁻¹ : H →L[ℂ] H) η)⟫_ℂ
    calc
      _ = ⟪star (ρ.algebra (fc s⁻¹)) ξ, star (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) η⟫_ℂ :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H)
          (star (ρ.algebra (fc s⁻¹)) ξ) η).symm
      _ = ⟪ξ, ρ.algebra (fc s⁻¹) (star (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) η)⟫_ℂ :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (ρ.algebra (fc s⁻¹))
          (star (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) η) ξ
      _ = _ := by rw [hInv]
  have hLeft :
      (∫ s : G, ⟪ρ.algebra ((star f) s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ), η⟫_ℂ ∂μ) =
        ⟪StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
          (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α (star f)) ξ, η⟫_ℂ :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_commSL (by intro r z; simp) (innerSLFlip ℂ η)
      (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedVector_integrable μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
        (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α (star f)) ξ)
  have hRight : (∫ s : G, F s ∂μ) =
      ⟪ξ, StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra fc η⟫_ℂ :=
    (innerSL ℂ ξ).integral_comp_comm
      (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedVector_integrable μ ρ.group ρ.algebra fc η)
  calc
    _ = ∫ s : G, ⟪ρ.algebra ((star f) s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ), η⟫_ℂ ∂μ := hLeft.symm
    _ = ∫ s : G, (Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) • F s⁻¹ ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall hPoint)
    _ = ∫ s : G, F s ∂μ :=
      integral_modularCharacter_smul_inv_of_hasCompactSupport μ hFcont hFcompact
    _ = _ := hRight

/-- The actual Haar core homomorphism whose values are the original vector-integrated operators. -/
def haarIntegratedHom : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) where
  toFun f := StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
    (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f)
  map_zero' := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro ξ
    rw [StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator_apply,
      HaarTwistedCore.toCc_zero]
    simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.zero_apply, map_zero]
    change (∫ _ : G, (0 : H) ∂μ) = (0 : H)
    exact integral_zero G H
  map_add' := by
    intro f g
    rw [HaarTwistedCore.toCc_add]
    exact StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator_add μ ρ.group ρ.algebra _ _
  map_mul' := haarIntegratedOperator_mul μ ρ
  map_smul' := by
    intro c f
    change StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
        (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α (c • f)) =
      c • StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
        (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f)
    rw [HaarTwistedCore.toCc_smul]
    exact StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator_smul μ ρ.group ρ.algebra _ _
  map_star' := haarIntegratedOperator_star μ ρ

/-- The computed homomorphism value is the original integrated operator on the same coefficient. -/
@[simp]
theorem haarIntegratedHom_apply (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f =
      StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
        (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f) :=
  rfl

/-- Every Hilbert-vector action is the literal original integrated covariant formula. -/
theorem haarIntegratedHom_apply_vector (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) (ξ : H) :
    haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f ξ =
      ∫ s : G, ρ.algebra (f s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ∂μ :=
  rfl

/-- The actual integrated homomorphism has the original Haar L1 coefficient bound. -/
theorem norm_haarIntegratedHom_le (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    ‖haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f‖ ≤ ∫ s : G, ‖f s‖ ∂μ :=
  StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.norm_integratedOperator_le μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
    (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f)

end

end CovariantRepresentation

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarIntegratedForm
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.MultiplierActions

/-!
# Actual integrated actions of the original Haar-core multipliers

Integrating the original coefficient and group actions gives multiplication
by the covariant coefficient operators and group unitaries. Consequently each
covariant operator seminorm has the actual coefficient bound and is unchanged
by either group action. These are prerequisites for the canonical multiplier
maps on the full crossed product. No raw-core norm or completed-model datum is
assumed, and no all-covariant supremum identity is asserted here.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped CompactlySupported CStarAlgebra

namespace CovariantRepresentation

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
variable {α : PointNormCStarAction G A} (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H)

/-- Original left coefficients integrate to left multiplication by the actual coefficient operator. -/
theorem haarIntegratedHom_coefficientLeft (a : A) (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    haarIntegratedHom μ ρ (HaarTwistedCore.coefficientLeft μ α a f) =
      ρ.algebra a * haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  rw [haarIntegratedHom_apply_vector]
  change (∫ s : G, ρ.algebra (a * f s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ∂μ) =
    ρ.algebra a (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f ξ)
  simp_rw [map_mul ρ.algebra]
  change (∫ s : G, ρ.algebra a (ρ.algebra (f s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)) ∂μ) =
    ρ.algebra a (∫ s : G, ρ.algebra (f s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ∂μ)
  exact (ρ.algebra a).integral_comp_comm
    (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedVector_integrable μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
      (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f) ξ)

/-- Original right coefficients integrate to right multiplication by the actual coefficient operator. -/
theorem haarIntegratedHom_coefficientRight (a : A) (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    haarIntegratedHom μ ρ (HaarTwistedCore.coefficientRight μ α a f) =
      haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f * ρ.algebra a := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  rw [haarIntegratedHom_apply_vector]
  change (∫ s : G, ρ.algebra (f s * α s a) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ∂μ) =
    haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f (ρ.algebra a ξ)
  rw [haarIntegratedHom_apply_vector]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with s
  have hu : star (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) * (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) = 1 :=
    (ρ.group s).prop.1
  have hCov : ρ.algebra (α s a) * (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) =
      (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) * ρ.algebra a := by
    rw [← ρ.covariance s a]
    simp only [mul_assoc, hu, mul_one]
  have hOp : ρ.algebra (f s * α s a) * (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) =
      ρ.algebra (f s) * (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) * ρ.algebra a := by
    rw [map_mul ρ.algebra]
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using congrArg (fun T => ρ.algebra (f s) * T) hCov
  exact congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => T ξ) hOp

/-- Original inverse left translation integrates to left multiplication by the group unitary. -/
theorem haarIntegratedHom_groupLeft (g : G) (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    haarIntegratedHom μ ρ (HaarTwistedCore.groupLeft μ α g f) =
      (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) * haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  rw [haarIntegratedHom_apply_vector]
  let K : G → H := fun s =>
    ρ.algebra (α g (f (g⁻¹ * s))) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)
  change (∫ s : G, K s ∂μ) = (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f ξ)
  calc
    _ = ∫ t : G, K (g * t) ∂μ := (integral_mul_left_eq_self (μ := μ) K g).symm
    _ = ∫ t : G, (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H)
        (ρ.algebra (f t) ((ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with t
      have hu : star (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) * (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) = 1 :=
        (ρ.group g).prop.1
      have hCov : ρ.algebra (α g (f t)) * (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) =
          (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) * ρ.algebra (f t) := by
        rw [← ρ.covariance g (f t)]
        simp only [mul_assoc, hu, mul_one]
      simp only [K, inv_mul_cancel_left, ρ.group.apply_mul]
      exact congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => T ((ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)) hCov
    _ = (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H)
        (∫ t : G, ρ.algebra (f t) ((ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ∂μ) :=
      (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H).integral_comp_comm
        (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedVector_integrable μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
          (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f) ξ)
    _ = _ := rfl

/-- Original modular right translation integrates to right multiplication by the group unitary. -/
theorem haarIntegratedHom_groupRight (g : G) (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    haarIntegratedHom μ ρ (HaarTwistedCore.groupRight μ α g f) =
      haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f * (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  rw [haarIntegratedHom_apply_vector]
  let F : G → H := fun s =>
    ρ.algebra (f (s * g⁻¹)) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)
  change (∫ s : G, ρ.algebra (((Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) : ℂ) • f (s * g⁻¹))
    ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ∂μ) =
      haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f ((ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)
  calc
    _ = ∫ s : G, (Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) • F s ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with s
      rw [map_smul]
      rfl
    _ = (Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) • ∫ s : G, F s ∂μ := integral_smul _ _
    _ = ∫ t : G, F (t * g) ∂μ := (integral_mul_right_modular μ F g).symm
    _ = ∫ t : G, ρ.algebra (f t)
        ((ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) ((ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with t
      simp only [F, mul_inv_cancel_right, ρ.group.apply_mul]
    _ = _ := rfl

/-- Every covariant seminorm has the actual left coefficient norm bound. -/
theorem norm_haarIntegratedHom_coefficientLeft_le (a : A) (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    ‖haarIntegratedHom μ ρ (HaarTwistedCore.coefficientLeft μ α a f)‖ ≤
      ‖a‖ * ‖haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f‖ := by
  rw [haarIntegratedHom_coefficientLeft]
  exact (norm_mul_le _ _).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le ρ.algebra a) (norm_nonneg _))

/-- Every covariant seminorm has the actual right coefficient norm bound. -/
theorem norm_haarIntegratedHom_coefficientRight_le (a : A) (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    ‖haarIntegratedHom μ ρ (HaarTwistedCore.coefficientRight μ α a f)‖ ≤
      ‖haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f‖ * ‖a‖ := by
  rw [haarIntegratedHom_coefficientRight]
  exact (norm_mul_le _ _).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le ρ.algebra a) (norm_nonneg _))

/-- Every covariant seminorm is unchanged by original inverse left translation. -/
theorem norm_haarIntegratedHom_groupLeft (g : G) (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    ‖haarIntegratedHom μ ρ (HaarTwistedCore.groupLeft μ α g f)‖ =
      ‖haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f‖ := by
  rw [haarIntegratedHom_groupLeft]
  exact CStarRing.norm_coe_unitary_mul (ρ.group g) (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f)

/-- Every covariant seminorm is unchanged by original modular right translation. -/
theorem norm_haarIntegratedHom_groupRight (g : G) (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    ‖haarIntegratedHom μ ρ (HaarTwistedCore.groupRight μ α g f)‖ =
      ‖haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f‖ := by
  rw [haarIntegratedHom_groupRight]
  exact CStarRing.norm_mul_coe_unitary (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f) (ρ.group g)

end

end CovariantRepresentation

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarIntegratedForm
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Algebra.NonUnitalStarCompletion.Hom

/-!
# The actual Haar-integrated representation on the original L1 completion

The literal L1 coefficient bound makes the original integrated star-algebra
homomorphism continuous for the computed L1 source norm. The existing
nonunital star-hom completion extension then acts on the same ordinary L1
completion. Its dense coefficient values are the original vector integral;
it is continuous and contractive, and these values determine it uniquely.

No approximate identity, source nondegeneracy, full covariant norm
comparison or alternative completed model is assumed by this construction.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory

namespace CovariantRepresentation

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
variable {α : PointNormCStarAction G A} (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H)

/-- The original coefficient-integral bound makes the same integrated map L1-continuous. -/
theorem continuous_haarIntegratedHom_for_L1 :
    let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
    Continuous (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
  let L : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α →ₗ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
    { toFun := haarIntegratedHom μ ρ
      map_add' := map_add (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ)
      map_smul' := fun c f => map_smul (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ) c f }
  let T : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α →L[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
    L.mkContinuous 1 (by
      intro f
      change ‖haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f‖ ≤ 1 * HaarTwistedCore.l1Gauge μ α f
      simpa only [one_mul, HaarTwistedCore.l1Gauge] using norm_haarIntegratedHom_le μ ρ f)
  exact T.continuous

/-- Extend the original integrated map through the same ordinary L1 completion. -/
def haarL1IntegratedHom :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
  let _ : NormedStarGroup (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1NormedStarGroup μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.fromCompletion (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ)
    (continuous_haarIntegratedHom_for_L1 μ ρ)

/-- The same completed map retains every original integrated coefficient value. -/
theorem haarL1IntegratedHom_apply (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    haarL1IntegratedHom μ ρ (HaarTwistedCore.toL1Completion μ α f) =
      haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
  let _ : NormedStarGroup (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1NormedStarGroup μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.fromCompletion_apply_coe (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ)
    (continuous_haarIntegratedHom_for_L1 μ ρ) f

/-- Every dense coefficient acts by the literal original Haar vector integral. -/
theorem haarL1IntegratedHom_apply_vector (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) (ξ : H) :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    haarL1IntegratedHom μ ρ (HaarTwistedCore.toL1Completion μ α f) ξ =
      ∫ s : G, ρ.algebra (f s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ∂μ := by
  rw [haarL1IntegratedHom_apply, haarIntegratedHom_apply_vector]

/-- The existing extension is continuous in the actual L1 completion topology. -/
theorem continuous_haarL1IntegratedHom :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    Continuous (haarL1IntegratedHom μ ρ) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
  let _ : NormedStarGroup (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1NormedStarGroup μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.continuous_fromCompletion (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ)
    (continuous_haarIntegratedHom_for_L1 μ ρ)

/-- The original L1 bound persists on every element of the same completed algebra. -/
theorem norm_haarL1IntegratedHom_le (x : HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    ‖haarL1IntegratedHom μ ρ x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
  let _ : NormedStarGroup (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1NormedStarGroup μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  have hcont := continuous_haarL1IntegratedHom μ ρ
  refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on
    (α := HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α)
    (p := fun x : HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α => ‖haarL1IntegratedHom μ ρ x‖ ≤ ‖x‖)
    x (isClosed_le (continuous_norm.comp hcont) continuous_norm) ?_
  intro f
  have hvalue : haarL1IntegratedHom μ ρ (f : HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) =
      haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f :=
    haarL1IntegratedHom_apply μ ρ f
  rw [hvalue, UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe]
  change ‖haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f‖ ≤ HaarTwistedCore.l1Gauge μ α f
  exact norm_haarIntegratedHom_le μ ρ f

/-- A continuous nonunital star hom with the same dense original values is this extension. -/
theorem haarL1IntegratedHom_unique :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
      HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    ∀ ψ : HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H),
      Continuous ψ →
        (∀ f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α,
          ψ (HaarTwistedCore.toL1Completion μ α f) = haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f) →
        ψ = haarL1IntegratedHom μ ρ := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
  let _ : NormedStarGroup (HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.sourceL1NormedStarGroup μ α
  let completionRing : NonUnitalNormedRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let completionNormedSpace : NormedSpace ℂ (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let completionStar : StarRing (HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α) :=
    HaarTwistedCore.l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  change ∀ hom : HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion μ α →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H),
    Continuous hom →
      (∀ f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α,
        hom (HaarTwistedCore.toL1Completion μ α f) = haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f) →
      hom = haarL1IntegratedHom μ ρ
  intro hom hhom hcoeff
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.fromCompletion_unique (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ)
    (continuous_haarIntegratedHom_for_L1 μ ρ) hom hhom hcoeff

end

end CovariantRepresentation
