module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarCovariantSeminorm
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.SeminormNonUnitalCompletionHom

/-!
# The original integrated representation on the actual intrinsic maximal completion

The actual integrated seminorm is bounded by the computed intrinsic
maximum on the original Haar core. Use the same bounded nonunital
star-hom separation/completion extension on that exact maximum. Its
canonical source images retain the literal original Haar vector integral.

The construction permits an arbitrary independent Hilbert universe and
requires no supplied completed representation. The identification of this
intrinsic seminorm with all nondegenerate covariant norms and the faithful
full crossed-product source statement remain separate obligations.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory

namespace CovariantRepresentation

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
variable {α : PointNormCStarAction G A} (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H)

/-- The original Haar integrated map extended to the same intrinsic maximal seminorm completion. -/
def haarMaximalIntegratedHom :
    let p := HaarTwistedCore.maximalCStarSeminorm μ α
    let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
    p.NonUnitalCompletion →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) := by
  let p := HaarTwistedCore.maximalCStarSeminorm μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
  change p.NonUnitalCompletion →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H)
  exact p.fromNonUnitalCompletion (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ)
    (norm_haarIntegratedHom_le_maximalCStarSeminorm μ ρ)

/-- Every original coefficient retains its actual integrated operator value. -/
theorem haarMaximalIntegratedHom_apply (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    let p := HaarTwistedCore.maximalCStarSeminorm μ α
    let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
    haarMaximalIntegratedHom μ ρ (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) = haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f := by
  let p := HaarTwistedCore.maximalCStarSeminorm μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
  change p.fromNonUnitalCompletion (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ)
    (norm_haarIntegratedHom_le_maximalCStarSeminorm μ ρ) (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) = _
  exact p.fromNonUnitalCompletion_apply (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ)
    (norm_haarIntegratedHom_le_maximalCStarSeminorm μ ρ) f

/-- The completed source image acts by the literal original Haar vector integral. -/
theorem haarMaximalIntegratedHom_apply_vector (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) (ξ : H) :
    let p := HaarTwistedCore.maximalCStarSeminorm μ α
    let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
    haarMaximalIntegratedHom μ ρ (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ =
      ∫ s : G, ρ.algebra (f s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ∂μ := by
  let p := HaarTwistedCore.maximalCStarSeminorm μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
  exact (congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => T ξ) (haarMaximalIntegratedHom_apply μ ρ f)).trans
    (haarIntegratedHom_apply_vector μ ρ f ξ)

/-- The constructed original completed representation is continuous in that completion's norm. -/
theorem continuous_haarMaximalIntegratedHom :
    let p := HaarTwistedCore.maximalCStarSeminorm μ α
    let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
    Continuous (haarMaximalIntegratedHom μ ρ) := by
  let p := HaarTwistedCore.maximalCStarSeminorm μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
  change Continuous (p.fromNonUnitalCompletion (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ)
    (norm_haarIntegratedHom_le_maximalCStarSeminorm μ ρ))
  exact p.continuous_fromNonUnitalCompletion (haarIntegratedHom μ ρ)
    (norm_haarIntegratedHom_le_maximalCStarSeminorm μ ρ)

end

end CovariantRepresentation

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarRegularCovariantModel
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.CompactSupportFaithful
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Hom

/-!
# Faithful original regular coefficient operators on the actual Haar L2 carrier

An actual zero regular coefficient operator annihilates every original
compact-support vector. The open-positive compact-support inclusion recovers
its literal pointwise values. Test a compact scalar bump nonzero at the
identity to recover the original coefficient operator rho(a).

A faithful original coefficient representation therefore gives a faithful
regular coefficient homomorphism, and the C-star homomorphism theorem gives
its original coefficient norm. This supplies faithful regular coefficient
maps for the reduced/full comparison without an assumed regular model or
source norm equality. The canonical GN selection is a separate constructor.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory
open scoped CompactlySupported CStarAlgebra

namespace PointNormCStarAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (ρ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H))
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.Regular] [μ.IsHaarMeasure]

/-- A zero original regular coefficient operator has zero original coefficient value under rho. -/
theorem regularCoefficientOperator_eq_zero_implies (a : A)
    (hZero : regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a = 0) : ρ a = 0 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψcomp, _hψnonneg, hψone⟩ := exists_continuous_nonneg_pos (1 : G)
  let F : C_c(G, H) :=
    { toFun s := ((ψ s : ℝ) : ℂ) • ξ
      continuous_toFun :=
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp ψ.continuous).smul continuous_const
      hasCompactSupport' := hψcomp.comp_left
        (g := fun r : ℝ => (r : ℂ) • ξ) (by simp) }
  let T := regularCoefficientField α ρ a
  let hT := continuous_regularCoefficientField_action α ρ a
  let J : C_c(G, H) := HaarL2.pointwiseCompactSupport T hT F
  have hImage : HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ J = 0 := by
    rw [← HaarL2.pointwiseOperator_apply_compactSupport T hT μ ‖a‖
      (norm_regularCoefficientField_le α ρ a) F]
    change regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a (HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ F) = 0
    rw [hZero]
    rfl
  have hJ : J = 0 := HaarL2.injective_compactSupportInclusion μ
    (hImage.trans (map_zero (HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion (H := H) μ)).symm)
  have hValue := congrArg (fun f : C_c(G, H) => f (1 : G)) hJ
  change ρ (α (1 : G)⁻¹ a) (((ψ (1 : G) : ℝ) : ℂ) • ξ) = 0 at hValue
  rw [inv_one, α.apply_one, map_smul] at hValue
  have hScalar : ((ψ (1 : G) : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hψone
    simpa using congrArg Complex.re h
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hValue).resolve_left hScalar

/-- A faithful original coefficient representation gives a faithful actual regular coefficient map. -/
theorem regularCoefficientHom_injective (hρ : Function.Injective ρ) :
    Function.Injective (regularCoefficientHom α ρ μ) := by
  intro a b hab
  apply hρ
  have hZero : regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (a - b) = 0 := by
    change regularCoefficientHom α ρ μ (a - b) = 0
    rw [map_sub, hab, sub_self]
  have hOriginal := regularCoefficientOperator_eq_zero_implies α ρ μ (a - b) hZero
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa only [map_sub] using hOriginal)

/-- The actual faithful regular coefficient homomorphism has the original source C-star norm. -/
theorem norm_regularCoefficientHom (hρ : Function.Injective ρ) (a : A) :
    ‖regularCoefficientHom α ρ μ a‖ = ‖a‖ :=
  NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_map (regularCoefficientHom α ρ μ)
    (regularCoefficientHom_injective α ρ μ hρ) a

end

end PointNormCStarAction

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.PointwiseOperator
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarRegularRepresentation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.PointNormAction
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Spectrum
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousLinearMap

/-!
# The original regular covariant model from an actual coefficient representation

On the original Lp H 2 Haar carrier, the coefficient at s is
rho(alpha(s inverse)(a)) applied to the original vector at s. The computed
bounded pointwise operator gives this literal formula on all L2 vectors.
The existing Haar left unitaries and these coefficient operators satisfy
the original covariance identity and define the actual regular pair.

The input is the original coefficient star representation, with independent
group, coefficient and Hilbert universes. No regular model, desired output
identity, countability or raw-core faithfulness is assumed. A canonical
source construction may later select an existing faithful GN representation;
source model independence remains a separate obligation.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace

namespace PointNormCStarAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (ρ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H))

/-- The original inverse-action coefficient field on the original Hilbert vectors. -/
def regularCoefficientField (a : A) : G → H →L[ℂ] H := fun s => ρ (α s⁻¹ a)

/-- The original point-norm action makes its coefficient field jointly vector continuous. -/
theorem continuous_regularCoefficientField_action (a : A) :
    Continuous (fun z : G × H => regularCoefficientField α ρ a z.1 z.2) := by
  have hρ : Continuous (ρ : A → (H →L[ℂ] H)) := map_continuous ρ
  exact ((hρ.comp ((α.continuous_orbit a).comp continuous_inv)).comp
    continuous_fst).clm_apply continuous_snd

omit [IsTopologicalGroup G] in
/-- The original coefficient norm uniformly bounds this actual operator field. -/
theorem norm_regularCoefficientField_le (a : A) (s : G) :
    ‖regularCoefficientField α ρ a s‖ ≤ ‖a‖ := by
  change ‖ρ (α s⁻¹ a)‖ ≤ ‖a‖
  exact (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le ρ (α s⁻¹ a)).trans (α.norm_apply s⁻¹ a).le

variable [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.Regular]

/-- The actual original regular coefficient operator on the same vector-valued L2 carrier. -/
def regularCoefficientOperator (a : A) : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ :=
  HaarL2.pointwiseOperator (regularCoefficientField α ρ a)
    (continuous_regularCoefficientField_action α ρ a) μ ‖a‖
    (norm_regularCoefficientField_le α ρ a)

/-- Every original L2 vector retains the printed inverse-action coefficient formula. -/
theorem regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq (a : A) (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a ξ =ᵐ[μ] fun s : G => ρ (α s⁻¹ a) (ξ s) :=
  HaarL2.pointwiseOperator_ae_eq (regularCoefficientField α ρ a)
    (continuous_regularCoefficientField_action α ρ a) μ ‖a‖
    (norm_regularCoefficientField_le α ρ a) ξ

/-- The original coefficient norm bounds every actual L2 image. -/
theorem norm_regularCoefficientOperator_apply_le (a : A) (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    ‖regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a ξ‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * ‖ξ‖ :=
  HaarL2.pointwiseOperator_norm_apply_le (regularCoefficientField α ρ a)
    (continuous_regularCoefficientField_action α ρ a) μ ‖a‖
    (norm_regularCoefficientField_le α ρ a) ξ

/-- The actual regular coefficient operators preserve original coefficient addition. -/
theorem regularCoefficientOperator_add (a b : A) :
    regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (a + b) =
      regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a + regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ b := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ (a + b) ξ,
    regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ a ξ,
    regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ b ξ,
    Lp.coeFn_add (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a ξ) (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ b ξ)]
    with s h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
  change regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (a + b) ξ s =
    (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a ξ + regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ b ξ) s
  rw [h₁, h₄, Pi.add_apply, h₂, h₃, map_add (α.aut s⁻¹), map_add ρ]
  rfl

/-- The actual regular coefficient operators preserve original complex scaling. -/
theorem regularCoefficientOperator_smul (c : ℂ) (a : A) :
    regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (c • a) = c • regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ (c • a) ξ,
    regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ a ξ,
    Lp.coeFn_smul c (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a ξ)] with s h₁ h₂ h₃
  change regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (c • a) ξ s =
    (c • regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a ξ) s
  rw [h₁, h₃, Pi.smul_apply, h₂, map_smul (α.aut s⁻¹), map_smul ρ]
  rfl

/-- The actual regular coefficient operators preserve original coefficient multiplication. -/
theorem regularCoefficientOperator_mul (a b : A) :
    regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (a * b) =
      regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a * regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ b := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ (a * b) ξ,
    regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ a (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ b ξ),
    regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ b ξ] with s h₁ h₂ h₃
  change regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (a * b) ξ s =
    regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ b ξ) s
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃, map_mul (α.aut s⁻¹), map_mul ρ]
  rfl

/-- The original coefficient involution gives the actual L2 operator adjoint. -/
theorem regularCoefficientOperator_star (a : A) :
    regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (star a) = star (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a) := by
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
  apply (ContinuousLinearMap.eq_adjoint_iff
    (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (star a)) (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a)).mpr
  intro ξ η
  rw [L2.inner_def, L2.inner_def]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ (star a) ξ,
    regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ a η] with s h₁ h₂
  rw [h₁, h₂, StarHomClass.map_star (α.aut s⁻¹), StarHomClass.map_star ρ]
  change ⟪star (ρ (α s⁻¹ a)) (ξ s), η s⟫_ℂ = ⟪ξ s, ρ (α s⁻¹ a) (η s)⟫_ℂ
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (ρ (α s⁻¹ a)) (η s) (ξ s)

/-- The computed original regular coefficient representation is a nonunital complex star hom. -/
def regularCoefficientHom : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) where
  toFun := regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ
  map_zero' := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro ξ
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ (0 : A) ξ,
      Lp.coeFn_zero H 2 μ] with s h₁ h₂
    change regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (0 : A) ξ s = (0 : Lp H 2 μ) s
    rw [h₁, h₂, map_zero (α.aut s⁻¹), map_zero ρ]
    rfl
  map_add' := regularCoefficientOperator_add α ρ μ
  map_mul' := regularCoefficientOperator_mul α ρ μ
  map_smul' := regularCoefficientOperator_smul α ρ μ
  map_star' := regularCoefficientOperator_star α ρ μ

variable [μ.IsHaarMeasure]

/-- The original Haar left translations and coefficient operators satisfy original covariance. -/
theorem regularCoefficientOperator_covariance (g : G) (a : A) :
    (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) * regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a *
      star (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) = regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (α g a) := by
  rw [StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.star_haarLeftRegular]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  let L (h : G) : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ :=
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H h
  let η := L g⁻¹ ξ
  have houter := StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular_ae_eq G μ H g
    (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a η)
  have hcoefficient := regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ a η
  have hinner := StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular_ae_eq G μ H g⁻¹ ξ
  have hpres : MeasurePreserving (fun s : G => g⁻¹ * s) μ μ := measurePreserving_smul g⁻¹ μ
  have hquasi : QuasiMeasurePreserving (fun s : G => g⁻¹ * s) μ μ :=
    ⟨hpres.measurable, by rw [hpres.map_eq]⟩
  have hcoefficient' := hquasi.ae_eq_comp hcoefficient
  have hinner' := hquasi.ae_eq_comp hinner
  filter_upwards [houter, hcoefficient', hinner', regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ (α g a) ξ]
    with s h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
  change L g (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a (L g⁻¹ ξ)) s =
    regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (α g a) ξ s
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at h₂ h₃
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄]
  simp only [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, mul_inv_cancel_left]
  exact congrArg (fun b : A => ρ b (ξ s)) (α.apply_mul s⁻¹ g a)

/-- The actual original regular covariant pair on the original vector-valued Haar L2 carrier. -/
def regularCovariantRepresentation : CovariantRepresentation α (Lp H 2 μ) where
  algebra := regularCoefficientHom α ρ μ
  group := StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H
  covariance := by
    intro g a
    change (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) * regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a *
      star (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) = regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (α g a)
    exact regularCoefficientOperator_covariance α ρ μ g a

end

end PointNormCStarAction

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.PointNormAction
public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.CompactlySupported
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.TransferInstance
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.TransferInstance
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Basic

/-!
# The original measure- and action-indexed Haar core carrier

The carrier is a one-field wrapper of the literal original C_c(G,A) function.
Both the given measure and coefficient action are indices, so different Haar
measures or actions have their own future twisted algebra structures. Exact
maps to and from C_c transport only the original additive and complex-module
data and function evaluation. Multiplication, star and norm are not inherited.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory
open scoped CompactlySupported

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Monoid G] [TopologicalSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The actual original compact-support function, indexed by its measure and coefficient action. -/
structure Carrier (μ : Measure G) (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) where
  /-- The same literal source compactly supported continuous coefficient function. -/
  toCc : C_c(G, A)

variable (μ : Measure G) (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- Read the original compact-support function without changing its values or topology. -/
def toCc (f : Carrier μ α) : C_c(G, A) := f.toCc

/-- Put the original compact-support function into its actual measure/action-indexed carrier. -/
def fromCc (f : C_c(G, A)) : Carrier μ α := ⟨f⟩

/-- The wrapper retains every original compact-support function exactly. -/
@[simp]
theorem toCc_fromCc (f : C_c(G, A)) : toCc μ α (fromCc μ α f) = f :=
  rfl

/-- The exact original function determines the same indexed wrapper. -/
@[simp]
theorem fromCc_toCc (f : Carrier μ α) : fromCc μ α (toCc μ α f) = f := by
  cases f
  rfl

/-- The measure/action-indexed carrier is exactly the original function type as a set of values. -/
def equivCc : Carrier μ α ≃ C_c(G, A) where
  toFun := toCc μ α
  invFun := fromCc μ α
  left_inv := fromCc_toCc μ α
  right_inv := toCc_fromCc μ α

/-- Only the original pointwise additive group is transported to the indexed core. -/
instance instAddCommGroupCarrier : AddCommGroup (Carrier μ α) :=
  (equivCc μ α).addCommGroup

/-- Only the original pointwise complex module is transported to the indexed core. -/
instance instModuleCarrier : Module ℂ (Carrier μ α) := by
  let e : Carrier μ α ≃+ C_c(G, A) := (equivCc μ α).addEquiv
  exact e.module ℂ

/-- Evaluation is the literal original compact-support coefficient value. -/
instance instCoeFunCarrier : CoeFun (Carrier μ α) (fun _ => G → A) :=
  ⟨fun f => (toCc μ α f : G → A)⟩

/-- The indexed additive zero is the same original zero coefficient function. -/
@[simp]
theorem toCc_zero : toCc μ α (0 : Carrier μ α) = 0 :=
  rfl

/-- Indexed addition retains the original pointwise additive coefficient function. -/
@[simp]
theorem toCc_add (f g : Carrier μ α) : toCc μ α (f + g) = toCc μ α f + toCc μ α g :=
  rfl

/-- Indexed complex scaling retains the original scalar coefficient function. -/
@[simp]
theorem toCc_smul (c : ℂ) (f : Carrier μ α) : toCc μ α (c • f) = c • toCc μ α f :=
  rfl

/-- The indexed core functions agree precisely when all original coefficient values agree. -/
@[ext]
theorem ext {f g : Carrier μ α} (h : ∀ s : G, f s = g s) : f = g := by
  apply (equivCc μ α).injective
  apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
  intro s
  exact h s

end

end HaarTwistedCore

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.CharacterSeminorm
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.SeminormNonUnitalCompletionHom
public import Mathlib.Topology.DenseEmbedding

/-!
# The actual dual character automorphism on the original full Haar completion

Extend the computed raw character automorphism on the same original maximal
norm quotient/completion. Its actual bound is the proved gauge isometry.
Dense original coefficient images prove identity, composition and the
inverse character laws. No completed action, norm, model or equivalence
conclusion is supplied as a constructor premise.

Point-norm continuity in the character parameter is a separate required
constructor fact; no global dual action is selected before it is proved.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory

namespace HaarTwistedCore

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (mu : Measure G) [mu.IsHaarMeasure] [mu.Regular] (alpha : PointNormCStarAction G A)

attribute [local instance] fullCovariantCompletionCStarAlgebra

/-- The original full-completion endomorphism induced by the actual raw character map. -/
def completedCharacterHom (chi : PontryaginDual G) :
    FullCovariantCompletion mu alpha →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] FullCovariantCompletion mu alpha := by
  let p := maximalCStarSeminorm mu alpha
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
  let f := p.toNonUnitalCompletion.comp (characterModulationEquiv mu alpha chi).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
  exact p.fromNonUnitalCompletion f (fun x => by
    change ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion (characterModulation mu alpha chi x)‖ ≤ p x
    rw [CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion, maximal_character_eq])

omit [mu.Regular] in
/-- The actual completed character map retains every original raw coefficient value. -/
@[simp]
theorem completedCharacterHom_apply (chi : PontryaginDual G) (f : Carrier mu alpha) :
    completedCharacterHom mu alpha chi (toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha f) =
      toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha (characterModulation mu alpha chi f) := by
  let p := maximalCStarSeminorm mu alpha
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
  exact p.fromNonUnitalCompletion_apply
    (p.toNonUnitalCompletion.comp (characterModulationEquiv mu alpha chi).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom)
    (fun x => by
      change ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion (characterModulation mu alpha chi x)‖ ≤ p x
      rw [CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion, maximal_character_eq]) f

omit [mu.Regular] in
/-- Identity character gives the actual identity map on the same original completion. -/
theorem completedCharacterHom_one : completedCharacterHom mu alpha 1 = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ _ := by
  have := NonUnitalStarAlgHom.instContinuousLinearMapClassComplex
    (F := FullCovariantCompletion mu alpha →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] FullCovariantCompletion mu alpha)
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro x
  refine (denseRange_toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha).induction_on x
    (isClosed_eq (map_continuous (completedCharacterHom mu alpha 1)) continuous_id) ?_
  intro f
  rw [completedCharacterHom_apply, characterModulation_one]
  rfl

omit [mu.Regular] in
/-- Actual completed character maps compose in the original character group order. -/
theorem completedCharacterHom_mul (chi eta : PontryaginDual G) :
    completedCharacterHom mu alpha (chi * eta) =
      (completedCharacterHom mu alpha chi).comp (completedCharacterHom mu alpha eta) := by
  have := NonUnitalStarAlgHom.instContinuousLinearMapClassComplex
    (F := FullCovariantCompletion mu alpha →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] FullCovariantCompletion mu alpha)
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro x
  refine (denseRange_toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha).induction_on x
    (isClosed_eq (map_continuous (completedCharacterHom mu alpha (chi * eta)))
      ((map_continuous (completedCharacterHom mu alpha chi)).comp
        (map_continuous (completedCharacterHom mu alpha eta)))) ?_
  intro f
  rw [completedCharacterHom_apply, characterModulation_mul_character]
  rw [NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply, completedCharacterHom_apply, completedCharacterHom_apply]

/-- The actual completed character map and its inverse character give a star-algebra equivalence. -/
def completedCharacterEquiv (chi : PontryaginDual G) :
    FullCovariantCompletion mu alpha ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] FullCovariantCompletion mu alpha :=
  StarAlgEquiv.ofNonUnitalStarAlgHom (completedCharacterHom mu alpha chi)
    (completedCharacterHom mu alpha chi⁻¹)
    (by rw [← completedCharacterHom_mul, inv_mul_cancel, completedCharacterHom_one])
    (by rw [← completedCharacterHom_mul, mul_inv_cancel, completedCharacterHom_one])

omit [mu.Regular] in
/-- Every completed dual automorphism has the original raw scalar character value. -/
@[simp]
theorem completedCharacterEquiv_apply (chi : PontryaginDual G) (f : Carrier mu alpha) :
    completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi (toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha f) =
      toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha (characterModulation mu alpha chi f) :=
  completedCharacterHom_apply mu alpha chi f

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.CharacterCompletion
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Set
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Group.CompactOpen
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/-!
# Point-norm continuity of the original full Haar character action

The compact-open character pairing is jointly continuous. Its difference
against a fixed character, multiplied by the original compact-support
coefficient, has one fixed compact support. The unrestricted compact-support
parametric-integral theorem gives continuity of its original L1 distance,
without first/second countability of the group or dual parameter space.

The original full norm is bounded by L1 on the dense raw core. The computed
completed character automorphisms are isometries, so the standard dense-core
estimate proves every full-completion orbit continuous. These are only the
facts needed to construct the original dual action; no Takai or compactness
comparison theorem is used.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Filter Topology
open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace HaarTwistedCore

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (mu : Measure G) [mu.IsHaarMeasure] [mu.Regular] (alpha : PointNormCStarAction G A)

attribute [local instance] fullCovariantCompletionCStarAlgebra

omit [IsTopologicalGroup G] [mu.Regular] in
/-- The original L1 character-distance integral is continuous on the full compact-open dual. -/
theorem continuous_l1CharacterDistance (chi0 : PontryaginDual G) (f : Carrier mu alpha) :
    Continuous (fun chi : PontryaginDual G =>
      l1Gauge mu alpha (characterModulation mu alpha chi f - characterModulation mu alpha chi0 f)) := by
  let F : PontryaginDual G → G → ℝ := fun chi s =>
    ‖((chi s : ℂ) - (chi0 s : ℂ)) • f s‖
  have heval : Continuous (fun p : PontryaginDual G × G => (p.1 p.2 : ℂ)) := by
    change Continuous (fun p : (G →ₜ* Circle) × G => (p.1 p.2 : ℂ))
    exact continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_eval
  have hfixed : Continuous (fun p : PontryaginDual G × G => (chi0 p.2 : ℂ)) :=
    (continuous_subtype_val.comp (map_continuous chi0)).comp continuous_snd
  have hF : Continuous (Function.uncurry F) :=
    ((heval.sub hfixed).smul ((map_continuous (toCc mu alpha f)).comp continuous_snd)).norm
  have hsupport : ∀ chi s, chi ∈ (Set.univ : Set (PontryaginDual G)) →
      s ∉ tsupport (toCc mu alpha f) → F chi s = 0 := by
    intro chi s _ hs
    dsimp only [F]
    rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hs, smul_zero, norm_zero]
  have hIntegral := continuousOn_integral_of_compact_support
    (f := F) (s := Set.univ) (μ := mu) (toCc mu alpha f).hasCompactSupport
    hF.continuousOn hsupport
  have hEq (chi : PontryaginDual G) :
      l1Gauge mu alpha (characterModulation mu alpha chi f - characterModulation mu alpha chi0 f) =
        ∫ s : G, F chi s ∂mu := by
    unfold l1Gauge
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun s => by
      change ‖(chi s : ℂ) • f s - (chi0 s : ℂ) • f s‖ = F chi s
      rw [← sub_smul]
  exact (continuousOn_univ.mp hIntegral).congr (fun chi => (hEq chi).symm)

omit [mu.Regular] in
/-- The actual completed raw-vector character distance is bounded by the original L1 distance. -/
theorem dist_completedCharacterEquiv_core_le
    (chi eta : PontryaginDual G) (f : Carrier mu alpha) :
    dist (completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi (toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha f))
        (completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha eta (toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha f)) ≤
      l1Gauge mu alpha (characterModulation mu alpha chi f - characterModulation mu alpha eta f) := by
  rw [completedCharacterEquiv_apply, completedCharacterEquiv_apply, dist_eq_norm, ← map_sub]
  change ‖(maximalCStarSeminorm mu alpha).toNonUnitalCompletion
    (characterModulation mu alpha chi f - characterModulation mu alpha eta f)‖ ≤ _
  rw [CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion]
  exact maximalCStarSeminorm_le_l1Gauge mu alpha _

omit [mu.Regular] in
/-- Every original dense-core character orbit is continuous in the actual full norm. -/
theorem continuous_completedCharacterEquiv_core (f : Carrier mu alpha) :
    Continuous (fun chi : PontryaginDual G =>
      completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi (toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha f)) := by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro chi0
  rw [ContinuousAt, Metric.tendsto_nhds]
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  have hzero : l1Gauge mu alpha
      (characterModulation mu alpha chi0 f - characterModulation mu alpha chi0 f) = 0 := by
    rw [sub_self, l1Gauge_zero]
  have hnear := ((continuous_l1CharacterDistance mu alpha chi0 f).continuousAt
    (x := chi0)).tendsto
  rw [hzero] at hnear
  filter_upwards [(Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hnear) epsilon hepsilon] with chi hchi
  have hsmall : l1Gauge mu alpha
      (characterModulation mu alpha chi f - characterModulation mu alpha chi0 f) < epsilon := by
    simpa only [dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (l1Gauge_nonneg mu alpha _)] using hchi
  exact (dist_completedCharacterEquiv_core_le mu alpha chi chi0 f).trans_lt hsmall

omit [mu.Regular] in
/-- Every original full-completion character orbit is point-norm continuous. -/
theorem continuous_completedCharacterEquiv_orbit (x : FullCovariantCompletion mu alpha) :
    Continuous (fun chi : PontryaginDual G => completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi x) := by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro chi0
  rw [ContinuousAt, Metric.tendsto_nhds]
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  have hthird : 0 < epsilon / 3 := div_pos hepsilon (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := (denseRange_toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha).exists_dist_lt x hthird
  have hf' : dist (toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha f) x < epsilon / 3 := by
    simpa only [dist_comm] using hf
  have hdist (chi : PontryaginDual G) (y z : FullCovariantCompletion mu alpha) :
      dist (completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi y) (completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi z) = dist y z :=
    (StarAlgEquiv.isometry (completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi)).dist_eq y z
  have hcore := (continuous_completedCharacterEquiv_core mu alpha f).continuousAt (x := chi0)
  filter_upwards [(Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hcore.tendsto) (epsilon / 3) hthird] with chi hchi
  calc
    dist (completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi x) (completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi0 x) ≤
      dist (completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi x)
          (completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi (toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha f)) +
        dist (completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi (toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha f))
          (completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi0 x) := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ dist x (toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha f) +
        (dist (completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi (toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha f))
          (completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi0 (toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha f)) +
          dist (toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha f) x) := by
      rw [hdist]
      exact add_le_add le_rfl (by
        simpa only [hdist] using dist_triangle
          (completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi (toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha f))
          (completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi0 (toFullCovariantCompletion mu alpha f))
          (completedCharacterEquiv mu alpha chi0 x))
    _ < epsilon / 3 + (epsilon / 3 + epsilon / 3) := add_lt_add hf (add_lt_add hchi hf')
    _ = epsilon := by ring

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Topology.Algebra.PontryaginDual.Pairing
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.StarRing
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.L1Gauge

/-!
# Actual character modulation on the original Haar twisted core

For an actual compact-open continuous character, multiply each original
coefficient value f(s) by the same scalar pairing chi(s). Compact support
and continuity are retained. The original twisted convolution and modular
involution are preserved, and the original L1 gauge is unchanged.

These strict algebraic maps are the prerequisite for the original dual
action on the full locally compact crossed product in Blackadar10.1.
No completed action, norm model or terminal duality conclusion is supplied.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped CompactlySupported CStarAlgebra

namespace HaarTwistedCore

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (mu : Measure G) [mu.IsHaarMeasure] [mu.Regular] (alpha : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- The original compact-support coefficient function multiplied by the actual scalar character. -/
def characterModulation (chi : PontryaginDual G) (f : Carrier mu alpha) : Carrier mu alpha where
  toCc :=
    { toFun := fun s => (chi s : ℂ) • f s
      continuous_toFun := (continuous_subtype_val.comp (map_continuous chi)).smul
        (map_continuous (toCc mu alpha f))
      hasCompactSupport' := HasCompactSupport.intro' (toCc mu alpha f).hasCompactSupport
        (isClosed_tsupport (toCc mu alpha f)) (fun s hs => by
          rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hs, smul_zero]) }

omit [IsTopologicalGroup G] [LocallyCompactSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
  [mu.IsHaarMeasure] [mu.Regular] in
/-- Every original modulated coefficient has its literal character value. -/
@[simp]
theorem characterModulation_apply (chi : PontryaginDual G) (f : Carrier mu alpha) (s : G) :
    characterModulation mu alpha chi f s = (chi s : ℂ) • f s := rfl

omit [IsTopologicalGroup G] [LocallyCompactSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
  [mu.IsHaarMeasure] [mu.Regular] in
/-- Character composition has the original scalar order on every coefficient. -/
theorem characterModulation_mul_character (chi eta : PontryaginDual G) (f : Carrier mu alpha) :
    characterModulation mu alpha (chi * eta) f =
      characterModulation mu alpha chi (characterModulation mu alpha eta f) := by
  apply ext mu alpha
  intro s
  change ((chi * eta) s : ℂ) • f s = (chi s : ℂ) • ((eta s : ℂ) • f s)
  rw [smul_smul]
  rfl

omit [IsTopologicalGroup G] [LocallyCompactSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
  [mu.IsHaarMeasure] [mu.Regular] in
/-- Identity character modulation is the original coefficient function. -/
@[simp]
theorem characterModulation_one (f : Carrier mu alpha) : characterModulation mu alpha 1 f = f := by
  apply ext mu alpha
  intro s
  change (1 : ℂ) • f s = f s
  exact one_smul ℂ (f s)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [mu.Regular] in
/-- The actual original character map preserves the printed Haar twisted convolution. -/
theorem characterModulation_convolution (chi : PontryaginDual G) (f h : Carrier mu alpha) :
    characterModulation mu alpha chi (convolution mu alpha f h) =
      convolution mu alpha (characterModulation mu alpha chi f) (characterModulation mu alpha chi h) := by
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  apply ext mu alpha
  intro s
  change (chi s : ℂ) • (∫ t : G, f t * alpha t (h (t⁻¹ * s)) ∂mu) =
    ∫ t : G, ((chi t : ℂ) • f t) * alpha t ((chi (t⁻¹ * s) : ℂ) • h (t⁻¹ * s)) ∂mu
  rw [← integral_smul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun t => by
    change (chi s : ℂ) • (f t * alpha t (h (t⁻¹ * s))) =
      ((chi t : ℂ) • f t) * alpha t ((chi (t⁻¹ * s) : ℂ) • h (t⁻¹ * s))
    have hcircle : chi t * chi (t⁻¹ * s) = chi s := by
      rw [← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel_left]
    have hscalar : (chi t : ℂ) * (chi (t⁻¹ * s) : ℂ) = (chi s : ℂ) := by
      calc
        (chi t : ℂ) * (chi (t⁻¹ * s) : ℂ) =
            ((chi t * chi (t⁻¹ * s) : Circle) : ℂ) :=
          (Circle.coe_mul (chi t) (chi (t⁻¹ * s))).symm
        _ = (chi s : ℂ) := congrArg (fun z : Circle => (z : ℂ)) hcircle
    rw [alpha.apply_smul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, hscalar]

omit [BorelSpace G] [mu.IsHaarMeasure] [mu.Regular] in
/-- The actual original character map preserves the printed modular involution. -/
theorem characterModulation_crossedStar (chi : PontryaginDual G) (f : Carrier mu alpha) :
    characterModulation mu alpha chi (crossedStar mu alpha f) =
      crossedStar mu alpha (characterModulation mu alpha chi f) := by
  apply ext mu alpha
  intro s
  have hu : PontryaginDual.unitaryCharacter chi s⁻¹ = (PontryaginDual.unitaryCharacter chi s)⁻¹ :=
    map_inv (PontryaginDual.unitaryCharacter chi) s
  have hscalar : star (chi s⁻¹ : ℂ) = (chi s : ℂ) := by
    have h : star (PontryaginDual.unitaryCharacter chi s⁻¹ : ℂ) =
        (PontryaginDual.unitaryCharacter chi s : ℂ) := by
      rw [hu]
      change star (star (PontryaginDual.unitaryCharacter chi s : ℂ)) = _
      exact star_star _
    simpa only [PontryaginDual.unitaryCharacter_coe] using h
  simp only [characterModulation_apply, crossedStar_apply, star_smul, alpha.apply_smul, hscalar, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  exact mul_comm _ _

omit [IsTopologicalGroup G] [LocallyCompactSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
  [mu.IsHaarMeasure] [mu.Regular] in
/-- The actual original coefficient-norm integral is unchanged by character modulation. -/
theorem l1Gauge_characterModulation (chi : PontryaginDual G) (f : Carrier mu alpha) :
    l1Gauge mu alpha (characterModulation mu alpha chi f) = l1Gauge mu alpha f := by
  unfold l1Gauge
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun s => by
    change ‖(chi s : ℂ) • f s‖ = ‖f s‖
    rw [norm_smul, Circle.norm_coe, one_mul]

/-- The actual algebraic dual character automorphism of the same original twisted core. -/
def characterModulationEquiv (chi : PontryaginDual G) : Carrier mu alpha ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] Carrier mu alpha where
  toFun := characterModulation mu alpha chi
  invFun := characterModulation mu alpha chi⁻¹
  left_inv f := by
    rw [← characterModulation_mul_character, inv_mul_cancel, characterModulation_one]
  right_inv f := by
    rw [← characterModulation_mul_character, mul_inv_cancel, characterModulation_one]
  map_add' f h := by
    apply ext mu alpha
    intro s
    change (chi s : ℂ) • (f s + h s) = (chi s : ℂ) • f s + (chi s : ℂ) • h s
    exact smul_add _ _ _
  map_mul' := characterModulation_convolution mu alpha chi
  map_smul' c f := by
    apply ext mu alpha
    intro s
    change (chi s : ℂ) • (c • f s) = c • ((chi s : ℂ) • f s)
    exact smul_comm _ _ _
  map_star' := characterModulation_crossedStar mu alpha chi

omit [mu.Regular] in
/-- The actual algebraic dual automorphism has its original character coefficient value. -/
@[simp]
theorem characterModulationEquiv_apply (chi : PontryaginDual G) (f : Carrier mu alpha) (s : G) :
    characterModulationEquiv mu alpha chi f s = (chi s : ℂ) • f s := rfl

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.CharacterModulation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.FullCovariantSeminorm
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.SeminormPullback

/-!
# Original full crossed-product gauge under actual character modulation

Composition with the computed raw character star automorphism preserves
admissibility by the original L1 isometry. The original maximal gauge is
itself admissible, so its character pullback is bounded by that same maximum.
The inverse character gives the reverse inequality. This is the original
all-covariant full norm, through its already proved intrinsic identification.
No covariant model, isometry certificate or desired completed action is input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory

namespace HaarTwistedCore

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (mu : Measure G) [mu.IsHaarMeasure] [mu.Regular] (alpha : PointNormCStarAction G A)

omit [mu.Regular] in
/-- Actual character pullback preserves the original L1-admissible C-star seminorm family. -/
theorem admissible_character_pullback
    (chi : PontryaginDual G) {p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier mu alpha)}
    (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms mu alpha) :
    p.comp (characterModulationEquiv mu alpha chi).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom ∈
      admissibleCStarSeminorms mu alpha := by
  intro f
  change p (characterModulation mu alpha chi f) ≤ l1Gauge mu alpha f
  exact (hp (characterModulation mu alpha chi f)).trans
    (l1Gauge_characterModulation mu alpha chi f).le

omit [mu.Regular] in
/-- The actual modulated original full gauge is bounded by the same original full gauge. -/
theorem maximal_character_le (chi : PontryaginDual G) (f : Carrier mu alpha) :
    maximalCStarSeminorm mu alpha (characterModulation mu alpha chi f) ≤
      maximalCStarSeminorm mu alpha f :=
  le_maximalCStarSeminorm mu alpha
    (admissible_character_pullback mu alpha chi (maximalCStarSeminorm_mem_admissible mu alpha)) f

omit [mu.Regular] in
/-- The actual original full covariant norm is exactly unchanged by the dual character. -/
theorem maximal_character_eq (chi : PontryaginDual G) (f : Carrier mu alpha) :
    maximalCStarSeminorm mu alpha (characterModulation mu alpha chi f) =
      maximalCStarSeminorm mu alpha f := by
  apply le_antisymm (maximal_character_le mu alpha chi f)
  have h := maximal_character_le mu alpha chi⁻¹ (characterModulation mu alpha chi f)
  simpa only [← characterModulation_mul_character, inv_mul_cancel, characterModulation_one] using h

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CanonicalApproximateUnit
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.CompletedMultiplierStrict
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Set

/-!
# Actual coefficient nondegeneracy on the same-seminorm completion

The original coefficient approximate-unit filter acts uniformly on the
compact coefficient range of each actual Haar-core function. Its literal
finite-on-compacts integral bound gives convergence in the original L1
gauge, and then in every admissible seminorm completion. These actual
coefficient images belong to the literal coefficient range span. The
proved dense core gives density of that span on the same completed carrier.

The computed strict multiplier pair therefore receives its actual
coefficient-nondegeneracy field. No approximate-unit, norm, density,
faithful embedding or desired pair is supplied as an output model.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter Set
open scoped Topology MultiplierAlgebra

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

section OriginalL1

variable (μ : Measure G) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- A uniform original coefficient error on its compact support bounds its literal L1 integral. -/
theorem l1Gauge_coefficientLeft_sub_le (a : A) (f : Carrier μ α) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hBound : ∀ s ∈ tsupport (toCc μ α f), ‖a * f s - f s‖ ≤ δ) :
    l1Gauge μ α (coefficientLeft μ α a f - f) ≤ μ.real (tsupport (toCc μ α f)) * δ := by
  let F := toCc μ α f
  let K := tsupport F
  let E := toCc μ α (coefficientLeft μ α a f - f)
  have hzero (s : G) (hs : s ∉ K) : ‖E s‖ = 0 := by
    have hFzero : F s = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hs
    change ‖a * F s - F s‖ = 0
    rw [hFzero, mul_zero, sub_self, norm_zero]
  have hCompact : HasCompactSupport (fun s : G => ‖E s‖) :=
    E.hasCompactSupport.comp_left (g := fun x : A => ‖x‖) norm_zero
  have hInt : Integrable (fun s : G => ‖E s‖) μ :=
    (map_continuous E).norm.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hCompact
  have hAll (s : G) : ‖E s‖ ≤ δ := by
    by_cases hs : s ∈ K
    · change ‖a * f s - f s‖ ≤ δ
      exact hBound s hs
    · rw [hzero s hs]
      exact hδ
  calc
    _ = ∫ s : G, ‖E s‖ ∂μ := rfl
    _ = ∫ s in K, ‖E s‖ ∂μ := (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hzero).symm
    _ ≤ ∫ _ in K, δ ∂μ :=
      integral_mono hInt.integrableOn (integrableOn_const F.hasCompactSupport.measure_ne_top) hAll
    _ = μ.real K * δ := by rw [setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul]

/-- The computed original coefficient approximate unit converges in the literal Haar-core L1 gauge. -/
theorem tendsto_l1Gauge_coefficientLeft_sub (f : Carrier μ α) :
    Tendsto (fun a : A => l1Gauge μ α (coefficientLeft μ α a f - f))
      (CStarAlgebra.canonicalApproximateUnit A) (𝓝 0) := by
  apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr
  intro ε hε
  let F := toCc μ α f
  let K := tsupport F
  let M := μ.real K
  let δ := ε / (M + 1)
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hDen : 0 < M + 1 := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos hM zero_lt_one
  have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos hε hDen
  have hImage : IsCompact (F '' K) := F.hasCompactSupport.image (map_continuous F)
  have hUniform := CStarAlgebra.canonicalApproximateUnit_eventually_compact_mul_sub_lt
    A (F '' K) hImage δ hδ
  filter_upwards [hUniform] with a ha
  have hBound : l1Gauge μ α (coefficientLeft μ α a f - f) ≤ M * δ :=
    l1Gauge_coefficientLeft_sub_le μ α a f δ hδ.le fun s hs => (ha (F s) ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩).le
  have hSmall : M * δ < ε := by
    calc
      M * δ < (M + 1) * δ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (lt_add_one M) hδ
      _ = ε := by rw [mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hDen.ne']
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (l1Gauge_nonneg μ α (coefficientLeft μ α a f - f))] using hBound.trans_lt hSmall

end OriginalL1

section CompletedCoefficient

variable [IsTopologicalGroup G] [LocallyCompactSpace G]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

attribute [local instance] CStarSeminorm.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra

variable (p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α))

/-- The literal complex span of the computed coefficient multiplier ranges on the actual completion. -/
def coefficientMultiplierSpan : Submodule ℂ p.NonUnitalCompletion :=
  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun z : A × p.NonUnitalCompletion =>
    (coefficientMultiplierHom μ α p z.1).fst z.2)

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- Each actual completed coefficient value belongs to its original coefficient range span. -/
theorem coefficientMultiplier_fst_mem_span (a : A) (x : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    (coefficientMultiplierHom μ α p a).fst x ∈ coefficientMultiplierSpan μ α p :=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨(a, x), rfl⟩

variable (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α)
include hp

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The computed coefficient approximate unit tends to the original source image in every admissible p. -/
theorem tendsto_toNonUnitalCompletion_coefficientLeft (f : Carrier μ α) :
    Tendsto (fun a : A => p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α a f))
      (CStarAlgebra.canonicalApproximateUnit A) (𝓝 (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f)) := by
  apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr
  intro ε hε
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_l1Gauge_coefficientLeft_sub μ α f).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε)] with a ha
  have hBound : dist (p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α a f))
      (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ≤ l1Gauge μ α (coefficientLeft μ α a f - f) := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, ← map_sub, CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion]
    exact hp _
  exact hBound.trans_lt ha

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- Every original core image lies in the closure of the actual coefficient multiplier range span. -/
theorem toNonUnitalCompletion_mem_coefficientMultiplierSpan_closure (f : Carrier μ α) :
    p.toNonUnitalCompletion f ∈ (coefficientMultiplierSpan μ α p).topologicalClosure := by
  let _ : (CStarAlgebra.canonicalApproximateUnit A).NeBot :=
    CStarAlgebra.canonicalApproximateUnit_neBot A
  change p.toNonUnitalCompletion f ∈ closure (coefficientMultiplierSpan μ α p : Set p.NonUnitalCompletion)
  apply mem_closure_of_tendsto (tendsto_toNonUnitalCompletion_coefficientLeft μ α p hp f)
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun a => by
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe]
    simpa only [coefficientMultiplierHom_apply, coefficientMultiplier_fst_apply] using
      coefficientMultiplier_fst_mem_span μ α p a (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f)

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The computed coefficient multiplier is nondegenerate on the same actual admissible completion. -/
theorem dense_coefficientMultiplierSpan :
    Dense (coefficientMultiplierSpan μ α p : Set p.NonUnitalCompletion) := by
  apply Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mpr
  apply le_antisymm le_top
  intro x _
  refine p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion.induction_on x ?_ ?_
  · exact (coefficientMultiplierSpan μ α p).isClosed_topologicalClosure
  · intro f
    exact toNonUnitalCompletion_mem_coefficientMultiplierSpan_closure μ α p hp f

/-- The original computed strict pair with its internally proved actual coefficient nondegeneracy. -/
def canonicalNondegenerateStrictMultiplierPair :
    { pair : (A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) ×
        (G →* unitary 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) //
      (∀ g : G, ∀ a : A,
        (pair.2 g : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) * pair.1 a *
          star (pair.2 g : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) = pair.1 (α g a)) ∧
      DoubleCentralizer.StrictContinuous (fun g : G => (pair.2 g : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion))) ∧
      Dense ((Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun z : A × p.NonUnitalCompletion =>
        (pair.1 z.1).fst z.2)) : Set p.NonUnitalCompletion) } :=
  ⟨(canonicalStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).val,
    (canonicalStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).property.1,
    (canonicalStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).property.2, by
      change Dense (coefficientMultiplierSpan μ α p : Set p.NonUnitalCompletion)
      exact dense_coefficientMultiplierSpan μ α p hp⟩

/-- The nondegenerate pair keeps the exact original coefficient and group multiplier maps. -/
@[simp]
theorem canonicalNondegenerateStrictMultiplierPair_val :
    (canonicalNondegenerateStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).val =
      (canonicalStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).val := rfl

/-- The actual pair carries the proved density of the original coefficient ranges. -/
theorem canonicalNondegenerateStrictMultiplierPair_nondegenerate :
    Dense ((Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun z : A × p.NonUnitalCompletion =>
      ((canonicalNondegenerateStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).val.1 z.1).fst z.2)) :
        Set p.NonUnitalCompletion) :=
  (canonicalNondegenerateStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).property.2.2

/-- The actual nondegenerate pair retains the original strict group continuity. -/
theorem canonicalNondegenerateStrictMultiplierPair_strictContinuous :
    DoubleCentralizer.StrictContinuous (fun g : G =>
      ((canonicalNondegenerateStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).val.2 g : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion))) :=
  (canonicalNondegenerateStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).property.2.1

/-- The actual nondegenerate pair retains the original conjugation covariance. -/
theorem canonicalNondegenerateStrictMultiplierPair_covariance (g : G) (a : A) :
    ((canonicalNondegenerateStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).val.2 g : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) *
        (canonicalNondegenerateStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).val.1 a *
          star ((canonicalNondegenerateStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).val.2 g : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) =
      (canonicalNondegenerateStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).val.1 (α g a) :=
  (canonicalNondegenerateStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).property.1 g a

end CompletedCoefficient

end

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.SeminormCoefficientActions
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Extend

/-!
# Actual coefficient actions on the same-seminorm completion

Each original coefficient map is extended along the actual dense separated
completion map. The bounds are proved from the coefficient square identity,
and the extension agrees with the literal original compact-support values.
The zero seminorm and the zero coefficient algebra are included.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

attribute [local instance] CStarSeminorm.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra

variable (p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α))

/-- The actual left coefficient map on the completion of the same original seminorm. -/
def coefficientLeftCompletion (a : A) :
    p.NonUnitalCompletion →L[ℂ] p.NonUnitalCompletion :=
  ((LinearMap.ofClass p.toNonUnitalCompletion).comp (coefficientLeft μ α a)).extendOfNorm
    (LinearMap.ofClass p.toNonUnitalCompletion)

/-- The actual right coefficient map on the completion of the same original seminorm. -/
def coefficientRightCompletion (a : A) :
    p.NonUnitalCompletion →L[ℂ] p.NonUnitalCompletion :=
  ((LinearMap.ofClass p.toNonUnitalCompletion).comp (coefficientRight μ α a)).extendOfNorm
    (LinearMap.ofClass p.toNonUnitalCompletion)

/-- Completed left multiplication has exactly the original coefficient values on the dense core. -/
theorem coefficientLeftCompletion_apply (a : A) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) =
      p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α a f) := by
  apply LinearMap.extendOfNorm_eq (p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion)
  refine ⟨‖a‖, fun h => ?_⟩
  change ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α a h)‖ ≤
    ‖a‖ * ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion h‖
  simpa only [CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion] using seminorm_coefficientLeft_le μ α p a h

/-- Completed right multiplication has exactly the original coefficient values on the dense core. -/
theorem coefficientRightCompletion_apply (a : A) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) =
      p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientRight μ α a f) := by
  apply LinearMap.extendOfNorm_eq (p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion)
  refine ⟨‖a‖, fun h => ?_⟩
  change ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientRight μ α a h)‖ ≤
    ‖a‖ * ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion h‖
  simpa only [CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion] using seminorm_coefficientRight_le μ α p a h

/-- The completed left action retains the actual original coefficient norm bound. -/
theorem norm_coefficientLeftCompletion_apply_le (a : A) (x : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    ‖coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a x‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * ‖x‖ := by
  apply LinearMap.norm_extendOfNorm_apply_le (p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion) ‖a‖
  intro f
  change ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α a f)‖ ≤
    ‖a‖ * ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion f‖
  simpa only [CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion] using seminorm_coefficientLeft_le μ α p a f

/-- The completed right action retains the actual original coefficient norm bound. -/
theorem norm_coefficientRightCompletion_apply_le (a : A) (x : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    ‖coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a x‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * ‖x‖ := by
  apply LinearMap.norm_extendOfNorm_apply_le (p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion) ‖a‖
  intro f
  change ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientRight μ α a f)‖ ≤
    ‖a‖ * ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion f‖
  simpa only [CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion] using seminorm_coefficientRight_le μ α p a f

/-- The computed completed left operator has norm at most the original coefficient norm. -/
theorem norm_coefficientLeftCompletion_le (a : A) :
    ‖coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a‖ ≤ ‖a‖ :=
  (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a).opNorm_le_bound (norm_nonneg a)
    (norm_coefficientLeftCompletion_apply_le μ α p a)

/-- The computed completed right operator has norm at most the original coefficient norm. -/
theorem norm_coefficientRightCompletion_le (a : A) :
    ‖coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a‖ ≤ ‖a‖ :=
  (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a).opNorm_le_bound (norm_nonneg a)
    (norm_coefficientRightCompletion_apply_le μ α p a)

/-- Zero acts by the zero completed left operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientLeftCompletion_zero : coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (0 : A) = 0 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p 0).continuous continuous_const ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, coefficientLeftCompletion_apply, zero_apply]
  have h : coefficientLeft μ α (0 : A) f = 0 := by
    apply ext μ α
    intro s
    simp only [coefficientLeft_apply, zero_mul]
    rfl
  rw [h, map_zero]

/-- Zero acts by the zero completed right operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientRightCompletion_zero : coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (0 : A) = 0 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p 0).continuous continuous_const ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, coefficientRightCompletion_apply, zero_apply]
  have h : coefficientRight μ α (0 : A) f = 0 := by
    apply ext μ α
    intro s
    simp only [coefficientRight_apply, α.apply_zero, mul_zero]
    rfl
  rw [h, map_zero]

/-- Adding original coefficients adds their actual completed left operators. -/
theorem coefficientLeftCompletion_add (a b : A) :
    coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (a + b) =
      coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a + coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p b := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (a + b)).continuous
    ((coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a).continuous.add
      (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p b).continuous) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.add_apply,
    coefficientLeftCompletion_apply, coefficientLeft_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add]

/-- Adding original coefficients adds their actual completed right operators. -/
theorem coefficientRightCompletion_add (a b : A) :
    coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (a + b) =
      coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a + coefficientRightCompletion μ α p b := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (a + b)).continuous
    ((coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a).continuous.add
      (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p b).continuous) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.add_apply,
    coefficientRightCompletion_apply, coefficientRight_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add]

/-- Scaling an original coefficient scales its actual completed left operator. -/
theorem coefficientLeftCompletion_smul (c : ℂ) (a : A) :
    coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (c • a) = c • coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (c • a)).continuous
    ((coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a).continuous.const_smul c) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
    coefficientLeftCompletion_apply, coefficientLeft_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]

/-- Scaling an original coefficient scales its actual completed right operator. -/
theorem coefficientRightCompletion_smul (c : ℂ) (a : A) :
    coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (c • a) = c • coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (c • a)).continuous
    ((coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a).continuous.const_smul c) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
    coefficientRightCompletion_apply, coefficientRight_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]

/-- Completed left coefficients compose in the original algebra order. -/
theorem coefficientLeftCompletion_mul (a b : A) :
    coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (a * b) =
      (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a).comp (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p b) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (a * b)).continuous
    ((coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a).continuous.comp
      (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p b).continuous) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply,
    coefficientLeftCompletion_apply, coefficientLeft_mul, LinearMap.comp_apply]

/-- Completed right coefficients compose in the original double-centralizer order. -/
theorem coefficientRightCompletion_mul (a b : A) :
    coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (a * b) =
      (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p b).comp (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (a * b)).continuous
    ((coefficientRightCompletion μ α p b).continuous.comp
      (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a).continuous) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply,
    coefficientRightCompletion_apply, coefficientRight_mul, LinearMap.comp_apply]

/-- The completed involution exchanges left coefficients with adjoint right coefficients. -/
theorem star_coefficientLeftCompletion (a : A) (x : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    star (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a x) =
      coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (star a) (star x) := by
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a).continuous.star
    ((coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (star a)).continuous.comp continuous_star) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, coefficientLeftCompletion_apply, ← map_star,
    coefficientRightCompletion_apply]
  exact congrArg p.toNonUnitalCompletion (crossedStar_coefficientLeft μ α a f)

/-- The completed involution exchanges right coefficients with adjoint left coefficients. -/
theorem star_coefficientRightCompletion (a : A) (x : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    star (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a x) =
      coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (star a) (star x) := by
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a).continuous.star
    ((coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (star a)).continuous.comp continuous_star) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, coefficientRightCompletion_apply, ← map_star,
    coefficientLeftCompletion_apply]
  exact congrArg p.toNonUnitalCompletion (crossedStar_coefficientRight μ α a f)

/-- The two computed completed coefficient maps are an actual compatible centralizer pair. -/
theorem coefficientCompletion_central (a : A) (x y : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a x * y = x * coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a y := by
  refine (p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).induction_on₂
    (p := fun u v : p.NonUnitalCompletion =>
      coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a u * v = u * coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a v)
    ?_ ?_ x y
  · exact isClosed_eq
      (((coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a).continuous.comp continuous_fst).mul continuous_snd)
      (continuous_fst.mul ((coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a).continuous.comp continuous_snd))
  · intro f h
    rw [coefficientRightCompletion_apply, coefficientLeftCompletion_apply, ← map_mul, ← map_mul]
    exact congrArg p.toNonUnitalCompletion (convolution_coefficientLeft μ α a f h).symm

end

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.CompletedCoefficientActions
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Multiplier

/-!
# The actual coefficient multiplier homomorphism

The completed original left and right actions form a double centralizer.
Their source algebra, scalar and adjoint laws give the genuine nonunital
star-algebra homomorphism into the ordinary multiplier algebra of the same
seminorm completion. No multiplier carrier, coefficient map or norm estimate
is supplied as input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped MultiplierAlgebra

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

attribute [local instance] CStarSeminorm.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra

variable (p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α))

/-- The multiplier is the literal pair of completed original coefficient actions. -/
def coefficientMultiplier (a : A) : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion) where
  fst := coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a
  snd := coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a
  central := coefficientCompletion_central μ α p a

/-- The left multiplier component agrees with every original coefficient-core value. -/
theorem coefficientMultiplier_fst_apply (a : A) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    (coefficientMultiplier μ α p a).fst (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) =
      p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α a f) :=
  coefficientLeftCompletion_apply μ α p a f

/-- The right multiplier component agrees with every original coefficient-core value. -/
theorem coefficientMultiplier_snd_apply (a : A) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    (coefficientMultiplier μ α p a).snd (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) =
      p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientRight μ α a f) :=
  coefficientRightCompletion_apply μ α p a f

/-- The original coefficient algebra acts by its computed actual multiplier homomorphism. -/
def coefficientMultiplierHom : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion) where
  toFun := coefficientMultiplier μ α p
  map_zero' := by
    apply DoubleCentralizer.ext ℂ p.NonUnitalCompletion
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact coefficientLeftCompletion_zero μ α p
    · exact coefficientRightCompletion_zero μ α p
  map_add' a b := by
    apply DoubleCentralizer.ext ℂ p.NonUnitalCompletion
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact coefficientLeftCompletion_add μ α p a b
    · exact coefficientRightCompletion_add μ α p a b
  map_smul' c a := by
    apply DoubleCentralizer.ext ℂ p.NonUnitalCompletion
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact coefficientLeftCompletion_smul μ α p c a
    · exact coefficientRightCompletion_smul μ α p c a
  map_mul' a b := by
    apply DoubleCentralizer.ext ℂ p.NonUnitalCompletion
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact coefficientLeftCompletion_mul μ α p a b
    · exact coefficientRightCompletion_mul μ α p a b
  map_star' a := by
    apply DoubleCentralizer.ext ℂ p.NonUnitalCompletion
    apply Prod.ext <;> apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext <;> intro x
    · change coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (star a) x =
        star (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a (star x))
      simpa only [star_star] using (star_coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a (star x)).symm
    · change coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (star a) x =
        star (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a (star x))
      simpa only [star_star] using (star_coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a (star x)).symm

/-- The constructed coefficient homomorphism is exactly the computed centralizer pair. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientMultiplierHom_apply (a : A) :
    coefficientMultiplierHom μ α p a = coefficientMultiplier μ α p a := rfl

/-- The genuine coefficient multiplier retains the original coefficient norm bound. -/
theorem norm_coefficientMultiplier_le (a : A) : ‖coefficientMultiplier μ α p a‖ ≤ ‖a‖ := by
  rw [← DoubleCentralizer.norm_fst]
  exact norm_coefficientLeftCompletion_le μ α p a

end

end HaarTwistedCore

Author: @toskua
