module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.SeminormGroupActions
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.SeminormNonUnitalCompletion
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Extend

/-!
# Original group translations on the same-seminorm completion

The literal inverse left translation and modular right translation preserve
every actual C-star seminorm. Extend their original linear maps along the
actual dense separated-completion map. The completed maps have their exact
original core values and form the same compatible centralizer pair.
The zero seminorm is allowed; no group multiplier or invariance is supplied.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
  (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

attribute [local instance] CStarSeminorm.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra

variable (p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α))

/-- The actual inverse left group translation on the same-seminorm completion. -/
def groupLeftCompletion (g : G) : p.NonUnitalCompletion →L[ℂ] p.NonUnitalCompletion :=
  ((LinearMap.ofClass p.toNonUnitalCompletion).comp (groupLeft μ α g)).extendOfNorm
    (LinearMap.ofClass p.toNonUnitalCompletion)

/-- The actual modular right group translation on the same-seminorm completion. -/
def groupRightCompletion (g : G) : p.NonUnitalCompletion →L[ℂ] p.NonUnitalCompletion :=
  ((LinearMap.ofClass p.toNonUnitalCompletion).comp (groupRight μ α g)).extendOfNorm
    (LinearMap.ofClass p.toNonUnitalCompletion)

/-- Completed inverse left translation retains every original Haar-core value. -/
theorem groupLeftCompletion_apply (g : G) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    groupLeftCompletion μ α p g (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) =
      p.toNonUnitalCompletion (groupLeft μ α g f) := by
  apply LinearMap.extendOfNorm_eq (p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion)
  refine ⟨1, fun h => ?_⟩
  change ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion (groupLeft μ α g h)‖ ≤
    1 * ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion h‖
  simp only [CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion, cstarSeminorm_groupLeft, one_mul, le_rfl]

/-- Completed modular right translation retains every original Haar-core value. -/
theorem groupRightCompletion_apply (g : G) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    groupRightCompletion μ α p g (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) =
      p.toNonUnitalCompletion (groupRight μ α g f) := by
  apply LinearMap.extendOfNorm_eq (p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion)
  refine ⟨1, fun h => ?_⟩
  change ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion (groupRight μ α g h)‖ ≤
    1 * ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion h‖
  simp only [CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion, cstarSeminorm_groupRight, one_mul, le_rfl]

/-- The completed inverse left translation preserves the actual same-seminorm norm. -/
theorem norm_groupLeftCompletion_apply (g : G) (x : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    ‖groupLeftCompletion μ α p g x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (groupLeftCompletion μ α p g).continuous.norm continuous_norm ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, groupLeftCompletion_apply,
    CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion, cstarSeminorm_groupLeft]

/-- The completed modular right translation preserves the actual same-seminorm norm. -/
theorem norm_groupRightCompletion_apply (g : G) (x : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    ‖groupRightCompletion μ α p g x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (groupRightCompletion μ α p g).continuous.norm continuous_norm ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, groupRightCompletion_apply,
    CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion, cstarSeminorm_groupRight]

/-- The group identity acts by the actual completed left identity operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem groupLeftCompletion_one : groupLeftCompletion μ α p (1 : G) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ _ := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (groupLeftCompletion μ α p 1).continuous continuous_id ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, groupLeftCompletion_apply, groupLeft_one, LinearMap.id_apply, id_eq]

/-- The group identity acts by the actual completed right identity operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem groupRightCompletion_one : groupRightCompletion μ α p (1 : G) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ _ := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (groupRightCompletion μ α p 1).continuous continuous_id ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, groupRightCompletion_apply, groupRight_one, LinearMap.id_apply, id_eq]

/-- Completed inverse left translations compose in the original group order. -/
theorem groupLeftCompletion_mul (g h : G) :
    groupLeftCompletion μ α p (g * h) =
      (groupLeftCompletion μ α p g).comp (groupLeftCompletion μ α p h) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (groupLeftCompletion μ α p (g * h)).continuous
    ((groupLeftCompletion μ α p g).continuous.comp
      (groupLeftCompletion μ α p h).continuous) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply,
    groupLeftCompletion_apply, groupLeft_mul, LinearMap.comp_apply]

/-- Completed modular right translations compose in the original centralizer order. -/
theorem groupRightCompletion_mul (g h : G) :
    groupRightCompletion μ α p (g * h) =
      (groupRightCompletion μ α p h).comp (groupRightCompletion μ α p g) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (groupRightCompletion μ α p (g * h)).continuous
    ((groupRightCompletion μ α p h).continuous.comp
      (groupRightCompletion μ α p g).continuous) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply,
    groupRightCompletion_apply, groupRight_mul, LinearMap.comp_apply]

/-- The completed star exchanges inverse left translation with inverse right translation. -/
theorem star_groupLeftCompletion (g : G) (x : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    star (groupLeftCompletion μ α p g x) = groupRightCompletion μ α p g⁻¹ (star x) := by
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (groupLeftCompletion μ α p g).continuous.star
    ((groupRightCompletion μ α p g⁻¹).continuous.comp continuous_star) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, groupLeftCompletion_apply, ← map_star, groupRightCompletion_apply]
  exact congrArg p.toNonUnitalCompletion (crossedStar_groupLeft μ α g f)

/-- The completed star exchanges modular right translation with inverse left translation. -/
theorem star_groupRightCompletion (g : G) (x : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    star (groupRightCompletion μ α p g x) = groupLeftCompletion μ α p g⁻¹ (star x) := by
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (groupRightCompletion μ α p g).continuous.star
    ((groupLeftCompletion μ α p g⁻¹).continuous.comp continuous_star) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, groupRightCompletion_apply, ← map_star, groupLeftCompletion_apply]
  exact congrArg p.toNonUnitalCompletion (crossedStar_groupRight μ α g f)

/-- The computed completed translations form the actual original group centralizer pair. -/
theorem groupCompletion_central (g : G) (x y : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    groupRightCompletion μ α p g x * y = x * groupLeftCompletion μ α p g y := by
  refine (p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).induction_on₂
    (p := fun u v : p.NonUnitalCompletion =>
      groupRightCompletion μ α p g u * v = u * groupLeftCompletion μ α p g v)
    ?_ ?_ x y
  · exact isClosed_eq
      (((groupRightCompletion μ α p g).continuous.comp continuous_fst).mul continuous_snd)
      (continuous_fst.mul ((groupLeftCompletion μ α p g).continuous.comp continuous_snd))
  · intro f h
    rw [groupRightCompletion_apply, groupLeftCompletion_apply, ← map_mul, ← map_mul]
    exact congrArg p.toNonUnitalCompletion (convolution_groupLeft μ α g f h).symm

end

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.CompletedGroupActions
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Multiplier
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.Unitary

/-!
# Actual group unitaries in the same-seminorm multiplier algebra

The original completed left and modular right translations form the actual
group multiplier. Their inverse and adjoint formulas prove its unitarity,
giving the computed homomorphism into the ordinary unitary multiplier group.
The source's full-norm comparison, group embedding and strict continuity
remain separate obligations. The zero completion is allowed.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped MultiplierAlgebra

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
  (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

attribute [local instance] CStarSeminorm.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra

variable (p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α))

/-- The group multiplier is the actual completed original translation pair. -/
def groupMultiplier (g : G) : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion) where
  fst := groupLeftCompletion μ α p g
  snd := groupRightCompletion μ α p g
  central := groupCompletion_central μ α p g

/-- The left group multiplier component has the original inverse-translation core values. -/
theorem groupMultiplier_fst_apply (g : G) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    (groupMultiplier μ α p g).fst (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) =
      p.toNonUnitalCompletion (groupLeft μ α g f) :=
  groupLeftCompletion_apply μ α p g f

/-- The right group multiplier component has the original modular-translation core values. -/
theorem groupMultiplier_snd_apply (g : G) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    (groupMultiplier μ α p g).snd (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) =
      p.toNonUnitalCompletion (groupRight μ α g f) :=
  groupRightCompletion_apply μ α p g f

/-- The original group acts by its actual computed multiplier homomorphism. -/
def groupMultiplierHom : G →* 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion) where
  toFun := groupMultiplier μ α p
  map_one' := by
    apply DoubleCentralizer.ext ℂ p.NonUnitalCompletion
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact groupLeftCompletion_one μ α p
    · exact groupRightCompletion_one μ α p
  map_mul' g h := by
    apply DoubleCentralizer.ext ℂ p.NonUnitalCompletion
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact groupLeftCompletion_mul μ α p g h
    · exact groupRightCompletion_mul μ α p g h

/-- The group homomorphism retains the literal computed multiplier pair. -/
@[simp]
theorem groupMultiplierHom_apply (g : G) :
    groupMultiplierHom μ α p g = groupMultiplier μ α p g := rfl

/-- The actual group multiplier adjoint is the multiplier of the original inverse group element. -/
theorem star_groupMultiplier (g : G) :
    star (groupMultiplier μ α p g) = groupMultiplier μ α p g⁻¹ := by
  apply DoubleCentralizer.ext ℂ p.NonUnitalCompletion
  apply Prod.ext <;> apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext <;> intro x
  · change star (groupRightCompletion μ α p g (star x)) = groupLeftCompletion μ α p g⁻¹ x
    simpa only [star_star] using star_groupRightCompletion μ α p g (star x)
  · change star (groupLeftCompletion μ α p g (star x)) = groupRightCompletion μ α p g⁻¹ x
    simpa only [star_star] using star_groupLeftCompletion μ α p g (star x)

/-- The computed original group multiplier is an actual unitary, including in the zero completion. -/
theorem groupMultiplier_mem_unitary (g : G) :
    groupMultiplier μ α p g ∈ unitary 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion) := by
  change star (groupMultiplier μ α p g) * groupMultiplier μ α p g = 1 ∧
    groupMultiplier μ α p g * star (groupMultiplier μ α p g) = 1
  simp only [star_groupMultiplier]
  constructor
  · change groupMultiplierHom μ α p g⁻¹ * groupMultiplierHom μ α p g = 1
    rw [← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one]
  · change groupMultiplierHom μ α p g * groupMultiplierHom μ α p g⁻¹ = 1
    rw [← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one]

/-- The actual group homomorphism into the ordinary unitary group of the same-seminorm multipliers. -/
def groupUnitaryMultiplierHom : G →* unitary 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion) where
  toFun g := ⟨groupMultiplierHom μ α p g, groupMultiplier_mem_unitary μ α p g⟩
  map_one' := Subtype.ext (map_one (groupMultiplierHom μ α p))
  map_mul' g h := Subtype.ext (map_mul (groupMultiplierHom μ α p) g h)

/-- The unitary-valued group map retains exactly the computed multiplier. -/
@[simp]
theorem groupUnitaryMultiplierHom_coe (g : G) :
    ((groupUnitaryMultiplierHom μ α p g : unitary 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) :
      𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) = groupMultiplier μ α p g := rfl

/-- The actual group multiplier has operator norm at most one; zero completions remain legal. -/
theorem norm_groupMultiplier_le_one (g : G) : ‖groupMultiplier μ α p g‖ ≤ 1 := by
  rw [← DoubleCentralizer.norm_fst]
  apply (groupLeftCompletion μ α p g).opNorm_le_bound zero_le_one
  intro x
  simpa only [one_mul] using (norm_groupLeftCompletion_apply μ α p g x).le

end

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.CompletedCoefficientMultiplier
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.CompletedGroupMultiplier
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.ConvolutionSeminormIntegral

/-!
# The actual algebraic coefficient/group multiplier pair

The coefficient and group maps are the computed same-seminorm multipliers.
Their original covariance is proved on the dense core and extended by
continuous equality. These literal maps form a pair with the covariance
proof as actual DATA. The full source pair's strict continuity and
nondegeneracy requirements remain separate.

For an admissible seminorm, the actual paired multiplier slices are
integrable on each original core vector and their Haar integral is its
original convolution image. This uses the constructed L1-to-seminorm
primitive, without a supplied integrated identity or full-norm comparison.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped MultiplierAlgebra

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

attribute [local instance] CStarSeminorm.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra

variable (p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α))

/-- The computed completed multiplier maps retain the original covariance orientation. -/
theorem groupMultiplier_coefficientMultiplier (g : G) (a : A) :
    groupMultiplier μ α p g * coefficientMultiplier μ α p a =
      coefficientMultiplier μ α p (α g a) * groupMultiplier μ α p g := by
  apply DoubleCentralizer.ext ℂ p.NonUnitalCompletion
  apply Prod.ext <;> apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext <;> intro x
  · change groupLeftCompletion μ α p g (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a x) =
      coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (α g a) (groupLeftCompletion μ α p g x)
    refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
      ((groupLeftCompletion μ α p g).continuous.comp
        (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a).continuous)
      ((coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (α g a)).continuous.comp
        (groupLeftCompletion μ α p g).continuous) ?_) x
    funext f
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, coefficientLeftCompletion_apply, groupLeftCompletion_apply]
    simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply] using
      congrArg (fun T : Carrier μ α →ₗ[ℂ] Carrier μ α => p.toNonUnitalCompletion (T f))
        (groupLeft_coefficientLeft μ α g a)
  · change coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a (groupRightCompletion μ α p g x) =
      groupRightCompletion μ α p g (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (α g a) x)
    refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
      ((coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a).continuous.comp
        (groupRightCompletion μ α p g).continuous)
      ((groupRightCompletion μ α p g).continuous.comp
        (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (α g a)).continuous) ?_) x
    funext f
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, coefficientRightCompletion_apply, groupRightCompletion_apply]
    simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply] using
      congrArg (fun T : Carrier μ α →ₗ[ℂ] Carrier μ α => p.toNonUnitalCompletion (T f))
        (coefficientRight_groupRight μ α g a)

/-- The actual group multiplier conjugates the original completed coefficient by its given action. -/
theorem groupMultiplier_conjugates_coefficient (g : G) (a : A) :
    groupMultiplier μ α p g * coefficientMultiplier μ α p a * star (groupMultiplier μ α p g) =
      coefficientMultiplier μ α p (α g a) := by
  rw [groupMultiplier_coefficientMultiplier, mul_assoc,
    Unitary.mul_star_self_of_mem (groupMultiplier_mem_unitary μ α p g), mul_one]

/-- The literal computed multiplier maps together with their proved algebraic covariance DATA. -/
def canonicalMultiplierPair :
    { pair : (A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) ×
        (G →* unitary 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) //
      ∀ g : G, ∀ a : A,
        (pair.2 g : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) * pair.1 a *
          star (pair.2 g : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) = pair.1 (α g a) } :=
  ⟨⟨coefficientMultiplierHom μ α p, groupUnitaryMultiplierHom μ α p⟩, fun g a => by
    change groupMultiplier μ α p g * coefficientMultiplier μ α p a *
      star (groupMultiplier μ α p g) = coefficientMultiplier μ α p (α g a)
    exact groupMultiplier_conjugates_coefficient μ α p g a⟩

/-- The pair retains exactly the actual computed coefficient homomorphism. -/
@[simp]
theorem canonicalMultiplierPair_coefficient :
    (canonicalMultiplierPair μ α p).val.1 = coefficientMultiplierHom μ α p := rfl

/-- The pair retains exactly the actual computed unitary group homomorphism. -/
@[simp]
theorem canonicalMultiplierPair_group :
    (canonicalMultiplierPair μ α p).val.2 = groupUnitaryMultiplierHom μ α p := rfl

/-- The literal pair has the original conjugation equation without a supplied covariance witness. -/
theorem canonicalMultiplierPair_covariance (g : G) (a : A) :
    ((canonicalMultiplierPair μ α p).val.2 g : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) *
        (canonicalMultiplierPair μ α p).val.1 a *
          star ((canonicalMultiplierPair μ α p).val.2 g : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) =
      (canonicalMultiplierPair μ α p).val.1 (α g a) :=
  (canonicalMultiplierPair μ α p).property g a

/-- Each paired multiplier slice has exactly its original coefficient/group value on the dense core. -/
theorem canonicalMultiplierPair_slice_apply (f : Carrier μ α) (s : G) (h : Carrier μ α) :
    ((canonicalMultiplierPair μ α p).val.1 (f s) *
        ((canonicalMultiplierPair μ α p).val.2 s : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion))).fst
          (p.toNonUnitalCompletion h) =
      p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α (f s) (groupLeft μ α s h)) := by
  change coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (f s)
    (groupLeftCompletion μ α p s (p.toNonUnitalCompletion h)) = _
  rw [groupLeftCompletion_apply, coefficientLeftCompletion_apply]

variable (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α)

include hp in
/-- Actual paired multiplier slices are integrable at every original source-core vector. -/
theorem integrable_canonicalMultiplierPair_slice (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    let _ : NormedSpace ℝ p.NonUnitalCompletion := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
    Integrable (fun s : G =>
      ((canonicalMultiplierPair μ α p).val.1 (f s) *
          ((canonicalMultiplierPair μ α p).val.2 s : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion))).fst
            (p.toNonUnitalCompletion h)) μ := by
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ p.NonUnitalCompletion := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
  apply (integrable_toNonUnitalCompletion_coefficientLeft_groupLeft μ α p hp f h).congr
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun s => (canonicalMultiplierPair_slice_apply μ α p f s h).symm

include hp in
/-- The actual paired multiplier integral on the dense core is the original convolution image. -/
theorem integral_canonicalMultiplierPair_slice (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    let _ : NormedSpace ℝ p.NonUnitalCompletion := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
    (∫ s : G,
      ((canonicalMultiplierPair μ α p).val.1 (f s) *
          ((canonicalMultiplierPair μ α p).val.2 s : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion))).fst
            (p.toNonUnitalCompletion h) ∂μ) = p.toNonUnitalCompletion (f * h) := by
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ p.NonUnitalCompletion := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
  calc
    _ = ∫ s : G, p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α (f s) (groupLeft μ α s h)) ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall fun s => canonicalMultiplierPair_slice_apply μ α p f s h)
    _ = _ := integral_toNonUnitalCompletion_coefficientLeft_groupLeft μ α p hp f h

end

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.CompletedMultiplierPair
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.L1Translation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Multiplier.Strict

import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/-!
# Actual strict continuity of the completed group multiplier

The original L1 translation limit controls the same-seminorm completion on
each actual core image. Proved density and the computed group isometry give
continuity on every completed vector. Original group composition shifts the
continuity from the identity; star exchange gives the right component.

The ordinary multiplier's explicit strict topology therefore makes the
computed group map strictly continuous. The actual algebraic multiplier
pair receives this proved continuity field, without a supplied continuity,
nondegeneracy or faithful embedding model.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped Topology MultiplierAlgebra

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

attribute [local instance] CStarSeminorm.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra

variable (p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α)) (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α)

include hp

/-- The original L1 translate distance controls every actual completed core orbit difference. -/
theorem dist_groupLeftCompletion_source_le (g : G) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    dist (groupLeftCompletion μ α p g (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f)) (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ≤
      l1Gauge μ α (groupLeft μ α g f - f) := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, groupLeftCompletion_apply, ← map_sub, CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion]
  exact hp _

/-- Each original completed core image has a continuous group orbit at the identity. -/
theorem groupLeftCompletion_source_continuousAt_one (f : Carrier μ α) :
    ContinuousAt (fun g : G => groupLeftCompletion μ α p g (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f)) 1 := by
  change Tendsto _ (𝓝 1) (𝓝 (groupLeftCompletion μ α p 1 (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f)))
  rw [groupLeftCompletion_apply, groupLeft_one, LinearMap.id_apply]
  apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr
  intro ε hε
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_l1Gauge_groupLeft_sub μ α f).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε)] with g hg
  exact (dist_groupLeftCompletion_source_le μ α p hp g f).trans_lt hg

/-- Proved core density and actual group isometry give continuity on every completed vector at one. -/
theorem groupLeftCompletion_continuousAt_one (x : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    ContinuousAt (fun g : G => groupLeftCompletion μ α p g x) 1 := by
  change Tendsto _ (𝓝 1) (𝓝 (groupLeftCompletion μ α p 1 x))
  rw [groupLeftCompletion_one, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]
  apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr
  intro ε hε
  have hthird : 0 < ε / 3 := div_pos hε (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨f, hApprox⟩ := p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion.exists_dist_lt x hthird
  have hCore : Tendsto (fun g : G => groupLeftCompletion μ α p g (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f))
      (𝓝 1) (𝓝 (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f)) := by
    have h := groupLeftCompletion_source_continuousAt_one μ α p hp f
    change Tendsto _ (𝓝 1) (𝓝 (groupLeftCompletion μ α p 1 (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f))) at h
    rw [groupLeftCompletion_apply, groupLeft_one, LinearMap.id_apply] at h
    exact h
  filter_upwards [Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hCore (ε / 3) hthird] with g hg
  have hDist : dist (groupLeftCompletion μ α p g x)
      (groupLeftCompletion μ α p g (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f)) =
        dist x (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) := by
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm, map_sub] using
      norm_groupLeftCompletion_apply μ α p g (x - p.toNonUnitalCompletion f)
  calc
    dist (groupLeftCompletion μ α p g x) x ≤
        dist (groupLeftCompletion μ α p g x)
          (groupLeftCompletion μ α p g (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f)) +
        dist (groupLeftCompletion μ α p g (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f)) x := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ dist x (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) +
        (dist (groupLeftCompletion μ α p g (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f))
          (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) + dist (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) x) := by
      rw [hDist]
      exact add_le_add le_rfl (dist_triangle _ _ _)
    _ < ε / 3 + (ε / 3 + ε / 3) :=
      add_lt_add hApprox (add_lt_add hg (by simpa only [dist_comm] using hApprox))
    _ = ε := by ring

/-- Original group composition gives continuity of every completed left orbit at every group point. -/
theorem continuous_groupLeftCompletion (x : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    Continuous (fun g : G => groupLeftCompletion μ α p g x) := by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro g₀
  have hAtOne : Tendsto (fun g : G => groupLeftCompletion μ α p g x) (𝓝 1) (𝓝 x) := by
    have h := groupLeftCompletion_continuousAt_one μ α p hp x
    change Tendsto _ (𝓝 1) (𝓝 (groupLeftCompletion μ α p 1 x)) at h
    rw [groupLeftCompletion_one, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply] at h
    exact h
  have hShift : Tendsto (fun g : G => g₀⁻¹ * g) (𝓝 g₀) (𝓝 1) := by
    have h := (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : G => g₀⁻¹)).mul
      (continuous_id : Continuous (id : G → G))
    have hfun : ((fun _ : G => g₀⁻¹) * (id : G → G)) = fun g : G => g₀⁻¹ * g := by
      funext g
      rw [Pi.mul_apply]
      rfl
    rw [hfun] at h
    simpa only [inv_mul_cancel] using h.tendsto g₀
  have hOrbit := ((groupLeftCompletion μ α p g₀).continuous.tendsto x).comp (hAtOne.comp hShift)
  have hfun : (fun g : G => groupLeftCompletion μ α p g₀
      (groupLeftCompletion μ α p (g₀⁻¹ * g) x)) = fun g : G => groupLeftCompletion μ α p g x := by
    funext g
    have h := congrArg (fun T : p.NonUnitalCompletion →L[ℂ] p.NonUnitalCompletion => T x)
      (groupLeftCompletion_mul μ α p g₀ (g₀⁻¹ * g)).symm
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, mul_inv_cancel_left] using h
  simp only [Function.comp_def] at hOrbit
  rw [hfun] at hOrbit
  exact hOrbit

/-- The computed right orbit is continuous by the actual inverse/star exchange. -/
theorem continuous_groupRightCompletion (x : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    Continuous (fun g : G => groupRightCompletion μ α p g x) := by
  have h := ((continuous_groupLeftCompletion μ α p hp (star x)).comp continuous_inv).star
  have hfun : (fun g : G => star (groupLeftCompletion μ α p g⁻¹ (star x))) =
      fun g : G => groupRightCompletion μ α p g x := by
    funext g
    simpa only [inv_inv, star_star] using star_groupLeftCompletion μ α p g⁻¹ (star x)
  simp only [Function.comp_def] at h
  rw [hfun] at h
  exact h

/-- The actual group multiplier is continuous for the existing explicit strict topology. -/
theorem strictContinuous_groupMultiplier :
    DoubleCentralizer.StrictContinuous (groupMultiplier μ α p) := by
  let _ : TopologicalSpace 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion) :=
    DoubleCentralizer.strictTopology p.NonUnitalCompletion
  change Continuous (groupMultiplier μ α p)
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro g
  change DoubleCentralizer.StrictTendsto (groupMultiplier μ α p) (𝓝 g) (groupMultiplier μ α p g)
  apply (DoubleCentralizer.strictTendsto_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro x
  exact ⟨(continuous_groupLeftCompletion μ α p hp x).tendsto g,
    (continuous_groupRightCompletion μ α p hp x).tendsto g⟩

/-- The same computed unitary-valued group map is strictly continuous after its ordinary inclusion. -/
theorem strictContinuous_groupUnitaryMultiplierHom :
    DoubleCentralizer.StrictContinuous (fun g : G =>
      (groupUnitaryMultiplierHom μ α p g : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion))) := by
  simpa only [groupUnitaryMultiplierHom_coe] using strictContinuous_groupMultiplier μ α p hp

/-- The actual coefficient/group pair with its internally proved original strict-continuity field. -/
def canonicalStrictMultiplierPair :
    { pair : (A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) ×
        (G →* unitary 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) //
      (∀ g : G, ∀ a : A,
        (pair.2 g : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) * pair.1 a *
          star (pair.2 g : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) = pair.1 (α g a)) ∧
      DoubleCentralizer.StrictContinuous (fun g : G => (pair.2 g : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion))) } :=
  ⟨(canonicalMultiplierPair μ α p).val,
    (canonicalMultiplierPair μ α p).property, strictContinuous_groupUnitaryMultiplierHom μ α p hp⟩

/-- Forgetting the new continuity proof preserves both original computed multiplier maps. -/
@[simp]
theorem canonicalStrictMultiplierPair_val :
    (canonicalStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).val = (canonicalMultiplierPair μ α p).val := rfl

/-- The actual strict pair carries the proved group strict-continuity value. -/
theorem canonicalStrictMultiplierPair_strictContinuous :
    DoubleCentralizer.StrictContinuous (fun g : G =>
      ((canonicalStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).val.2 g : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion))) :=
  (canonicalStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).property.2

/-- The actual strict pair retains the original full conjugation covariance. -/
theorem canonicalStrictMultiplierPair_covariance (g : G) (a : A) :
    ((canonicalStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).val.2 g : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) *
        (canonicalStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).val.1 a *
          star ((canonicalStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).val.2 g : 𝓜(ℂ, p.NonUnitalCompletion)) =
      (canonicalStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).val.1 (α g a) :=
  (canonicalStrictMultiplierPair μ α p hp).property.1 g a

end

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.Basic
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.LocallyIntegrable
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Prod
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Set

/-!
# The literal original Haar twisted convolution

The source functions retain their original compact supports and coefficient
values. Parameter continuity uses scalar factor one and the existing compact
bilinear integral statement. The source algebra is nonunital, including zero;
no coefficient identity or global countability assumption enters the kernel.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped CompactlySupported Topology Pointwise

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The original left-Haar twisted convolution integrand at parameter s and integration coordinate t. -/
def kernel (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : C_c(G, A)) (s t : G) : A :=
  f t * α t (g (t⁻¹ * s))

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] in
/-- The original source integrand is jointly continuous in its parameter and Haar coordinate. -/
theorem continuous_kernel (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : C_c(G, A)) :
    Continuous (Function.uncurry (kernel α f g)) := by
  exact ((map_continuous f).comp continuous_snd).mul
    (α.continuous_apply continuous_snd
      ((map_continuous g).comp (continuous_snd.inv.mul continuous_fst)))

omit [IsTopologicalGroup G] [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] in
/-- The original integrand is zero outside the original first compact support. -/
theorem kernel_zero_of_notMem_tsupport_left (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)
    (f g : C_c(G, A)) (s t : G) (ht : t ∉ tsupport f) : kernel α f g s t = 0 := by
  rw [kernel, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport ht, zero_mul]

variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The exact original kernel is integrable for every original source parameter. -/
theorem integrable_kernel (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : C_c(G, A)) (s : G) :
    Integrable (kernel α f g s) μ := by
  have hc : Continuous (kernel α f g s) :=
    (continuous_kernel α f g).comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  have hcomp : HasCompactSupport (kernel α f g s) :=
    HasCompactSupport.intro' f.hasCompactSupport (isClosed_tsupport f)
      (kernel_zero_of_notMem_tsupport_left α f g s)
  exact hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcomp

/-- The actual original convolution coefficient is its printed left-Haar integral. -/
def convolutionValue (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : C_c(G, A)) (s : G) : A :=
  letI : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  ∫ t : G, kernel α f g s t ∂μ

omit [IsTopologicalGroup G] [LocallyCompactSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
  [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Outside the product of original supports, every source convolution coefficient vanishes. -/
theorem convolutionValue_zero_of_notMem_product (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)
    (f g : C_c(G, A)) (s : G) (hs : s ∉ tsupport f * tsupport g) :
    convolutionValue μ α f g s = 0 := by
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun t => by
    change kernel α f g s t = 0
    by_cases ht : t ∈ tsupport f
    · have hg : t⁻¹ * s ∉ tsupport g := by
        intro hgt
        apply hs
        simpa only [mul_inv_cancel_left] using Set.mul_mem_mul ht hgt
      rw [kernel, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hg, α.apply_zero, mul_zero]
    · exact kernel_zero_of_notMem_tsupport_left α f g s t ht

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Scalar-one compact parameter integration makes the original convolution continuous. -/
theorem continuous_convolutionValue (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : C_c(G, A)) :
    Continuous (convolutionValue μ α f g) := by
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  let L : ℂ →L[ℂ] A →L[ℂ] A := ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℂ ℂ
  have hq : IntegrableOn (fun _ : G => (1 : ℂ)) (tsupport f) μ :=
    integrableOn_const f.hasCompactSupport.measure_ne_top
  have hc :=
    _root_.continuousOn_integral_bilinear_of_locally_integrable_of_compact_support
      L f.hasCompactSupport (continuous_kernel α f g).continuousOn
      (fun s t _ ht => kernel_zero_of_notMem_tsupport_left α f g s t ht) hq
      (s := Set.univ)
  have hfun : (fun s : G => ∫ t : G, L (1 : ℂ) (kernel α f g s t) ∂μ) =
      convolutionValue μ α f g := by
    funext s
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun t => by
      dsimp only [L]
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, one_smul]
  rw [hfun] at hc
  exact continuousOn_univ.mp hc

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [BorelSpace G] [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The convolution's actual topological support lies in the product of the original supports. -/
theorem tsupport_convolutionValue_subset (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : C_c(G, A)) :
    tsupport (convolutionValue μ α f g) ⊆ tsupport f * tsupport g := by
  apply closure_minimal
  · intro s hs
    by_contra hnot
    exact hs (convolutionValue_zero_of_notMem_product μ α f g s hnot)
  · exact (isClosed_tsupport g).mul_left_of_isCompact f.hasCompactSupport

/-- The literal original convolution as a compactly supported continuous coefficient function. -/
def ccConvolution (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : C_c(G, A)) : C_c(G, A) where
  toFun := convolutionValue μ α f g
  continuous_toFun := continuous_convolutionValue μ α f g
  hasCompactSupport' :=
    (f.hasCompactSupport.mul g.hasCompactSupport).of_isClosed_subset
      (isClosed_tsupport _) (tsupport_convolutionValue_subset μ α f g)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The C_c convolution retains every original coefficient integral. -/
theorem ccConvolution_apply (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : C_c(G, A)) (s : G) :
    ccConvolution μ α f g s =
      letI : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
      ∫ t : G, f t * α t (g (t⁻¹ * s)) ∂μ :=
  rfl

/-- The original Haar convolution on the same measure/action-indexed source function carrier. -/
def convolution (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : Carrier μ α) : Carrier μ α :=
  fromCc μ α (ccConvolution μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g))

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Every indexed convolution value is the literal printed original Haar coefficient. -/
theorem convolution_apply (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : Carrier μ α) (s : G) :
    convolution μ α f g s =
      letI : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
      ∫ t : G, f t * α t (g (t⁻¹ * s)) ∂μ :=
  rfl

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Zero on the left acts by the actual zero convolution. -/
theorem convolution_zero_left (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (g : Carrier μ α) :
    convolution μ α 0 g = 0 := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [convolution_apply]
  simp only [toCc_zero, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.zero_apply, zero_mul, integral_zero]

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Zero on the right acts by the actual zero convolution. -/
theorem convolution_zero_right (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    convolution μ α f 0 = 0 := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [convolution_apply]
  simp only [toCc_zero, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.zero_apply,
    α.apply_zero, mul_zero, integral_zero]

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Original convolution is additive in its first coefficient function. -/
theorem convolution_add_left (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g h : Carrier μ α) :
    convolution μ α (f + g) h = convolution μ α f h + convolution μ α g h := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [toCc_add, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply]
  rw [convolution_apply, convolution_apply, convolution_apply]
  have hk : (fun t : G => (f + g) t * α t (h (t⁻¹ * s))) =
      (fun t : G => f t * α t (h (t⁻¹ * s)) + g t * α t (h (t⁻¹ * s))) := by
    funext t
    rw [toCc_add, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply, add_mul]
  rw [hk]
  exact integral_add (integrable_kernel μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) s)
    (integrable_kernel μ α (toCc μ α g) (toCc μ α h) s)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Original convolution is additive in its second coefficient function. -/
theorem convolution_add_right (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g h : Carrier μ α) :
    convolution μ α f (g + h) = convolution μ α f g + convolution μ α f h := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [toCc_add, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply]
  rw [convolution_apply, convolution_apply, convolution_apply]
  have hk : (fun t : G => f t * α t ((g + h) (t⁻¹ * s))) =
      (fun t : G => f t * α t (g (t⁻¹ * s)) + f t * α t (h (t⁻¹ * s))) := by
    funext t
    rw [toCc_add, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply, α.apply_add, mul_add]
  rw [hk]
  exact integral_add (integrable_kernel μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g) s)
    (integrable_kernel μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) s)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Original convolution is complex linear in its first coefficient function. -/
theorem convolution_smul_left (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (c : ℂ) (f g : Carrier μ α) :
    convolution μ α (c • f) g = c • convolution μ α f g := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [toCc_smul, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply]
  rw [convolution_apply, convolution_apply]
  let L : A →L[ℂ] A := c • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ A
  have hL (z : A) : L z = c • z := rfl
  have hk : (fun t : G => (c • f) t * α t (g (t⁻¹ * s))) =
      (fun t : G => L (f t * α t (g (t⁻¹ * s)))) := by
    funext t
    rw [toCc_smul, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, hL]
    exact smul_mul_assoc _ _ _
  rw [hk]
  simpa only [hL, kernel] using
    L.integral_comp_comm (integrable_kernel μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g) s)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Original convolution is complex linear in its second coefficient function. -/
theorem convolution_smul_right (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (c : ℂ) (f g : Carrier μ α) :
    convolution μ α f (c • g) = c • convolution μ α f g := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [toCc_smul, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply]
  rw [convolution_apply, convolution_apply]
  let L : A →L[ℂ] A := c • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ A
  have hL (z : A) : L z = c • z := rfl
  have hk : (fun t : G => f t * α t ((c • g) (t⁻¹ * s))) =
      (fun t : G => L (f t * α t (g (t⁻¹ * s)))) := by
    funext t
    rw [toCc_smul, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, α.apply_smul, mul_smul_comm, hL]
  rw [hk]
  simpa only [hL, kernel] using
    L.integral_comp_comm (integrable_kernel μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g) s)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Original Haar convolution coefficients associate by compact Fubini and literal left translation. -/
theorem convolutionValue_assoc (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g h : C_c(G, A)) (s : G) :
    convolutionValue μ α (ccConvolution μ α f g) h s =
      convolutionValue μ α f (ccConvolution μ α g h) s := by
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  let K : G → G → A := fun t r => kernel α f g t r * α t (h (t⁻¹ * s))
  have hKcont : Continuous K.uncurry :=
    (continuous_kernel α f g).mul
      (α.continuous_apply continuous_fst
        ((map_continuous h).comp (continuous_fst.inv.mul_const s)))
  let Sfg : Set G := tsupport f * tsupport g
  have hSfgcompact : IsCompact Sfg := f.hasCompactSupport.mul g.hasCompactSupport
  have hSfgclosed : IsClosed Sfg :=
    (isClosed_tsupport g).mul_left_of_isCompact f.hasCompactSupport
  have hKzero (p : G × G) (hp : p ∉ Sfg ×ˢ tsupport f) : K p.1 p.2 = 0 := by
    by_cases hr : p.2 ∈ tsupport f
    · have ht : p.1 ∉ Sfg := fun ht => hp ⟨ht, hr⟩
      have hg : p.2⁻¹ * p.1 ∉ tsupport g := by
        intro hgp
        apply ht
        simpa only [mul_inv_cancel_left] using Set.mul_mem_mul hr hgp
      simp only [K, kernel, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hg, α.apply_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    · simp only [K, kernel_zero_of_notMem_tsupport_left α f g p.1 p.2 hr, zero_mul]
  have hKcompact : HasCompactSupport K.uncurry :=
    HasCompactSupport.intro' (hSfgcompact.prod f.hasCompactSupport)
      (hSfgclosed.prod (isClosed_tsupport f)) hKzero
  have hLeft : convolutionValue μ α (ccConvolution μ α f g) h s =
      ∫ t : G, (∫ r : G, K t r ∂μ) ∂μ := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun t => by
      let R : A →L[ℂ] A := (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).flip (α t (h (t⁻¹ * s)))
      have hR := R.integral_comp_comm (integrable_kernel μ α f g t)
      rw [kernel, ccConvolution_apply]
      simpa only [K, kernel, R,
        ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply'] using hR.symm
  have hSwap : (∫ t : G, (∫ r : G, K t r ∂μ) ∂μ) =
      ∫ r : G, (∫ t : G, K t r ∂μ) ∂μ :=
    MeasureTheory.integral_integral_swap_of_hasCompactSupport
      hKcont hKcompact
  have hRight : (∫ r : G, (∫ t : G, K t r ∂μ) ∂μ) =
      convolutionValue μ α f (ccConvolution μ α g h) s := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun r => by
      let a : A →L[ℂ] A :=
        ⟨LinearMap.ofClass (α.aut r), (StarAlgEquiv.isometry (α.aut r)).continuous⟩
      let L : A →L[ℂ] A := (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A (f r)).comp a
      have hL (z : A) : L z = f r * α r z := rfl
      have hPoint (u : G) : K (r * u) r = L (kernel α g h (r⁻¹ * s) u) := by
        calc
          K (r * u) r = (f r * α r (g u)) *
              α r (α u (h (u⁻¹ * (r⁻¹ * s)))) := by
            simp only [K, kernel, inv_mul_cancel_left, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc, α.apply_mul]
          _ = f r * (α r (g u) * α r (α u (h (u⁻¹ * (r⁻¹ * s))))) :=
            mul_assoc _ _ _
          _ = f r * α r (g u * α u (h (u⁻¹ * (r⁻¹ * s)))) :=
            congrArg (fun z : A => f r * z) (α.apply_mul_elem r _ _).symm
          _ = L (kernel α g h (r⁻¹ * s) u) := (hL _).symm
      calc
        (∫ t : G, K t r ∂μ) = ∫ u : G, K (r * u) r ∂μ :=
          (integral_mul_left_eq_self (μ := μ) (fun t : G => K t r) r).symm
        _ = ∫ u : G, L (kernel α g h (r⁻¹ * s) u) ∂μ :=
          integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall hPoint)
        _ = L (∫ u : G, kernel α g h (r⁻¹ * s) u ∂μ) :=
          L.integral_comp_comm (integrable_kernel μ α g h (r⁻¹ * s))
        _ = kernel α f (ccConvolution μ α g h) s r := by
          rw [hL]
          rfl
  exact hLeft.trans (hSwap.trans hRight)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The same original measure/action-indexed Haar convolution is associative. -/
theorem convolution_assoc (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g h : Carrier μ α) :
    convolution μ α (convolution μ α f g) h = convolution μ α f (convolution μ α g h) := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  change convolutionValue μ α
      (ccConvolution μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g)) (toCc μ α h) s =
    convolutionValue μ α (toCc μ α f)
      (ccConvolution μ α (toCc μ α g) (toCc μ α h)) s
